charts.name: Module Colors and Weighted Edges

charts.name: Single-Series Radar

charts.name: Multi-Series Radar with Per-Axis Normalization

charts.name: PCA vs t-SNE
charts.description: PCA (linear, preserves global variance) versus t-SNE (perplexity=30, seed=42): both recover the three cell types, but t-SNE's tight, well-separated blobs are an algorithmic artifact, not evidence of stronger separation.

charts.name: Perplexity Sweep
charts.description: Perplexity 5 fragments each type into artificial subclusters; 30 gives a balanced picture; 100 over-smooths the geometry into dense blobs whose spacing no longer reflects the data.

charts.name: PCA Pre-Reduction
charts.description: t-SNE on all 200 scaled features versus t-SNE on the top-50 PCs: pre-reduction denoises the input, cleaning up within-type structure without changing the three-cluster conclusion.

charts.name: Default View

charts.name: Rotation Panel

charts.name: Travel-Ratio Distributions with Significance Stars
charts.nameZh: 带显著性星号的 travel-ratio 分布
charts.description: Travel-ratio distributions for all active genes; the Welch test p value is annotated with stars.

charts.name: Signature-Correlation Modules
charts.description: Pairwise correlations of signature scores; rectangles mark the three co-varying modules.

charts.name: Clustering Samples into Immune Subtypes
charts.description: Samples clustered by signature scores (top annotation = subtype); six subtypes emerge from the three modules.

charts.name: Score Distributions per Subtype
charts.description: Distribution of three representative signature scores within the six subtypes (dashed line = overall median).

charts.name: De Novo Mutation-Signature Decomposition
charts.nameZh: 从头突变 signature 分解
charts.description: De novo signature decomposition of a simulated 96-channel catalogue: NMF-extracted signature profiles (top) and per-sample exposures (bottom).

charts.name: Split Violin + Raw Points (Two Groups)
charts.nameZh: 分半小提琴 + 原始点（两组）
charts.description: Split violin per group: half violin + box on the left half, raw points on the right half; Mann-Whitney p annotated.

charts.name: 3D PCA (Interactive + Static Projection)
charts.description: Static companion: PC1 × PC3 projection with 80% ellipses; the third dimension is colour-coded via PC2.

charts.name: Enriched Two-Group Scatter + Fisher r-to-z
charts.nameZh: 富集两组散点 + Fisher r-to-z
charts.description: Age vs DNAmAge in normal and tumour samples; size = |age - DNAmAge|, colour = group, each group's regression line; Fisher r-to-z compares the two correlations.

charts.name: Per-Cell Pathway Scores (GSVA Heatmap)
charts.nameZh: 逐细胞通路评分（GSVA 热图）
charts.description: Pathway scores per cell (columns) split by subpopulation; EC1 carries the angiogenesis/activation/hypoxia programs.

charts.name: Comparing a Pathway Between Clusters
charts.description: Angiogenesis scores per cell in EC1 vs EC2; the Wilcoxon p value is annotated.

charts.name: Samples Sorted by mRNAsi with Clinical Strips
charts.nameZh: 按 mRNAsi 排序的样本与临床色条
charts.description: Samples sorted by mRNAsi (top gradient row) with subgroup and metastasis strips; the dedifferentiated end enriches for Group 3/4 and M1.

charts.name: mRNAsi by Molecular Subgroup
charts.description: mRNAsi across medulloblastoma subgroups; the Kruskal-Wallis p value is annotated.

charts.name: Heatmap with Per-Gene Group-Comparison P Values
charts.nameZh: 带组间比较 P 值的表达热图
charts.description: z-scored expression of 12 genes across samples from three WHO-like grades (columns split by grade); the right strip encodes per-gene BH-adjusted Kruskal-Wallis P.

charts.name: Subtype-Specific Diagonal Heatmap
charts.description: Subtype-specific diagonal heatmap: top-10 one-vs-rest up genes per simulated subtype, z-scored, columns grouped by subtype; rows stay in subtype-block order.

charts.name: Mutation-Context Lego/Heatmap with Class Pie
charts.nameZh: 突变上下文乐高/热图与类别饼图
charts.description: Mutation context: 6 substitution classes x 16 flanking contexts as a colour-depth heatmap (left) and the six-class proportion pie (right).

charts.name: Run-Mean Smoothing (100-Gene Windows)
charts.nameZh: 滑动均值平滑（100 基因窗口）
charts.description: CNV heatmap: cells (rows, malignant on top) x chromosomal positions (columns, chromosome boundaries ticked); smoothed over 100-gene windows.

charts.name: Malignant vs Non-Malignant Separation by CNV Score
charts.nameZh: 依 CNV 评分区分恶性与非恶性
charts.description: Per-cell CNV score separates malignant from non-malignant cells; the Wilcoxon p value is annotated.

charts.name: Tumor Index Across Pathological Stages
charts.nameZh: 跨病理阶段的肿瘤指数
charts.description: Tumor index across four pathological stages of the simulated validation cohort; the model separates tumour from non-tumour and ranks intermediate stages in between.

charts.name: Reference Layout: One Panel per External Cohort
charts.nameZh: 参考版式：每个外部队列一个面板
charts.description: Reference-style multi-cohort layout: each external dataset gets its own TI panel (simulated).

charts.name: Multi-Group Bar Chart with Subgroup Gradient
charts.nameZh: 多组柱形图 + 亚组渐变色
charts.description: Multi-group bar chart with subgroup gradient fills, error bars (mean ± SE) and intra-group comparison brackets.

charts.name: ChIP/ATAC Signal Tracks + Gene Structure (ggplot2)
charts.nameZh: ChIP/ATAC 信号轨道 + 基因结构（ggplot2）
charts.description: Simulated ATAC-seq and ChIP-seq signal tracks around a gene body; the bottom panel shows the exon structure.

charts.name: Dual-Axis Bar + Line Chart
charts.description: Dual-axis chart: bars = number of immune-related lncRNAs (left), line = proportion of immune-related lncRNAs (right), per cancer type.

charts.name: Stratified KM Curves Across Clinical Subgroups
charts.nameZh: 跨临床亚组的分层 KM 曲线
charts.description: Stratified KM curves by clinical subgroup (age group and stage), with log-rank p values.

charts.name: Nine-Grid Quadrant Scatter with Labels
charts.nameZh: 九宫格象限散点图 + 标签
charts.description: Quadrant scatter: RNA-seq vs proteomics log2FC. Vertical and horizontal lines mark fold-change thresholds (±1). Named genes are labelled with ggrepel.

charts.name: Coloured Quadrant Regions
charts.description: Genes colour-coded by quadrant: concordant up (red), concordant down (blue), discordant (green), and non-significant (grey).

charts.name: CellPhoneDB-Style Ligand-Receptor Dot Plot
charts.nameZh: CellPhoneDB 风格配体-受体点图
charts.description: CellPhoneDB-style dot plot: rows = ligand-receptor pairs, columns = cell-type pairs; point size = permutation P, colour = scaled mean expression.

charts.name: RNA Velocity Arrows on PCA
charts.nameZh: PCA 上的 RNA 速率箭头
charts.description: RNA velocity arrows projected on PCA: arrows point from each cell towards its predicted future state. Longer arrows indicate higher transcriptional activity.

charts.name: Velocity Magnitude by Cell Type
charts.nameZh: 各细胞类型的速率量级
charts.description: Velocity magnitude (speed) by cell type; mature cells show the highest transcriptional activity.

charts.name: Bland-Altman with Slope Test (Constant Bias Assessment)
charts.nameZh: 带斜率检验的 Bland-Altman 图（恒定偏倚评估）
charts.description: Bland-Altman plot with linear regression of differences on averages. The slope test assesses proportional bias (H0: slope = 0).

charts.name: Scale-Free Topology Fit and Mean Connectivity
charts.nameZh: 无标度拓扑拟合指数与平均连接度
charts.description: Scale-free topology fit index (left) and mean connectivity (right) vs soft-thresholding power. The dashed line marks fit index = 0.8.

charts.name: Multi-Gene Correlation with FDR
charts.nameZh: 多基因相关性与 FDR 校正
charts.description: Correlation of simulated genes with a target gene; bars sorted by r, red = significant after BH correction.

charts.name: KM Curve with Risk Table
charts.nameZh: 带风险表的 KM 曲线
charts.description: KM curve with risk table showing number at risk at each time point, stratified by treatment group.

charts.name: Grouped Pie Charts
charts.description: Grouped pie charts showing the proportion of three cell types in High vs Low risk groups.

charts.name: Scatterpie on a 2D Embedding
charts.nameZh: 二维嵌入上的散点饼图
charts.description: Scatterpie: small pies showing cell-type proportions on a 2D embedding, one pie per sample group.

charts.name: Protein-Mutation Lollipop Plot
charts.description: Protein-mutation lollipop: TP53 hot-spots on the protein axis with domain boxes. Circle size encodes the number of samples carrying each site; stalks alternate above and below the axis to reduce crowding.

charts.name: Multi-Group KM with Confidence Ribbons
charts.nameZh: 多组 KM 曲线与置信区间带
charts.description: Three-arm KM comparison (high/medium/low expression) with log-rank P and 95% confidence ribbons; the risk table counts patients at risk per arm.

charts.name: Cross-Cohort AUC Screen
charts.description: Cross-cohort AUC screen. (A) each gene plotted by its AUC in cohort 1 vs cohort 2; blue = protein-detected, grey = not detected, red = the gene of interest; the dashed box marks the double-hit region. (B) mean AUC of the hit genes.

charts.name: Cluster-Correlation Heatmap
charts.description: Annotated heatmap of z-scored expression: samples ordered by consensus gene cluster (top annotation) and genes split into positively (A) vs negatively (B) cluster-correlated signatures (left annotation).

charts.name: Signature Score from the First Principal Component
charts.nameZh: 由第主成分构建 signature 得分
charts.description: Per-sample signature score PC1(A) - PC1(B): the first principal component of each gene signature is subtracted, giving a single axis that orders the three subtypes.

charts.name: Single-Cell Cluster-Mean Marker Heatmap
charts.nameZh: 单细胞簇均值标记热图
charts.description: Cluster-mean marker heatmap for scRNA-seq: per-gene z-scores clipped at +-2, marker-set row order kept, complete-linkage column clustering, left colour bar annotates cell types.

charts.name: Multi-Block Horizontal Heatmap Composition
charts.description: Publication panel from three row-aligned pheatmap blocks: response annotation bar, drug-by-gene expression matrix and a CMap score column with in-cell numbers (NA when missing).

charts.name: Mirrored Up/Down Enrichment Dot Plot
charts.description: Mirror dot plot of up/down enrichment: the down arm flips left of zero via negated counts, dot size encodes gene count, colour encodes log-scale FDR, arms scale independently.

charts.name: Three-Level KEGG Hierarchy Bar Panel
charts.nameZh: 三层 KEGG 层级条形面板
charts.description: Three-column KEGG class hierarchy panel: group-tinted level2/level1 labels (GSH green, GSL red), grey detected counts and group-coloured enriched counts on log axes.

charts.name: Cohort-Level Random-Effects Meta Forest
charts.nameZh: 队列级随机效应 meta 森林图
charts.description: Random-effects meta-analysis forest pooling published cohort HRs with 95% CIs by inverse variance: per-cohort rows, pooled diamond and I2/Q/tau2 heterogeneity prints.

charts.name: Gene Loadings Along PC1 Read the Expression Programme
charts.nameZh: PC1 载荷解读表达程序
charts.description: Left: four oocyte-like subtypes (C1-C4) on the PC1/PC2 plane. Right: PC1 loadings of the six marker genes - the folliculogenesis set on one side of zero, the meiosis/methylation set on the other.

charts.name: GiViTI Calibration Belt with Bootstrap Bands
charts.nameZh: GiViTI 校准带与 bootstrap 置信带
charts.description: GiViTI-style calibration belt: the observed-rate curve (binned, weighted, forward-selected polynomial) with nested one-sided 80% and 95% bootstrap bands against the ideal diagonal; the mean deviation carries a bootstrap p.

charts.name: Box-and-Density Stacked Pair
charts.nameZh: 箱线-密度上下叠放组合图
charts.description: Cisplatin AUC estimates for three response strata: density curves with rug marks on top, horizontal box plots below, both panels painted from one palette with the Kruskal-Wallis p slung along the seam.

charts.name: K-means Groups on the PCA Plane with Convex-Hull Borders
charts.nameZh: K-means 簇的 PCA 平面凸包边界图
charts.description: Four k-means groups on the PCA plane: per-cluster convex-hull polygons mark the empirical partition, repelled labels tag one representative sample each, variance shares printed on the axes.

charts.name: Mutation Landscape with Signature Contribution Track
charts.nameZh: 带签名贡献轨道的突变景观图
charts.description: Two blocks stacked on one sample axis: the oncoprint (top TMB bars, bottom iCS colour strip) over a three-row APOBEC/AFR2/OTHER signature-contribution heatmap, samples sorted by subtype then signature share.

charts.name: Multi-Biomarker ROC Panel with AUC Confidence Bands
charts.nameZh: 多标志物 ROC 面板与 AUC 置信区间
charts.description: Smoothed ROC curves of four candidate biomarkers against the chance diagonal; the legend prints AUC with its bootstrap 95% CI - M4 separates the cohorts, M1 does not.

charts.name: Pan-Cancer NES Bubble Grid Across Tumour Types
charts.nameZh: 泛癌 NES 泡点矩阵
charts.description: Pan-cancer NES bubble grid: tumour types across the base, pathways up the side; colour = normalized enrichment score, size = -log10(FDR); the built-in proliferation/metabolism pattern reads as designed.

charts.name: Split-Facet Violin Matrix with Adjusted p Annotations
charts.nameZh: 分面小提琴矩阵与校正 p 标注
charts.description: Marker x cell-type facet matrix of split violins: young vs. old in every facet, Bonferroni-adjusted Mann-Whitney p with stars printed only where the shift is real (DDX4 in oocytes, p.adj < 1e-4).

charts.name: miRNA-Target Link Panel with Pathway Rings
charts.nameZh: 带通路圆环的 miRNA-靶基因连线面板
charts.description: miRNA-target link panel: eight miRNAs on the left rail, five pathway rings packed with 120 target nodes; link and node colour encode the high/low class, the ring number counts members.

charts.name: Three-Layer Alluvium: Gene to Mutation Class to Subtype
charts.nameZh: 三层桑基图：基因到突变类别到亚型
charts.description: Three-layer alluvium of a simulated cohort: gene, mutation class and subtype as strata; block heights are counts, the flows make the gene-to-subtype crossings visible.

charts.name: Pan-Cancer m6A-Regulator log2FC Heatmap
charts.nameZh: 泛癌 m6A 调控因子 log2FC 热图
charts.description: Pan-cancer m6A panel: tumour-vs-normal log2FC of 18 readers/writers/erasers over 10 TCGA cohorts; ward.D keeps each functional class in one block, the left strip annotates it.

charts.name: Differential Communication Bars and Diff Circle
charts.nameZh: 差异通讯蝴蝶条图与差值圆图
charts.description: STIM-vs-CTRL differential communication: top sender|receiver pairs ranked by the count difference (red = up in STIM), the same diff matrix also drawn as a circle pulled open to only the changed links.

charts.name: Multi-Gene Single-Pathway Pan-Cancer NES Grid
charts.nameZh: 多基因单通路泛癌 NES 矩阵
charts.description: The NES grid transposed: one hallmark pathway down a ferroptosis gene panel over ten tumour types; colour = NES, size = -log10(FDR), the planted first-half-up pattern reads as designed.

charts.name: Mutation-Report t-SNE: Highlight and Feature Strip
charts.nameZh: 突变报告 t-SNE：高亮图与特征条
charts.description: Publication-style t-SNE panel: the 100 mutated cells pop out yellow on a greyed population, while the mutation's report gene and two lineage markers are painted as feature panels on the shared embedding.

charts.name: Venn Diagram With Multiset-Intersection p Value
charts.nameZh: 带多重集交集 p 值的韦恩图
charts.description: Three PDX-model pathway sets with the exact multiset-intersection test printed beneath: the planted 52-member core makes the triple overlap astronomically richer than independent sampling allows (P < 1e-30).

charts.name: Differential Communication Circle Network
charts.description: The same STIM-minus-CTRL diff matrix as a circular network: node ring width scales with total communication, curved links show only the changed pairs (red up in STIM, blue up in CTRL).

charts.name: Protein Architecture with Mutation Density and Domain-Aware Lollipops
charts.nameZh: 蛋白结构域架构、突变密度与结构域感知的棒棒糖图
charts.description: Domain-aware mutation lollipop for a 1800-aa protein: top, Pfam-style domain architecture (signal peptide, domains A-E, low-complexity region) with the Gaussian-kernel mutation density (sd = 22 aa) above it; bottom, one lollipop per variant, coloured by variant class, sized by patient count, labelled by class and cancer type. The PRAD hotspot at residue 1044 (n = 62) is the peak of the density track.

charts.name: Pairwise Alignment with Identity String and Conservation Track
charts.nameZh: 成对比对、一致性串与保守性轨
charts.type: BLAST Pairwise Alignment and Read Pileup Plot
charts.description: BLAST+ style pairwise alignment: query (top), subject (bottom), match/mismatch/gap string, and per-window identity.

charts.name: Read Pileup, Base Colours and Coverage Track
charts.nameZh: 碱基着色的读段堆叠与覆盖度轨
charts.type: BLAST Pairwise Alignment and Read Pileup Plot
charts.description: Read pileup over 420 bp (GRCh38 chr1:12,000-12,419): base colours, SNP markers, a 5 bp deletion junction, a 3 bp insertion, and read-depth coverage.

charts.name: Zoomed Deletion Junction with Base Letters
charts.nameZh: 缺失连接点放大视图（含碱基字母）
charts.type: BLAST Pairwise Alignment and Read Pileup Plot
charts.description: Zoom on the 5 bp deletion: reference row, base letters per read, and open brackets on the three deletion-carrying reads.

charts.name: Four-Channel Trace with Called Bases
charts.nameZh: 四通道峰图与识别碱基
charts.description: Sanger trace: four fluorescent channels, called bases, and the C/T heterozygote at position 61.

charts.name: Heterozygous Peak Decomposition
charts.description: Local decomposition of the C/T site: overlapping C and T peaks at half height, with the surrounding homozygous peaks for scale.

charts.name: Anchored Ideogram, Signal Track and Marker Rug
charts.nameZh: 锚定核型、信号轨道与标记刻度
charts.description: Anchored ideogram with cumulative coordinates: five chromosomes laid end to end (4 Mb gaps), band shading and centromere pinches on top, per-window Fst below with two planted selective-sweep peaks (chr2:62 Mb, chr4:20 Mb) and the 0.25 outlier threshold, and a marker rug (tRNA/rRNA/miRNA/QTL) on the top axis.

charts.name: Alignment Dot Plot with Orientation Classes
charts.nameZh: 带方向分类的比对点阵图
charts.description: Whole-genome alignment dot plot: 46 collinear blocks along the diagonal (blue), seven inverted blocks (red), and one query block aligned to four target loci (purple)

charts.name: Gene-Level Synteny Ribbon
charts.description: Gene-level synteny between two haplotypes: grey ribbons are collinear, orange ribbons cross because g07-g08 is inverted in H2, and purple ribbons mark the translocated g03-g04 block

charts.name: Windowed Identity Heatmap
charts.description: Windowed identity heatmap (100 kb windows): the dark diagonal is the collinear alignment, two off-diagonal blocks are direct repeats, and the short anti-diagonal stripe is an inverted repeat

charts.name: Fusion Transcript Models with the Breakpoint
charts.nameZh: 带断点的融合转录本模型
charts.type: Gene Fusion Transcript and Breakpoint Plot
charts.description: Fusion transcript models on chr2: EML4 exons 1-13 (retained, protein-coding) joined to ALK exons 20-29 (retained), with the breakpoint marked between them. The dashed vertical line is the junction; both partners are drawn 5' to 3' so retained exons are those left of (EML4) and right of (ALK) the line.

charts.name: Junction Read Evidence
charts.type: Gene Fusion Transcript and Breakpoint Plot
charts.description: Junction evidence in junction-centred coordinates: 4 split reads cross the breakpoint (one half on each partner), 8 spanning reads stop at it; orange dots mark reads with MAPQ <= 42, the pattern a repeat-mediated artefact would also produce.

charts.name: Protein Domain Consequence
charts.type: Gene Fusion Transcript and Breakpoint Plot
charts.description: Protein-level consequence: the fusion protein is divided at the exon-13/20 junction; EML4 WD40 repeats are retained on the N-terminal side, the ALK kinase domain is retained on the C-terminal side, and the ALK MAM and transmembrane domains are lost. Filled = present in the fusion, open = discarded.

charts.name: 1 Coverage in Transcript Coordinates, Not Genomic Coordinates
charts.nameZh: 1 转录本坐标下的覆盖度，而非基因组坐标
charts.description: Coverage of one gene in three isoforms, each in its own transcript coordinate (exons concatenated with a 30 bp gap). T1 includes all eight exons, T2 skips exons 3 and 6, and T3 skips exons 2 and 5; the coverage ribbon is scaled within each row. The same exon has a different x coordinate in every row, which is the point: in genomic coordinates the three profiles would be superimposed on exons they do not share.

charts.name: 2 Gene Neighbourhood: Order and Orientation as the Axis
charts.nameZh: 2 基因邻域：把顺序与方向当作坐标轴
charts.description: Gene neighbourhood of six orthologues across five species: x is gene order (1 kb per slot), arrow direction is strand, and colour is orthologue group. sp3 has lost g5 and carries g2 inverted between g3 and g4; sp4 carries g4 inverted; sp5 has lost g6. On a base-pair axis these three events would require three separate zoomed panels to see.

charts.name: Genetic Map with Recombination Rate Profile
charts.nameZh: 遗传图谱与重组率剖面
charts.type: Genetic Map with Marker Order and Recombination Rate
charts.description: Linkage-group map for Species A: markers placed on a centimorgan axis (left) beside the local recombination rate derived from the same map by finite differences (right, square-root scale). The hotspot cluster at 80-90 Mb carries most of the genetic length inside a tenth of the physical span.

charts.name: Comparative Genetic Maps Aligned by Marker Name
charts.nameZh: 按标记名对齐的比较遗传图谱
charts.type: Genetic Map with Marker Order and Recombination Rate
charts.description: Comparative genetic maps: Species A and Species B linkage groups on their own centimorgan axes, with 24 orthologous markers connected; the linking lines fan out where the two recombination landscapes differ, showing that conservation of marker order does not imply conservation of genetic distance.

charts.name: Assembly Graph with Segment Length as Node Width
charts.nameZh: 以片段长度为节点宽度的组装图
charts.description: Assembly graph of a 1.5 kb locus with two bubbles: node width encodes segment length, shared segments are grey, and the reference and alternate alleles of each bubble are blue and red.

charts.name: Sequence-Tube-Map Bubble
charts.nameZh: Sequence tube map 分支视图
charts.description: Sequence-tube-map view: haplotype pipes diverge into allele-specific lanes across a SNP plus 150 bp insertion (H2) and a deletion (H3), then re-join on the shared flank.

charts.name: 1D Path Layout
charts.description: Path-guided 1D layout: each row is a haplotype, each node is drawn at its reference-ordered position, and allele boxes are coloured by variant class.

charts.name: Runs of Homozygosity Along the Chromosomes
charts.description: Runs of homozygosity in 12 samples across five chromosomes laid end to end: each bar is a maximal run of 20 or more consecutive homozygous SNPs, coloured by run length. S02 and S08 carry long runs on every chromosome (consanguinity or a strongly inbred line), S05 carries a single long run restricted to chr3 that no other sample shows (a candidate somatic deletion), and S11 carries a patchy set of intermediate runs on chr1-chr2 only. Eight samples carry no run at all. Note that S02, S05 and S08 look nearly identical at this scale: ROH cannot separate inbreeding from a germline deletion on its own.

charts.name: D′ and r² Triangles, Same SNP Order
charts.nameZh: 同序排列的 D′ 与 r² 三角图
charts.description: Linkage disequilibrium triangle for 30 HLA-DRB1 SNPs: left, D' (recombination history); right, r^2 (statistical redundancy), on identical SNP order and identical colour limits so the two statistics can be compared cell by cell.

charts.name: LD Blocks with the Gene Track and Population Facets
charts.nameZh: LD 块、基因轨与群体分面
charts.description: LD blocks faceted by population with the HLA-DRB1 gene model on a shared axis: the European panel shows two long blocks and the African panel three shorter ones, which is the expected decay of LD — the block boundaries, not the colour, carry the message.

charts.name: Ancestry Painting Along the Chromosomes
charts.description: Ancestry painting for 12 admixed individuals across four chromosomes: each row is one individual, each colour a source population (AFR, EUR, NAT; archaic in red). Tract lengths are the signal — a long block is a segment inherited intact — and the archaic haplotype is the single red block at chr2:60-85 Mb in the five carriers. The facet widths are proportional to chromosome length, so blocks are comparable within a chromosome and not across them.

charts.name: Ancestry Proportion Along One Chromosome
charts.nameZh: 单条染色体上的祖源比例
charts.description: Mean ancestry proportion across the 12 individuals along chr2 in 1 Mb windows, stacked to 1. The archaic haplotype at 60-85 Mb raises the red component to about 0.4, the fraction of the sampled individuals that carry it, rather than to 1. The step boundaries are the same ones visible in the painting above.

charts.name: Coancestry Matrix From the Same Tracts
charts.nameZh: 由同一批片段计算的共祖矩阵
charts.description: Pairwise coancestry among the 12 individuals, computed as the fraction of 1 Mb bins with the same ancestry label and clustered by 1 - similarity. Three high-similarity blocks recover the AFR, EUR and NAT groups without using the group labels, and the archaic carriers raise sharing between groups; the diagonal is grey because self-similarity is 1 by construction.

charts.name: Regional Association Panel (LocusZoom Style)
charts.nameZh: 区域关联面板（LocusZoom 风格）
charts.description: Regional association panel around a sentinel variant (chr1:412.6 Mb, 1.2 Mb window): -log10 P coloured by r2 to the sentinel (diamond), gene models below and local recombination rate (cM/Mb) at the bottom. The second, weaker signal at +0.33 Mb falls outside the sentinel's LD block, so it is an independent signal rather than a shadow of the lead SNP.

charts.name: Per-Read Methylation Matrix Above Its Coverage Track
charts.nameZh: 逐读段甲基化矩阵与下方覆盖度轨道
charts.description: Per-read methylation matrix for 60 CpG sites and 24 reads, split into two haplotypes with a differentially methylated region at sites 20-34 (dashed). Filled cells are methylation (blue 0, red 1); grey cells are sites with no call. Below: coverage per site, with the 10x filter drawn and the 5 sites that fail it in grey; bottom: the four-exon gene model on the same axis. The DMR is invisible in either marginal summary but obvious in the matrix.

charts.name: Sorted Methylation Ladder With Coverage-Scaled Points
charts.nameZh: 按甲基化排序的阶梯图与覆盖度定尺寸的点
charts.description: Sorted methylation ladder for the haplotype-1 reads: sites ordered by mean methylation, with a binomial 95% interval, point size proportional to read count, and sites below 5x drawn grey. The 3 sites that fail the coverage floor are kept in the plot so the discarded fraction is visible; the interval widens exactly where the point is small.

charts.name: Nanopore Current Signal: Where the Modification Actually Lives
charts.nameZh: 纳米孔电流信号：修饰究竟发生在哪里
charts.description: Raw nanopore current for six reads over a 90-sample window: three reads carry a 6mA at sample 46 (orange) and three do not (blue). Thin lines are individual reads, thick lines the group means; the shaded band marks the modified k-mer. The only systematic difference between the groups is an 11 pA rise at that position.

charts.name: RNA Structure Logo: A Logo With Base-Pair Arcs
charts.nameZh: RNA 结构 logo：带碱基配对弧的序列 logo
charts.description: RNA structure logo for a 24-nt stem-loop: information content per column on top (bits), sequence letters scaled by information below it, and base-pair arcs joining the paired columns. The five-pair stem (columns 4-8 with 17-21) is drawn solid; the single pair with weak covariation support (columns 10 and 15) is drawn dashed, because a pairing seen in one sequence is not evidence of conserved structure.

charts.name: Stacked Homology Ribbons Between Adjacent Genomes
charts.nameZh: 相邻基因组之间的堆叠同源带
charts.description: Stacked multi-genome comparison of five assemblies sharing seven homologous blocks: each track is one genome, block width encodes block length on a shared Mb axis, and ribbons join the same block in adjacent genomes. G2 is collinear except for transposed E/D, G3 has lost E (the gap in its ribbon fan), and G4 carries an inverted B-C (the crossing orange ribbons, with a white tick marking reverse-strand blocks); G5 keeps the reference order but is 15% shorter, which the absolute axis shows as a shorter track.

charts.name: Concentric Rings With Chords
charts.description: BRIG-style concentric rings: five genomes share one 12 o'clock origin and run clockwise over the same 360 degrees, so a block boundary lines up radially and the loss of E in G3 appears as a hole in that one ring. Chords connect blocks between the outer ring (G1) and G4; the two inverted blocks (B, C) are drawn orange and cross their partners, which is the only way a circular layout can show orientation.

charts.name: Absolute Versus Normalised Coordinates
charts.nameZh: 绝对坐标与归一化坐标
charts.description: The same G1/G4 comparison on an absolute axis (top) and a percent-of-genome axis (bottom). G4 is 10% longer, so its absolute track runs to 5.83 Mb while G1 ends at 5.30 Mb; on the normalised axis both tracks end at 100% and the 10% length difference disappears. The normalised panel is right for comparing block order and wrong for comparing block length.

charts.name: Conservation Shading with a Secondary-Structure Strip (ESPript style)
charts.nameZh: 二级结构标注 + 守恒着色（ESPript 风格）
charts.description: ESPript-style conservation shading on a 60-column protein alignment: residues are shaded black when the column is fully conserved, blue-grey when all residues share the same physicochemical class (Boxshade rules), and left unshaded otherwise; the strip above the alignment marks alpha-helices and beta-strands so conserved columns can be read against secondary structure.

charts.name: Tree, Mutation Matrix and Gene Track on One Row Axis
charts.nameZh: 树、突变矩阵与基因轨道共享同一行轴
charts.description: Average-linkage tree of 14 pathogen genomes aligned to a mutation matrix and a six-gene model: each row is one tip, each mark is a variant carried by that genome, coloured by the clade the variant defines, and the top strip gives the variant class. The tree and the matrix share one leaf-order vector, so rows cannot drift apart; the six blue blocks are the gene bodies.

charts.name: Circular Tree With Metadata Rings
charts.description: The same tree in polar coordinates: radial lines are branches, arcs are the connectors, and the tip order is unchanged. Two outer tracks add metadata — region as an inner colour arc and collection year as outer points on a continuous colour scale — plus clade-coloured tip dots. The rings are legible only because they use the same tip positions as the tree.

charts.name: Variant Density by Clade Along the Genome
charts.nameZh: 各分支沿基因组的变异密度
charts.description: ALT alleles per 250 bp bin along the genome, one line per clade (A, B, C). Clade-specific peaks are visible where a lineage accumulates variants, and the shaded gene bodies give the annotation frame. The counts are raw, not normalised by clade size, so the relative height of two lines reflects both the number of genomes and the number of variants.

charts.name: Circular Map with Feature Arrows and Restriction Ring
charts.nameZh: 带特征箭头与酶切环的环状图谱
charts.description: Circular map of a 5,240 bp EGFP expression plasmid: strand-aware feature arrows on the inner track, a scale ring in kb, and unique restriction sites on the outer ring. AmpR and LacZ-alpha point counter-clockwise because they are on the reverse strand.

charts.name: Linear Cloning Map with the Insert and Primers
charts.nameZh: 含插入片段与引物的线性克隆图谱
charts.description: Linear map of the same plasmid coloured by construct segment (backbone / insert), with the cloning sites used to build it and both sequencing primers drawn as arrows; the insert spans 2,050-4,200 bp and the junctions sit inside the MCS.

charts.name: Domain Architecture Across Paralogs
charts.nameZh: 旁系同源蛋白的结构域架构
charts.type: Protein Domain and Sequence Feature Plot
charts.description: Domain architecture of three paralogs on a shared amino-acid axis: arrows point N to C, colours mark domain families, labels give names and residue ranges.

charts.name: Domain Track plus Variant and PTM Lollipops
charts.nameZh: 结构域轨与变异/PTM 棒棒糖轨
charts.type: Protein Domain and Sequence Feature Plot
charts.description: SIM4 domain track above a variant/PTM lollipop track on one shared amino-acid axis; stem height is supporting reads or PTM score, colour is the event class.

charts.name: Genome-to-Protein Mapping of Exons and Domains
charts.nameZh: 外显子与结构域的基因组—蛋白映射
charts.type: Protein Domain and Sequence Feature Plot
charts.description: Genome-to-protein map: eight coding exons on the kilobase axis connected to the domain track on the amino-acid axis; domain boundaries can be traced back to exon boundaries.

charts.name: k-mer Self-Similarity: The Higher-Order Repeat Map
charts.nameZh: k-mer 自相似性：高阶重复图谱
charts.description: k-mer Jaccard self-similarity for a 200 kb tandem array in 1 kb bins: the diagonal is the array itself, and dark red blocks are bins sharing the same repeat unit type. The two blue squares mark a 60 kb block that occurs twice, 100 kb apart; that off-diagonal square is the higher-order repeat. Different unit types share almost no 9-mers (mean Jaccard 0.002), while same-type bins score about 0.97.

charts.name: STR Read Pileup: Allele Length as a Distribution
charts.nameZh: STR 读段堆叠：等位基因长度是一个分布
charts.description: Read pileup across a CAG short tandem repeat: 26 reads from two alleles, each drawn from zero to its own repeat count. Allele 1 centres on 12 units and allele 2 on 45, but stutter spreads each cluster over several units, so the genotype is two modes rather than two exact lengths. Dashed lines mark the two modal sizes.

charts.name: Motif Composition: Length Is Not the Genotype
charts.nameZh: Motif 组成：长度不等于基因型
charts.description: Motif decomposition of the two alleles: each tile is one repeat unit, coloured by sequence. Allele 1 carries a single CAA interruption at position 10; allele 2 carries a CCG at position 41 and a CAA at 45. The repeat count alone cannot distinguish these alleles from a length-matched allele with a different interruption pattern.

charts.name: Strand-Split Sashimi Plot
charts.nameZh: 按链拆分的 Sashimi 图
charts.description: Strand-split Sashimi plot of a four-exon locus: per-sample coverage tracks, junction arcs scaled to supporting reads, up-strand solid and down-strand dashed below the baseline.

charts.name: PSI Panel: A Ratio, Not a Count
charts.nameZh: PSI 面板：比率而非计数
charts.description: Percent-spliced-in of exon E3 per replicate (bars) with the group mean (diamond): PSI is a bounded ratio, unlike the read counts in the Sashimi panel.

charts.name: Isoform Models the Junctions Support
charts.nameZh: 弧线所支持的转录本模型
charts.description: Transcript models for the inclusion and skipping isoforms; dashed connectors mark the two junctions quantified in the Sashimi panel.

charts.name: Depth Ratio and B-Allele Frequency: The Two-Panel Call
charts.nameZh: 深度比与 B 等位频率：双面板判定
charts.description: Paired depth-ratio and B-allele-frequency panels for three clones of one tumour (chr1, 1 Mb bins): clone A is diploid (log2 depth ratio 0, copy number 2, BAF at 0.5), clone B carries a 3-copy gain from 20-55 Mb (BAF bands at 1/3 and 2/3, dashed expectations), and clone C a single-copy loss from 20-90 Mb (BAF pushed to 0 and 1). Segments are drawn as red lines; the dashed blue lines are the expected BAF values, not a fit.

charts.name: Chromosome Arcs by SV Type
charts.nameZh: 按 SV 类型绘制的染色体弧
charts.description: Structural variant arc plot on three chromosomes (GRCh38, Mb): six variants drawn as arcs between their breakends. Arcs are coloured by SV type, inverted variants are drawn dashed, and the two inter-chromosomal rearrangements cross the gap between chromosome tracks.

charts.name: Evidence and Carrier Structure
charts.description: Variant evidence and carrier structure: left, split-read and discordant-pair support per variant (variants sorted by total support); right, the 12-sample carrier matrix in the arc-panel order. The fold-back inversion (SV06) has the weakest read support, which is expected for a repeat-rich locus.

charts.name: Direction-Coded Ribbons
charts.description: Direction-coded synteny ribbon between two genetic maps: b04 and b08 are inverted (orange, crossing ribbons, '<' blocks) and b06-b07 are translocated (purple, swapped order); grey ribbons are syntenic

charts.name: Three Static Layouts from One Block Table
charts.nameZh: 同一区块表的三种静态版式
charts.description: Three static layouts from one block table: (A) linear ribbons between two maps, (B) Evolution Highway rows of four species along a common reference chromosome, and (C) chromosome painting of three target chromosomes by reference chromosome of origin

charts.name: Nucleotide Frequency and VAF Along the Locus
charts.nameZh: 沿位点的核苷酸频率与 VAF
charts.description: Nucleotide frequency and VAF along GRCh38 chr17 (TP53 locus): stacked base composition per site for three tumours and one normal; variant labels give the alt allele fraction.

charts.name: Read-Backed Haplotype Phasing
charts.description: Read-backed haplotype phasing across three phase blocks on GRCh38 chr17; one grey read carries a switch and remains unphased.

charts.name: Consequence Matrix and Cohort Density
charts.nameZh: 功能后果矩阵与队列密度
charts.description: Variant consequence per gene and sample (colour = effect, size = VAF) with cohort variant density along GRCh38 chromosomes.

charts.name: Mauve-Style Linked Backbones
charts.description: Mauve-style whole-genome alignment of three genomes: homologous blocks drawn to scale on each backbone and connected by ribbons between consecutive genomes (G1-G2, G2-G3). G2 carries a transposition (E before D), an inversion (hollow triangle on block G) and a swap (H before G); G3 has lost blocks B and G and gained the foreign block X.

charts.name: Block-Order Matrix
charts.description: Block-order matrix for the three genomes: x is the rank of the block within its genome, fill is block identity, and a hollow triangle marks the inverted block. The transposition (E before D), the swap (H before G) and the two deletions in G3 are readable without any coordinate axis; the foreign block X occupies a rank but has no counterpart.

charts.name: Dot Plot with Orientation
charts.description: Dot plot of G1 against G2 at block resolution: each block is one point at its midpoint, coloured by its orientation in G2. Forward blocks lie on the dotted diagonal, the transposition (D, E) shifts two points off it symmetrically, and the inverted block G appears as the only red point, mirrored across the diagonal.

charts.name: Where the Pixel Overview Helps, and Where It Stops
charts.nameZh: 像素级概览能做什么、不能做什么
charts.description: Pixel-level genome overview under the backbone panel (SequenceSurveyor / DNASkittle idea): one column per 10 kb, coloured by GC content, with a GC-rich domain planted at 4.2-5.4 Mb. The strip shows compositional structure at a glance but carries no homology information, which is why it is stacked under an alignment panel rather than replacing it.

charts.name: Genome Map with Gene and Composition Tracks
charts.nameZh: 基因与组成轨道的基因组图
charts.description: Genome map of a 50 kb contig with strand-specific genes, GC content, and GC skew

charts.name: Synteny Rings Across Three Genomes
charts.nameZh: 三个基因组的共线性环图
charts.description: Three-genome synteny rings; block D is inverted in G2 (D*) and block E is absent from G3

charts.name: Three-Ring Genome Comparison with Oriented Ribbons
charts.nameZh: 三环基因组比较与带方向
charts.description: Multi-genome comparison Circos: three E. coli assemblies, ten syntenic blocks, ribbons coloured by target genome; the 2.6 Mb inversion in ST131 makes its ribbons cross, and the blocks absent from O157:H7 / ST131 are marked on their own rings.

charts.name: Conserved-Block Matrix Beside the Circle
charts.nameZh: 与环形图配套的保守块矩阵
charts.description: Presence matrix for the same ten syntenic blocks: filled = conserved forward, filled with a white arrow = conserved inverted, dashed empty = absent. Blocks B8-B9 (O157:H7) and B2 (ST131) read as holes in the otherwise shared backbone.

charts.name: Four-Track Browser View on One Coordinate Axis
charts.nameZh: 共享单一坐标轴的四轨道浏览器视图
charts.description: Four-track genome browser view of a 12 kb window on chr17 (GRCh38): ATAC-seq coverage, H3K27ac signal, called ATAC peaks, and the gene model. All four tracks share one coordinate axis; the promoter peak carries an eQTL at 41% variant allele fraction, and the weaker enhancer peak is marked as a candidate regulatory element.

charts.name: Stacked Signal Summary Across Conditions
charts.nameZh: 跨条件的堆叠信号汇总
charts.description: ATAC-seq in two conditions on the same window: wild-type and a knockdown, with the wild-type minus knockdown difference track below. The enhancer peak at 8.2 kb loses almost all accessibility while the promoter peak is unchanged, which the difference track makes explicit.

charts.name: Pangenome Frequency Curve
charts.description: Pangenome frequency curve for 900 orthologous clusters across 20 S. pneumoniae genomes: unique (present in one genome), accessory (2-19) and core (20) fractions, annotated with counts; the shape is the same axes used by anvi-summarize's pangenome view.

charts.name: Accessory-Genome Presence Matrix, Ordered by Phylogeny
charts.nameZh: 按系统发育排序的附属基因组存在矩阵
charts.description: Presence matrix of 20 genomes x 900 orthologous clusters; rows are genomes ordered by hierarchical clustering of presence/absence alone, columns are clusters sorted by prevalence. Blue = cluster present; clade-specific accessory blocks appear as horizontal stripes, and the 180 core clusters form the solid right-hand block.

charts.name: Core-Size Accumulation Curve
charts.description: Core- and pan-genome accumulation over 20 genomes: the core declines toward its asymptotic size while the pan-genome keeps growing, shown as a single panel with two y scales replaced by magnitude-normalised curves.

charts.name: Advanced: normalisation, TAD boundaries and the rotated view
charts.nameZh: 进阶：归一化、TAD 边界与旋转视图
charts.description: Observed/expected Hi-C contact map (100 Mb at 500 kb resolution, simulated with five TADs and s^-1 distance decay): left, the lower triangle of the log2 obs/exp matrix with the four TAD boundaries drawn as white dashed rules; right, the same matrix rotated 45 degrees so genomic midpoint runs along x and separation along y, which makes each TAD a symmetric triangle and each boundary a vertical edge.

charts.name: Pan-Cancer Boxplot with Per-Tissue Significance (FigureYa55plus)
charts.nameZh: 泛癌箱线图 + 逐组织显著性（FigureYa55plus）
charts.description: Pan-cancer boxplot of the simulated TP53-like matrix: jittered points over tumour/normal boxes per tissue; stars above each tissue are per-tissue Wilcoxon tests.

charts.name: Div-Low vs Div-High
charts.description: Diversity score of 16 simulated tumour samples split at the median (Div-Low / Div-High): coloured points are samples, dashes and error bars are group means ± SEM, and the Wilcoxon P-value is annotated on top.

charts.name: ECDF with Wilcoxon Rank-Sum P-Values
charts.nameZh: 带 Wilcoxon 秩和检验 p 值的 ECDF
charts.description: Three simulated log2 fold-change distributions (n = 100 each): ECDFs annotated with two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum p-values against the Non-targets reference (P = 0.027 for CLIP targets, P < 0.001 for CLIP + RIP targets).

charts.name: GMM-Classified AUC Scatter
charts.nameZh: GMM 分类 AUC 散点
charts.description: GMM clustering of 1023 simulated combination-model AUCs over model index: points coloured by Gaussian-mixture cluster (BIC-selected), separating the useless-model mass from the high-AUC tail.

charts.name: One Mini-Panel per Cancer Type
charts.description: Paired tumour-vs-normal scores of 8 simulated cancer types (20 pairs each): connecting lines join paired samples, magenta = tumour, green = normal, paired Wilcoxon stars above each panel and dashed separators between types.

charts.name: Pan-Cancer Split Violin with Quartile Marks (FigureYa55panCancerviolinV2)
charts.nameZh: 泛癌分半小提琴 + 四分位标记（FigureYa55panCancerviolinV2）
charts.description: Pan-cancer split violin of a simulated TP53-like TPM matrix across 10 tissues: tumour (right, red) vs matched normal (left, yellow); dashes = quartiles per half; stars = per-tissue Wilcoxon tests (***: p < 0.001).

charts.name: Bubble Grid: Motif P-Value Size × TF Expression Fill (FigureYa5bubbles)
charts.nameZh: 气泡网格：motif P 值作大小 × TF 表达作填充（FigureYa5bubbles）
charts.description: Bubble grid of 14 simulated motifs across 5 differentiation stages: dot size = -log10(P) of motif enrichment, fill = the TF's simulated FPKM; both clamped to the plotting range as in the reference.

charts.name: Consensus Matrix, k = 3
charts.type: Consensus Clustering on the Gene Dimension
charts.description: Consensus matrix of 40 simulated genes clustered on the gene dimension (k = 3, 100 resamples): glycolytic (C1) and cholesterogenic (C2) blocks show high within-cluster consensus with the Pathway annotation strip, while C3 collects unaffiliated genes.

charts.name: Correlation Chord Around the Circle (circlize)
charts.description: Spearman correlation chord of the top 16 pairs among 10 simulated genes: gene arcs coloured with the d3 palette, link width = |cor|, link colour = signed cor (green = negative, red = positive), gradient bar as the legend.

charts.name: Split-Triangle Bubble Matrix
charts.description: Two-cohort immune-cell correlation triangle (simulated): upper-right bubbles are cohort A (green-white-red), lower-left cohort B (yellow-white-purple); bubble radius = |r|, colour = r, and pairs with P > 0.05 stay empty.

charts.name: 10 Subtype-Centroid Heatmap with Signature-Score Annotations (PAM50-Style)
charts.nameZh: 10 亚型质心热图 + signature 评分注释（PAM50 风格）
charts.description: Subtype-centroid heatmap (50 simulated PAM50-style genes, 60 samples): samples ordered and split by nearest-centroid prediction; top annotations show the subtype call, two signature-score lines (AR-like: Basal-high; proliferation: LumB-high) and the AR phenotype.

charts.name: 11 Binned-Median Correlation Panels (FigureYa73batchCorrelation)
charts.description: Binned-median correlation panels for a simulated target gene: 20 bins over the sorted samples; each panel plots a top-correlated partner's binned median vs the target's binned median with an lm line and titles r / P.

charts.name: Butterfly Correlation Links
charts.description: Butterfly correlation heatmap of a query gene against 12 simulated pathways in two cohorts: line colour = significance class, linewidth = |r| bin, radiating from the query gene.

charts.name: Top-N Loading Arrows with Multi-Level Confidence Ellipses
charts.nameZh: Top-N 载荷箭头 + 多层置信椭圆
charts.description: PCA of a simulated 3-cancer panel (30 genes): arrows point along the top-3 contributing genes (loading x sqrt(eigenvalue) over PC1-PC2); each group carries nested 90% (dashed) and 95% (solid) confidence ellipses.

charts.name: Nearest-Centroid Prediction
charts.description: Nearest-centroid classification of the test set: each sample's correlation to the class-A vs class-B centroid decides its predicted class (accuracy printed).

charts.name: Test-Set Heatmap Ordered by Predicted Class
charts.nameZh: 按预测类别排序的测试集热图
charts.description: Test-set heatmap (genes x samples, row-scaled) ordered by predicted class: annotation bars show True and Predicted labels; concordance between the two bars is the visual accuracy read.

charts.name: Mutation-Frequency Composition Across Three Subtypes (FigureYa64triangle)
charts.nameZh: 三个亚型间的突变频率构成（FigureYa64triangle）
charts.description: Ternary plot of 22 simulated mutations across pGBM/LGG/sGBM: axes are the within-mutation subtype frequency shares (sum = 1); dot size uses the reference's segmented scaling (10^f x 3 above 0.1, linear 50f below).

charts.name: Cell-Type Proportion Bars with a Cluster-wise Fisher Post-hoc Test
charts.nameZh: 细胞类型比例柱形图 + 分簇 Fisher 事后检验
charts.description: Cell-type composition per cluster (WT vs KO, simulated). Stars are BH-adjusted one-vs-rest Fisher tests per cluster; the overall Fisher exact test on the full table gives p < 0.0001 (Monte-Carlo, B = 10^5).

charts.name: Cell-Type Proportion Bars with a Cluster-wise Fisher Post-hoc Test
charts.nameZh: 细胞类型比例柱形图 + 分簇 Fisher 事后检验
charts.description: The same composition faceted by sequencing replicate: the depletion (C2) and enrichment (C6) are consistent across runs.

charts.name: Gradient-Filled Bars (ggpattern)
charts.description: Radial-gradient bars: the dark metastatic fraction carries white percentage labels; values are simulated prevalence data.

charts.name: Gradient-Filled Bars (ggpattern)
charts.description: Horizontal-gradient bars assembled from mirrored left/right halves with black segment borders (ggpattern).

charts.name: Reference-Line Bars and Diverging Gray/Colored Bars
charts.nameZh: 参考线柱形图与发散式灰/彩柱形图
charts.description: Waterfall of simulated best tumour-response by type: one colour per type, dashed RECIST reference lines at -30/0/+20; the y axis is clipped at 50 and the towering bar carries its true value.

charts.name: Reference-Line Bars and Diverging Gray/Colored Bars
charts.nameZh: 参考线柱形图与发散式灰/彩柱形图
charts.description: Diverging GSVA-style t-value bars (endothelial cells, tumour vs non-malignant, simulated): bars beyond |t| = 4 are coloured by direction, the rest gray; names sit beside each bar.

charts.name: The Metagene Profile: One Line per Sample Across Ordered Windows
charts.nameZh: 元基因剖面：有序窗口上每样本一条线
charts.description: Metagene profile over 3,000 simulated genes: mean tag density across 100-bp upstream windows, the compressed gene body and 3-kb downstream windows, one line per sample (IP vs Input); dashed lines mark TSS and TTS.

charts.name: One Sample, Many Region Classes: the Single-bigWig Profile
charts.nameZh: 单样本、多区域类别：单 bigWig 剖面图
charts.description: Single-sample metagene profile by promoter class (simulated): mean H3K4me3 density over TSS +-2 kb for high- (HCP), intermediate- (ICP) and low-CpG (LCP) promoters; dashed lines mark TSS and the gene-body end.

charts.name: Side-by-Side Connectivity Heatmap + Pie
charts.nameZh: 并排连接热图 + 饼图
charts.description: Drug-term connectivity heatmap (left) and per-drug connectivity-count pie (right): the pie summarises how many terms each drug connects to.

charts.name: The Pie Matrix
charts.description: Pie-chart matrix of simulated lncRNA epigenetic alteration frequencies: rows = lncRNAs, columns = cancer types; each pie's pink arc is the epigenetic-activation (hypomethylation) fraction, green the silencing (hypermethylation) fraction; empty rings mark pairs with no alteration.

charts.name: Double-Y-Axis Scatter with Two Correlations (FigureYa62twoAxis)
charts.nameZh: 双 Y 轴散点与两组相关（FigureYa62twoAxis）
charts.description: Double-Y-axis scatter (simulated): miRNA expression (left axis, blue) and cg10586317 methylation beta (right axis, orange) vs mRNA expression; both with lm fits; the secondary variable is pre-scaled onto the primary axis; Pearson R annotated per series.

charts.name: Circular Score Comparison with a Highlighted Case (circlize)
charts.nameZh: 圆环评分对比 + 突出病例（circlize）
charts.description: Two-ring score comparison (circlize): outer ring = 800 simulated tumour samples, inner ring = 120 normal samples, grey radial lines = group medians, red pointer = the index patient's score of 20.

charts.name: Column-Network with Data-Driven Encodings
charts.description: Crosslink-style bipartite network of 8 simulated regulators and 12 pathways: nodes stacked in two labelled columns with size/fill encodings, edges shrunk at both ends coloured by correlation sign and typed by strength.

charts.name: HR Sweep, Lowess, and the Detected Breakpoint
charts.nameZh: HR 扫描、lowess 与检出的变点
charts.description: Effect-size breakpoint scan of simulated HR estimates across ELN counts 1-20: per-count Cox HRs with CI arrows, lowess spine and Chow-test breakpoint at ELN = 10 (top), with the two-piece linear fit of the smoothed curve (bottom).

charts.name: Two-Group Differential Communication as an Edge-Bundled Chord
charts.nameZh: 两组差异通讯的边捆弦图
charts.description: Differential ligand-receptor communication as an edge-bundled chord (ggraph): radial tree arms per cell type, bundles coloured by ligand log2 fold change (red = up in STIM), leaf size = expressing fraction, open = ligand, filled = receptor.

charts.name: Signal Tracks Around a Gene Without Gviz (ggplot2 Recreation)
charts.nameZh: 无 Gviz 的基因周边信号轨道（ggplot2 复现）
charts.description: IGV-style signal tracks around a target gene (simulated bigWig bins): four coverage facets plus a dedicated gene-model track with exon rectangles on the intron line; x axis in kilobases.

charts.name: Heatmap Rings, Links, and Class Bars
charts.description: Circos composite of simulated differential KOs vs KEGG B-classes: six per-sample abundance heatmap rings on the KO sector (GSH1-3 severe, GSL4-6 mild scab, outer to inner), links coloured by enrichment direction (red GSH, green GSL), and stacked per-class KO counts as inner bars.

charts.name: The Genome Circle
charts.description: Genome-overview circos of 9 simulated chromosomes with 8 stacked rings: chromosome ideograms, GC content line, TE density heatmap, gene density heatmap, gene number line, per-sample RPKM tracks (sample 2 shows planted Chr3/Chr8 gains) and het/hom SNP points.

charts.name: Faceted Burden Boxplots with Pairwise Symbols
charts.nameZh: 分面负荷箱线图与两两符号
charts.description: Focal (300 features) and arm-level (23 arms) CNV burden of 150 simulated samples across three immune subtypes: boxplots with BH-adjusted pairwise Wilcoxon symbols (ns / * / ** / ***).

charts.name: Module Detection and Module-Phenotype Heatmap
charts.nameZh: 模块检测与模块-表型热图
charts.description: Module eigengene vs phenotype correlations (WGCNA-style, simulated): rows = modules from the dynamic hybrid cut, columns = quantitative traits; numbers give Pearson r, the dendrograms cluster both margins.

charts.name: Mirrored DNAmAge Barplot
charts.description: Mirrored barplot of DNA methylation age vs chronological age for 20 simulated samples: upward bars = DNAmAge, downward bars = chronological age, coloured difference bars mark accelerated (red) vs decelerated (blue) samples.

charts.name: Stacked and Diverging Subgroup Bars
charts.description: FGA/FGG/FGL of 60 simulated patients by clinical stage: stacked FGG+FGL percent per subgroup (top) and the diverging gained/lost layout with SE bars and stage-ANOVA stars (bottom); cBioPortal algorithm with |log2R| > 0.2.

charts.name: clusterProfiler GSEA with the Ranked-List Curve (FigureYa60GSEAclusterProfilerV2)
charts.nameZh: clusterProfiler GSEA 与排序列表曲线（FigureYa60GSEAclusterProfilerV2）
charts.description: GSEA of 1,500 simulated ranked genes against GO TERM2GENE: running ES lines for the top 3 terms (immune-response term leads), gene-rank barcode and ranked-list metric below.

charts.name: ssGSEA Immune-Infiltration Heatmap (FigureYa71ssGSEAupdate)
charts.description: ssGSEA immune-infiltration heatmap of 40 simulated samples x 6 immune cell types (row-scaled scores): the annotation bar separates the planted immune-hot and immune-cold subgroups; pheatmap with navy-white-firebrick ramp.

charts.name: Immunophenogram with Legend Strips
charts.description: Immunophenogram of a simulated sample: outer ring = 26 gene wedges coloured by z-score, inner ring = EC/SC/CP/MHC summary wedges, centre reports the IPS; legend strips show the z and weighted-z colour scales.

charts.name: IP vs Input Coverage Tracks
charts.nameZh: IP 与 Input 覆盖轨迹
charts.description: m6A IP vs input coverage along three simulated transcripts: shaded bands are merged significant peaks (BH FDR < 0.05, IP/input > 2); two transcripts carry planted 3'UTR enrichment, one is unmodified.

charts.name: Peaks Across Transcript Regions
charts.nameZh: 峰在各转录本区域的分布
charts.description: Significant windows per transcript region, stacked by transcript: the simulated m6A peaks concentrate in the 3'UTR and CDS (stop-codon adjacent), with a rare 5'UTR peak.

charts.name: Repelled Labels and Per-Chromosome Colour (ggplot2)
charts.nameZh: 避让标签与逐染色体配色（ggplot2）
charts.description: Manhattan plot of 8 simulated chromosomes (2,500 SNPs each): red threshold at -log10(P) = 5, points above it enlarged and labeled with gene + rs-ID via ggrepel; alternating chromosome colours.

charts.name: CpG Methylation Heatmap with Dual Annotations
charts.nameZh: CpG 甲基化热图（双注释）
charts.description: CpG methylation clustering (80 probes x 50 samples): column annotation = CIMP subtype, row annotation = CpG region class; island probes in CIMP-high samples show the characteristic gain.

charts.name: Mean Beta by Region x Subtype
charts.nameZh: 区域 × 亚型的平均 beta
charts.description: Mean beta value by CpG region and CIMP subtype: island probes separate the subtypes; shore and open-sea probes do not.

charts.name: Standardized Feature Heatmap
charts.description: Standardized immune feature heatmap of 240 simulated samples from 3 cohorts, column-annotated by ICI cluster (kmeans) and cohort; features sorted for block coherence showing the planted cluster structure.

charts.name: Survival by ICI Cluster
charts.description: Kaplan-Meier overall survival by ICI cluster for 240 simulated patients with the risk table; log-rank p < 0.001 across the three clusters.

charts.name: From an Expression Cluster to a Gene Family: Heatmap + Tree + Alignment
charts.nameZh: 从表达聚类到基因家族：热图 + 进化树 + 多序列比对
charts.description: Expression heatmap of the 12-member simulated family (rows z-scored, complete linkage): the two co-expression blocks correspond to the two subfamilies.

charts.name: From an Expression Cluster to a Gene Family: Heatmap + Tree + Alignment
charts.nameZh: 从表达聚类到基因家族：热图 + 进化树 + 多序列比对
charts.description: First 60 alignment positions of the 12 family members (ggmsa, Chemistry_AA colouring): each subfamily carries shared diagnostic substitutions plus private ones.

charts.name: From an Expression Cluster to a Gene Family: Heatmap + Tree + Alignment
charts.nameZh: 从表达聚类到基因家族：热图 + 进化树 + 多序列比对
charts.description: Neighbour-joining tree from pairwise sequence identity (ggtree): the two clades match the two expression blocks of the heatmap.

charts.name: Significance Scatter
charts.description: MutSigCV-style significance scatter (simulated): non-silent mutations per gene vs the background covariate; coloured and enlarged points are BH-significant (q < 0.1) genes that rise above the covariate-matched background.

charts.name: Top-Gene Lollipop
charts.description: BH-significant genes sorted by q-value: observed mutations (dot) against the covariate-matched 95% background band (grey line), connected by a stem.

charts.name: Faceted Mutation-vs-Expression Boxplots
charts.nameZh: 分面突变 vs 表达箱线图
charts.description: Expression of 6 driver genes by mutation status (simulated): only EGFR (up) and ERBB2 (down) show planted mutation effects; stars are per-gene Wilcoxon p-values.

charts.name: 01-Matrix Oncoprint Split by Pathway with Clinical Annotation
charts.nameZh: 01 矩阵 oncoprint：按通路拆分 + 临床注释
charts.description: 01-matrix oncoprint of 12 genes in 40 simulated samples: rows split by pathway (RTK/RAS, PI3K, p53/cell cycle), green = mutated, bottom annotation rows carry smoking, stage and treatment; the top barplot counts mutations per sample.

charts.name: Co-occurrence / Mutual Exclusivity by Correlogram (FigureYa70mutationEvents)
charts.nameZh: 相关图上的共发生/互斥（FigureYa70mutationEvents）
charts.description: Co-occurrence / mutual exclusivity correlogram of 8 simulated genes: ellipse colour and shape encode the phi correlation of the mutated/not 2x2 tables; grey crosses mark non-significant Fisher tests (p >= 0.05).

charts.name: NNLS Exposure Fit
charts.description: Recovered per-sample signature exposures (NNLS on the simulated 96-channel counts), sorted by APOBEC exposure: the planted APOBEC-high samples separate cleanly from the aging-dominated majority.

charts.name: Fit-Quality Reconstruction Check
charts.description: Reconstruction quality per sample: observed (dark) vs fitted (light) counts across the 96 channels for two samples at the APOBEC extremes; cosine similarity in each title.

charts.name: GO Semantic-Similarity "Friend" Screen (FigureYa68friendsV2)
charts.nameZh: GO 语义相似度"伙伴"筛选（FigureYa68friendsV2）
charts.description: GO semantic-similarity friend screen of 8 simulated formin-family genes (Wang method, sqrt(MF*CC) combination): boxes show each gene's similarity distribution to the others, ordered by mean; the dashed line marks 0.75.

charts.name: PDS Heatmap with Subtype Annotation
charts.description: Pathifier pathway deregulation scores (simulated): 40 tumours (annotation: non-luminal vs luminal-like) x 6 pathways, row-scaled and winsorized, unclustered — proliferation and hypoxia shift up in luminal tumours, EMT in non-luminal.

charts.name: Faceted Lollipop + Stacked Bar + pheatmap
charts.nameZh: 分面棒棒糖 + 堆叠条 + pheatmap
charts.description: Single-cell marker composite of 9 simulated clusters: faceted lollipop of marker expression per cluster (top), 100% stacked bar of tissue preference (middle), and pheatmap of marker genes x clusters (bottom).

charts.name: Correlation-Clustered corrplot
charts.description: Pearson correlation heatmap of 44 simulated NMF programs: colour = Pearson r, ordered by ward.D2 with 7 black cluster rectangles.

charts.name: RSS Bars, Highlighted Embedding, Binarized RAS
charts.nameZh: RSS 柱、高亮嵌入、二值化 RAS
charts.description: pySCENIC-style regulon readout of 5 simulated haematopoietic cell types: RSS bars per cell type and regulon (top), Erythroblast highlighted on the t-SNE (bottom left) and the binarized Lmo2 regulon activity on the same map (bottom right).

charts.name: Cells and Co-accessibility Arcs
charts.description: Cicero-style co-accessibility view of a simulated 1 Mb locus: two simulated cell clusters on LSI-UMAP (top) and arcs between a promoter peak and nine distal peaks coloured by signed co-accessibility with a collapsed gene model beneath (bottom).

charts.name: Pathway-Activity DE Dot Plot Across Cell Types
charts.nameZh: 跨细胞类型的通路活性差异点图
charts.description: Pathway-activity differential dot plot (12 pathways x 4 cell types): dot size = Bonferroni-FDR bins, colour = log2 fold change of the activity score; the bottom strip groups pathways into Immune / Metabolism / Signaling / Proliferation.

charts.name: Gene-Concept Circular Network (GOplot-Style)
charts.nameZh: 基因-概念环形网络（GOplot 风格）
charts.description: Gene-concept network of 3 top enriched BP terms (clusterProfiler + enrichplot): term hubs sized by member count, gene nodes coloured by log2 fold change (blue = up, red = down); simulated IFN-gamma response gene set.

charts.name: TMB Scatter with Ti/Tv Strips
charts.description: Tumour mutation burden across 8 simulated cohorts (log10(TMB+1), ordered by ascending median; grey segments = medians) with per-cohort Ti/Tv fraction strips sharing the sample order: THCA is C>T-dominant (deamination), SKCM is C>A-dominant (UV).

charts.name: Size-Encoded Volcano for Small-Effect Screens (PDUI Style)
charts.nameZh: 小效应量筛选的尺寸编码火山图（PDUI 风格）
charts.description: Size-encoded volcano of simulated 3'UTR-usage (PDUI) events between vital-status groups: colour = direction gate (|delta PDUI| > 0.05 and adjusted P < 0.1), dot size = |delta PDUI x -log10 P|; the strongest shift on each side is labeled.

charts.name: The Tiered "Cool" Volcano (FigureYa59volcanoV2)
charts.description: Tiered volcano of 900 simulated events: nested gates at |logFC| = 1.5/2.5/5 and adjusted P = 0.05/1e-4/1e-5 drive colour darkness and point size; pathway-coloured, black-circled and labeled points are the validation picks.

charts.name: Bubble Volcano on the Enrichment-Score Axis (FigureYa75bubblevolcano)
charts.nameZh: 富集分数轴上的气泡火山图（FigureYa75bubblevolcano）
charts.description: Bubble volcano of 40 simulated enrichment terms: x = enrichment score, y = -log10(P); bubbles sized only for the four selected pathways (coloured), grey size-1 points for the rest; dashed gates at p = 0.05 and |score| = 1.5; selected terms above the gates labeled.

charts.name: Diverging Connectivity Bar Chart
charts.description: CMap-style connectivity scores (simulated): blue bars mimic the disease signature, red bars reverse it; opaque bars pass Fisher p < 0.05; faded bars are not significant.

charts.name: Curves, Probability Matrix, and Risk Table
charts.nameZh: 曲线、概率矩阵与风险表
charts.description: Conditional survival of 300 simulated patients: KM step curves conditioned on 0-5 years already survived (top), the lower-triangle conditional probability matrix (middle, S(y | y0) = S(y)/S(y0)) and the numbers at risk (bottom).

charts.name: Many Models at One Horizon: Value and Over-Intervention
charts.nameZh: 一个 horizon 上的多模型比较：获益与避免过度干预
charts.description: Decision curves for four risk models at the 2-year horizon (simulated cohort, n = 500): net benefit against treat-all and treat-none defaults.

charts.name: Many Models at One Horizon: Value and Over-Intervention
charts.nameZh: 一个 horizon 上的多模型比较：获益与避免过度干预
charts.description: Net interventions avoided per 100 patients for the same four models: the value of a model is how many treat-all interventions it can spare at equal missed events.

charts.name: Drug x Cancer-Type Boxplots
charts.description: Simulated ln(IC50) by cancer type for three drugs: each panel is one drug, boxes are cancer types; the planted LUAD-Erlotinib sensitivity and HNSC-Dasatinib resistance are visible.

charts.name: Per-Type Wilcoxon Stars
charts.description: Erlotinib ln(IC50) by type with stars from per-type Wilcoxon tests vs all other types (BH-corrected).

charts.name: Spearman Lollipop and PPS-Stratified Boxplots
charts.nameZh: Spearman 棒棒糖与 PPS 分层箱线图
charts.description: Drug-sensitivity readout for 6 simulated drugs: Spearman correlation lollipop with PPS (Panel A, reversed axis, dot size = -log10(P)) and predicted AUC boxplots stratified by High/Low PPS with Wilcoxon stars (Panel B); all drugs have significant negative PPS associations.

charts.name: Score Separation Boxplot
charts.description: TIDE-style score by response class (simulated): non-responders score higher (higher tumour-intrinsic immune suppression); boxes carry jittered points.

charts.name: Prediction ROC
charts.description: ROC of the TIDE-style score for predicting non-response (simulated): AUC printed in the legend; the dashed diagonal is chance.

charts.name: Pairwise Log-rank Comparisons Across Many Groups
charts.nameZh: 多组间的两两 log-rank 比较
charts.description: Five-stratum KM curves with risk table; the lower-left table gives Holm-adjusted pairwise log-rank p-values (columns vs rows), and the overall log-rank test gives p < 0.001.

charts.name: Batch Optimal Cutpoints (Best Separation)
charts.nameZh: 批量最优截断值（最佳分离）
charts.description: Batch best-separation screen of 8 simulated markers: KM curves for the markers whose maximally-selected log-rank p passes 0.05, with the optimal cutoff, n per group, HR and 95% CI printed in each panel.

charts.name: The Optimal-Split Landscape for One Marker
charts.nameZh: 单标志物的最优分离景观图
charts.description: The split landscape of one simulated marker (200 samples): log-rank p-value and HR at every possible dichotomisation; dashed lines at p = 0.05 and HR = 2 / 0.5; the minimum-p split is highlighted.

charts.name: The Optimal-Split Landscape for One Marker
charts.nameZh: 单标志物的最优分离景观图
charts.description: KM curves of the same marker dichotomised two ways: the min-P split (left) versus the median split (right); the difference in reported p-values is the optimism the landscape warns about.

charts.name: LOESS Mortality Trend
charts.description: 5-year mortality vs tumour size (900 simulated patients): LOESS-smoothed rate with CI ribbon over the raw per-mm rates; the mortality rises with size and saturates above ~35 mm.

charts.name: Calibrate the Nomogram
charts.description: Bootstrap calibration of the Cox nomogram at 3 years (u = 1095 days): apparent (×) vs bias-corrected (•) survival against the ideal 45° line.

charts.name: Calibrate the Nomogram
charts.description: Bootstrap calibration of the Cox nomogram at 5 years (u = 1825 days): the model tracks the ideal line within the bootstrap confidence bars.

charts.name: Error-Rate Curve and Importance Lollipop
charts.nameZh: 误差率曲线与重要性棒棒糖
charts.description: Random survival forest screening of 200 simulated patients: OOB error rate vs number of trees (left) and relative importance of Cox-prefiltered genes rescaled to the top gene with a 0.2 cutoff (right); the six planted prognostic genes top the ranking.

charts.name: Score / Outcome / Expression, One Ordering
charts.nameZh: 评分 / 结局 / 表达，同一排序
charts.description: Risk-score overview of a simulated 8-gene prognostic signature: patients ranked by ascending risk score with the median split (dashed); survival status beside it; row-scaled, winsorized signature expression with a group strip below — all three panels share one patient ordering.

charts.name: RMS Curve per Marker
charts.nameZh: 每个标记的 RMS 曲线
charts.type: Restricted Mean Survival by Risk Percentile
charts.description: Restricted mean survival (months, tau = 120) of cumulative risk-percentile subgroups for a base and a modified marker (250 simulated patients): the modified marker's curve sits below the base at high percentiles.

charts.name: Screen, Ranking, and Combination Sweep
charts.description: Signature combination search on 180 simulated patients: univariate Cox volcano (left), top-10 importance lollipop (middle, five planted genes on top) and the top-20 gene combinations by -log10(log-rank P) (right) - the 5-gene combination wins.

charts.name: Smoothed Hazard + Risk Table
charts.description: Kernel-smoothed hazard curves for 260 simulated patients split by gender (Male higher than Female throughout), with the number-at-risk strip beneath; grid trimmed to 66 months to avoid the right-boundary censoring spike.

charts.name: Scatter + Marginal Logrank-Score Strips
charts.nameZh: 散点 + 页边 log-rank 得分条
charts.description: CD274 vs CD8A expression scatter (simulated) with MSI/MSS point shapes, median and survival-optimal cut-off lines, regression with 95% CI, quadrant percentages I-IV, and marginal log-rank score strips whose peaks (arrows) pick the cut-offs.

charts.name: 3-State Landscape Heatmap
charts.description: Survival landscape of 6 simulated genes across 6 cancer types: blue = protective (Cox HR < 1, p < 0.05), red = risky (HR > 1, p < 0.05), grey = not significant; rows annotated by gene function (Writer/Reader/Eraser).

charts.name: One Lane per Patient
charts.description: Swimmer plot of 12 simulated patients: blue lanes are time on study, yellow overlays new-therapy duration, red arrowheads mark patients alive at last follow-up, crosses deaths, asterisks lost to follow-up, and open circles progression.

charts.name: One Curve per Model
charts.description: BootCV time-dependent C-index of three nested Cox models (clinical / biomarker / combined) over a 12-108 month grid on 220 simulated patients: the combined model dominates and discrimination decreases with follow-up.

charts.name: Anchored Ideogram, Signal Track and Marker Rug
charts.nameZh: 锚定核型、信号轨道与标记刻度
charts.description: Anchored ideogram with cumulative coordinates for a simulated five-chromosome genome laid end to end (4 Mb gaps): band shading with chromosome outlines and the centromere drawn as a dark tick on top, per-window Fst below with two planted selective-sweep peaks (chr2:62 Mb, chr4:20 Mb) and the 0.25 outlier threshold, and a marker rug (tRNA/rRNA/miRNA/QTL) on the top axis.

charts.name: The Problem: a Plain PCoA Scatter
charts.nameZh: 问题所在：朴素 PCoA 散点
charts.description: Plain PCoA scatter of 600 simulated samples from 5 subtypes × 2 cohorts, coloured by subtype: clouds overlap and individual points cannot be told apart.

charts.name: The Fix: Group-Mean Circles with ± SD Bars
charts.nameZh: 解决之道：组均值圆圈 + ± SD 误差线
charts.description: PCoA redrawn as per-group mean ± SD bars and labelled circles: closed = TCGA-like cohort, open = Yau-like cohort; paired colours link the two cohorts of each subtype.

charts.name: Is the Grouping Real? Permutation Pseudo-F (PERMANOVA)
charts.nameZh: 分组是真的吗？置换伪 F（PERMANOVA）
charts.description: Hand-rolled PERMANOVA (pseudo-F, 1000 label permutations) run within each cohort: both cohorts separate the simulated subtypes strongly (p < 0.001), matching the visible cluster structure.

charts.name: Stable Pairs in Normals and Their Tumour Reversal
charts.nameZh: 正常样本稳定对与肿瘤反转
charts.description: LncRIndiv screening: kept pairs show ≥95% rank consistency in normals; the reversal plot marks tumour-reversed pairs by their Fisher FDR — driver lncRNAs (planted up-shift) dominate the significant end.

charts.name: Per-Patient Dysregulation Calls
charts.description: LncRIndiv dysregulation matrix: rows = query lncRNAs, columns = tumour samples; yellow = called up (outranks ≥ half of its stable partners), black = not called. The six planted drivers are called in nearly all tumour samples.

charts.name: Single pheatmap with Method Annotation and Gaps
charts.nameZh: 单张 pheatmap：方法注释 + 间隙
charts.description: Immune landscape as a single pheatmap: samples ordered by risk score (gaps split high/low), algorithm blocks separated by row gaps, RiskScore bar on top; z-scored, ±2 capped.

charts.name: ComplexHeatmap Stacked Version: One Ramp per Algorithm
charts.nameZh: ComplexHeatmap 拼接版：每个算法一条色带
charts.description: ComplexHeatmap stacked rendering: one sub-heatmap per algorithm, each with its own ramp (blue-red, green-red, blue-yellow, inferno, viridis, magma), samples ordered identically by risk score.

charts.name: Reshape and Classify: Shared vs Subtype-Specific
charts.nameZh: 重塑与分类：共享 vs 亚型特异
charts.description: DEG membership matrix after dcast and ordering: rows sorted by the number of subtypes a gene is DE in, with the shared/specific annotation shown as the left strip of the subsequent heatmaps.

charts.name: Up-Regulated Genes (Direction "O")
charts.description: Binary heatmap of up-regulated (direction O) DEGs per subtype: filled tile = the gene is a DEG of that subtype; left strip marks subtype-specific vs shared DEGs.

charts.name: Down-Regulated Genes (Direction "Y") at the Same Height
charts.nameZh: 下调基因（方向 Y）等高呈现
charts.description: Binary heatmap of down-regulated (direction Y) DEGs, drawn at the same physical height as the up-regulated plot: the visibly sparser fill quantifies the direction asymmetry.

charts.name: Grouping Layers: Patient, Diagnosis, Cell State
charts.nameZh: 分组图层：病人、诊断、细胞状态
charts.description: The same t-SNE embedding coloured three ways: by patient (Ctrl left, GBM right), by diagnosis (2 colours), and by cell state; the state layer is the one that explains the structure.

charts.name: Gradient Pathway Scores on the Embedding
charts.nameZh: 嵌入图上的渐变通路评分
charts.description: Six pathway scores overlaid on the t-SNE embedding with a reversed RdYlBu gradient: each planted signature (signal transduction, transcription, adhesion, apoptosis, GTPase, angiogenesis) highlights a distinct cell state.

charts.name: Rings by Region Complexity
charts.description: Circular Venn region chart for 6 simulated organ-expression sets: wedges grouped into rings by region complexity (innermost = ABCDEF shared core, outer = set-specific), fill = gene count capped at 1000, labels give region and count.

charts.name: Same Chart from Raw Overlap Counts
charts.nameZh: 从原始 overlap 计数直接作图
charts.description: Circular Venn chart built directly from a name/count table (the reference's easy_input route): region wedges ordered by complexity rings, labels every other wedge to avoid crowding.

charts.name: Four Alignment Rings with Split Arcs
charts.nameZh: 四条对齐环 + 分段弧
charts.description: Circos alignment of four PDAC subtype classifications over 150 samples (sectors = samples, sorted): each ring is one classification split by its own labels; colour blocks persisting across rings mark agreement, fragmented blocks mark disagreement.

charts.name: With Packed Legends
charts.description: Circos alignment with packed legends on the right: one legend per ring (TCGA metabolic, Moffitt, Bailey, Collisson), drawn with ComplexHeatmap::packLegend outside the circle viewport.

charts.name: Single-Panel Algorithm (EPIC-Like, 8 Cell Types)
charts.nameZh: 单面板算法（EPIC 式，8 种细胞）
charts.description: EPIC-like panel: Spearman correlation of the query gene with 8 immune cell types across 12 tumour types; colour = rho (blue -1 to red +1), filled square = p<0.05, open diamond = non-significant.

charts.name: Two-Row Layout for Many Cell Types (TIMER-Like)
charts.nameZh: 多细胞类型的两行版式（TIMER 式）
charts.description: TIMER-like two-row assembly: one sub-heatmap per immune cell type (3 top, 3 bottom), x labels only on the outer edge, panels sized equally, one collected colour legend.

charts.name: Wide Algorithm (CIBERSORT-Like, 22 Cell Types)
charts.nameZh: 宽面板算法（CIBERSORT 式，20 种细胞）
charts.description: CIBERSORT-like single tall panel: 22 cell types × 12 tumour types; the planted cytotoxic-T and other-cells correlations reproduce across all three algorithms.

charts.name: The Full Reference Layout
charts.description: Per-cluster DEG strip plot: red = up-regulated (dark red = adj p<0.01), blue = down-regulated, black = non-significant direction; grey bands span each cluster's observed log2FC range, top-5 up/down genes are labelled, and the coloured bar marks cluster identity at FC = 0.

charts.name: Same Plot, Cell-Type-Annotated
charts.nameZh: 同一张图，细胞类型标注
charts.description: DEG strip plot with cluster numbers replaced by cell-type names on the x axis: the planted PBMC markers (CCR7, S100A8, CD79A, GZMB, FCER1A, PPBP) land in their canonical clusters.

charts.name: The MIA Statistic, Computed Correctly
charts.description: MIA map: -log10 hypergeometric p for every cell type (rows, with marker-set sizes) x ST region (columns, with sizes); red = enriched overlap, blue = depleted. Each cell type lights up in its preferred region, with fibroblasts/macrophages into stroma and both cancer clones into the cancer region.

charts.name: Raw Overlap Counts as the Column Bar
charts.nameZh: 原始交集计数作为对照图
charts.description: Raw overlap counts between cell-type and region marker sets (annotated on the same layout): the planted biology shows as large overlaps on the diagonal, while statistics in the MIA map weight these by set sizes.

charts.name: Variance Decomposition per Gene Pair
charts.description: Variance decomposition per ortholog pair: fraction of expression variance from tissue (x) vs species (y); green = tissue-dominated above its 75th percentile, red = species-dominated above its 75th percentile, grey = mixed. The planted classes separate as designed.

charts.name: Naming the Genes That Matter
charts.description: The same decomposition with the most extreme gene pairs of each class labelled: the tissue-dominated pair (top-left corner) is a mouse-model-safe gene; the species-dominated pair (bottom-right) generalizes from mouse to human only with caution.

charts.name: Per-Region Correlation Summary
