set.seed(42)
genes9 <- paste0("Gene", 1:8)
stage  <- factor(rep(paste0("stage", 1:3), each = 10))

expr9 <- sapply(seq_along(genes9), function(g) {
  eff <- if (g %in% c(2, 5)) c(0, 1.5, 3) else c(0, 0, 0)  # stage-dependent genes
  rnorm(30, mean = 3 + eff[stage], sd = 0.8)
})
colnames(expr9) <- genes9

long9 <- data.frame(stage = stage, expr9) |>
  pivot_longer(-stage, names_to = "gene", values_to = "expr")

# One-way ANOVA per gene + significance stars
sig9 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(genes9, function(g) {
  p <- summary(aov(expr ~ stage, data = subset(long9, gene == g)))[[1]]$"Pr(>F)"[1]
  data.frame(gene = g,
             label = paste0("ANOVA p ",
                            ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", p)), " ",
                            cut(p, c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
                                labels = c("***", "**", "*", ""))))
}))

ymax9 <- tapply(long9$expr, long9$gene, max)

ggplot(long9, aes(x = stage, y = expr, fill = stage)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = sig9,
            aes(x = 2, y = ymax9[gene] + 0.5, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#BDD7E7", "#6BAED6", "#2171B5")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative expression (log2)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"))

set.seed(404)
clusters <- c("C1", "C2", "C3")
n_per <- 30
sig_sets <- list(
  `Immune checkpoint` = paste0("ICG", 1:15),
  `Antigen processing` = paste0("APM", 1:15),
  `TGF-beta response` = paste0("TGF", 1:15)
)
all_genes <- unlist(sig_sets)
meta <- data.frame(sample = paste0("S", 1:90),
                   cluster = rep(clusters, each = n_per))

expr10 <- matrix(rnorm(45 * 90, sd = 1), nrow = 45, dimnames = list(all_genes, meta$sample))
shift <- c(0, 0.7, 1.6)[match(meta$cluster, clusters)]      # C3 strongest
for (gs in c("Immune checkpoint", "Antigen processing")) {
  expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ] <- sweep(expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ], 2, shift, "+")  # shift applies per sample (column)
}
expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] <-
  expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] - 1.2

## sign-corrected PC1 score per signature (the reference workflow's core step)
score_of <- function(gs) {
  m <- expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], , drop = FALSE]
  pc <- prcomp(t(m), retx = TRUE)
  pc$x[, 1] * sign(cor(pc$x[, 1], colMeans(m)))
}
scores <- sapply(names(sig_sets), score_of)

long10 <- data.frame(sample = meta$sample, cluster = meta$cluster, scores) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(sample, cluster), names_to = "Signature", values_to = "Score") |>
  mutate(Score = as.numeric(scale(Score)))

ggplot(long10, aes(Signature, Score, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
  stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif", method = "kruskal.test") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E31A1C", "#E7B800", "#2E9FDF")) +
  labs(y = "Signature score (scaled)", fill = "TME cluster") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

set.seed(5501)
tissues <- c("BRCA", "COAD", "HNSC", "KIRC", "LUAD", "LUSC", "PRAD", "STAD", "THCA", "UCEC")
n_per <- 120
tp53_base <- c(BRCA = 2.6, COAD = 2.2, HNSC = 2.8, KIRC = 2.4, LUAD = 2.5,
               LUSC = 2.9, PRAD = 2.3, STAD = 2.7, THCA = 2.2, UCEC = 2.5)
pan <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tissues, function(t) {
  rbind(data.frame(tissue = t, type2 = "tumor", tpm = rnorm(n_per, tp53_base[t] + 0.9, 0.75)),
        data.frame(tissue = t, type2 = "normal", tpm = rnorm(n_per, tp53_base[t] - 0.4, 0.6)))
}))
pan$type2 <- factor(pan$type2, levels = c("tumor", "normal"))
pan$tissue <- factor(pan$tissue, levels = tissues)
wt <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tissues, function(t) {
  d1 <- pan$tpm[pan$tissue == t & pan$type2 == "tumor"]
  d0 <- pan$tpm[pan$tissue == t & pan$type2 == "normal"]
  data.frame(tissue = t, p = wilcox.test(d1, d0)$p.value)
}))
star_df <- data.frame(tissue = factor(wt$tissue, levels = tissues),
                      y = max(pan$tpm) + 0.55,
                      lab = ifelse(wt$p < 0.001, "***",
                                   ifelse(wt$p < 0.01, "**",
                                          ifelse(wt$p < 0.05, "*", ""))))

                  color = "black", palette = c("#DF2020", "#DDDF21"),
                  ylab = "TP53 expression (log2 TPM, simulated)", xlab = NULL,
                  add = "jitter", jitter = 0.18,
                  add.params = list(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.35, color = "type2"),
                  outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_text(data = star_df, aes(tissue, y, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.2, colour = "grey10") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min(pan$tpm) - 0.5, max(pan$tpm) + 1.1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

set.seed(404)
clusters <- c("C1", "C2", "C3")
n_per <- 30
sig_sets <- list(
  `Immune checkpoint` = paste0("ICG", 1:15),
  `Antigen processing` = paste0("APM", 1:15),
  `TGF-beta response` = paste0("TGF", 1:15)
)
all_genes <- unlist(sig_sets)
meta <- data.frame(sample = paste0("S", 1:90),
                   cluster = rep(clusters, each = n_per))

expr10 <- matrix(rnorm(45 * 90, sd = 1), nrow = 45, dimnames = list(all_genes, meta$sample))
shift <- c(0, 0.7, 1.6)[match(meta$cluster, clusters)]      # C3 strongest
for (gs in c("Immune checkpoint", "Antigen processing")) {
  expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ] <- sweep(expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ], 2, shift, "+")  # shift applies per sample (column)
}
expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] <-
  expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] - 1.2

## sign-corrected PC1 score per signature (the reference workflow's core step)
score_of <- function(gs) {
  m <- expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], , drop = FALSE]
  pc <- prcomp(t(m), retx = TRUE)
  pc$x[, 1] * sign(cor(pc$x[, 1], colMeans(m)))
}
scores <- sapply(names(sig_sets), score_of)

long10 <- data.frame(sample = meta$sample, cluster = meta$cluster, scores) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(sample, cluster), names_to = "Signature", values_to = "Score") |>
  mutate(Score = as.numeric(scale(Score)))

ggplot(long10, aes(Signature, Score, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
  stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif", method = "kruskal.test") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E31A1C", "#E7B800", "#2E9FDF")) +
  labs(y = "Signature score (scaled)", fill = "TME cluster") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

set.seed(404)
clusters <- c("C1", "C2", "C3")
n_per <- 30
sig_sets <- list(
  `Immune checkpoint` = paste0("ICG", 1:15),
  `Antigen processing` = paste0("APM", 1:15),
  `TGF-beta response` = paste0("TGF", 1:15)
)
all_genes <- unlist(sig_sets)
meta <- data.frame(sample = paste0("S", 1:90),
                   cluster = rep(clusters, each = n_per))

expr10 <- matrix(rnorm(45 * 90, sd = 1), nrow = 45, dimnames = list(all_genes, meta$sample))
shift <- c(0, 0.7, 1.6)[match(meta$cluster, clusters)]      # C3 strongest
for (gs in c("Immune checkpoint", "Antigen processing")) {
  expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ] <- sweep(expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ], 2, shift, "+")  # shift applies per sample (column)
}
expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] <-
  expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] - 1.2

## sign-corrected PC1 score per signature (the reference workflow's core step)
score_of <- function(gs) {
  m <- expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], , drop = FALSE]
  pc <- prcomp(t(m), retx = TRUE)
  pc$x[, 1] * sign(cor(pc$x[, 1], colMeans(m)))
}
scores <- sapply(names(sig_sets), score_of)

long10 <- data.frame(sample = meta$sample, cluster = meta$cluster, scores) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(sample, cluster), names_to = "Signature", values_to = "Score") |>
  mutate(Score = as.numeric(scale(Score)))

  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
  stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif", method = "kruskal.test") +

  eff <- if (g %in% c(2, 5)) c(0, 1.5, 3) else c(0, 0, 0)  # stage-dependent genes

})

  data.frame(gene = g,
             label = paste0("ANOVA p ",
                            ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", p)), " ",
                            cut(p, c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
                                labels = c("***", "**", "*", ""))))
}))

set.seed(404)
clusters <- c("C1", "C2", "C3")
n_per <- 30
sig_sets <- list(
  `Immune checkpoint` = paste0("ICG", 1:15),
  `Antigen processing` = paste0("APM", 1:15),
  `TGF-beta response` = paste0("TGF", 1:15)
)
all_genes <- unlist(sig_sets)
meta <- data.frame(sample = paste0("S", 1:90),
                   cluster = rep(clusters, each = n_per))

expr10 <- matrix(rnorm(45 * 90, sd = 1), nrow = 45, dimnames = list(all_genes, meta$sample))
shift <- c(0, 0.7, 1.6)[match(meta$cluster, clusters)]      # C3 strongest
for (gs in c("Immune checkpoint", "Antigen processing")) {
  expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ] <- sweep(expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ], 2, shift, "+")  # shift applies per sample (column)
}
expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] <-
  expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] - 1.2

## sign-corrected PC1 score per signature (the reference workflow's core step)
score_of <- function(gs) {
  m <- expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], , drop = FALSE]
  pc <- prcomp(t(m), retx = TRUE)
  pc$x[, 1] * sign(cor(pc$x[, 1], colMeans(m)))
}
scores <- sapply(names(sig_sets), score_of)

long10 <- data.frame(sample = meta$sample, cluster = meta$cluster, scores) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(sample, cluster), names_to = "Signature", values_to = "Score") |>
  mutate(Score = as.numeric(scale(Score)))

ggplot(long10, aes(Signature, Score, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
  stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif", method = "kruskal.test") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E31A1C", "#E7B800", "#2E9FDF")) +
  labs(y = "Signature score (scaled)", fill = "TME cluster") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

  eff <- if (g %in% c(2, 5)) c(0, 1.5, 3) else c(0, 0, 0)  # stage-dependent genes
  rnorm(30, mean = 3 + eff[stage], sd = 0.8)
})

  pivot_longer(-stage, names_to = "gene", values_to = "expr")

# One-way ANOVA per gene + significance stars

  p <- summary(aov(expr ~ stage, data = subset(long9, gene == g)))[[1]]$"Pr(>F)"[1]
  data.frame(gene = g,
             label = paste0("ANOVA p ",
                            ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", p)), " ",
                            cut(p, c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
                                labels = c("***", "**", "*", ""))))
}))

ymax9 <- tapply(long9$expr, long9$gene, max)

  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +

set.seed(404)
clusters <- c("C1", "C2", "C3")
n_per <- 30
sig_sets <- list(
  `Immune checkpoint` = paste0("ICG", 1:15),
  `Antigen processing` = paste0("APM", 1:15),
  `TGF-beta response` = paste0("TGF", 1:15)
)
all_genes <- unlist(sig_sets)
meta <- data.frame(sample = paste0("S", 1:90),
                   cluster = rep(clusters, each = n_per))

expr10 <- matrix(rnorm(45 * 90, sd = 1), nrow = 45, dimnames = list(all_genes, meta$sample))
shift <- c(0, 0.7, 1.6)[match(meta$cluster, clusters)]      # C3 strongest
for (gs in c("Immune checkpoint", "Antigen processing")) {
  expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ] <- sweep(expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ], 2, shift, "+")  # shift applies per sample (column)
}
expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] <-
  expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] - 1.2

## sign-corrected PC1 score per signature (the reference workflow's core step)
score_of <- function(gs) {
  m <- expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], , drop = FALSE]
  pc <- prcomp(t(m), retx = TRUE)
  pc$x[, 1] * sign(cor(pc$x[, 1], colMeans(m)))
}
scores <- sapply(names(sig_sets), score_of)

long10 <- data.frame(sample = meta$sample, cluster = meta$cluster, scores) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(sample, cluster), names_to = "Signature", values_to = "Score") |>
  mutate(Score = as.numeric(scale(Score)))

ggplot(long10, aes(Signature, Score, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
  stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif", method = "kruskal.test") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E31A1C", "#E7B800", "#2E9FDF")) +
  labs(y = "Signature score (scaled)", fill = "TME cluster") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

set.seed(404)
clusters <- c("C1", "C2", "C3")
n_per <- 30
sig_sets <- list(
  `Immune checkpoint` = paste0("ICG", 1:15),
  `Antigen processing` = paste0("APM", 1:15),
  `TGF-beta response` = paste0("TGF", 1:15)
)
all_genes <- unlist(sig_sets)
meta <- data.frame(sample = paste0("S", 1:90),
                   cluster = rep(clusters, each = n_per))

expr10 <- matrix(rnorm(45 * 90, sd = 1), nrow = 45, dimnames = list(all_genes, meta$sample))
shift <- c(0, 0.7, 1.6)[match(meta$cluster, clusters)]      # C3 strongest
for (gs in c("Immune checkpoint", "Antigen processing")) {
  expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ] <- sweep(expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ], 2, shift, "+")  # shift applies per sample (column)
}
expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] <-
  expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] - 1.2

## sign-corrected PC1 score per signature (the reference workflow's core step)
score_of <- function(gs) {
  m <- expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], , drop = FALSE]
  pc <- prcomp(t(m), retx = TRUE)
  pc$x[, 1] * sign(cor(pc$x[, 1], colMeans(m)))
}
scores <- sapply(names(sig_sets), score_of)

  pivot_longer(-c(sample, cluster), names_to = "Signature", values_to = "Score") |>
  mutate(Score = as.numeric(scale(Score)))

  eff <- if (g %in% c(2, 5)) c(0, 1.5, 3) else c(0, 0, 0)  # stage-dependent genes
  rnorm(30, mean = 3 + eff[stage], sd = 0.8)
})

  pivot_longer(-stage, names_to = "gene", values_to = "expr")

  p <- summary(aov(expr ~ stage, data = subset(long9, gene == g)))[[1]]$"Pr(>F)"[1]
  data.frame(gene = g,
             label = paste0("ANOVA p ",
                            ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", p)), " ",
                            cut(p, c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
                                labels = c("***", "**", "*", ""))))
}))

  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +

set.seed(404)
clusters <- c("C1", "C2", "C3")
n_per <- 30
sig_sets <- list(
  `Immune checkpoint` = paste0("ICG", 1:15),
  `Antigen processing` = paste0("APM", 1:15),
  `TGF-beta response` = paste0("TGF", 1:15)
)
all_genes <- unlist(sig_sets)
meta <- data.frame(sample = paste0("S", 1:90),
                   cluster = rep(clusters, each = n_per))

expr10 <- matrix(rnorm(45 * 90, sd = 1), nrow = 45, dimnames = list(all_genes, meta$sample))
shift <- c(0, 0.7, 1.6)[match(meta$cluster, clusters)]      # C3 strongest
for (gs in c("Immune checkpoint", "Antigen processing")) {
  expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ] <- sweep(expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ], 2, shift, "+")  # shift applies per sample (column)
}
expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] <-
  expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] - 1.2

## sign-corrected PC1 score per signature (the reference workflow's core step)
score_of <- function(gs) {
  m <- expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], , drop = FALSE]
  pc <- prcomp(t(m), retx = TRUE)
  pc$x[, 1] * sign(cor(pc$x[, 1], colMeans(m)))
}
scores <- sapply(names(sig_sets), score_of)

long10 <- data.frame(sample = meta$sample, cluster = meta$cluster, scores) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(sample, cluster), names_to = "Signature", values_to = "Score") |>
  mutate(Score = as.numeric(scale(Score)))

ggplot(long10, aes(Signature, Score, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
  stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif", method = "kruskal.test") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E31A1C", "#E7B800", "#2E9FDF")) +
  labs(y = "Signature score (scaled)", fill = "TME cluster") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

set.seed(404)
clusters <- c("C1", "C2", "C3")
n_per <- 30
sig_sets <- list(
  `Immune checkpoint` = paste0("ICG", 1:15),
  `Antigen processing` = paste0("APM", 1:15),
  `TGF-beta response` = paste0("TGF", 1:15)
)
all_genes <- unlist(sig_sets)
meta <- data.frame(sample = paste0("S", 1:90),
                   cluster = rep(clusters, each = n_per))

expr10 <- matrix(rnorm(45 * 90, sd = 1), nrow = 45, dimnames = list(all_genes, meta$sample))
shift <- c(0, 0.7, 1.6)[match(meta$cluster, clusters)]      # C3 strongest
for (gs in c("Immune checkpoint", "Antigen processing")) {
  expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ] <- sweep(expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ], 2, shift, "+")  # shift applies per sample (column)
}
expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] <-
  expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] - 1.2

## sign-corrected PC1 score per signature (the reference workflow's core step)
score_of <- function(gs) {
  m <- expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], , drop = FALSE]
  pc <- prcomp(t(m), retx = TRUE)
  pc$x[, 1] * sign(cor(pc$x[, 1], colMeans(m)))
}
scores <- sapply(names(sig_sets), score_of)

long10 <- data.frame(sample = meta$sample, cluster = meta$cluster, scores) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(sample, cluster), names_to = "Signature", values_to = "Score") |>
  mutate(Score = as.numeric(scale(Score)))

ggplot(long10, aes(Signature, Score, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
  stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif", method = "kruskal.test") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E31A1C", "#E7B800", "#2E9FDF")) +
  labs(y = "Signature score (scaled)", fill = "TME cluster") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

data("iris")

# Load the TCGA-LIHC gene expression dataset from a processed CSV file  
TCGA_gene_expression <- read.csv("files/cos/TCGA-LIHC.star_fpkm_processed.csv")

  mutate(T = as.factor(T))

#Prepare Statistics data
data_summary <- function(data, varname, groupnames) {
  summary_func <- function(x, col) {
    c(mean = mean(x[[col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(x[[col]], na.rm = TRUE))
  }
  data_sum <- ddply(data, groupnames, .fun = summary_func, varname)
  
  data_sum <- rename_with(data_sum, ~ varname, "mean")
  
  return(data_sum)
}
iris_sum <- data_summary(iris, varname="Sepal.Length", groupnames="Species")
TCGA_gene_sum <- data_summary(TCGA_gene_expression, varname="gene_expression", groupnames="sample")
p1 <- beeswarm(iris$Sepal.Length)

TCGA_gene_expression_RAB4B <- subset(TCGA_gene_expression, sample == "RAB4B")
p1_2 <- beeswarm(TCGA_gene_expression_RAB4B$gene_expression)
p2 <- beeswarm(TCGA_clinic$OS.time, horizontal=TRUE)

p3_1 <- beeswarm(iris$Sepal.Length,col= "blue",pch=16,
         cex=1.5,method="center" )

p3_2 <- beeswarm(TCGA_clinic$OS.time,col= "blue",pch=16,
         cex=1.5,method="center" )

p4_1 <- beeswarm( Sepal.Length ~ Species, data=iris, 
         col=c("orange", "lightblue", "magenta"), pch =19)

p4_2 <- beeswarm(OS.time ~ T, data=TCGA_clinic, 
         col=c("orange", "lightblue", "magenta"), pch =19)

p5_1 <- beeswarm( Sepal.Length ~ Species, data=iris,
         col=c("orange", "lightblue", "magenta"), pch =19,corral ="gutter")

p5_2 <- beeswarm( OS.time ~ T, data=TCGA_clinic, 
         col=c("orange", "lightblue", "magenta"), pch =15,corral = "gutter")

  geom_beeswarm()
p6_1

  geom_beeswarm()
p6_2

  geom_beeswarm()
p7_2

  geom_beeswarm(color='blue') +    
  theme_minimal()
p8_1

  geom_beeswarm(color='blue') +    
  theme_minimal()
p8_2

   geom_beeswarm(method='center')
p9_1

  scale_color_manual(values=c("#999999", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9","blue")) +  
  theme_minimal()
p10_1

p11_1 <- ggplot()+
  geom_bar(iris_sum,
           mapping=aes(x=Species,y=Sepal.Length,fill=Species),

           alpha=0.5,position=position_dodge())+
  geom_errorbar(iris_sum,
                mapping=aes(x=Species,y=Sepal.Length,
                            ymin=Sepal.Length-sd,

 geom_errorbar(TCGA_gene_sum,
               mapping=aes(x=sample,y=gene_expression,
                           ymin=gene_expression-sd,ymax=gene_expression+sd),

 geom_beeswarm(TCGA_gene_expression,
               mapping=aes(x=sample,y=gene_expression,fill=sample),

# Generate simulated clinical data
set.seed(123)
n <- 12  # Sample size

df <- data.frame(
  id = 1:n,
  patient = paste0("P-", sprintf("%02d", 1:n)),
  value = c(rnorm(6, 80, 15), rnorm(6, 120, 20)),  # Control group and treatment group
  group = rep(c("Control", "Treatment"), each = 6)
) %>%
  mutate(
    angle = 90 - 360 * (id - 0.5)/n,
    hjust = ifelse(angle < -90, 1, 0),
    angle = ifelse(angle < -90, angle + 180, angle)
  )

# Adding built-in datasets
data("iris")

# Basic histogram
p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(id), y = value)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = group), width = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_radial(inner.radius = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#1E88E5", "#D81B60")) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Comparison of indicators between the treatment group\nand the control group")
p1

p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(id))) +
  geom_col(aes(y = value, fill = group), width = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(y = value + 15, label = patient, angle = angle), 
            size = 3, hjust = 0.3) +
  coord_radial(start = -0.05 * pi) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#004D40", "#FFA000")) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(fill = "Experimental groups")

p2

p1 <- ggplot(df) +
  geom_col(aes(x = id, y = value, fill = group), width = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(50, 100, 150), 
             color = "grey80", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0.5, xend = n+0.5, y = 100, yend = 100),
               color = "#283593", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(x = id, y = value + 20, label = patient, angle = angle),
            size = 3, hjust = 0.3) +
  coord_radial(inner.radius = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_void() +
  labs(caption = "The dotted line represents the reference interval of clinical indicators") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p1

# Generate the main drawing object
p1 <-  ggplot(df) +
  geom_col(aes(x = id, y = value, fill = group), 
           width = 0.85, alpha = 0.8) +
  
  # ========== Core coordinate axis system ==========
# Main Y axis (along the 0 degree direction)
geom_segment(aes(x = 0.5, xend = 0.5, y = 0, yend = max(df$value) * 1.1),
             color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6, 
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"))) +
  
  # Y-axis scale lines (radial)
  do.call(c, lapply(c(50, 100, 150), function(yval) {
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0.5 - 0.05, xend = 0.5 + 0.05,
                     y = yval, yend = yval),
                 color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4)
  })) +  # Merge elements in a list
  
  # Y-axis tick labels (along the axis direction)
  do.call(c, lapply(c(50, 100, 150), function(yval) {
    geom_text(aes(x = 0.5 + 0.1, y = yval,
                  label = yval, angle = -90),
              color = "grey30", size = 3.5, hjust = 0)
  })) +  # Merge elements in a list
  
  # Other horizontal lines and data labels
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(50, 100, 150), 
             color = "grey80", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0.5, xend = 0.5, y = 100, yend = 100), 
               color = "#283593", linewidth = 0.8) + # Modify the end coordinates to adapt to polar coordinates
  geom_text(aes(x = id, y = value + 20, label = patient, angle = angle),
            size = 3, hjust = 0.3) +
  
  # ========== Coordinate system settings ==========

  # ========== Visual Mapping ==========

set.seed(1301)
mk_group <- function(n, r, offset) {
  age <- sample(20:70, n, replace = TRUE)
  dnam <- age * r + rnorm(n, sd = 12 * sqrt(1 - r^2)) + offset
  data.frame(age = age, dnam = pmax(dnam, 0))
}
norm <- mk_group(150, 0.90, 8)
tum <- mk_group(150, 0.55, 4)
norm$group <- "Normal"; tum$group <- "Tumour"
df_sc <- rbind(norm, tum)

test2cor <- function(x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  r1 <- cor(x1, y1); r2 <- cor(x2, y2)
  n1 <- length(x1); n2 <- length(x2)
  z1 <- atanh(r1); z2 <- atanh(r2)
  se <- sqrt(1/(n1 - 3) + 1/(n2 - 3))
  z <- (z1 - z2)/se
  p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))
  list(r1 = r1, r2 = r2, p = p)
}
cor_cmp <- test2cor(norm$age, norm$dnam, tum$age, tum$dnam)

ggplot(df_sc, aes(age, dnam, colour = group, size = abs(dnam - age))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Normal = "#2874C5", Tumour = "#B2182B")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 4), name = "|age − DNAmAge|") +
  labs(title = sprintf("Normal r = %.2f vs Tumour r = %.2f (Fisher z p %s)",
       cor_cmp$r1, cor_cmp$r2,
       ifelse(cor_cmp$p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", cor_cmp$p))),
       x = "Chronological age", y = "DNAm age", colour = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

set.seed(1301)
mk_group <- function(n, r, offset) {
  age <- sample(20:70, n, replace = TRUE)
  dnam <- age * r + rnorm(n, sd = 12 * sqrt(1 - r^2)) + offset
  data.frame(age = age, dnam = pmax(dnam, 0))
}
norm <- mk_group(150, 0.90, 8)
tum <- mk_group(150, 0.55, 4)
norm$group <- "Normal"; tum$group <- "Tumour"
df_sc <- rbind(norm, tum)

test2cor <- function(x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  r1 <- cor(x1, y1); r2 <- cor(x2, y2)
  n1 <- length(x1); n2 <- length(x2)
  z1 <- atanh(r1); z2 <- atanh(r2)
  se <- sqrt(1/(n1 - 3) + 1/(n2 - 3))
  z <- (z1 - z2)/se
  p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))
  list(r1 = r1, r2 = r2, p = p)
}
cor_cmp <- test2cor(norm$age, norm$dnam, tum$age, tum$dnam)

ggplot(df_sc, aes(age, dnam, colour = group, size = abs(dnam - age))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Normal = "#2874C5", Tumour = "#B2182B")) +

       cor_cmp$r1, cor_cmp$r2,
       ifelse(cor_cmp$p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", cor_cmp$p))),
       x = "Chronological age", y = "DNAm age", colour = NULL) +

  theme(legend.position = "top")

set.seed(1301)
mk_group <- function(n, r, offset) {
  age <- sample(20:70, n, replace = TRUE)
  dnam <- age * r + rnorm(n, sd = 12 * sqrt(1 - r^2)) + offset
  data.frame(age = age, dnam = pmax(dnam, 0))
}
norm <- mk_group(150, 0.90, 8)
tum <- mk_group(150, 0.55, 4)
norm$group <- "Normal"; tum$group <- "Tumour"
df_sc <- rbind(norm, tum)

test2cor <- function(x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  r1 <- cor(x1, y1); r2 <- cor(x2, y2)
  n1 <- length(x1); n2 <- length(x2)
  z1 <- atanh(r1); z2 <- atanh(r2)
  se <- sqrt(1/(n1 - 3) + 1/(n2 - 3))
  z <- (z1 - z2)/se
  p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))
  list(r1 = r1, r2 = r2, p = p)
}
cor_cmp <- test2cor(norm$age, norm$dnam, tum$age, tum$dnam)

ggplot(df_sc, aes(age, dnam, colour = group, size = abs(dnam - age))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Normal = "#2874C5", Tumour = "#B2182B")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 4), name = "|age − DNAmAge|") +
  labs(title = sprintf("Normal r = %.2f vs Tumour r = %.2f (Fisher z p %s)",
       cor_cmp$r1, cor_cmp$r2,
       ifelse(cor_cmp$p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", cor_cmp$p))),
       x = "Chronological age", y = "DNAm age", colour = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

mk_group <- function(n, r, offset) {
  age <- sample(20:70, n, replace = TRUE)
  dnam <- age * r + rnorm(n, sd = 12 * sqrt(1 - r^2)) + offset
  data.frame(age = age, dnam = pmax(dnam, 0))
}

test2cor <- function(x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  r1 <- cor(x1, y1); r2 <- cor(x2, y2)
  n1 <- length(x1); n2 <- length(x2)
  z1 <- atanh(r1); z2 <- atanh(r2)
  se <- sqrt(1/(n1 - 3) + 1/(n2 - 3))
  z <- (z1 - z2)/se
  p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))
  list(r1 = r1, r2 = r2, p = p)
}

n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

subtypes <- c("LumA", "LumB", "Basal")
n_per <- 20
genes <- paste0("PAM50_", sprintf("%02d", 1:50))
n_samp <- length(subtypes) * n_per
sub_lab <- factor(rep(subtypes, each = n_per), levels = subtypes)
base <- matrix(rnorm(50 * n_samp, sd = 0.6), 50, n_samp,
               dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_samp))))
sig_blocks <- list(
  LumA  = list(up = 1:10,  dn = NULL,  eff = 1.1),
  LumB  = list(up = 11:20, dn = NULL,  eff = 1.2),
  Basal = list(up = 21:30, dn = 31:40, eff = 1.3))
for (st in subtypes) {
  idx <- which(sub_lab == st)
  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
}
## proliferation genes: high in LumB only
base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] <- base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] + 1.2

## nearest-centroid classification from a training split (SSP stand-in)
train <- c(TRUE, FALSE)[rep(1:2, length.out = n_samp)]
cent <- sapply(subtypes, function(st) rowMeans(base[, train & sub_lab == st]))
pred <- apply(base[, !train], 2, function(x) {
  corrs <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(cent)), function(k) cor(x, cent[, k]))
  subtypes[which.max(corrs)] })
pred <- factor(pred, levels = subtypes)
cat("held-out accuracy:", round(mean(pred == sub_lab[!train]), 2), "\n")

sig_scores <- rbind(
  `AR score`  = colMeans(base[21:30, ]) - colMeans(base[31:40, ]),  # Basal-high
  `Prolif score` = colMeans(base[41:50, ]))                          # LumB-high
pheno <- ifelse(sig_scores["AR score", ] > 0, "AR-high", "AR-low")

## mean-centre each gene (no scaling, the reference's fold-difference scale) and clip

mat[mat > 4] <- 4; mat[mat < -4] <- -4

ar_o <- sig_scores["AR score", ord]; pro_o <- sig_scores["Prolif score", ord]

set.seed(503)
gene_r <- paste0("MMP", sprintf("%02d", 1:24))
cancer_r <- c("BRCA", "LUAD", "COAD", "STAD", "KIRC", "HNSC", "LUSC", "PRAD")
logfc_r <- matrix(rnorm(24 * 8, sd = 1.5), 24, 8,
                  dimnames = list(gene_r, cancer_r))
logfc_r[1:6, ] <- logfc_r[1:6, ] + 1.8      # up-regulated block
logfc_r[7:12, ] <- logfc_r[7:12, ] - 1.8    # down-regulated block
## explicit P-value design: strong bands significant, weak genes mostly not
p_low <- ifelse(runif(24 * 8) < 0.25, runif(24 * 8, 1e-3, 0.045),
                                       runif(24 * 8, 0.06, 0.9))
pval_r <- ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 2, runif(24 * 8, 1e-8, 1e-3),
          ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 1, runif(24 * 8, 1e-4, 0.04), p_low))
gene_type <- rep(c("Collagen-binding", "Membrane-type", "Gelatin-binding",
                   "Secreted", "Matrisome", "Other"),
                 each = 4)

## bin into 5 fold-change bands; P >= 0.05 overrides to a 6th (white) band
logfc_cat <- apply(logfc_r, 2, function(x)
  cut(x, breaks = c(-Inf, -2, -1, 1, 2, Inf),
      labels = c("< -2", "-2 - -1", "-1 - 1", "1 - 2", "> 2")))
rownames(logfc_cat) <- gene_r
logfc_cat[pval_r >= 0.05] <- "P >= 0.05"

col_cat <- c("> 2" = "#A80C3A", "1 - 2" = "#ED5E57", "-1 - 1" = "#DDD3D2",
             "-2 - -1" = "#6B9AB7", "< -2" = "#2F5B89", "P >= 0.05" = "white")

cell_fun <- function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
  dark <- logfc_cat[i, j] %in% c("> 2", "1 - 2", "< -2", "-2 - -1")
  val <- logfc_r[i, j]; if (abs(val) < 0.05) val <- 0
  grid::grid.text(sprintf("%.1f", val), x, y,
                  gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8,
                                  col = if (dark) "white" else "black"))
}

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors <- list(Cluster = c(C1 = "#B31E22", C2 = "#529B40", C3 = "#020105"))
ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         annotation_legend = FALSE,          # legends crowd out the body otherwise
         show_colnames = FALSE,              # 30 sample names would overprint
         cutree_cols = 3,
         legend_breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
         legend_labels = c("mRNA\ndown-regulation", "mRNA\nno-change", "mRNA\nup-regulation"),
         fontsize_row = 8)

  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))

n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

grades <- c("G2", "G3", "G4")
samples <- paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:60))

expr_p <- matrix(rnorm(12 * 60, sd = 0.8), 12, 60, dimnames = list(genes_p, samples))

expr_p[5:8, grade_v == "G4"] <- expr_p[5:8, grade_v == "G4"] - 1.2

## one Kruskal-Wallis per gene, BH-adjusted (the reference's cross_subtype_compr)
p_kw <- apply(expr_p, 1, function(x) kruskal.test(x ~ grade_v)$p.value)
p_adj <- p.adjust(p_kw, method = "BH")

subtypes <- c("LumA", "LumB", "Basal")

sub_lab <- factor(rep(subtypes, each = n_per), levels = subtypes)
base <- matrix(rnorm(50 * n_samp, sd = 0.6), 50, n_samp,
               dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_samp))))
sig_blocks <- list(
  LumA  = list(up = 1:10,  dn = NULL,  eff = 1.1),
  LumB  = list(up = 11:20, dn = NULL,  eff = 1.2),
  Basal = list(up = 21:30, dn = 31:40, eff = 1.3))
for (st in subtypes) {
  idx <- which(sub_lab == st)
  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
}
## proliferation genes: high in LumB only
base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] <- base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] + 1.2

## nearest-centroid classification from a training split (SSP stand-in)
train <- c(TRUE, FALSE)[rep(1:2, length.out = n_samp)]
cent <- sapply(subtypes, function(st) rowMeans(base[, train & sub_lab == st]))
pred <- apply(base[, !train], 2, function(x) {
  corrs <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(cent)), function(k) cor(x, cent[, k]))
  subtypes[which.max(corrs)] })
pred <- factor(pred, levels = subtypes)
cat("held-out accuracy:", round(mean(pred == sub_lab[!train]), 2), "\n")

  `AR score`  = colMeans(base[21:30, ]) - colMeans(base[31:40, ]),  # Basal-high
  `Prolif score` = colMeans(base[41:50, ]))                          # LumB-high

logfc_r[7:12, ] <- logfc_r[7:12, ] - 1.8    # down-regulated block
## explicit P-value design: strong bands significant, weak genes mostly not
p_low <- ifelse(runif(24 * 8) < 0.25, runif(24 * 8, 1e-3, 0.045),
                                       runif(24 * 8, 0.06, 0.9))
pval_r <- ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 2, runif(24 * 8, 1e-8, 1e-3),
          ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 1, runif(24 * 8, 1e-4, 0.04), p_low))

                   "Secreted", "Matrisome", "Other"),
                 each = 4)

logfc_cat <- apply(logfc_r, 2, function(x)
  cut(x, breaks = c(-Inf, -2, -1, 1, 2, Inf),
      labels = c("< -2", "-2 - -1", "-1 - 1", "1 - 2", "> 2")))
rownames(logfc_cat) <- gene_r

             "-2 - -1" = "#6B9AB7", "< -2" = "#2F5B89", "P >= 0.05" = "white")

  grid::grid.text(sprintf("%.1f", val), x, y,
                  gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8,

}

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up

  x0 <- j - 0.5; y0 <- i - 0.5
  if (upper) data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 0, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 1, 1))   # upper-left triangle

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors <- list(Cluster = c(C1 = "#B31E22", C2 = "#529B40", C3 = "#020105"))
ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up

         annotation_colors = ann_colors,

         show_colnames = FALSE,              # 30 sample names would overprint
         cutree_cols = 3,

         fontsize_row = 8)

genes_p <- paste0("m6A", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))
grades <- c("G2", "G3", "G4")
samples <- paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:60))
grade_v <- factor(rep(grades, each = 20), levels = grades)

expr_p <- matrix(rnorm(12 * 60, sd = 0.8), 12, 60, dimnames = list(genes_p, samples))
expr_p[1:4, grade_v == "G3"] <- expr_p[1:4, grade_v == "G3"] + 0.9
expr_p[1:4, grade_v == "G4"] <- expr_p[1:4, grade_v == "G4"] + 1.6
expr_p[5:8, grade_v == "G4"] <- expr_p[5:8, grade_v == "G4"] - 1.2

## one Kruskal-Wallis per gene, BH-adjusted (the reference's cross_subtype_compr)
p_kw <- apply(expr_p, 1, function(x) kruskal.test(x ~ grade_v)$p.value)
p_adj <- p.adjust(p_kw, method = "BH")

z_mat <- t(scale(t(expr_p)))
p_cut <- cut(p_adj, breaks = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
             labels = c("P < 0.001", "P < 0.01", "P < 0.05", "n.s."))
p_col <- c("P < 0.001" = "#B2182B", "P < 0.01" = "#EF8A62",
           "P < 0.05" = "#FDDBC7", "n.s." = "grey90")
## per-GENE p values go as a row annotation on the right (one p per gene,
## like the reference's extra p column)
row_ha_p <- rowAnnotation(`KW P (BH)` = factor(p_cut, levels = names(p_col)),
  col = list(`KW P (BH)` = p_col),
  annotation_name_side = "bottom")

grade_col <- c(G2 = "#445EAD", G3 = "#EABF00", G4 = "#B2182B")
ha_col <- HeatmapAnnotation(Grade = grade_v, col = list(Grade = grade_col),
                            show_legend = FALSE)

Heatmap(z_mat, name = "Expression (z)",
        top_annotation = ha_col, right_annotation = row_ha_p,
        col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")),
        cluster_columns = FALSE,

subtypes <- c("LumA", "LumB", "Basal")

n_samp <- length(subtypes) * n_per
sub_lab <- factor(rep(subtypes, each = n_per), levels = subtypes)
base <- matrix(rnorm(50 * n_samp, sd = 0.6), 50, n_samp,
               dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_samp))))
sig_blocks <- list(
  LumA  = list(up = 1:10,  dn = NULL,  eff = 1.1),
  LumB  = list(up = 11:20, dn = NULL,  eff = 1.2),
  Basal = list(up = 21:30, dn = 31:40, eff = 1.3))
for (st in subtypes) {
  idx <- which(sub_lab == st)
  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
}
## proliferation genes: high in LumB only
base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] <- base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] + 1.2

## nearest-centroid classification from a training split (SSP stand-in)
train <- c(TRUE, FALSE)[rep(1:2, length.out = n_samp)]
cent <- sapply(subtypes, function(st) rowMeans(base[, train & sub_lab == st]))
pred <- apply(base[, !train], 2, function(x) {
  corrs <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(cent)), function(k) cor(x, cent[, k]))
  subtypes[which.max(corrs)] })
pred <- factor(pred, levels = subtypes)
cat("held-out accuracy:", round(mean(pred == sub_lab[!train]), 2), "\n")

  `AR score`  = colMeans(base[21:30, ]) - colMeans(base[31:40, ]),  # Basal-high
  `Prolif score` = colMeans(base[41:50, ]))                          # LumB-high

## mean-centre each gene (no scaling, the reference's fold-difference scale) and clip

gene_r <- paste0("MMP", sprintf("%02d", 1:24))

                  dimnames = list(gene_r, cancer_r))
logfc_r[1:6, ] <- logfc_r[1:6, ] + 1.8      # up-regulated block
logfc_r[7:12, ] <- logfc_r[7:12, ] - 1.8    # down-regulated block
## explicit P-value design: strong bands significant, weak genes mostly not
p_low <- ifelse(runif(24 * 8) < 0.25, runif(24 * 8, 1e-3, 0.045),
                                       runif(24 * 8, 0.06, 0.9))
pval_r <- ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 2, runif(24 * 8, 1e-8, 1e-3),
          ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 1, runif(24 * 8, 1e-4, 0.04), p_low))

                   "Secreted", "Matrisome", "Other"),
                 each = 4)

## bin into 5 fold-change bands; P >= 0.05 overrides to a 6th (white) band
logfc_cat <- apply(logfc_r, 2, function(x)
  cut(x, breaks = c(-Inf, -2, -1, 1, 2, Inf),
      labels = c("< -2", "-2 - -1", "-1 - 1", "1 - 2", "> 2")))
rownames(logfc_cat) <- gene_r
logfc_cat[pval_r >= 0.05] <- "P >= 0.05"

             "-2 - -1" = "#6B9AB7", "< -2" = "#2F5B89", "P >= 0.05" = "white")

  val <- logfc_r[i, j]; if (abs(val) < 0.05) val <- 0
  grid::grid.text(sprintf("%.1f", val), x, y,
                  gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8,

}

n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")

ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors <- list(Cluster = c(C1 = "#B31E22", C2 = "#529B40", C3 = "#020105"))
ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up

         annotation_colors = ann_colors,

subtypes <- c("LumA", "LumB", "Basal")

sub_lab <- factor(rep(subtypes, each = n_per), levels = subtypes)
base <- matrix(rnorm(50 * n_samp, sd = 0.6), 50, n_samp,
               dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_samp))))
sig_blocks <- list(
  LumA  = list(up = 1:10,  dn = NULL,  eff = 1.1),
  LumB  = list(up = 11:20, dn = NULL,  eff = 1.2),
  Basal = list(up = 21:30, dn = 31:40, eff = 1.3))
for (st in subtypes) {
  idx <- which(sub_lab == st)
  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
}
## proliferation genes: high in LumB only
base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] <- base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] + 1.2

## nearest-centroid classification from a training split (SSP stand-in)
train <- c(TRUE, FALSE)[rep(1:2, length.out = n_samp)]
cent <- sapply(subtypes, function(st) rowMeans(base[, train & sub_lab == st]))
pred <- apply(base[, !train], 2, function(x) {
  corrs <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(cent)), function(k) cor(x, cent[, k]))
  subtypes[which.max(corrs)] })
pred <- factor(pred, levels = subtypes)

n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP

rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

set.seed(3110)
subtypes <- c("LumA", "LumB", "Basal")
n_per <- 20
genes <- paste0("PAM50_", sprintf("%02d", 1:50))
n_samp <- length(subtypes) * n_per
sub_lab <- factor(rep(subtypes, each = n_per), levels = subtypes)
base <- matrix(rnorm(50 * n_samp, sd = 0.6), 50, n_samp,
               dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_samp))))
sig_blocks <- list(
  LumA  = list(up = 1:10,  dn = NULL,  eff = 1.1),
  LumB  = list(up = 11:20, dn = NULL,  eff = 1.2),
  Basal = list(up = 21:30, dn = 31:40, eff = 1.3))
for (st in subtypes) {
  idx <- which(sub_lab == st)
  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
}
## proliferation genes: high in LumB only
base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] <- base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] + 1.2

## nearest-centroid classification from a training split (SSP stand-in)
train <- c(TRUE, FALSE)[rep(1:2, length.out = n_samp)]
cent <- sapply(subtypes, function(st) rowMeans(base[, train & sub_lab == st]))
pred <- apply(base[, !train], 2, function(x) {
  corrs <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(cent)), function(k) cor(x, cent[, k]))
  subtypes[which.max(corrs)] })
pred <- factor(pred, levels = subtypes)
cat("held-out accuracy:", round(mean(pred == sub_lab[!train]), 2), "\n")

sig_scores <- rbind(
  `AR score`  = colMeans(base[21:30, ]) - colMeans(base[31:40, ]),  # Basal-high
  `Prolif score` = colMeans(base[41:50, ]))                          # LumB-high
pheno <- ifelse(sig_scores["AR score", ] > 0, "AR-high", "AR-low")

## mean-centre each gene (no scaling, the reference's fold-difference scale) and clip
mat <- t(scale(t(base), center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
mat[mat > 4] <- 4; mat[mat < -4] <- -4
ord <- order(pred)
pred_o <- pred[ord]; mat_o <- mat[, ord]

ar_o <- sig_scores["AR score", ord]; pro_o <- sig_scores["Prolif score", ord]

logfc_r[7:12, ] <- logfc_r[7:12, ] - 1.8    # down-regulated block
## explicit P-value design: strong bands significant, weak genes mostly not
p_low <- ifelse(runif(24 * 8) < 0.25, runif(24 * 8, 1e-3, 0.045),
                                       runif(24 * 8, 0.06, 0.9))
pval_r <- ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 2, runif(24 * 8, 1e-8, 1e-3),
          ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 1, runif(24 * 8, 1e-4, 0.04), p_low))

                   "Secreted", "Matrisome", "Other"),
                 each = 4)

  cut(x, breaks = c(-Inf, -2, -1, 1, 2, Inf),
      labels = c("< -2", "-2 - -1", "-1 - 1", "1 - 2", "> 2")))

gene_d <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%02d", 1:10))

del <- matrix(runif(80, 0, 0.55), 10, 8, dimnames = list(gene_d, cancer_d))

del[5:10, ] <- del[5:10, ] + 0.30    # tumour-suppressor-like: deleted
amp <- pmin(amp, 0.95); del <- pmin(del, 0.95)

make_tri <- function(i, j, upper) {
  x0 <- j - 0.5; y0 <- i - 0.5
  if (upper) data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 0, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 1, 1))   # upper-left triangle
  else data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 1, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 0, 1))         # lower-right triangle
}
cells <- expand.grid(i = seq_len(10), j = seq_len(8))
tri_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(cells)), function(k) {
  i <- cells$i[k]; j <- cells$j[k]
  rbind(cbind(make_tri(i, j, TRUE),  value =  amp[i, j], id = k, tri = "up",   gi = i, cj = j),
        cbind(make_tri(i, j, FALSE), value = -del[i, j], id = k, tri = "dn",   gi = i, cj = j))
}))
tri_df$gene <- factor(gene_d[tri_df$gi], levels = rev(gene_d))
tri_df$cancer <- factor(cancer_d[tri_df$cj], levels = cancer_d)

## polygons need NUMERIC x/y — a discrete aes would collapse the vertices
ggplot(tri_df, aes(x, y, group = interaction(id, tri), fill = value)) +
  geom_polygon(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors <- list(Cluster = c(C1 = "#B31E22", C2 = "#529B40", C3 = "#020105"))
ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up

  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))

n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

set.seed(3110)
subtypes <- c("LumA", "LumB", "Basal")
n_per <- 20
genes <- paste0("PAM50_", sprintf("%02d", 1:50))
n_samp <- length(subtypes) * n_per
sub_lab <- factor(rep(subtypes, each = n_per), levels = subtypes)
base <- matrix(rnorm(50 * n_samp, sd = 0.6), 50, n_samp,
               dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_samp))))
sig_blocks <- list(
  LumA  = list(up = 1:10,  dn = NULL,  eff = 1.1),
  LumB  = list(up = 11:20, dn = NULL,  eff = 1.2),
  Basal = list(up = 21:30, dn = 31:40, eff = 1.3))
for (st in subtypes) {
  idx <- which(sub_lab == st)
  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
}
## proliferation genes: high in LumB only
base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] <- base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] + 1.2

## nearest-centroid classification from a training split (SSP stand-in)
train <- c(TRUE, FALSE)[rep(1:2, length.out = n_samp)]
cent <- sapply(subtypes, function(st) rowMeans(base[, train & sub_lab == st]))
pred <- apply(base[, !train], 2, function(x) {
  corrs <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(cent)), function(k) cor(x, cent[, k]))
  subtypes[which.max(corrs)] })
pred <- factor(pred, levels = subtypes)
cat("held-out accuracy:", round(mean(pred == sub_lab[!train]), 2), "\n")

sig_scores <- rbind(
  `AR score`  = colMeans(base[21:30, ]) - colMeans(base[31:40, ]),  # Basal-high
  `Prolif score` = colMeans(base[41:50, ]))                          # LumB-high
pheno <- ifelse(sig_scores["AR score", ] > 0, "AR-high", "AR-low")

## mean-centre each gene (no scaling, the reference's fold-difference scale) and clip
mat <- t(scale(t(base), center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
mat[mat > 4] <- 4; mat[mat < -4] <- -4
ord <- order(pred)
pred_o <- pred[ord]; mat_o <- mat[, ord]
pheno_o <- factor(pheno[ord], levels = c("AR-low", "AR-high"))
ar_o <- sig_scores["AR score", ord]; pro_o <- sig_scores["Prolif score", ord]

set.seed(503)
gene_r <- paste0("MMP", sprintf("%02d", 1:24))
cancer_r <- c("BRCA", "LUAD", "COAD", "STAD", "KIRC", "HNSC", "LUSC", "PRAD")
logfc_r <- matrix(rnorm(24 * 8, sd = 1.5), 24, 8,
                  dimnames = list(gene_r, cancer_r))
logfc_r[1:6, ] <- logfc_r[1:6, ] + 1.8      # up-regulated block
logfc_r[7:12, ] <- logfc_r[7:12, ] - 1.8    # down-regulated block
## explicit P-value design: strong bands significant, weak genes mostly not
p_low <- ifelse(runif(24 * 8) < 0.25, runif(24 * 8, 1e-3, 0.045),
                                       runif(24 * 8, 0.06, 0.9))
pval_r <- ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 2, runif(24 * 8, 1e-8, 1e-3),
          ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 1, runif(24 * 8, 1e-4, 0.04), p_low))
gene_type <- rep(c("Collagen-binding", "Membrane-type", "Gelatin-binding",
                   "Secreted", "Matrisome", "Other"),
                 each = 4)

## bin into 5 fold-change bands; P >= 0.05 overrides to a 6th (white) band
logfc_cat <- apply(logfc_r, 2, function(x)
  cut(x, breaks = c(-Inf, -2, -1, 1, 2, Inf),
      labels = c("< -2", "-2 - -1", "-1 - 1", "1 - 2", "> 2")))
rownames(logfc_cat) <- gene_r
logfc_cat[pval_r >= 0.05] <- "P >= 0.05"

col_cat <- c("> 2" = "#A80C3A", "1 - 2" = "#ED5E57", "-1 - 1" = "#DDD3D2",
             "-2 - -1" = "#6B9AB7", "< -2" = "#2F5B89", "P >= 0.05" = "white")

cell_fun <- function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
  dark <- logfc_cat[i, j] %in% c("> 2", "1 - 2", "< -2", "-2 - -1")
  val <- logfc_r[i, j]; if (abs(val) < 0.05) val <- 0
  grid::grid.text(sprintf("%.1f", val), x, y,
                  gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8,
                                  col = if (dark) "white" else "black"))
}

del[5:10, ] <- del[5:10, ] + 0.30    # tumour-suppressor-like: deleted

make_tri <- function(i, j, upper) {
  x0 <- j - 0.5; y0 <- i - 0.5
  if (upper) data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 0, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 1, 1))   # upper-left triangle
  else data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 1, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 0, 1))         # lower-right triangle
}

  i <- cells$i[k]; j <- cells$j[k]
  rbind(cbind(make_tri(i, j, TRUE),  value =  amp[i, j], id = k, tri = "up",   gi = i, cj = j),
        cbind(make_tri(i, j, FALSE), value = -del[i, j], id = k, tri = "dn",   gi = i, cj = j))
}))

tri_df$cancer <- factor(cancer_d[tri_df$cj], levels = cancer_d)

n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20

normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")

                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors <- list(Cluster = c(C1 = "#B31E22", C2 = "#529B40", C3 = "#020105"))
ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,

         show_colnames = FALSE,              # 30 sample names would overprint
         cutree_cols = 3,
         legend_breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
         legend_labels = c("mRNA\ndown-regulation", "mRNA\nno-change", "mRNA\nup-regulation"),
         fontsize_row = 8)
