target <- rnorm(n_sam)                                   # target gene (TIM-3-like) expression
subtype <- factor(sample(c("Classical", "Mesenchymal", "Neural", "Proneural"), n_sam, TRUE))
idh     <- factor(sample(c("WT", "Mutant"), n_sam, TRUE, prob = c(0.6, 0.4)))

mat <- matrix(rnorm(299 * n_sam), nrow = 299,
              dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", seq_len(n_sam))))
# Simulate biology: 15 genes co-vary with the target, 10 vary in opposition
pos_seed <- sample(genes, 15)
neg_seed <- sample(setdiff(genes, pos_seed), 10)
mat[pos_seed, ] <- mat[pos_seed, ] + outer(rep(1, 15), target) * 0.9
mat[neg_seed, ] <- mat[neg_seed, ] - outer(rep(1, 10), target) * 0.9
mat <- rbind(mat, "TARGET" = target)                     # add the target gene row

# Genes correlated with the target: top-15 positive, top-10 negative
cors      <- cor(t(mat[genes, ]), mat["TARGET", ])
pos_genes <- names(sort(cors[, 1], decreasing = TRUE))[1:15]
neg_genes <- names(sort(cors[, 1], decreasing = FALSE))[1:10]

sel  <- c(pos_genes, neg_genes)                          # rows: positive block first
mat_sel <- t(scale(t(mat[sel, ])))                       # row-wise z-score
mat_sel[mat_sel >  3] <-  3
mat_sel[mat_sel < -3] <- -3
ord    <- order(mat["TARGET", ])                         # columns ordered by the target gene
mat_sel <- mat_sel[, ord]

col_fun    <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-3, 0, 3), c("#6699CC", "white", "#FF3C38"))
target_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b"))

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Target expression` = mat["TARGET", ord],
  Subtype = droplevels(subtype)[ord],
  IDH     = idh[ord],
  col = list(`Target expression` = target_fun,
             Subtype = c(Classical = "#CEDC7C", Mesenchymal = "#EA6767",
                         Neural = "#F7C07C", Proneural = "#445EAD"),
             IDH = c(WT = "#EA6767", Mutant = "#70C17A")))

Heatmap(mat_sel, name = "Z-score", top_annotation = ha,
        col = col_fun,
        cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,   # keep the target-gene gradient
        row_split = factor(rep(c("Positively correlated", "Negatively correlated"),
                               c(length(pos_genes), length(neg_genes)))),
        border = TRUE)

set.seed(5101)
clusters <- c("T", "B", "Mye", "NK")
n_clust <- length(clusters); n_genes_per <- 6
genes <- c(paste0("T_M", 1:n_genes_per), paste0("B_M", 1:n_genes_per),
           paste0("M_M", 1:n_genes_per), paste0("NK_M", 1:n_genes_per))
# cluster-mean marker expression: each marker set peaks only in its own cluster
avg <- matrix(rnorm(length(genes) * n_clust, sd = 0.4), nrow = length(genes),
              dimnames = list(genes, clusters))
for (k in 1:n_clust) {
  idx <- ((k - 1) * n_genes_per + 1):(k * n_genes_per)
  avg[idx, k] <- avg[idx, k] + 2.5
}
clip_scale <- function(x, lo = -2, hi = 2)
  matrix(pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi), nrow = nrow(x), dimnames = dimnames(x))
# per-gene z-score, clipped to +-2 so one loud gene cannot saturate the scale
ph_data <- clip_scale(t(scale(t(avg))))

ann <- data.frame(cluster = rep(clusters, each = n_genes_per))
cl_cols <- setNames(c("#B2182B", "#2166AC", "#EABF00", "#4D9342"), clusters)
hm <- ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(ph_data,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "white", "red3"))(99),
  scale = "none", cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
  clustering_method = "complete", show_rownames = FALSE,
  annotation_row = ann, annotation_colors = list(cluster = cl_cols),
  border_color = NA)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(hm)

# the simulated marker blocks must each peak in their own cluster (diagonal)
diag_hits <- sapply(1:n_clust, function(k) {
  idx <- ((k - 1) * n_genes_per + 1):(k * n_genes_per)
  all(apply(avg[idx, , drop = FALSE], 1, which.max) == k)
})
stopifnot(sum(diag_hits) == n_clust)

mat[neg_seed, ] <- mat[neg_seed, ] - outer(rep(1, 10), target) * 0.9

set.seed(11)
mk_enrich <- function(prefix, n) {
  data.frame(
    Term = sprintf("%s pathway %d", prefix, 1:n),
    PValue = 10^(-runif(n, 1.3, 6)),
    Count = sample(5:60, n),
    Pop.Hits = sample(80:200, n)
  )
}
enrich <- rbind(cbind(direction = "Down", mk_enrich("Down", 8)),
                cbind(direction = "Up",   mk_enrich("Up", 8)))
enrich$GeneRatio <- enrich$Pop.Hits / enrich$Count

enrich_bubble <- function(dat, legend_pos, term_side = "left") {
  dat <- dat[order(dat$GeneRatio), ]
  dat$Term <- factor(dat$Term, levels = dat$Term)      # keep the sorted order
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(GeneRatio, Term, colour = PValue)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = Count)) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10)) +
    scale_color_gradientn(colours = c("red", "yellow")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    ylab(NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = legend_pos, legend.justification = legend_pos,
          legend.background = element_blank(), legend.key = element_blank())
  if (term_side == "right") p <- p + scale_y_discrete(position = "right")
  p
}

p_down <- enrich_bubble(subset(enrich, direction == "Down"), "bottom")
p_up   <- enrich_bubble(subset(enrich, direction == "Up"),   "bottom", term_side = "right")

plot_grid(p_down, p_up, labels = c("Down-regulated", "Up-regulated"),
          label_x = 0.02, hjust = 0)

library(patchwork)
set.seed(6101)
subtypes <- c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4")
n_cell <- 120
cls <- rep(subtypes, each = n_cell / 4)
prog <- as.numeric(factor(cls, levels = subtypes))      # differentiation score 1..4
base_genes <- paste0("G", sprintf("%03d", 1:40))
mark_up <- c("ZP1", "BMP15", "GDF9")   # folliculogenesis genes rising with C1 -> C4
mark_dn <- c("WEE2", "AURKA", "DNMT3A")  # meiosis/methylation genes falling along it
genes <- c(base_genes, mark_up, mark_dn)
mu <- matrix(rnorm(length(genes) * n_cell, sd = 0.5), nrow = length(genes),
             dimnames = list(genes, paste0("cell", 1:n_cell)))
# 标记基因随发育梯度变化：整个矩阵即是
for (g in mark_up) mu[g, ] <- mu[g, ] + 3.6 * (prog / max(prog))
for (g in mark_dn) mu[g, ] <- mu[g, ] - 3.6 * (prog / max(prog))
pc <- prcomp(t(mu), scale. = TRUE)
score <- pc$x[, 1]; load1 <- pc$rotation[, 1]
# 主成分轴的符号是任意的：调向使上调组占据正载荷一侧
if (mean(load1[mark_up]) < mean(load1[mark_dn])) { load1 <- -load1; score <- -score }
stopifnot(min(load1[mark_up]) > max(load1[mark_dn]))
var_pct <- round(pc$sdev^2 / sum(pc$sdev^2) * 100, 1)
df_cells <- data.frame(PC1 = score, PC2 = pc$x[, 2], subtype = cls)
p_a <- ggplot(df_cells, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = subtype)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(C1 = "#8E3189", C2 = "#4C72B4", C3 = "#85B846", C4 = "#C64941")) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var_pct[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", var_pct[2], "%)")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
df_genes <- rbind(data.frame(gene = mark_up, load = load1[mark_up], set = "up"),
                  data.frame(gene = mark_dn, load = load1[mark_dn], set = "down"))
p_b <- ggplot(df_genes, aes(load, reorder(gene, load))) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = 0), colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = set), size = 3.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(up = "#B2182B", down = "#2166AC"), guide = "none") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "PC1 loading", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
print(p_a + p_b + plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect"))

library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)
set.seed(6201)
n_s <- 96
lab4 <- c("G1", "G2", "G3", "G4")
grp <- rep(lab4, each = n_s / 4)
n_feat <- 32
mat <- matrix(rnorm(n_feat * n_s, sd = 0.65), nrow = n_feat,
              dimnames = list(paste0("Gene", 1:n_feat), NULL))
# 每个真实簇携带一个高表达标记块 -> 簇间分离干净可审
for (k in 1:4) {
  blk <- ((k - 1) * 8 + 1):(k * 8)          # eight-gene marker block per cluster
  mat[blk, grp == lab4[k]] <- mat[blk, grp == lab4[k]] + 3.2
}
set.seed(6202)
km <- kmeans(t(mat), centers = 4, nstart = 25)   # k-means clusters the rows of x
pa <- prcomp(t(mat), scale. = TRUE)
dat <- data.frame(PC1 = pa$x[, 1], PC2 = pa$x[, 2],
                  cluster = factor(paste0("C", km$cluster), levels = paste0("C", 1:4)),
                  rownames = sprintf("S%02d", 1:n_s))
# 可恢复性门槛：每个真实组的多数成员须落入同一簇
tb <- table(grp, dat$cluster)
hit <- sum(tb[cbind(seq_len(nrow(tb)), apply(tb, 1, which.max))])
stopifnot(hit / n_s >= 0.90)
var1 <- round(pa$sdev[1]^2 / sum(pa$sdev^2) * 100, 1)
var2 <- round(pa$sdev[2]^2 / sum(pa$sdev^2) * 100, 1)
hull_rows <- list()
for (k in levels(dat$cluster)) {
  d <- dat[dat$cluster == k, ]
  hi <- chull(d$PC1, d$PC2)                 # base grDevices function
  hull_rows[[k]] <- data.frame(PC1 = d$PC1[hi], PC2 = d$PC2[hi],
                               cluster = factor(k, levels = levels(dat$cluster)))
}
hulls <- do.call(rbind, hull_rows)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(c(hulls$PC1, hulls$PC2))) && nrow(hulls) >= 12)
tag <- dat[!duplicated(dat$cluster), ]       # one labelled representative per cluster
tag <- tag[order(as.numeric(factor(tag$cluster))), ]
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls, aes(PC1, PC2, group = cluster, fill = cluster),
               alpha = 0.22, colour = NA) +
  geom_point(data = dat, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = cluster), size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(data = tag, aes(PC1, PC2, label = rownames),
                  size = 2.4, force = 2, max.iter = 200) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(C1 = "#B2182B", C2 = "#2166AC", C3 = "#4D9342", C4 = "#EABF00")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(C1 = "#8A1B24", C2 = "#174A85", C3 = "#2F6B28", C4 = "#9E7E00")) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var1, "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", var2, "%)"),
       title = "K-means groups on the PCA plane, hull = empirical partition") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.title = element_blank())

set.seed(3801)
grp2 <- factor(rep(c("BRCA", "OV", "LUSC"), each = 20))
expr_pg <- matrix(rnorm(30 * 60, 5, 1), 60, 30)
expr_pg[grp2 == "BRCA", 1:2] <- expr_pg[grp2 == "BRCA", 1:2] + 2.4
expr_pg[grp2 == "OV", 3:4] <- expr_pg[grp2 == "OV", 3:4] + 2.2
expr_pg[grp2 == "LUSC", 5] <- expr_pg[grp2 == "LUSC", 5] + 2.0
colnames(expr_pg) <- c("GATA3", "XBP1", "MUC1", "FOLR1", "KRT17",
                       paste0("G", sprintf("%02d", 6:30)))
pca_pg <- prcomp(expr_pg, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
pv_pg <- summary(pca_pg)$importance[2, ]
contrib <- rowSums(abs(pca_pg$rotation[, 1:2]) * pv_pg[1:2])
top_genes <- names(sort(contrib, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
scores_pg <- as.data.frame(pca_pg$x[, 1:2])
scores_pg$grp <- grp2

## nested covariance ellipses at two coverage levels
ell <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0.9, 0.95), function(pro) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(grp2), function(g) {
    d <- scores_pg[scores_pg$grp == g, 1:2]
    ctr <- colMeans(d); eg <- eigen(cov(d))
    ang <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 120)
    r <- sqrt(qchisq(pro, df = 2))
    data.frame(
      x = ctr[1] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[1, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[1, 2]),
      y = ctr[2] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[2, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[2, 2]),
      grp = g, pro = pro)
  }))
}))

load_top <- pca_pg$rotation[top_genes, 1:2]
load_top <- load_top / apply(abs(load_top), 1, max) * sc_arrow

ggplot(scores_pg, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = grp)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_path(data = ell, aes(x, y, colour = grp, linetype = factor(pro)),

  geom_segment(data = as.data.frame(load_top),

# 每个真实簇携带一个高表达标记块 -> 簇间分离干净可审
for (k in 1:4) {
  blk <- ((k - 1) * 8 + 1):(k * 8)          # eight-gene marker block per cluster
  mat[blk, grp == lab4[k]] <- mat[blk, grp == lab4[k]] + 3.2
}
set.seed(6202)
km <- kmeans(t(mat), centers = 4, nstart = 25)   # k-means clusters the rows of x
pa <- prcomp(t(mat), scale. = TRUE)
dat <- data.frame(PC1 = pa$x[, 1], PC2 = pa$x[, 2],
                  cluster = factor(paste0("C", km$cluster), levels = paste0("C", 1:4)),
                  rownames = sprintf("S%02d", 1:n_s))
# 可恢复性门槛：每个真实组的多数成员须落入同一簇
tb <- table(grp, dat$cluster)
hit <- sum(tb[cbind(seq_len(nrow(tb)), apply(tb, 1, which.max))])
stopifnot(hit / n_s >= 0.90)
var1 <- round(pa$sdev[1]^2 / sum(pa$sdev^2) * 100, 1)
var2 <- round(pa$sdev[2]^2 / sum(pa$sdev^2) * 100, 1)
hull_rows <- list()
for (k in levels(dat$cluster)) {
  d <- dat[dat$cluster == k, ]
  hi <- chull(d$PC1, d$PC2)                 # base grDevices function
  hull_rows[[k]] <- data.frame(PC1 = d$PC1[hi], PC2 = d$PC2[hi],
                               cluster = factor(k, levels = levels(dat$cluster)))
}
hulls <- do.call(rbind, hull_rows)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(c(hulls$PC1, hulls$PC2))) && nrow(hulls) >= 12)
tag <- dat[!duplicated(dat$cluster), ]       # one labelled representative per cluster
tag <- tag[order(as.numeric(factor(tag$cluster))), ]

  geom_polygon(data = hulls, aes(PC1, PC2, group = cluster, fill = cluster),
               alpha = 0.22, colour = NA) +

expr_pg[grp2 == "OV", 3:4] <- expr_pg[grp2 == "OV", 3:4] + 2.2
expr_pg[grp2 == "LUSC", 5] <- expr_pg[grp2 == "LUSC", 5] + 2.0
colnames(expr_pg) <- c("GATA3", "XBP1", "MUC1", "FOLR1", "KRT17",
                       paste0("G", sprintf("%02d", 6:30)))
pca_pg <- prcomp(expr_pg, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
pv_pg <- summary(pca_pg)$importance[2, ]
contrib <- rowSums(abs(pca_pg$rotation[, 1:2]) * pv_pg[1:2])
top_genes <- names(sort(contrib, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
scores_pg <- as.data.frame(pca_pg$x[, 1:2])
scores_pg$grp <- grp2

## nested covariance ellipses at two coverage levels
ell <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0.9, 0.95), function(pro) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(grp2), function(g) {
    d <- scores_pg[scores_pg$grp == g, 1:2]
    ctr <- colMeans(d); eg <- eigen(cov(d))
    ang <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 120)
    r <- sqrt(qchisq(pro, df = 2))
    data.frame(
      x = ctr[1] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[1, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[1, 2]),
      y = ctr[2] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[2, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[2, 2]),
      grp = g, pro = pro)
  }))
}))

mark_up <- c("ZP1", "BMP15", "GDF9")   # folliculogenesis genes rising with C1 -> C4
mark_dn <- c("WEE2", "AURKA", "DNMT3A")  # meiosis/methylation genes falling along it

mu <- matrix(rnorm(length(genes) * n_cell, sd = 0.5), nrow = length(genes),
             dimnames = list(genes, paste0("cell", 1:n_cell)))
# 标记基因随发育梯度变化：整个矩阵即是
for (g in mark_up) mu[g, ] <- mu[g, ] + 3.6 * (prog / max(prog))
for (g in mark_dn) mu[g, ] <- mu[g, ] - 3.6 * (prog / max(prog))

# 主成分轴的符号是任意的：调向使上调组占据正载荷一侧
if (mean(load1[mark_up]) < mean(load1[mark_dn])) { load1 <- -load1; score <- -score }
stopifnot(min(load1[mark_up]) > max(load1[mark_dn]))

library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)
set.seed(6201)
n_s <- 96
lab4 <- c("G1", "G2", "G3", "G4")
grp <- rep(lab4, each = n_s / 4)
n_feat <- 32
mat <- matrix(rnorm(n_feat * n_s, sd = 0.65), nrow = n_feat,
              dimnames = list(paste0("Gene", 1:n_feat), NULL))
# 每个真实簇携带一个高表达标记块 -> 簇间分离干净可审
for (k in 1:4) {
  blk <- ((k - 1) * 8 + 1):(k * 8)          # eight-gene marker block per cluster
  mat[blk, grp == lab4[k]] <- mat[blk, grp == lab4[k]] + 3.2
}
set.seed(6202)
km <- kmeans(t(mat), centers = 4, nstart = 25)   # k-means clusters the rows of x
pa <- prcomp(t(mat), scale. = TRUE)
dat <- data.frame(PC1 = pa$x[, 1], PC2 = pa$x[, 2],
                  cluster = factor(paste0("C", km$cluster), levels = paste0("C", 1:4)),
                  rownames = sprintf("S%02d", 1:n_s))
# 可恢复性门槛：每个真实组的多数成员须落入同一簇
tb <- table(grp, dat$cluster)
hit <- sum(tb[cbind(seq_len(nrow(tb)), apply(tb, 1, which.max))])
stopifnot(hit / n_s >= 0.90)
var1 <- round(pa$sdev[1]^2 / sum(pa$sdev^2) * 100, 1)
var2 <- round(pa$sdev[2]^2 / sum(pa$sdev^2) * 100, 1)
hull_rows <- list()
for (k in levels(dat$cluster)) {
  d <- dat[dat$cluster == k, ]
  hi <- chull(d$PC1, d$PC2)                 # base grDevices function
  hull_rows[[k]] <- data.frame(PC1 = d$PC1[hi], PC2 = d$PC2[hi],
                               cluster = factor(k, levels = levels(dat$cluster)))
}
hulls <- do.call(rbind, hull_rows)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(c(hulls$PC1, hulls$PC2))) && nrow(hulls) >= 12)
tag <- dat[!duplicated(dat$cluster), ]       # one labelled representative per cluster
tag <- tag[order(as.numeric(factor(tag$cluster))), ]
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls, aes(PC1, PC2, group = cluster, fill = cluster),
               alpha = 0.22, colour = NA) +
  geom_point(data = dat, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = cluster), size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(data = tag, aes(PC1, PC2, label = rownames),
                  size = 2.4, force = 2, max.iter = 200) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(C1 = "#B2182B", C2 = "#2166AC", C3 = "#4D9342", C4 = "#EABF00")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(C1 = "#8A1B24", C2 = "#174A85", C3 = "#2F6B28", C4 = "#9E7E00")) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var1, "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", var2, "%)"),
       title = "K-means groups on the PCA plane, hull = empirical partition") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.title = element_blank())

set.seed(3801)
grp2 <- factor(rep(c("BRCA", "OV", "LUSC"), each = 20))
expr_pg <- matrix(rnorm(30 * 60, 5, 1), 60, 30)

expr_pg[grp2 == "OV", 3:4] <- expr_pg[grp2 == "OV", 3:4] + 2.2
expr_pg[grp2 == "LUSC", 5] <- expr_pg[grp2 == "LUSC", 5] + 2.0
colnames(expr_pg) <- c("GATA3", "XBP1", "MUC1", "FOLR1", "KRT17",
                       paste0("G", sprintf("%02d", 6:30)))
pca_pg <- prcomp(expr_pg, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
pv_pg <- summary(pca_pg)$importance[2, ]
contrib <- rowSums(abs(pca_pg$rotation[, 1:2]) * pv_pg[1:2])
top_genes <- names(sort(contrib, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
scores_pg <- as.data.frame(pca_pg$x[, 1:2])
scores_pg$grp <- grp2

## nested covariance ellipses at two coverage levels
ell <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0.9, 0.95), function(pro) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(grp2), function(g) {
    d <- scores_pg[scores_pg$grp == g, 1:2]
    ctr <- colMeans(d); eg <- eigen(cov(d))
    ang <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 120)
    r <- sqrt(qchisq(pro, df = 2))
    data.frame(
      x = ctr[1] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[1, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[1, 2]),
      y = ctr[2] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[2, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[2, 2]),
      grp = g, pro = pro)
  }))
}))

sc_arrow <- max(abs(scores_pg[, 1:2])) * 0.32
load_top <- pca_pg$rotation[top_genes, 1:2]
load_top <- load_top / apply(abs(load_top), 1, max) * sc_arrow

ggplot(scores_pg, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = grp)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_path(data = ell, aes(x, y, colour = grp, linetype = factor(pro)),
            linewidth = 0.6, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = as.data.frame(load_top),
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.14, "cm")),
               colour = "brown", linewidth = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = as.data.frame(load_top),
            aes(x = PC1 * 1.15, y = PC2 * 1.15, label = top_genes),
            colour = "brown", size = 3.4, fontface = "bold", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("0.9" = 2, "0.95" = 1), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.0f%%)", 100 * pv_pg[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.0f%%)", 100 * pv_pg[2]),
       title = "PCA with top-3 loading arrows and 90/95% ellipses",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

pca_pg <- prcomp(expr_pg, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
pv_pg <- summary(pca_pg)$importance[2, ]
contrib <- rowSums(abs(pca_pg$rotation[, 1:2]) * pv_pg[1:2])
top_genes <- names(sort(contrib, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
scores_pg <- as.data.frame(pca_pg$x[, 1:2])
scores_pg$grp <- grp2

## nested covariance ellipses at two coverage levels
ell <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0.9, 0.95), function(pro) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(grp2), function(g) {
    d <- scores_pg[scores_pg$grp == g, 1:2]
    ctr <- colMeans(d); eg <- eigen(cov(d))
    ang <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 120)
    r <- sqrt(qchisq(pro, df = 2))
    data.frame(
      x = ctr[1] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[1, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[1, 2]),
      y = ctr[2] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[2, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[2, 2]),
      grp = g, pro = pro)
  }))
}))

sc_arrow <- max(abs(scores_pg[, 1:2])) * 0.32
load_top <- pca_pg$rotation[top_genes, 1:2]
load_top <- load_top / apply(abs(load_top), 1, max) * sc_arrow

ggplot(scores_pg, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = grp)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_path(data = ell, aes(x, y, colour = grp, linetype = factor(pro)),
            linewidth = 0.6, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = as.data.frame(load_top),
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.14, "cm")),
               colour = "brown", linewidth = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = as.data.frame(load_top),
            aes(x = PC1 * 1.15, y = PC2 * 1.15, label = top_genes),
            colour = "brown", size = 3.4, fontface = "bold", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("0.9" = 2, "0.95" = 1), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.0f%%)", 100 * pv_pg[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.0f%%)", 100 * pv_pg[2]),
       title = "PCA with top-3 loading arrows and 90/95% ellipses",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

# InstallData("ifnb")

ifnb <- RunUMAP(ifnb, dims = 1:20) # UMAP Dimensionality Reduction

                 n_neighbors = 15, 
                 min_dist = 0.2,
                 metric = "euclidean")

       aes(X1, X2, color = Diagnosis)) +

  labs(title = "UMAP of Wisconsin Breast Cancer Dataset",

  list(n_neighbors=15, min_dist=0.2, label="Default"),

)

                  min_dist = params[[i]]$min_dist)
  
  df <- data.frame(umap_res$layout, Diagnosis = diagnosis)
  
  plots[[i]] <- ggplot(df, aes(X1, X2, color = Diagnosis)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = paste("Params:", params[[i]]$label),
         subtitle = sprintf("n_neighbors=%d, min_dist=%.1f", 
                          params[[i]]$n_neighbors, params[[i]]$min_dist),
         x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("benign" = "#1b9e77", "malignant" = "#d95f02"))
}

# Using patchwork for typesetting
(plots[[1]] / plots[[2]] / plots[[3]])

subgrp <- list(c("A1", "A2", "A3"), c("B1", "B2"), c("C1", "C2", "C3"))
base_col <- c("Group A" = "#2874C5", "Group B" = "#B2182B", "Group C" = "#4D9342")

df_b <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(major), function(k) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(subgrp[[k]]), function(j) {
    n <- 25
    val <- rnorm(n, mean = 20 + k * 8 + j * 2, sd = 5)
    data.frame(major = major[k], subgroup = subgrp[[k]][j], value = val)
  }))
}))
summ_b <- df_b |>
  group_by(major, subgroup) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(value), se = sd(value) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

major_of <- setNames(rep(major, sapply(subgrp, length)), unlist(subgrp))
summ_b$major_col <- base_col[major_of[summ_b$subgroup]]
# lighter shades for subgroup index within each major group
shade_fac <- c(0.5, 0.75, 1.0)
summ_b$idx <- as.integer(factor(summ_b$subgroup, levels = unlist(subgrp)))
summ_b$shade <- shade_fac[summ_b$idx]

subgroup_cols <- c(
  "A1" = "#7BA7D6", "A2" = "#5288CC", "A3" = "#2874C5",
  "B1" = "#CE6B6B", "B2" = "#B2182B",
  "C1" = "#7BC17B", "C2" = "#4D9342", "C3" = "#3D7A35")

ggplot(summ_b, aes(subgroup, mean, fill = subgroup)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = subgroup_cols) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean ± SE") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

set.seed(2900)
clusters <- paste0("C", 1:8)
p0 <- c(0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.11, 0.10, 0.10, 0.09)
# KO proportions: unaffected clusters keep p0 exactly; only C2/C6/C8 are reallocated
p_ko <- p0
p_ko[2] <- 0.05; p_ko[6] <- 0.22; p_ko[8] <- 0.08
stopifnot(abs(sum(p_ko) - 1) < 1e-12)
n_wt <- 900; n_ko <- 900
mk_cells <- function(n, p, grp) {
  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}
cellinfo <- rbind(mk_cells(n_wt, p0, "WT"), mk_cells(n_ko, p_ko, "KO"))
cellinfo$cluster <- factor(cellinfo$cluster, levels = clusters)

tbl <- table(cellinfo$cluster, cellinfo$group)
ft <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
post <- rstatix::row_wise_fisher_test(tbl)

cell.col <- c(WT = "#1A63A8", KO = "#FC6910")
prop_df <- as.data.frame(tbl, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(prop_df) <- c("cluster", "group", "n")
prop_df$cluster <- factor(prop_df$cluster, levels = clusters)
prop_df$group <- factor(prop_df$group, levels = c("WT", "KO"))
sig_df <- as.data.frame(post)
sig_df$cluster <- factor(sig_df$group, levels = clusters)
sig_df$lab <- ifelse(sig_df$p.adj.signif == "ns", "", sig_df$p.adj.signif)

ggplot(prop_df, aes(cluster, n, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.72,
           colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = sig_df, aes(x = cluster, y = 1.05, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.4, colour = "grey10") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell.col, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), labels = scales::percent,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Fraction of cells",
       title = "Cell-type composition per cluster (KO vs WT)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(size = 11))

# same cells as the chunk above, now split by sequencing run
ggplot(cellinfo, aes(run, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.85, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~cluster, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell.col, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.5), labels = scales::percent) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +

  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}

set.seed(2900)
clusters <- paste0("C", 1:8)
p0 <- c(0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.11, 0.10, 0.10, 0.09)
# KO proportions: unaffected clusters keep p0 exactly; only C2/C6/C8 are reallocated
p_ko <- p0
p_ko[2] <- 0.05; p_ko[6] <- 0.22; p_ko[8] <- 0.08
stopifnot(abs(sum(p_ko) - 1) < 1e-12)
n_wt <- 900; n_ko <- 900
mk_cells <- function(n, p, grp) {
  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}
cellinfo <- rbind(mk_cells(n_wt, p0, "WT"), mk_cells(n_ko, p_ko, "KO"))
cellinfo$cluster <- factor(cellinfo$cluster, levels = clusters)

tbl <- table(cellinfo$cluster, cellinfo$group)
ft <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
post <- rstatix::row_wise_fisher_test(tbl)

cell.col <- c(WT = "#1A63A8", KO = "#FC6910")
prop_df <- as.data.frame(tbl, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(prop_df) <- c("cluster", "group", "n")
prop_df$cluster <- factor(prop_df$cluster, levels = clusters)
prop_df$group <- factor(prop_df$group, levels = c("WT", "KO"))
sig_df <- as.data.frame(post)
sig_df$cluster <- factor(sig_df$group, levels = clusters)
sig_df$lab <- ifelse(sig_df$p.adj.signif == "ns", "", sig_df$p.adj.signif)

  geom_col(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.72,

  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), labels = scales::percent,

clusters <- paste0("C", 1:8)

# KO proportions: unaffected clusters keep p0 exactly; only C2/C6/C8 are reallocated
p_ko <- p0
p_ko[2] <- 0.05; p_ko[6] <- 0.22; p_ko[8] <- 0.08
stopifnot(abs(sum(p_ko) - 1) < 1e-12)
n_wt <- 900; n_ko <- 900
mk_cells <- function(n, p, grp) {
  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}
cellinfo <- rbind(mk_cells(n_wt, p0, "WT"), mk_cells(n_ko, p_ko, "KO"))
cellinfo$cluster <- factor(cellinfo$cluster, levels = clusters)

tbl <- table(cellinfo$cluster, cellinfo$group)
ft <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
post <- rstatix::row_wise_fisher_test(tbl)

colnames(prop_df) <- c("cluster", "group", "n")

prop_df$group <- factor(prop_df$group, levels = c("WT", "KO"))
sig_df <- as.data.frame(post)
sig_df$cluster <- factor(sig_df$group, levels = clusters)
sig_df$lab <- ifelse(sig_df$p.adj.signif == "ns", "", sig_df$p.adj.signif)

set.seed(2900)
clusters <- paste0("C", 1:8)
p0 <- c(0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.11, 0.10, 0.10, 0.09)
# KO proportions: unaffected clusters keep p0 exactly; only C2/C6/C8 are reallocated
p_ko <- p0
p_ko[2] <- 0.05; p_ko[6] <- 0.22; p_ko[8] <- 0.08
stopifnot(abs(sum(p_ko) - 1) < 1e-12)
n_wt <- 900; n_ko <- 900
mk_cells <- function(n, p, grp) {
  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}
cellinfo <- rbind(mk_cells(n_wt, p0, "WT"), mk_cells(n_ko, p_ko, "KO"))
cellinfo$cluster <- factor(cellinfo$cluster, levels = clusters)

tbl <- table(cellinfo$cluster, cellinfo$group)
ft <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
post <- rstatix::row_wise_fisher_test(tbl)

cell.col <- c(WT = "#1A63A8", KO = "#FC6910")
prop_df <- as.data.frame(tbl, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(prop_df) <- c("cluster", "group", "n")
prop_df$cluster <- factor(prop_df$cluster, levels = clusters)
prop_df$group <- factor(prop_df$group, levels = c("WT", "KO"))
sig_df <- as.data.frame(post)
sig_df$cluster <- factor(sig_df$group, levels = clusters)
sig_df$lab <- ifelse(sig_df$p.adj.signif == "ns", "", sig_df$p.adj.signif)

ggplot(prop_df, aes(cluster, n, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.72,
           colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = sig_df, aes(x = cluster, y = 1.05, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.4, colour = "grey10") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell.col, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), labels = scales::percent,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Fraction of cells",
       title = "Cell-type composition per cluster (KO vs WT)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(size = 11))

set.seed(2900)
clusters <- paste0("C", 1:8)
p0 <- c(0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.11, 0.10, 0.10, 0.09)
# KO proportions: unaffected clusters keep p0 exactly; only C2/C6/C8 are reallocated
p_ko <- p0
p_ko[2] <- 0.05; p_ko[6] <- 0.22; p_ko[8] <- 0.08
stopifnot(abs(sum(p_ko) - 1) < 1e-12)
n_wt <- 900; n_ko <- 900
mk_cells <- function(n, p, grp) {
  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}
cellinfo <- rbind(mk_cells(n_wt, p0, "WT"), mk_cells(n_ko, p_ko, "KO"))
cellinfo$cluster <- factor(cellinfo$cluster, levels = clusters)

tbl <- table(cellinfo$cluster, cellinfo$group)
ft <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
post <- rstatix::row_wise_fisher_test(tbl)

colnames(prop_df) <- c("cluster", "group", "n")
prop_df$cluster <- factor(prop_df$cluster, levels = clusters)
prop_df$group <- factor(prop_df$group, levels = c("WT", "KO"))
sig_df <- as.data.frame(post)
sig_df$cluster <- factor(sig_df$group, levels = clusters)
sig_df$lab <- ifelse(sig_df$p.adj.signif == "ns", "", sig_df$p.adj.signif)

  geom_col(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.72,

clusters <- paste0("C", 1:8)
p0 <- c(0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.11, 0.10, 0.10, 0.09)
# KO proportions: unaffected clusters keep p0 exactly; only C2/C6/C8 are reallocated
p_ko <- p0
p_ko[2] <- 0.05; p_ko[6] <- 0.22; p_ko[8] <- 0.08
stopifnot(abs(sum(p_ko) - 1) < 1e-12)
n_wt <- 900; n_ko <- 900
mk_cells <- function(n, p, grp) {
  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}
cellinfo <- rbind(mk_cells(n_wt, p0, "WT"), mk_cells(n_ko, p_ko, "KO"))
cellinfo$cluster <- factor(cellinfo$cluster, levels = clusters)

tbl <- table(cellinfo$cluster, cellinfo$group)
ft <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
post <- rstatix::row_wise_fisher_test(tbl)

colnames(prop_df) <- c("cluster", "group", "n")

prop_df$group <- factor(prop_df$group, levels = c("WT", "KO"))
sig_df <- as.data.frame(post)

sig_df$lab <- ifelse(sig_df$p.adj.signif == "ns", "", sig_df$p.adj.signif)

  geom_col(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.72,

  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}

  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}

p_ko <- p0

stopifnot(abs(sum(p_ko) - 1) < 1e-12)

  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}
cellinfo <- rbind(mk_cells(n_wt, p0, "WT"), mk_cells(n_ko, p_ko, "KO"))

p_ko <- p0

stopifnot(abs(sum(p_ko) - 1) < 1e-12)
n_wt <- 900; n_ko <- 900
mk_cells <- function(n, p, grp) {
  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}
cellinfo <- rbind(mk_cells(n_wt, p0, "WT"), mk_cells(n_ko, p_ko, "KO"))
cellinfo$cluster <- factor(cellinfo$cluster, levels = clusters)

tbl <- table(cellinfo$cluster, cellinfo$group)
ft <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
post <- rstatix::row_wise_fisher_test(tbl)

prop_df$group <- factor(prop_df$group, levels = c("WT", "KO"))
sig_df <- as.data.frame(post)

p_ko <- p0
p_ko[2] <- 0.05; p_ko[6] <- 0.22; p_ko[8] <- 0.08
stopifnot(abs(sum(p_ko) - 1) < 1e-12)
n_wt <- 900; n_ko <- 900
mk_cells <- function(n, p, grp) {
  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}
cellinfo <- rbind(mk_cells(n_wt, p0, "WT"), mk_cells(n_ko, p_ko, "KO"))
cellinfo$cluster <- factor(cellinfo$cluster, levels = clusters)

ft <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)

p_ko <- p0

stopifnot(abs(sum(p_ko) - 1) < 1e-12)
n_wt <- 900; n_ko <- 900
mk_cells <- function(n, p, grp) {
  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}
cellinfo <- rbind(mk_cells(n_wt, p0, "WT"), mk_cells(n_ko, p_ko, "KO"))
cellinfo$cluster <- factor(cellinfo$cluster, levels = clusters)

ft <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)

  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}

head_words_english

# Use the jiebaR package to split the text into phrases
words_seg <- words %>%
  segment(worker()) %>%                    # Split text into words
  tibble(word = .) %>%  
  filter(nchar(word) > 1) %>%              # Remove single-word phrases
  count(word, sort = TRUE) %>%             # Statistical word frequency
  filter(!str_detect(word, "[0-9]+")) %>%  # Remove numbers
  slice_max(n, n = 50)                     # Select words with high frequency

head(words_seg)

# Split directly into single words
words_english %>%
 str_replace_all(",", " ") %>%         # Replace punctuation marks with spaces
 str_replace_all("\\.", " ") %>%
 str_replace_all("\\(", " ") %>%
 str_replace_all("\\)", " ") %>%
 str_split(" ", simplify = TRUE) %>%  # Split text into words
 .[nchar(.) > 1] %>%                  # Remove words of length 1 or 0
 tibble(word = .) %>%
 filter(!grepl("[0-9]+", word)) %>%   # Remove numbers
 table() %>%
 as.data.frame() %>%
 arrange(desc(Freq)) %>%
 slice(1:60) -> words_english_sep     # Select the top 60 words

set.seed(4401)
n_gene <- 3000
resol <- 100
span <- 3000
gb_win <- 20
up_win <- span / resol
w_up <- seq_len(up_win)
w_gb <- seq_len(gb_win)
w_dn <- seq_len(up_win)
pos_lab <- c(paste0("-", seq(span, resol, -resol)),
             rep("gene body", gb_win),
             paste0("+", seq(resol, span, resol)))
axis_at <- c(1, up_win, up_win + gb_win, length(pos_lab))
axis_lab <- c("-3 kb", "TSS", "TTS", "+3 kb")
mk_profile <- function(amp_tss, amp_gb, noise) {
  up <- exp(-(w_up - max(w_up))^2 / (2 * (up_win / 2.2)^2)) * amp_tss
  gb <- (0.25 + 0.5 * seq(0, 1, length.out = gb_win)) * amp_gb
  dn <- exp(-(w_dn - 1)^2 / (2 * (up_win / 2.5)^2)) * (amp_tss * 0.35)
  pmax(0, c(up, gb, dn) + rnorm(length(up) + length(gb) + length(dn), 0, noise))
}
prof <- data.frame(
  window = seq_along(pos_lab),
  Cxxc1 = mk_profile(1.0, 0.55, 0.012),
  Input = mk_profile(0.30, 0.18, 0.010))
prof_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(prof, cols = c(Cxxc1, Input),
                                 names_to = "sample", values_to = "signal")
ggplot(prof_long, aes(window, signal, colour = sample)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(up_win + 0.5, up_win + gb_win + 0.5),
             linetype = 2, colour = "grey55") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = up_win + 0.5, xmax = up_win + gb_win + 0.5,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.06, fill = "#2166AC") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "3 kb upstream", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win + gb_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "gene body (compressed)", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win + gb_win + up_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "3 kb downstream", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = axis_at, labels = axis_lab,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean tag density (simulated, 3,000 genes)",
       title = "Metagene profile: IP vs Input over extended gene bodies",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

             region = cl)
}))

                     labels = c("-2 kb", "TSS", "TTS", "+2 kb"),

w_gb <- seq_len(gb_win)
w_dn <- seq_len(up_win)

             rep("gene body", gb_win),
             paste0("+", seq(resol, span, resol)))
axis_at <- c(1, up_win, up_win + gb_win, length(pos_lab))
axis_lab <- c("-3 kb", "TSS", "TTS", "+3 kb")
mk_profile <- function(amp_tss, amp_gb, noise) {
  up <- exp(-(w_up - max(w_up))^2 / (2 * (up_win / 2.2)^2)) * amp_tss
  gb <- (0.25 + 0.5 * seq(0, 1, length.out = gb_win)) * amp_gb
  dn <- exp(-(w_dn - 1)^2 / (2 * (up_win / 2.5)^2)) * (amp_tss * 0.35)
  pmax(0, c(up, gb, dn) + rnorm(length(up) + length(gb) + length(dn), 0, noise))
}

set.seed(4401)
n_gene <- 3000
resol <- 100
span <- 3000
gb_win <- 20
up_win <- span / resol
w_up <- seq_len(up_win)
w_gb <- seq_len(gb_win)
w_dn <- seq_len(up_win)
pos_lab <- c(paste0("-", seq(span, resol, -resol)),
             rep("gene body", gb_win),
             paste0("+", seq(resol, span, resol)))
axis_at <- c(1, up_win, up_win + gb_win, length(pos_lab))
axis_lab <- c("-3 kb", "TSS", "TTS", "+3 kb")
mk_profile <- function(amp_tss, amp_gb, noise) {
  up <- exp(-(w_up - max(w_up))^2 / (2 * (up_win / 2.2)^2)) * amp_tss
  gb <- (0.25 + 0.5 * seq(0, 1, length.out = gb_win)) * amp_gb
  dn <- exp(-(w_dn - 1)^2 / (2 * (up_win / 2.5)^2)) * (amp_tss * 0.35)
  pmax(0, c(up, gb, dn) + rnorm(length(up) + length(gb) + length(dn), 0, noise))
}

  window = seq_along(pos_lab),
  Cxxc1 = mk_profile(1.0, 0.55, 0.012),

           label = "3 kb upstream", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win + gb_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "gene body (compressed)", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win + gb_win + up_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "3 kb downstream", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +

  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

set.seed(4401)
n_gene <- 3000
resol <- 100
span <- 3000
gb_win <- 20
up_win <- span / resol
w_up <- seq_len(up_win)
w_gb <- seq_len(gb_win)
w_dn <- seq_len(up_win)
pos_lab <- c(paste0("-", seq(span, resol, -resol)),
             rep("gene body", gb_win),
             paste0("+", seq(resol, span, resol)))
axis_at <- c(1, up_win, up_win + gb_win, length(pos_lab))
axis_lab <- c("-3 kb", "TSS", "TTS", "+3 kb")
mk_profile <- function(amp_tss, amp_gb, noise) {
  up <- exp(-(w_up - max(w_up))^2 / (2 * (up_win / 2.2)^2)) * amp_tss
  gb <- (0.25 + 0.5 * seq(0, 1, length.out = gb_win)) * amp_gb
  dn <- exp(-(w_dn - 1)^2 / (2 * (up_win / 2.5)^2)) * (amp_tss * 0.35)
  pmax(0, c(up, gb, dn) + rnorm(length(up) + length(gb) + length(dn), 0, noise))
}
prof <- data.frame(
  window = seq_along(pos_lab),
  Cxxc1 = mk_profile(1.0, 0.55, 0.012),
  Input = mk_profile(0.30, 0.18, 0.010))
prof_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(prof, cols = c(Cxxc1, Input),
                                 names_to = "sample", values_to = "signal")
ggplot(prof_long, aes(window, signal, colour = sample)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(up_win + 0.5, up_win + gb_win + 0.5),
             linetype = 2, colour = "grey55") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = up_win + 0.5, xmax = up_win + gb_win + 0.5,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.06, fill = "#2166AC") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "3 kb upstream", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win + gb_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "gene body (compressed)", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win + gb_win + up_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "3 kb downstream", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = axis_at, labels = axis_lab,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean tag density (simulated, 3,000 genes)",
       title = "Metagene profile: IP vs Input over extended gene bodies",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

## Domain architecture of a toy protein (residues 1-1800), UniProt-style.
domains <- data.frame(
  start = c(35, 120, 410, 720, 1105, 1420, 1650),
  end   = c(112, 210, 505, 845, 1180, 1500, 1790),
  type  = c("signal", "domain", "domain", "domain", "domain", "domain",
            "low complexity"),
  name  = c("signal", "Pfam A", "Pfam B", "Pfam C", "Pfam D", "Pfam E",
            "LC region"),
  row   = c(1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3)
)

## Somatic mutations: position, class and cancer type.
mutations <- data.frame(
  pos = c(184, 245, 312, 468, 512, 604, 771, 802, 918, 1044,
          1122, 1190, 1288, 1345, 1466, 1522, 1608, 1712),
  cls = c("missense", "missense", "nonsense", "missense", "missense",
          "missense", "inframe del", "missense", "missense", "missense",
          "missense", "splice", "missense", "missense", "nonsense",
          "missense", "missense", "inframe ins"),
  cancer = c("BRCA", "LUAD", "COAD", "BRCA", "PRAD", "LUAD", "BRCA",
             "SKCM", "LUAD", "PRAD", "BRCA", "COAD", "LUAD", "BRCA",
             "SKCM", "PRAD", "LUAD", "COAD")
) |>
  mutate(n = round(exp(rnorm(n(), 2.4, 0.9))))

mut_cols <- c(missense = "#1b7837", nonsense = "#b2182b",
              `inframe del` = "#d95f02", `inframe ins` = "#7570b3",
              splice = "#8c510a")

## Gaussian-kernel density of the mutation positions, weighted by patients.
dens <- data.frame(pos = seq(1, 1800, by = 2)) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(d = sum(mutations$n * dnorm(pos, mutations$pos, 22)) /
           sum(mutations$n)) |>
  ungroup()

p_arch <- ggplot() +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1800, y = 0, yend = 0,
           linewidth = 0.4, colour = "#bdbdbd") +
  geom_rect(data = domains,
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -0.13 + row * 0.3,
                ymax = 0.13 + row * 0.3, fill = type),
            colour = "#525252", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(data = domains, aes(x = (start + end) / 2, y = row * 0.3 + 0.19,
                                label = name), size = 1.9, colour = "#252525") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(signal = "#a6bddb", domain = "#9ebcda",
                               `low complexity` = "#f0f0f0"),
                    guide = "none") +
  geom_area(data = dens, aes(x = pos, y = 1.2 + 1.9 * d / max(d)), fill = "#7570b3",
            alpha = 0.22, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(data = dens, aes(x = pos, y = 1.2 + 1.9 * d / max(d)), colour = "#542788",
            linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x = 20, y = 3.2,
           label = "mutation density (Gaussian kernel, sd = 22 aa)",
           size = 2.2, colour = "#542788", hjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.35, 3.3), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1810), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1800, 300)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5))

p_lol <- ggplot(mutations, aes(pos, n)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = pos, yend = 0, colour = cls), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = cls, size = n), alpha = 0.95) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = ifelse(n > 40,
                                    paste0(cls, "\n(", cancer, "), n = ", n),

                      colour = cls),
                  size = 1.85, show.legend = FALSE, min.segment.length = 0,

  ## outline labels are placed by repel; keep the headroom for them

  scale_colour_manual(values = mut_cols, name = "variant class") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.2, 4.2), name = "patients") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 92), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1810), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1800, 300)) +
  labs(x = "protein position (amino acid)",

  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +

## Domain architecture of a toy protein (residues 1-1800), UniProt-style.
domains <- data.frame(
  start = c(35, 120, 410, 720, 1105, 1420, 1650),
  end   = c(112, 210, 505, 845, 1180, 1500, 1790),
  type  = c("signal", "domain", "domain", "domain", "domain", "domain",
            "low complexity"),
  name  = c("signal", "Pfam A", "Pfam B", "Pfam C", "Pfam D", "Pfam E",
            "LC region"),
  row   = c(1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3)
)

## Somatic mutations: position, class and cancer type.
mutations <- data.frame(
  pos = c(184, 245, 312, 468, 512, 604, 771, 802, 918, 1044,
          1122, 1190, 1288, 1345, 1466, 1522, 1608, 1712),
  cls = c("missense", "missense", "nonsense", "missense", "missense",
          "missense", "inframe del", "missense", "missense", "missense",
          "missense", "splice", "missense", "missense", "nonsense",
          "missense", "missense", "inframe ins"),
  cancer = c("BRCA", "LUAD", "COAD", "BRCA", "PRAD", "LUAD", "BRCA",
             "SKCM", "LUAD", "PRAD", "BRCA", "COAD", "LUAD", "BRCA",
             "SKCM", "PRAD", "LUAD", "COAD")
) |>
  mutate(n = round(exp(rnorm(n(), 2.4, 0.9))))

mut_cols <- c(missense = "#1b7837", nonsense = "#b2182b",
              `inframe del` = "#d95f02", `inframe ins` = "#7570b3",
              splice = "#8c510a")

## Gaussian-kernel density of the mutation positions, weighted by patients.
dens <- data.frame(pos = seq(1, 1800, by = 2)) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(d = sum(mutations$n * dnorm(pos, mutations$pos, 22)) /
           sum(mutations$n)) |>
  ungroup()

p_arch <- ggplot() +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1800, y = 0, yend = 0,
           linewidth = 0.4, colour = "#bdbdbd") +
  geom_rect(data = domains,
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -0.13 + row * 0.3,
                ymax = 0.13 + row * 0.3, fill = type),
            colour = "#525252", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(data = domains, aes(x = (start + end) / 2, y = row * 0.3 + 0.19,
                                label = name), size = 1.9, colour = "#252525") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(signal = "#a6bddb", domain = "#9ebcda",
                               `low complexity` = "#f0f0f0"),
                    guide = "none") +
  geom_area(data = dens, aes(x = pos, y = 1.2 + 1.9 * d / max(d)), fill = "#7570b3",
            alpha = 0.22, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(data = dens, aes(x = pos, y = 1.2 + 1.9 * d / max(d)), colour = "#542788",
            linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x = 20, y = 3.2,
           label = "mutation density (Gaussian kernel, sd = 22 aa)",
           size = 2.2, colour = "#542788", hjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.35, 3.3), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1810), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1800, 300)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5))

## Domain architecture of a toy protein (residues 1-1800), UniProt-style.
domains <- data.frame(
  start = c(35, 120, 410, 720, 1105, 1420, 1650),
  end   = c(112, 210, 505, 845, 1180, 1500, 1790),
  type  = c("signal", "domain", "domain", "domain", "domain", "domain",
            "low complexity"),
  name  = c("signal", "Pfam A", "Pfam B", "Pfam C", "Pfam D", "Pfam E",
            "LC region"),
  row   = c(1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3)
)

## Somatic mutations: position, class and cancer type.
mutations <- data.frame(
  pos = c(184, 245, 312, 468, 512, 604, 771, 802, 918, 1044,
          1122, 1190, 1288, 1345, 1466, 1522, 1608, 1712),
  cls = c("missense", "missense", "nonsense", "missense", "missense",
          "missense", "inframe del", "missense", "missense", "missense",
          "missense", "splice", "missense", "missense", "nonsense",
          "missense", "missense", "inframe ins"),
  cancer = c("BRCA", "LUAD", "COAD", "BRCA", "PRAD", "LUAD", "BRCA",
             "SKCM", "LUAD", "PRAD", "BRCA", "COAD", "LUAD", "BRCA",
             "SKCM", "PRAD", "LUAD", "COAD")
) |>
  mutate(n = round(exp(rnorm(n(), 2.4, 0.9))))

mut_cols <- c(missense = "#1b7837", nonsense = "#b2182b",
              `inframe del` = "#d95f02", `inframe ins` = "#7570b3",
              splice = "#8c510a")

## Gaussian-kernel density of the mutation positions, weighted by patients.
dens <- data.frame(pos = seq(1, 1800, by = 2)) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(d = sum(mutations$n * dnorm(pos, mutations$pos, 22)) /
           sum(mutations$n)) |>
  ungroup()

p_arch <- ggplot() +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1800, y = 0, yend = 0,
           linewidth = 0.4, colour = "#bdbdbd") +
  geom_rect(data = domains,
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -0.13 + row * 0.3,
                ymax = 0.13 + row * 0.3, fill = type),
            colour = "#525252", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(data = domains, aes(x = (start + end) / 2, y = row * 0.3 + 0.19,
                                label = name), size = 1.9, colour = "#252525") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(signal = "#a6bddb", domain = "#9ebcda",
                               `low complexity` = "#f0f0f0"),
                    guide = "none") +
  geom_area(data = dens, aes(x = pos, y = 1.2 + 1.9 * d / max(d)), fill = "#7570b3",
            alpha = 0.22, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(data = dens, aes(x = pos, y = 1.2 + 1.9 * d / max(d)), colour = "#542788",
            linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x = 20, y = 3.2,
           label = "mutation density (Gaussian kernel, sd = 22 aa)",
           size = 2.2, colour = "#542788", hjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.35, 3.3), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1810), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1800, 300)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5))

  pos = c(184, 245, 312, 468, 512, 604, 771, 802, 918, 1044,
          1122, 1190, 1288, 1345, 1466, 1522, 1608, 1712),
  cls = c("missense", "missense", "nonsense", "missense", "missense",

  start = c(35, 120, 410, 720, 1105, 1420, 1650),
  end   = c(112, 210, 505, 845, 1180, 1500, 1790),
  type  = c("signal", "domain", "domain", "domain", "domain", "domain",
            "low complexity"),
  name  = c("signal", "Pfam A", "Pfam B", "Pfam C", "Pfam D", "Pfam E",
            "LC region"),

)

  pos = c(184, 245, 312, 468, 512, 604, 771, 802, 918, 1044,
          1122, 1190, 1288, 1345, 1466, 1522, 1608, 1712),

  mutate(n = round(exp(rnorm(n(), 2.4, 0.9))))

# Simulated cohort mutations: one row per sample, amino-acid position 1-393
mut <- data.frame(

               158, 179, 196, 213, 234, 245, 280, 306, 338, 34, 72, 115,
               133, 141))
# Protein domains (e.g. from maftools::pfamDomains or UniProt)
dom <- data.frame(
  name = c("Proline-rich", "DNA-binding", "Tetramerization"),
  start = c(60, 100, 320), end = c(80, 290, 360),
  fill = c("#EABF00", "#445EAD", "#4D9342"))

pos_tab <- table(mut$position)
lp_df <- data.frame(position = as.numeric(names(pos_tab)),
                    freq = as.numeric(pos_tab))
# Alternate stalks above/below the axis to avoid crowding
lp_df$layer <- rep(c("top", "bottom"), length.out = nrow(lp_df))
lp_df$y <- ifelse(lp_df$layer == "top", log2(lp_df$freq) + 0.6,
                  -(log2(lp_df$freq) + 0.6))

ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = dom, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end,
                            ymin = -0.35, ymax = 0.35, fill = name),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(dom$fill, dom$name), name = "Domain") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = position, xend = position, y = 0, yend = y),
               data = lp_df, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(x = position, y = y, size = freq),
             data = lp_df, shape = 21, fill = "#B2182B", stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7), name = "n samples") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", xlim = c(0, 400)) +
  labs(title = "TP53 mutation landscape (simulated cohort)",
       x = "Amino-acid position", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")

set.seed(43509)
options(ggrepel.max.overlaps = Inf)

## Domain architecture of a toy protein (residues 1-1800), UniProt-style.
domains <- data.frame(
  start = c(35, 120, 410, 720, 1105, 1420, 1650),
  end   = c(112, 210, 505, 845, 1180, 1500, 1790),
  type  = c("signal", "domain", "domain", "domain", "domain", "domain",
            "low complexity"),
  name  = c("signal", "Pfam A", "Pfam B", "Pfam C", "Pfam D", "Pfam E",
            "LC region"),
  row   = c(1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3)
)

## Somatic mutations: position, class and cancer type.
mutations <- data.frame(
  pos = c(184, 245, 312, 468, 512, 604, 771, 802, 918, 1044,
          1122, 1190, 1288, 1345, 1466, 1522, 1608, 1712),
  cls = c("missense", "missense", "nonsense", "missense", "missense",
          "missense", "inframe del", "missense", "missense", "missense",
          "missense", "splice", "missense", "missense", "nonsense",
          "missense", "missense", "inframe ins"),
  cancer = c("BRCA", "LUAD", "COAD", "BRCA", "PRAD", "LUAD", "BRCA",
             "SKCM", "LUAD", "PRAD", "BRCA", "COAD", "LUAD", "BRCA",
             "SKCM", "PRAD", "LUAD", "COAD")
) |>
  mutate(n = round(exp(rnorm(n(), 2.4, 0.9))))

mut_cols <- c(missense = "#1b7837", nonsense = "#b2182b",
              `inframe del` = "#d95f02", `inframe ins` = "#7570b3",
              splice = "#8c510a")

## Gaussian-kernel density of the mutation positions, weighted by patients.
dens <- data.frame(pos = seq(1, 1800, by = 2)) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(d = sum(mutations$n * dnorm(pos, mutations$pos, 22)) /
           sum(mutations$n)) |>
  ungroup()

p_arch <- ggplot() +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1800, y = 0, yend = 0,
           linewidth = 0.4, colour = "#bdbdbd") +
  geom_rect(data = domains,
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -0.13 + row * 0.3,
                ymax = 0.13 + row * 0.3, fill = type),
            colour = "#525252", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(data = domains, aes(x = (start + end) / 2, y = row * 0.3 + 0.19,
                                label = name), size = 1.9, colour = "#252525") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(signal = "#a6bddb", domain = "#9ebcda",
                               `low complexity` = "#f0f0f0"),
                    guide = "none") +
  geom_area(data = dens, aes(x = pos, y = 1.2 + 1.9 * d / max(d)), fill = "#7570b3",
            alpha = 0.22, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(data = dens, aes(x = pos, y = 1.2 + 1.9 * d / max(d)), colour = "#542788",
            linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x = 20, y = 3.2,
           label = "mutation density (Gaussian kernel, sd = 22 aa)",
           size = 2.2, colour = "#542788", hjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.35, 3.3), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1810), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1800, 300)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5))

p_lol <- ggplot(mutations, aes(pos, n)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = pos, yend = 0, colour = cls), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = cls, size = n), alpha = 0.95) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = ifelse(n > 40,
                                    paste0(cls, "\n(", cancer, "), n = ", n),
                                    paste0(cls, "\n(", cancer, ")")),
                      colour = cls),
                  size = 1.85, show.legend = FALSE, min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = 0.15, seed = 3, direction = "both",
                  box.padding = 0.28, point.padding = 0.12,
                  max.overlaps = Inf, max.time = 3, max.iter = 50000) +
  ## outline labels are placed by repel; keep the headroom for them
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = mut_cols, name = "variant class") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.2, 4.2), name = "patients") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 92), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1810), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1800, 300)) +
  labs(x = "protein position (amino acid)",
       y = "patients carrying the variant") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.32, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6.8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7.4),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 5, 5))

p_arch / p_lol + plot_layout(heights = c(0.6, 1))

## Domain architecture of a toy protein (residues 1-1800), UniProt-style.
domains <- data.frame(
  start = c(35, 120, 410, 720, 1105, 1420, 1650),
  end   = c(112, 210, 505, 845, 1180, 1500, 1790),
  type  = c("signal", "domain", "domain", "domain", "domain", "domain",
            "low complexity"),
  name  = c("signal", "Pfam A", "Pfam B", "Pfam C", "Pfam D", "Pfam E",
            "LC region"),
  row   = c(1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3)
)

## Somatic mutations: position, class and cancer type.
mutations <- data.frame(
  pos = c(184, 245, 312, 468, 512, 604, 771, 802, 918, 1044,
          1122, 1190, 1288, 1345, 1466, 1522, 1608, 1712),
  cls = c("missense", "missense", "nonsense", "missense", "missense",
          "missense", "inframe del", "missense", "missense", "missense",
          "missense", "splice", "missense", "missense", "nonsense",
          "missense", "missense", "inframe ins"),
  cancer = c("BRCA", "LUAD", "COAD", "BRCA", "PRAD", "LUAD", "BRCA",
             "SKCM", "LUAD", "PRAD", "BRCA", "COAD", "LUAD", "BRCA",
             "SKCM", "PRAD", "LUAD", "COAD")
) |>
  mutate(n = round(exp(rnorm(n(), 2.4, 0.9))))

mut_cols <- c(missense = "#1b7837", nonsense = "#b2182b",
              `inframe del` = "#d95f02", `inframe ins` = "#7570b3",
              splice = "#8c510a")

## Gaussian-kernel density of the mutation positions, weighted by patients.
dens <- data.frame(pos = seq(1, 1800, by = 2)) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(d = sum(mutations$n * dnorm(pos, mutations$pos, 22)) /
           sum(mutations$n)) |>
  ungroup()

p_arch <- ggplot() +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1800, y = 0, yend = 0,
           linewidth = 0.4, colour = "#bdbdbd") +
  geom_rect(data = domains,
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -0.13 + row * 0.3,
                ymax = 0.13 + row * 0.3, fill = type),
            colour = "#525252", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(data = domains, aes(x = (start + end) / 2, y = row * 0.3 + 0.19,
                                label = name), size = 1.9, colour = "#252525") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(signal = "#a6bddb", domain = "#9ebcda",
                               `low complexity` = "#f0f0f0"),
                    guide = "none") +
  geom_area(data = dens, aes(x = pos, y = 1.2 + 1.9 * d / max(d)), fill = "#7570b3",
            alpha = 0.22, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(data = dens, aes(x = pos, y = 1.2 + 1.9 * d / max(d)), colour = "#542788",
            linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x = 20, y = 3.2,
           label = "mutation density (Gaussian kernel, sd = 22 aa)",
           size = 2.2, colour = "#542788", hjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.35, 3.3), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1810), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1800, 300)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5))

p_lol <- ggplot(mutations, aes(pos, n)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = pos, yend = 0, colour = cls), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = cls, size = n), alpha = 0.95) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = ifelse(n > 40,
                                    paste0(cls, "\n(", cancer, "), n = ", n),
                                    paste0(cls, "\n(", cancer, ")")),
                      colour = cls),
                  size = 1.85, show.legend = FALSE, min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = 0.15, seed = 3, direction = "both",
                  box.padding = 0.28, point.padding = 0.12,
                  max.overlaps = Inf, max.time = 3, max.iter = 50000) +
  ## outline labels are placed by repel; keep the headroom for them
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = mut_cols, name = "variant class") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.2, 4.2), name = "patients") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 92), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1810), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1800, 300)) +
  labs(x = "protein position (amino acid)",
       y = "patients carrying the variant") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.32, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6.8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7.4),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 5, 5))

# Simulate three DE result tables (id, log2FC, FDR)
set.seed(123)
mk_deg <- function(n) {
  data.frame(id = sample(genes, n),
             log2FC = rnorm(n, sd = 2),
             FDR = runif(n))
}
deg_deseq2 <- mk_deg(400)
deg_edger  <- mk_deg(400)
deg_limma  <- mk_deg(400)

adjcutoff <- 0.05
sig_list <- list(
  DESeq2 = deg_deseq2$id[deg_deseq2$FDR <= adjcutoff & deg_deseq2$log2FC > 0],
  edgeR  = deg_edger$id[deg_edger$FDR <= adjcutoff & deg_edger$log2FC > 0],
  limma  = deg_limma$id[deg_limma$FDR <= adjcutoff & deg_limma$log2FC > 0]
)
sapply(sig_list, length)

ggVennDiagram(sig_list, label_alpha = 0) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "lightblue")

set.seed(1639)
n_bg  <- 800                                    # background: pathway universe
bg    <- paste0("P", sprintf("%04d", seq_len(n_bg)))
core  <- sample(bg, 52)                          # pathways shared by all three models
sz    <- c(158, 172, 141)
S1 <- unique(c(core, sample(setdiff(bg, core), sz[1] - length(core))))
S2 <- unique(c(core, sample(setdiff(bg, core), sz[2] - length(core))))
S3 <- unique(c(core, sample(setdiff(bg, core), sz[3] - length(core))))
dat <- list(PDX_95 = S1, PDX_112 = S2, PDX_207 = S3)

## binomial approximation of the triple-intersection test (independent-inclusion
## null): observed triple-overlap count vs Binomial(n, p1*p2*p3); slightly
## conservative under the true fixed-size null
t3 <- length(intersect(intersect(S1, S2), S3))
pval <- binom.test(t3, n = n_bg, p = prod(sz / n_bg),
                   alternative = "greater")$p.value

# UpSetR can accept three formats of data. The first is a list with named vectors (see listInput variable), the second is an expression vector (see expressionInput variable), and the third is a data frame consisting of 0,1 (see movies and mutations variables)
# Reading CSV data
# The list format requires each vector in the list to be a set. UpSetR requires each set to be named, and the elements in the vector are members of the corresponding set. When using the upset function to draw, you need to use the fromList function to convert the list data format.
listInput <- list(one = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 11, 12, 13), two = c(1, 2, 4, 5, 10), three = c(1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13))
# The expression format accepts a vector of expressions. The elements of the expression vector are the names of the sets in the intersection (separated by &), and the numeric elements in the intersection. When using the upset function to draw, you need to use the fromExpression function to convert the list data format.
expressionInput <- c(one = 2, two = 1, three = 2, `one&two` = 1, `one&three` = 4, `two&three` = 1, `one&two&three` = 2)

# In the data frame format, each column is a set and each row is an element. The data frame is required to consist of 0 and 1, which respectively indicate whether the element exists in the set. When a column has a value other than 0 or 1, the column is considered to be an attribute of the element.
movies <- read.csv( system.file("extdata", "movies.csv", package = "UpSetR"), header=T, sep=";" )
mutations <- read.csv( system.file("extdata", "mutations.csv", package = "UpSetR"), header=T, sep = ",")

# Use the above three data types to draw the Upset graph
upset(fromList(listInput))
upset(fromExpression(expressionInput))
upset(movies)

# Set nset to 6 and use the mutations dataset
upset(mutations, nsets = 6)

# Three different order.by settings, using the mutations dataset
upset(mutations)
upset(mutations, order.by = "degree")
upset(mutations, order.by = "freq")

# Specify "TTN", "NF1", "FLG", "KEL" as the target set, and keep the order of the set bar graph consistent with the sets parameter
upset(mutations, sets = c("TTN","NF1","FLG","KEL"), keep.order = T)

# Show Empty Intersections
upset(mutations, sets = c("TTN","NF1","FLG","KEL"), keep.order = T, empty.intersections=T)

# Reverse sort direction
upset(mutations, sets = c("TTN","NF1","FLG","KEL"), keep.order = T, decreasing = c(T, T))
upset(mutations, mb.ratio=c(0.5,0.5))

upset(mutations,
      shade.color = "#4C4C4C", # Color of the intersection matrix point shadow
      matrix.color = "#067522", # Colors of points and lines in the matrix
      main.bar.color = "#3E7B92", # Color of the histogram of the number of intersection elements
      sets.bar.color = "#C9AE42" # Color of the collection quantity bar chart
)

upset(mutations, sets = c("TTN","NF1","FLG","KEL"), keep.order = T,
      query.legend = "top", 
      queries = list(list(query = intersects, params = list("TTN"), active = T, query.name = "NAME"),
                     list(query = elements, params = list("TTN","NF1"))))

upset(mutations,
      number.angles = 30, # The tilt angle of the numbers above the intersection bar graph
      point.size = 2, # The size of the points in the matrix
      line.size = 1, # Size of the lines in the matrix
      sets.x.label = "NAME1", # Axis labels for a collection of bar charts
      mainbar.y.label = "NAME2", # Axis labels for intersection bar chart
      text.scale = c(1.3, 1.3, 1, 1, 1.2,1)) # Text size settings, corresponding to the axis labels of the intersection bar chart, the numbers of the intersection bar chart, the axis labels of the set bar chart, the numbers of the set bar chart, the name of the set, and the numbers above the intersection bar chart

upset(movies, sets = c("Action", "Adventure", "Children", "War", "Noir"),
      queries = list(list(query = elements, params = list("ReleaseDate",1995), active = T)))

                           )

# UpSetR can accept three formats of data. The first is a list with named vectors (see listInput variable), the second is an expression vector (see expressionInput variable), and the third is a data frame consisting of 0,1 (see movies and mutations variables)
# Reading CSV data
# The list format requires each vector in the list to be a set. UpSetR requires each set to be named, and the elements in the vector are members of the corresponding set. When using the upset function to draw, you need to use the fromList function to convert the list data format.
listInput <- list(one = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 11, 12, 13), two = c(1, 2, 4, 5, 10), three = c(1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13))
# The expression format accepts a vector of expressions. The elements of the expression vector are the names of the sets in the intersection (separated by &), and the numeric elements in the intersection. When using the upset function to draw, you need to use the fromExpression function to convert the list data format.
expressionInput <- c(one = 2, two = 1, three = 2, `one&two` = 1, `one&three` = 4, `two&three` = 1, `one&two&three` = 2)

# In the data frame format, each column is a set and each row is an element. The data frame is required to consist of 0 and 1, which respectively indicate whether the element exists in the set. When a column has a value other than 0 or 1, the column is considered to be an attribute of the element.

# Create a data frame
data <- data.frame(
  gene = c("HRAS", "NRAS", "RET fusion", "MAP2K1", "ROS1 fusion", "ERBB2", 
           "ALK fusion", "MET ex14",  "BRAF", "EGFR", "KRAS", "None", "RIT1",
           "ERBB2 amp", "MET amp", "NF1"),
  percentage = c(0.4, 0.4, 0.9, 0.9, 1.7, 1.7, 1.3, 4.3,  7.0, 11.3, 32.2, 24.4,
                 2.2, 0.9, 2.2, 8.3)
)
data$gene <- factor(data$gene,levels = data$gene)
data$focus = c(rep(0, 12), rep(0.2, 4))
data$anno <- ifelse(data$gene == "KRAS", "KRAS\n(32.2%)",
                    ifelse(data$gene == "EGFR", "EGFR\n(11.3%)",
                           ifelse(data$gene == "BRAF", "BRAF\n(7.0%)",
                                  ifelse(data$gene == "None", "None\n(24.4%)",
                                         ifelse(data$gene == "NF1", "NF1\n(8.3%)", NA)))))
data <- 
  data %>%
  mutate(end_angle = 2*pi*cumsum(percentage)/100,
         start_angle = lag(end_angle, default = 0),
         mid_angle = 0.5*(start_angle + end_angle)) %>%
  mutate(legend = paste0(gene," (",percentage,"%)"))

data$legend <- factor(data$legend,levels = data$legend)

col <- c("#891619","#040503","#AF353D","#CF5057","#EE2129","#E7604D","#F58667","#F7A387","#FBC4AE","#FDE2D6","#FDF1EA","#AAD9C0","#0073AE","#069BDA","#68B0E1","#B8CBE8")

# Draw a pie chart using ggplot
pie <- 
  ggplot() +
  geom_arc_bar(data=data, stat = "pie", # Draw pie charts in normal Cartesian coordinates, not polar coordinates
               aes(x0=0,y0=0,r0=0,r=2, # If you need a donut chart, just change r0 to 1.
                   amount=percentage,
                   fill=gene,color=gene,
                   explode=focus)) +
  geom_arc(data=data[1:8,], size=1,color="black",
           aes(x0=0, y0=0, r=2.1, start = start_angle, end = end_angle)) +
  geom_arc(data=data[11,], size=1,color="grey60",
           aes(x0=0, y0=0, r=2, start = start_angle-0.3, end = end_angle+0.3)) +
  geom_arc(data=data[13:15,], size = 1,color="black",
           aes(x0=0,y0=0,r=2.3,size = index,start = start_angle, end = end_angle))+
  annotate("text", x=1.3, y=0.9, label=expression(atop(italic("BRAF"),"(7.0%)")), 
           size=6, angle=0, hjust=0.5) +
  annotate("text", x=1.4, y=0.08, label=expression(atop(italic("EGFR"),"(11.3%)")),
           size=6, angle=0, hjust=0.5) +
  annotate("text", x=0.2, y=-1.1, label=expression(atop(italic("KRAS"),"(32.2%)")),
           size=6, angle=0, hjust=0.5) +
  annotate("text", x=-1.2, y=0.1, label="None\n(24.4%)", size=6, angle=0, 
           hjust=0.5) +
  annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=1.75, label=expression(atop(italic("NF1"),"(8.3%)")),
           size=6, angle=0, hjust=0.5) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_no_axes() +
  scale_fill_discrete(breaks=data$gene[c(1:8, 13:15)],
                      labels=data$legend[c(1:8, 13:15)], type=col) +
  scale_color_discrete(breaks=data$gene[c(1:8, 13:15)],
                       labels=data$legend[c(1:8, 13:15)], type=col) +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.margin = margin(t = 1,r = 0,b = 0,l = 0,unit = "cm"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size=14),
        legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0.3,"cm"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.4,"cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.4,"cm"))

n_sam <- 20
meta_status <- rep(c("LN+", "LN-"), each = 10)
genes_sig <- paste0("Sig", sprintf("%02d", 1:40))
expr_d <- matrix(rnorm(40 * n_sam, sd = 1), nrow = 40,
                 dimnames = list(genes_sig, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_sam))))
expr_d[1:20, meta_status == "LN+"] <- expr_d[1:20, meta_status == "LN+"] + 2.0   # half of the signature shifts in LN+ (a uniform shift is invisible to Pearson correlation)

## Pearson distance + Ward clustering (the reference recipe)
d_hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor(expr_d, method = "pearson")), method = "ward.D")  # sample-sample correlations
clust <- cutree(d_hc, k = 2)
dend_sorted <- sort(as.dendrogram(d_hc))          # tidy the leaves
leaf_order <- order.dendrogram(dend_sorted)

jco <- c("#2874C5", "#EABF00"); cherry <- "#700353"; lightgrey <- "#dcddde"
clust_col  <- ifelse(clust[leaf_order] == 1, jco[1], jco[2])
status_col <- ifelse(meta_status[leaf_order] == "LN+", cherry, lightgrey)

col_dend <- dendextend::color_branches(dend_sorted, k = 2, col = jco)

par(mar = c(8, 2, 2, 2))
plot(col_dend, axes = FALSE)
xx <- seq_along(leaf_order)
h <- max(attr(dend_sorted, "height"))
y0 <- -h * 0.10                                    # strip rows below the leaves
rect(xx - 0.5, y0 - h * 0.05, xx + 0.5, y0, col = clust_col, border = NA, xpd = NA)
rect(xx - 0.5, y0 - h * 0.11, xx + 0.5, y0 - h * 0.06, col = status_col, border = NA, xpd = NA)
text(x = 0.55, y = y0 - h * 0.025, labels = "Cluster", adj = 1, xpd = NA, cex = 0.8)
text(x = 0.55, y = y0 - h * 0.085, labels = "MetaStatus", adj = 1, xpd = NA, cex = 0.8)
legend("topright", bty = "n", cex = 0.8, ncol = 2,

  mutate(breaks = as.character(breaks))

# Convert nested dataframe data to side list data and then draw a tree diagram.
edges_level1_2 <- warpbreaks %>%
  select(wool, tension) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rename(from = wool, to = tension)

edges_level2_3 <- warpbreaks %>%
  select(tension, breaks) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rename(from = tension, to = breaks)

edge_list <- bind_rows(edges_level1_2, edges_level2_3) # merge
edge_list_unique <- edge_list[edge_list$from != "B",]
edge_list_unique$to <- make.unique(edge_list_unique$to)


# Create a graph object
mygraph_unique <- graph_from_data_frame(edge_list_unique)

# Hierarchical grouping
V(mygraph_unique)$group <- case_when(
  V(mygraph_unique)$name %in% unique(warpbreaks$wool) ~ "Group 1", # root node wool
  str_detect(V(mygraph_unique)$name, "^[LMH]") ~ "Group 2", # First layer of tension
  str_detect(V(mygraph_unique)$name, "^[0-9]") ~ "Group 3", # Second layer breaks
  TRUE ~ "Group 4" # Additional correction layer
)
V(mygraph_unique)$color <- case_when(
  V(mygraph_unique)$group == "Group 1" ~ "red",
  V(mygraph_unique)$group == "Group 2" ~ "yellow",
  V(mygraph_unique)$group == "Group 3" ~ "green",
  V(mygraph_unique)$group == "Group 4" ~ "blue"
)

sample_type <- substr(colnames(expression_subset), nchar(colnames(expression_subset)), nchar(colnames(expression_subset)))
colors <- ifelse(sample_type == "A", "red", "blue")
brca_dend <- as.dendrogram(cluster_result)

ggraph(mygraph_unique, layout = 'dendrogram', circular = FALSE) +

  geom_node_point() +

set.seed(502)
n_sam <- 20
meta_status <- rep(c("LN+", "LN-"), each = 10)
genes_sig <- paste0("Sig", sprintf("%02d", 1:40))
expr_d <- matrix(rnorm(40 * n_sam, sd = 1), nrow = 40,
                 dimnames = list(genes_sig, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_sam))))
expr_d[1:20, meta_status == "LN+"] <- expr_d[1:20, meta_status == "LN+"] + 2.0   # half of the signature shifts in LN+ (a uniform shift is invisible to Pearson correlation)

## Pearson distance + Ward clustering (the reference recipe)
d_hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor(expr_d, method = "pearson")), method = "ward.D")  # sample-sample correlations
clust <- cutree(d_hc, k = 2)
dend_sorted <- sort(as.dendrogram(d_hc))          # tidy the leaves
leaf_order <- order.dendrogram(dend_sorted)

jco <- c("#2874C5", "#EABF00"); cherry <- "#700353"; lightgrey <- "#dcddde"
clust_col  <- ifelse(clust[leaf_order] == 1, jco[1], jco[2])
status_col <- ifelse(meta_status[leaf_order] == "LN+", cherry, lightgrey)

col_dend <- dendextend::color_branches(dend_sorted, k = 2, col = jco)

par(mar = c(8, 2, 2, 2))
plot(col_dend, axes = FALSE)
xx <- seq_along(leaf_order)
h <- max(attr(dend_sorted, "height"))
y0 <- -h * 0.10                                    # strip rows below the leaves
rect(xx - 0.5, y0 - h * 0.05, xx + 0.5, y0, col = clust_col, border = NA, xpd = NA)
rect(xx - 0.5, y0 - h * 0.11, xx + 0.5, y0 - h * 0.06, col = status_col, border = NA, xpd = NA)
text(x = 0.55, y = y0 - h * 0.025, labels = "Cluster", adj = 1, xpd = NA, cex = 0.8)
text(x = 0.55, y = y0 - h * 0.085, labels = "MetaStatus", adj = 1, xpd = NA, cex = 0.8)
legend("topright", bty = "n", cex = 0.8, ncol = 2,
       legend = c("C1", "C2", "LN+", "LN-"),
       fill = c(jco[1], jco[2], cherry, lightgrey), border = NA)
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")
