inputData <- data.frame(X = sort(rnorm(n_ta, 6, 1.6)))
inputData$Y1 <- 2.2 * inputData$X + rnorm(n_ta, 0, 1.1) + 14    # miRNA (left)
inputData$Y2 <- 0.55 * inputData$X + rnorm(n_ta, 0, 0.35) + 0.2 # methylation (right)
scaleFactor <- max(inputData$Y1) / max(inputData$Y2)
AspectRatio <- 5 / 2
ratioValues <- ((max(inputData$X) - min(inputData$X)) /
                  (max(inputData$Y1) - min(inputData$Y1))) / AspectRatio
R1 <- cor.test(inputData$X, inputData$Y1, method = "pearson")
R2 <- cor.test(inputData$X, inputData$Y2, method = "pearson")
R1cor <- sprintf('italic(R)~"="~%.2f', R1$estimate)
R2cor <- sprintf('italic(R)~"="~%.2f', R2$estimate)
s1Colour <- "#6B9EC2"; s2Colour <- "#EE861A"

ggplot(inputData, aes(x = X)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Y1), col = s1Colour, size = 1.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = X, y = Y1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, col = s1Colour) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Y2 * scaleFactor), col = s2Colour, size = 1.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = X, y = Y2 * scaleFactor), method = "lm", se = FALSE,
              colour = s2Colour) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "miRNA expression (simulated)",
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(trans = ~ . / scaleFactor,
                                         name = "cg10586317 methylation (beta)")) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = ratioValues) +
  annotate("text", x = max(inputData$X) * 0.97, y = max(inputData$Y1) * 0.97,
           label = R1cor, size = 4.5, parse = TRUE, colour = s1Colour) +
  annotate("text", x = max(inputData$X) * 0.97, y = max(inputData$Y1) * 0.88,

  labs(x = "mRNA expression (simulated)") +

        axis.title.y.left = element_text(colour = s1Colour),
        axis.text.y.left = element_text(colour = s1Colour),
        axis.title.y.right = element_text(colour = s2Colour),

inputData$Y2 <- 0.55 * inputData$X + rnorm(n_ta, 0, 0.35) + 0.2 # methylation (right)
scaleFactor <- max(inputData$Y1) / max(inputData$Y2)
AspectRatio <- 5 / 2
ratioValues <- ((max(inputData$X) - min(inputData$X)) /
                  (max(inputData$Y1) - min(inputData$Y1))) / AspectRatio
R1 <- cor.test(inputData$X, inputData$Y1, method = "pearson")
R2 <- cor.test(inputData$X, inputData$Y2, method = "pearson")
R1cor <- sprintf('italic(R)~"="~%.2f', R1$estimate)

  geom_smooth(aes(x = X, y = Y1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, col = s1Colour) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Y2 * scaleFactor), col = s2Colour, size = 1.8) +

inputData$Y2 <- 0.55 * inputData$X + rnorm(n_ta, 0, 0.35) + 0.2 # methylation (right)

ratioValues <- ((max(inputData$X) - min(inputData$X)) /
                  (max(inputData$Y1) - min(inputData$Y1))) / AspectRatio
R1 <- cor.test(inputData$X, inputData$Y1, method = "pearson")
R2 <- cor.test(inputData$X, inputData$Y2, method = "pearson")

inputData$Y2 <- 0.55 * inputData$X + rnorm(n_ta, 0, 0.35) + 0.2 # methylation (right)

inputData$Y2 <- 0.55 * inputData$X + rnorm(n_ta, 0, 0.35) + 0.2 # methylation (right)
scaleFactor <- max(inputData$Y1) / max(inputData$Y2)
AspectRatio <- 5 / 2
ratioValues <- ((max(inputData$X) - min(inputData$X)) /
                  (max(inputData$Y1) - min(inputData$Y1))) / AspectRatio
R1 <- cor.test(inputData$X, inputData$Y1, method = "pearson")
R2 <- cor.test(inputData$X, inputData$Y2, method = "pearson")

  geom_smooth(aes(x = X, y = Y1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, col = s1Colour) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Y2 * scaleFactor), col = s2Colour, size = 1.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = X, y = Y2 * scaleFactor), method = "lm", se = FALSE,

  scale_y_continuous(name = "miRNA expression (simulated)",
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(trans = ~ . / scaleFactor,
                                         name = "cg10586317 methylation (beta)")) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = ratioValues) +
  annotate("text", x = max(inputData$X) * 0.97, y = max(inputData$Y1) * 0.97,

        axis.text.y.left = element_text(colour = s1Colour),
        axis.title.y.right = element_text(colour = s2Colour),

n_ta <- 60
inputData <- data.frame(X = sort(rnorm(n_ta, 6, 1.6)))
inputData$Y1 <- 2.2 * inputData$X + rnorm(n_ta, 0, 1.1) + 14    # miRNA (left)
inputData$Y2 <- 0.55 * inputData$X + rnorm(n_ta, 0, 0.35) + 0.2 # methylation (right)
scaleFactor <- max(inputData$Y1) / max(inputData$Y2)
AspectRatio <- 5 / 2
ratioValues <- ((max(inputData$X) - min(inputData$X)) /
                  (max(inputData$Y1) - min(inputData$Y1))) / AspectRatio
R1 <- cor.test(inputData$X, inputData$Y1, method = "pearson")
R2 <- cor.test(inputData$X, inputData$Y2, method = "pearson")
R1cor <- sprintf('italic(R)~"="~%.2f', R1$estimate)
R2cor <- sprintf('italic(R)~"="~%.2f', R2$estimate)
s1Colour <- "#6B9EC2"; s2Colour <- "#EE861A"

ggplot(inputData, aes(x = X)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Y1), col = s1Colour, size = 1.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = X, y = Y1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, col = s1Colour) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Y2 * scaleFactor), col = s2Colour, size = 1.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = X, y = Y2 * scaleFactor), method = "lm", se = FALSE,
              colour = s2Colour) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "miRNA expression (simulated)",
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(trans = ~ . / scaleFactor,
                                         name = "cg10586317 methylation (beta)")) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = ratioValues) +
  annotate("text", x = max(inputData$X) * 0.97, y = max(inputData$Y1) * 0.97,
           label = R1cor, size = 4.5, parse = TRUE, colour = s1Colour) +
  annotate("text", x = max(inputData$X) * 0.97, y = max(inputData$Y1) * 0.88,
           label = R2cor, size = 4.5, parse = TRUE, colour = s2Colour) +
  labs(x = "mRNA expression (simulated)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y.left = element_text(colour = s1Colour),
        axis.text.y.left = element_text(colour = s1Colour),
        axis.title.y.right = element_text(colour = s2Colour),
        axis.text.y.right = element_text(colour = s2Colour))

inputData$Y2 <- 0.55 * inputData$X + rnorm(n_ta, 0, 0.35) + 0.2 # methylation (right)
scaleFactor <- max(inputData$Y1) / max(inputData$Y2)
AspectRatio <- 5 / 2
ratioValues <- ((max(inputData$X) - min(inputData$X)) /
                  (max(inputData$Y1) - min(inputData$Y1))) / AspectRatio
R1 <- cor.test(inputData$X, inputData$Y1, method = "pearson")
R2 <- cor.test(inputData$X, inputData$Y2, method = "pearson")
R1cor <- sprintf('italic(R)~"="~%.2f', R1$estimate)

  geom_smooth(aes(x = X, y = Y1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, col = s1Colour) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Y2 * scaleFactor), col = s2Colour, size = 1.8) +

tcga_brca_survival <- readr::read_tsv("files/cos/TCGA-BRCA.survival.tsv")

tcga_brca_filtered <- tcga_brca_survival %>%
  filter(OS.time <= 2000) %>%
  mutate(month = floor(OS.time / 30))

monthly_death_counts <- tcga_brca_filtered %>%
  filter(OS == 1) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(deaths = n())

# AirPassengers
data("AirPassengers")
air_passenger_data <- as.data.frame(AirPassengers)

air_passenger_data$Month <- rep(month.name, 12)
air_passenger_data$Year <- rep(1949:1960, each=12)
air_passenger_data$x <- as.numeric(air_passenger_data$x)

air_passenger_long <- air_passenger_data %>%
  gather(key = "Variable", value = "Value", -Year, -Month)

air_passenger_percentage <- air_passenger_long %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = Value / sum(Value) * 100) # Calculate the percentage for each month

air_passenger_time_series <- data.frame(datetime = time(AirPassengers), count = as.vector(AirPassengers))

air_passenger_time_series$datetime <- as.Date(air_passenger_time_series$datetime)
air_passenger_xts <- xts(x = air_passenger_time_series$count, order.by = air_passenger_time_series$datetime) # Creating an XTS object

# Basic area plot
p <- ggplot(monthly_death_counts, aes(x = month, y = deaths)) +
  geom_area() +
  labs(title = "Cumulative Deaths Over Time",
       x = "Months",
       y = "Number of Deaths")

p

# Custom area plot
p <- ggplot(monthly_death_counts, aes(x = month, y = deaths)) +
  geom_area(fill="#69b3a2", alpha=0.4) +
  geom_line(color="#69b3a2", size=1.2) +
  geom_point(size=3, color="#69b3a2") +
  theme_ipsum() +
  labs(title = "Cumulative Deaths Over Time",
       x = "Months",
       y = "Number of Deaths")

p

# Add gradient colors
p <- ggplot(monthly_death_counts, aes(x = month, y = deaths)) +  
  geom_area() +  
  labs(title = "Cumulative Deaths Over Time",       
      x = "Months",       
      y = "Number of Deaths") +  
  geom_area_pattern(data = monthly_death_counts, 
                    pattern = "gradient", 
                    pattern_fill = "white",
                    pattern_fill2 = "red")

p

                  pattern_fill2 = "blue")

p

tcga_brca_filtered <- tcga_brca_survival %>%
  filter(OS.time <= 2000) %>%
  mutate(month = floor(OS.time / 30))

monthly_death_counts <- tcga_brca_filtered %>%
  filter(OS == 1) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(deaths = n())

# AirPassengers
data("AirPassengers")
air_passenger_data <- as.data.frame(AirPassengers)

air_passenger_data$Month <- rep(month.name, 12)
air_passenger_data$Year <- rep(1949:1960, each=12)
air_passenger_data$x <- as.numeric(air_passenger_data$x)

air_passenger_long <- air_passenger_data %>%
  gather(key = "Variable", value = "Value", -Year, -Month)

air_passenger_percentage <- air_passenger_long %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = Value / sum(Value) * 100) # Calculate the percentage for each month

air_passenger_time_series <- data.frame(datetime = time(AirPassengers), count = as.vector(AirPassengers))

air_passenger_time_series$datetime <- as.Date(air_passenger_time_series$datetime)
air_passenger_xts <- xts(x = air_passenger_time_series$count, order.by = air_passenger_time_series$datetime) # Creating an XTS object

# Basic area plot
p <- ggplot(monthly_death_counts, aes(x = month, y = deaths)) +
  geom_area() +
  labs(title = "Cumulative Deaths Over Time",
       x = "Months",
       y = "Number of Deaths")

p

# Custom area plot
p <- ggplot(monthly_death_counts, aes(x = month, y = deaths)) +
  geom_area(fill="#69b3a2", alpha=0.4) +
  geom_line(color="#69b3a2", size=1.2) +
  geom_point(size=3, color="#69b3a2") +
  theme_ipsum() +
  labs(title = "Cumulative Deaths Over Time",
       x = "Months",
       y = "Number of Deaths")

p

# Add gradient colors
p <- ggplot(monthly_death_counts, aes(x = month, y = deaths)) +  
  geom_area() +  
  labs(title = "Cumulative Deaths Over Time",       
      x = "Months",       
      y = "Number of Deaths") +  
  geom_area_pattern(data = monthly_death_counts, 
                    pattern = "gradient", 
                    pattern_fill = "white",
                    pattern_fill2 = "red")

p

# Gradient colors with transparency
p <- ggplot(monthly_death_counts, aes(x = month, y = deaths)) +
  geom_area_pattern(data = monthly_death_counts, 
                  pattern = "gradient",
                  fill = "#00000010",
                  pattern_fill  = "#00000010",
                  pattern_fill2 = "blue")

p

# Fully customized area map with gradient
p <- ggplot(monthly_death_counts, aes(x = month, y = deaths)) +
  geom_area_pattern(data = monthly_death_counts,
                    pattern = "gradient", 
                    fill = "#00000000",
                    pattern_fill  = "#00000000",
                    pattern_fill2 = "magenta") + 
  geom_line(data = monthly_death_counts, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 4.5, colour = "purple") +
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 2.5, colour = "white") +
  ggtitle("Cumulative Deaths Over Time") + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
        panel.border       = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x        = element_line(),
        text               = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.ticks         = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y        = element_text(margin = margin(0,15,0,0, unit = "pt"))) +
  scale_alpha_identity() + labs(x="",y="")

p

plot(monthly_death_counts$month, monthly_death_counts$deaths, col=rgb(0.2,0.1,0.5,0.9), type="o", lwd=3,
     xlab="Months", ylab="Number of Deaths", pch=20, main="Cumulative Deaths Over Time")

polygon(
  x = c(min(monthly_death_counts$month), monthly_death_counts$month,
        max(monthly_death_counts$month)), # Close x-boundary
  y = c(0, monthly_death_counts$deaths, 0), # Close y-boundary
  col = rgb(0.2, 0.1, 0.5, 0.2),
  border = FALSE) # Use polygon() to fill the area.

p <- ggplot(air_passenger_long, aes(x = Year, y = Value, fill = Month)) +
  geom_area() +
  labs(title = "Monthly Air Passengers (Stacked Area Chart)", 
       x = "Year", y = "Number of Passengers") +
  theme_minimal()

p

# Sort by month
air_passenger_data$Month <- factor(air_passenger_data$Month, levels = month.name) # Convert the Month column into ordered factors.

air_passenger_long <- air_passenger_data %>%
  gather(key = "Variable", value = "Value", -Year, -Month)

p <- ggplot(air_passenger_long, aes(x = Year, y = Value, fill = Month)) +
  geom_area() +
  labs(title = "Monthly Air Passengers", 
       x = "Year", y = "Number of Passengers") +
  theme_minimal()

p

# Sort alphabetically
myLevels <- levels(factor(air_passenger_long$Month)) 
air_passenger_long$Month <- factor(air_passenger_long$Month, levels = sort(myLevels))

p <- ggplot(air_passenger_long, aes(x = Year, y = Value, fill = Month)) +
  geom_area() +
  labs(title = "Monthly Air Passengers",
       x = "Year", y = "Number of Passengers") +
  theme_minimal()

p

# Sort by value for a specific year (e.g., 1949)
myLevels_value <- air_passenger_long %>%
  filter(Year == 1949) %>%  
  arrange(Value) 

air_passenger_long$Month <- factor(air_passenger_long$Month, levels = myLevels_value$Month)

p <- ggplot(air_passenger_long, aes(x = Year, y = Value, fill = Month)) +
  geom_area() +
  labs(title = "Monthly Air Passengers (Sorted by 1949 Values)",
       x = "Year", y = "Number of Passengers") +
  theme_minimal()

p

p <- ggplot(air_passenger_long, aes(x = Year, y = Value, fill = Month)) +
  geom_area(alpha=0.6 , size=.5, colour="white") +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = T) +
  theme_ipsum() + 
  ggtitle("Monthly Air Passengers")

p

p <- ggplot(air_passenger_percentage, aes(x = Year, y = Percentage, fill = Month)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.6, size = 1, colour = "black") +
  labs(title = "Monthly Air Passengers",
       x = "Year", y = "Percentage of Passengers") +
  theme_minimal()

p

p <- dygraph(air_passenger_xts) %>%
  dyOptions(labelsUTC = TRUE, fillGraph = TRUE, fillAlpha = 0.1, drawGrid = FALSE, colors = "#D8AE5A") %>%
  dyRangeSelector() %>%
  dyCrosshair(direction = "vertical") %>%
  dyHighlight(highlightCircleSize = 5, highlightSeriesBackgroundAlpha = 0.2, hideOnMouseOut = FALSE) %>%
  dyRoller(rollPeriod = 1)

p

# 2.Quantitative dehydration estimation data
data_water <- read.csv("files/cos/dehydration_estimation.csv", header = T)

axis_name <- colnames(data_water)[c(5, 8)]        # Record column names
data_water <- data_water %>%                      # Select 2 sets of data
  slice(c(19:27, 46:54)) %>%
  select(c(1, 5, 8)) %>%        
  setNames(c("V1", "V2", "V3")) %>%               # Change column name
  mutate(V4 = case_when(V1 == 3 ~ "people1",      # Column V4 serves as category labels.
                        V1 == 6 ~ "people2"))

head(data_water)

# Basic plot
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = date, y = psavert)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("")

p

# geom_point() display observation point
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = date, y = psavert)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("") +
  geom_point()

p

# Multi-class data plotting
p <- ggplot(data_water, aes(x = V2, y = V3, group = V4)) +     # V4 category labels are mapped to grouping and color features.
  geom_line(aes(color = V4)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = V4)) +
  ylab(axis_name[2]) +                      # Add axis labels
  xlab(axis_name[1]) +
  # Change the legend position
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.85))

p

# Set the date using scale_x_date()
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = date, y = psavert)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("") + 
  geom_point() + 
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y-%m")  

p

# Use scale_x_date() to set the display interval of date labels
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = date, y = psavert)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("") + 
  geom_point() + 
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y/%m",date_breaks = "9 month")

p

# Adjust the label angle using theme()
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = date, y = psavert)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("") + 
  geom_point() + 
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y/%m",date_breaks = "3 month")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))     # The `angle` parameter adjusts the label angle; `hjust=1` aligns the rightmost horizontal edge of the label name with the label tick mark.

p

# Extracting a time-limited image using the limit parameter of scale_x_date()
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = date, y = psavert)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("") + 
  geom_point() + 
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y/%m",date_breaks = "3 month",
               limit = c(as.Date("1968-01-01"), as.Date("1969-12-01")))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))

p

# Notes and separators
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = date, y = psavert)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("") + 
  geom_point() + 
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y/%m",date_breaks = "3 month")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))+
# Comment text
  annotate(geom="text",x=as.Date("1971-06-01"),y=14.7,label="MAX of pasavert")+
# Comment points
  annotate(geom="point",x=as.Date("1971-06-01"),y=14.7,color="red")+
# Add horizontal line
  geom_hline(yintercept=13.5,color="blue")

p

# To display subgraphs on a single graph, the patchwork needs to be loaded.
p <- ggplot(data_double, aes(x = date, y = psavert)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("")

p1 <- ggplot(data_double, aes(x = date, y = uempmed)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("")

p + p1          # Subgraph merging

# For dual y-axis setup, use sec.axis to set the second y-axis.
p <- ggplot(data_double, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = psavert),color = "red") +
  geom_line(aes(y = uempmed * 3),color = "blue") +      # The scales are inconsistent, so a multiplier is needed.
  xlab("")+
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "psavert",
# `transform` divides the left y-axis coordinate by the multiple above, and `name` sets the name.
    sec.axis = sec_axis(transform = ~ . / 3, name = "uempmed")   
  ) +
# Set the title for the dual y-axis to the same color as the corresponding line segment for easy differentiation.
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "red", size = 13),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "blue", size = 13),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p

                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  p <- which(paths == tgt_path[i])
  tri <- runif(1, 0, 2 * pi)
  data.frame(tgt = targets[i], path = paths[p], type = tgt_type[i],
             x = path_df$cx[p] + path_df$r[p] * cos(tri),

  lines(x0 + r * cos(th), y0 + r * sin(th), col = col, lwd = 1)

  p <- which(paths == tgt_path[i])
  tri <- runif(1, 0, 2 * pi)
  data.frame(tgt = targets[i], path = paths[p], type = tgt_type[i],
             x = path_df$cx[p] + path_df$r[p] * cos(tri),

path_sizes <- c(30, 28, 24, 22, 16)

                    tgt = sample(targets, 380, replace = TRUE),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
links <- links[!duplicated(links), ]
links$source_type <- src_type[match(links$src, sources)]
stopifnot(nrow(links) >= 250 && all(links$source_type %in% c("src_up", "src_dn")))

# geometry: sources share one vertical rail at x = 0; each pathway becomes a circle
src_df <- data.frame(src = sources, src_type = src_type,
                     x = 0, y = seq_along(sources) * 1.2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cen_y <- c(10.5, 8.2, 5.9, 3.6, 1.3)  # staggered rows, centre gaps > 2r so circles never overlap
path_df <- data.frame(path = paths, cx = 4.2, cy = cen_y, r = 1.05,
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
tgt_xy <- lapply(seq_along(targets), function(i) {
  p <- which(paths == tgt_path[i])
  tri <- runif(1, 0, 2 * pi)
  data.frame(tgt = targets[i], path = paths[p], type = tgt_type[i],
             x = path_df$cx[p] + path_df$r[p] * cos(tri),
             y = path_df$cy[p] + path_df$r[p] * sin(tri), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
tgt_df <- do.call(rbind, tgt_xy)

# parametric circle helper (pure base graphics)
circle <- function(x0, y0, r, col) {
  th <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 120)
  lines(x0 + r * cos(th), y0 + r * sin(th), col = col, lwd = 1)
}
# pathway circles first, targets overlay them later
for (k in seq_along(paths)) {
  circle(path_df$cx[k], path_df$cy[k], path_df$r[k], "grey25")
  cnt <- sum(tgt_df$path == paths[k])
  text(path_df$cx[k] + path_df$r[k] + 0.28, path_df$cy[k], paths[k], cex = 0.82, col = "grey25")
  text(path_df$cx[k], path_df$cy[k], cnt, cex = 0.9, col = "grey45")
}

set.seed(7401)
n_src <- 8; n_tgt <- 120; n_path <- 5
sources <- paste0("miR", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_src))
targets <- paste0("T", sprintf("%03d", 1:n_tgt))
paths <- paste0("PATH", 1:n_path)
src_type <- c(rep("src_up", n_src / 2), rep("src_dn", n_src / 2))
src_type <- src_type[sample(n_src)]
path_sizes <- c(30, 28, 24, 22, 16)
tgt_path <- rep(paths, times = path_sizes)
tgt_type <- sample(c("tar_up", "tar_dn"), n_tgt, replace = TRUE)
links <- data.frame(src = sample(sources, 380, replace = TRUE),
                    tgt = sample(targets, 380, replace = TRUE),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
links <- links[!duplicated(links), ]
links$source_type <- src_type[match(links$src, sources)]
stopifnot(nrow(links) >= 250 && all(links$source_type %in% c("src_up", "src_dn")))

# geometry: sources share one vertical rail at x = 0; each pathway becomes a circle
src_df <- data.frame(src = sources, src_type = src_type,
                     x = 0, y = seq_along(sources) * 1.2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cen_y <- c(10.5, 8.2, 5.9, 3.6, 1.3)  # staggered rows, centre gaps > 2r so circles never overlap
path_df <- data.frame(path = paths, cx = 4.2, cy = cen_y, r = 1.05,
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
tgt_xy <- lapply(seq_along(targets), function(i) {
  p <- which(paths == tgt_path[i])
  tri <- runif(1, 0, 2 * pi)
  data.frame(tgt = targets[i], path = paths[p], type = tgt_type[i],
             x = path_df$cx[p] + path_df$r[p] * cos(tri),
             y = path_df$cy[p] + path_df$r[p] * sin(tri), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
tgt_df <- do.call(rbind, tgt_xy)
colmap <- c(src_up = "#C0272D", src_dn = "#1F5FA6", tar_up = "#D85A5F", tar_dn = "#5E93D0")
par(mar = c(2, 2, 2, 2))
plot(NA, NA, xlim = c(-1.2, 6.2), ylim = c(-1.2, 12), xlab = NA, ylab = NA,
     xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n", bty = "n", pch = NA, asp = 1)
# parametric circle helper (pure base graphics)
circle <- function(x0, y0, r, col) {
  th <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 120)
  lines(x0 + r * cos(th), y0 + r * sin(th), col = col, lwd = 1)
}
# pathway circles first, targets overlay them later
for (k in seq_along(paths)) {
  circle(path_df$cx[k], path_df$cy[k], path_df$r[k], "grey25")
  cnt <- sum(tgt_df$path == paths[k])
  text(path_df$cx[k] + path_df$r[k] + 0.28, path_df$cy[k], paths[k], cex = 0.82, col = "grey25")
  text(path_df$cx[k], path_df$cy[k], cnt, cex = 0.9, col = "grey45")
}
# links coloured by source class, half transparent so the web stays readable
for (r in seq_len(nrow(links))) {
  x0 <- src_df$x[match(links$src[r], src_df$src)]
  y0 <- src_df$y[match(links$src[r], src_df$src)]
  ti <- match(links$tgt[r], tgt_df$tgt)
  lines(c(x0, tgt_df$x[ti]), c(y0, tgt_df$y[ti]),
        col = adjustcolor(colmap[[links$source_type[r]]], alpha = 0.55), lwd = 0.5)
}
# source nodes with rotated labels, then target nodes coloured by type
points(src_df$x, src_df$y, pch = 16, cex = 1.5, col = colmap[src_df$src_type])
text(src_df$x - 0.25, src_df$y, src_df$src, srt = 90, adj = 1, cex = 0.72)
points(tgt_df$x, tgt_df$y, pch = 16, cex = 1.0, col = colmap[tgt_df$type])

patient_score <- 20

prop <- 0.05; mark <- patient_score
plot.region <- c(min(scores$Value), max(scores$Value))
plot.region <- rbind(plot.region, (plot.region - min(plot.region)) * prop)
plot.data <- split(scores[, c("Group", "Value"), drop = FALSE], scores$Group)
deg.adjust <- 360 * 0.5 * prop
circos.par("start.degree" = 360 - deg.adjust, track.margin = c(0.01, 0.01))
circos.initialize(sectors = c("main", "spare"), xlim = plot.region)

## outer ring: tumour samples

            clock.wise = FALSE, col = "#FF000080", border = NA)

circos.track(sectors = rep("main", nrow(tumor)), x = tumor$Value,
             y = runif(nrow(tumor)), panel.fun = function(x, y) {
               circos.points(x, y, col = "deepskyblue3", bg = "deepskyblue",
                             pch = 21, cex = 0.7)
             }, ylim = c(0, 1), bg.border = NA)

             sector.index = "main", track.index = 1, col = "#618895", lwd = 2)

draw.sector(deg.adjust, 360 - deg.adjust, rou1 = 0.77, rou2 = 0.57,
            clock.wise = FALSE, col = "#B1CFC3", border = NA)

circos.xaxis(sector.index = "main", track.index = 1, h = "top",

text(x = 0, y = 0, sprintf("Patient: %.0f", mark), cex = 0.9)
legend("topright", inset = c(0.005, 0.02), bty = "n", cex = 0.82, xpd = NA,
       legend = c("Tumour (n = 800)", "Normal (n = 120)",

       col = c("deepskyblue3", "firebrick3", "#618895", "#FF000080"),

set.seed(7501)
n <- 420
genes <- c("TP53", "KRAS", "EGFR", "PIK3CA")
gprob <- c(0.34, 0.26, 0.22, 0.18)
mutlv <- c("Mis", "Non", "Fs", "Sil")
dfE <- data.frame(gene = sample(genes, n, replace = TRUE, prob = gprob),
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dfE$mutation <- ifelse(dfE$gene == "TP53",
                       sample(c("Mis", "Non", "Fs", "Sil"), n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(.5, .2, .2, .1)),
                       sample(mutlv, n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(.4, .25, .2, .15)))
dfE$subtype <- ifelse(dfE$gene %in% c("TP53"),
                      sample(c("Basal", "Luminal", "Normal"), n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(.5, .3, .2)),
                      sample(c("Basal", "Luminal", "Normal"), n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(.2, .5, .3)))
loE <- to_lodes_form(dfE[, c("gene", "mutation", "subtype")], key = "Gene", axes = 1:3, id = "Cohort")
stopifnot(sum(is.na(loE$stratum)) == 0 && nrow(loE) > 0)
mycol <- rep(c("#223D6C", "#D20A13", "#FFD121", "#088247", "#11AA4D", "#58CDD9",
               "#7A142C", "#5D90BA", "#029149", "#431A3D", "#91612D", "#6E568C",
               "#E0367A", "#D8D155", "#64495D", "#7CC767"), 2)
p_e <- ggplot(loE, aes(x = Gene, stratum = stratum, alluvium = Cohort,
                       fill = stratum, label = stratum)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  geom_flow(width = 1 / 9) +
  geom_stratum(alpha = 0.92, width = 1 / 11) +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", size = 2.5, colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mycol, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank())
print(p_e)
# gate: every gene reaches >= 2 subtypes - the crossing the alluvium exists to show
cross <- with(dfE, tapply(subtype, gene, function(z) length(unique(z))))
stopifnot(all(cross >= 2))
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")

# Co-authored Network Data Processing and Graphics
# 1.Data layout transformation
connect <- data_dif %>% # connect stores the edge information of the nodes.
  gather(key = "to", value = "value", -1) %>% # Use this method to convert the data excluding the first column into two columns (one column for column names and one column for values).
  mutate(to = gsub("\\.", " ", to)) %>% # Change the column name format from "to" to be consistent with "from".
  na.omit() # Remove NA value

# 2.Node statistics
coauth <- # coauth stores node names and in/out degree information; grouping information will be added later.
  c(as.character(connect$from), as.character(connect$to)) %>%
  as.tibble() %>% # Similar to a data frame type, column names default to "value" —
  group_by(value) %>% # Group by "value"
  summarize(n = n()) # Count the in-degree and out-degree of node names
colnames(coauth) <- c("name", "n") # Change column name

# 3.Grouping nodes
mygraph <- graph_from_data_frame(connect, vertices = coauth, directed = FALSE) # Generate a graph
com <- walktrap.community(mygraph) # Grouping based on the path size of the nodes————
# Add group information to Coauth
coauth <- coauth %>%
  mutate(grp = com$membership) %>% # Add Groups
  arrange(grp) %>% # Sort by group
  mutate(name = factor(name, name))

# 4.Select the top 15 groups
coauth <- coauth[coauth$grp < 16, ]
# Filter connections that appear only in the first 15 sets of points.
connect <- connect %>%
  filter(from %in% coauth$name) %>%
  filter(to %in% coauth$name)

# 5.Generate a graph

# Generate colors by group

  geom_edge_arc(edge_colour = "black", edge_alpha = 0.2, edge_width = 0.3, fold = TRUE) +
  geom_node_point(aes(size = n, color = as.factor(grp), fill = grp), alpha = 0.5) + # Map n and the grouping variable to size and color.
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 8)) + # Set size range
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolor) + # Set the group color
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), angle = 65, hjust = 1, nudge_y = -1.1, size = 2.3) + # Set node labels and skew them to avoid overlap.
  theme_void() + # Remove background table, axis theme
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # Remove legend

    panel.spacing = unit(c(0, 0, 3.4, 0), "null")

set.seed(43529)
gmax <- 12

## 46 collinear anchors along the main diagonal.
n <- 46
q0 <- runif(n, 0.15, 10.7)
q1 <- pmin(q0 + runif(n, 0.25, 1.15), 11.95)
fwd <- data.frame(q0 = q0, q1 = q1,
                  t0 = pmax(q0 + rnorm(n, 0, 0.035), 0.02),
                  t1 = pmin(q1 + rnorm(n, 0, 0.035), 11.98),
                  class = "Forward")

## Inverted blocks: the target is traversed right-to-left, so the slope is negative.
inv_q0 <- c(1.30, 2.75, 4.15, 5.55, 7.05, 8.55, 9.95)
inv_len <- c(0.60, 0.45, 0.75, 0.50, 0.65, 0.40, 0.70)
inv <- data.frame(q0 = inv_q0, q1 = inv_q0 + inv_len,
                  t0 = inv_q0 + 1.35 + runif(7, 0, 0.12),
                  t1 = inv_q0 + 1.35 - inv_len, class = "Inverted")

## One duplicated 0.8 Mb query block aligned to four target loci.
rep_loci <- c(3.20, 6.00, 8.80, 10.35)
reps <- data.frame(q0 = 2.00, q1 = 2.80, t0 = rep_loci,
                   t1 = rep_loci + 0.80, class = "Repeat")

aln <- rbind(fwd, inv, reps)
aln$class <- factor(aln$class, levels = c("Forward", "Inverted", "Repeat"))

ggplot(aln) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = q0, xend = q1, y = t0, yend = t1, colour = class),
               linewidth = 0.55, lineend = "round", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "22",
              colour = "grey35", linewidth = 0.35) +
  annotate("text", x = 9.05, y = 9.35, label = "collinear diagonal",
           angle = 45, size = 2.5, colour = "grey35", hjust = 0) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Forward = "#2f6db3", Inverted = "#c94c3b",
                                 Repeat = "#7b52ab"), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 12, 3), limits = c(0, 12),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 12, 3), limits = c(0, 12),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "Query assembly (Mb)", y = "Reference assembly (Mb)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey91", linewidth = 0.25),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey55", fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 0.5),
        legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.55, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "grey25"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8.3),
        plot.margin = margin(4, 8, 4, 4))

set.seed(43530)
ids <- sprintf("g%02d", 1:10)
family <- rep(c("F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5"), each = 2)
glen <- c(0.95, 0.80, 1.05, 0.90, 1.10, 0.85, 0.75, 1.00, 0.95, 0.90)
gap <- 0.12

h1_order <- 1:10
h2_order <- c(1, 2, 5, 6, 8, 7, 3, 4, 9, 10)

layout <- function(order, strand) {
  len <- glen[order]
  x0 <- cumsum(c(0, len[-length(len)] + gap))
  data.frame(id = ids[order], family = family[order], len = len,
             x0 = x0, x1 = x0 + len, mid = x0 + len / 2,
             strand = strand[match(ids[order], ids)],
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
h1 <- layout(h1_order, rep("+", length(ids))); h1$y <- 2.15

set.seed(43522)

## One gene with eight exons and three isoforms. Transcript coordinates are the
## exons concatenated with a fixed 30 bp gap; the same exon therefore has a
## different coordinate in every isoform.
exons <- data.frame(
  exon = 1:8,
  gstart = c(100, 500, 800, 1100, 1500, 1900, 2300, 2700),
  gend   = c(300, 620, 900, 1250, 1600, 2000, 2450, 2900)
)
tx <- list(T1 = 1:8, T2 = c(1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8), T3 = c(1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8))
gap <- 30

tx_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tx), function(t) {
  ids <- tx[[t]]
  e <- exons[match(ids, exons$exon), ]
  e$x0 <- cumsum(c(0, (e$gend - e$gstart + gap)[-nrow(e)]))
  e$x1 <- e$x0 + (e$gend - e$gstart)
  e$tx <- t
  e
}))
tx_tab$y <- as.numeric(factor(tx_tab$tx, levels = names(tx)))

## Coverage in each transcript's own coordinates. In genomic coordinates the
## same reads would be forced onto one axis and the isoform-specific peaks
## would overlap.

## One gene with eight exons and three isoforms. Transcript coordinates are the
## exons concatenated with a fixed 30 bp gap; the same exon therefore has a
## different coordinate in every isoform.
exons <- data.frame(
  exon = 1:8,
  gstart = c(100, 500, 800, 1100, 1500, 1900, 2300, 2700),
  gend   = c(300, 620, 900, 1250, 1600, 2000, 2450, 2900)
)
tx <- list(T1 = 1:8, T2 = c(1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8), T3 = c(1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8))
gap <- 30

tx_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tx), function(t) {
  ids <- tx[[t]]
  e <- exons[match(ids, exons$exon), ]
  e$x0 <- cumsum(c(0, (e$gend - e$gstart + gap)[-nrow(e)]))
  e$x1 <- e$x0 + (e$gend - e$gstart)
  e$tx <- t
  e
}))
tx_tab$y <- as.numeric(factor(tx_tab$tx, levels = names(tx)))

## Coverage in each transcript's own coordinates. In genomic coordinates the
## same reads would be forced onto one axis and the isoform-specific peaks
## would overlap.
cov_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tx), function(t) {
  e <- tx_tab |> filter(tx == t)
  p <- seq(0, max(e$x1), by = 5)
  inside <- sapply(p, function(x) any(x >= e$x0 & x <= e$x1))
  peak_at <- mean(e$x0[e$exon %in% c(1, 4)])
  sig <- ifelse(inside, 0.35, 0.05) +
    0.9 * exp(-((p - peak_at)^2) / (2 * 180^2)) +
    rnorm(length(p), 0, 0.03)
  data.frame(tx = t, pos = p, cov = pmax(sig, 0), y = unique(e$y))
}))

}

set.seed(43522)

## One gene with eight exons and three isoforms. Transcript coordinates are the
## exons concatenated with a fixed 30 bp gap; the same exon therefore has a
## different coordinate in every isoform.
exons <- data.frame(
  exon = 1:8,
  gstart = c(100, 500, 800, 1100, 1500, 1900, 2300, 2700),
  gend   = c(300, 620, 900, 1250, 1600, 2000, 2450, 2900)
)
tx <- list(T1 = 1:8, T2 = c(1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8), T3 = c(1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8))
gap <- 30

tx_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tx), function(t) {
  ids <- tx[[t]]
  e <- exons[match(ids, exons$exon), ]
  e$x0 <- cumsum(c(0, (e$gend - e$gstart + gap)[-nrow(e)]))
  e$x1 <- e$x0 + (e$gend - e$gstart)
  e$tx <- t
  e
}))
tx_tab$y <- as.numeric(factor(tx_tab$tx, levels = names(tx)))

## Coverage in each transcript's own coordinates. In genomic coordinates the
## same reads would be forced onto one axis and the isoform-specific peaks
## would overlap.
cov_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tx), function(t) {
  e <- tx_tab |> filter(tx == t)
  p <- seq(0, max(e$x1), by = 5)
  inside <- sapply(p, function(x) any(x >= e$x0 & x <= e$x1))
  peak_at <- mean(e$x0[e$exon %in% c(1, 4)])
  sig <- ifelse(inside, 0.35, 0.05) +
    0.9 * exp(-((p - peak_at)^2) / (2 * 180^2)) +
    rnorm(length(p), 0, 0.03)
  data.frame(tx = t, pos = p, cov = pmax(sig, 0), y = unique(e$y))
}))
cov_tab <- cov_tab |> group_by(tx) |> mutate(cov = cov / max(cov) * 0.62) |> ungroup()

## Gene neighbourhood in five species: g2 is inverted in sp3, g4 in sp4, g5 is
## absent in sp3 and g6 is absent in sp5.
sp <- c("sp1", "sp2", "sp3", "sp4", "sp5")
nb <- data.frame(
  species = rep(sp, each = 6),
  order = rep(1:6, 5),
  gene = c("g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","g6",
           "g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","g6",
           "g1","g3","g2","g4","g6","-",
           "g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","g6",
           "g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","-"),
  forward = c(rep(TRUE, 6), rep(TRUE, 6),
              TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE,
              TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE,
              rep(TRUE, 5), FALSE)
) |>
  filter(gene != "-") |>
  mutate(x0 = (order - 1) * 1000, x1 = x0 + 820)

ggplot() +
  ## Coverage as a ribbon from the row baseline, so each isoform keeps its own
  ## y band instead of overlapping the next one.
  geom_ribbon(data = cov_tab, aes(x = pos, ymin = y, ymax = y + cov, group = tx),
              fill = "#9ecae1", alpha = 0.75, colour = NA) +
  geom_rect(data = tx_tab, aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = y - 0.10, ymax = y + 0.10),
            fill = "#2c7bb6", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = tx_tab, aes((x0 + x1) / 2, y, label = exon),
            size = 1.7, colour = "white") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = names(tx),
                     limits = c(0.6, 3.75), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  labs(x = "transcript coordinate (bp, exons concatenated)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

ggplot(nb, aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, y = species, fill = gene, forward = forward)) +
  gggenes::geom_gene_arrow(arrowhead_height = unit(3, "mm"),
                           arrowhead_width = unit(1, "mm")) +
  geom_text(aes((x0 + x1) / 2, species, label = gene), size = 2.1, colour = "#222222") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(sp)) +
  labs(x = "gene neighbourhood coordinate (bp)", y = NULL) +
  gggenes::theme_genes() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8))

mk_track <- function(base, peaks, noise_sd = 0.08) {
  sig <- rep(base, n_bin)
  for (pk in peaks) sig[pk[1]:pk[2]] <- sig[pk[1]:pk[2]] + pk[3]
  sig + rnorm(n_bin, sd = noise_sd)
}

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("ATAC-seq" = "#445EAD", "ChIP-seq" = "#B2182B")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Signal") +

set.seed(43522)

## One gene with eight exons and three isoforms. Transcript coordinates are the
## exons concatenated with a fixed 30 bp gap; the same exon therefore has a
## different coordinate in every isoform.
exons <- data.frame(
  exon = 1:8,
  gstart = c(100, 500, 800, 1100, 1500, 1900, 2300, 2700),
  gend   = c(300, 620, 900, 1250, 1600, 2000, 2450, 2900)
)
tx <- list(T1 = 1:8, T2 = c(1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8), T3 = c(1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8))
gap <- 30

tx_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tx), function(t) {
  ids <- tx[[t]]
  e <- exons[match(ids, exons$exon), ]
  e$x0 <- cumsum(c(0, (e$gend - e$gstart + gap)[-nrow(e)]))
  e$x1 <- e$x0 + (e$gend - e$gstart)
  e$tx <- t
  e
}))
tx_tab$y <- as.numeric(factor(tx_tab$tx, levels = names(tx)))

## Coverage in each transcript's own coordinates. In genomic coordinates the
## same reads would be forced onto one axis and the isoform-specific peaks
## would overlap.
cov_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tx), function(t) {
  e <- tx_tab |> filter(tx == t)
  p <- seq(0, max(e$x1), by = 5)
  inside <- sapply(p, function(x) any(x >= e$x0 & x <= e$x1))
  peak_at <- mean(e$x0[e$exon %in% c(1, 4)])
  sig <- ifelse(inside, 0.35, 0.05) +
    0.9 * exp(-((p - peak_at)^2) / (2 * 180^2)) +
    rnorm(length(p), 0, 0.03)
  data.frame(tx = t, pos = p, cov = pmax(sig, 0), y = unique(e$y))
}))
cov_tab <- cov_tab |> group_by(tx) |> mutate(cov = cov / max(cov) * 0.62) |> ungroup()

## Gene neighbourhood in five species: g2 is inverted in sp3, g4 in sp4, g5 is
## absent in sp3 and g6 is absent in sp5.
sp <- c("sp1", "sp2", "sp3", "sp4", "sp5")
nb <- data.frame(
  species = rep(sp, each = 6),
  order = rep(1:6, 5),
  gene = c("g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","g6",
           "g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","g6",
           "g1","g3","g2","g4","g6","-",
           "g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","g6",
           "g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","-"),
  forward = c(rep(TRUE, 6), rep(TRUE, 6),
              TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE,
              TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE,
              rep(TRUE, 5), FALSE)
) |>
  filter(gene != "-") |>
  mutate(x0 = (order - 1) * 1000, x1 = x0 + 820)

ggplot() +
  ## Coverage as a ribbon from the row baseline, so each isoform keeps its own
  ## y band instead of overlapping the next one.
  geom_ribbon(data = cov_tab, aes(x = pos, ymin = y, ymax = y + cov, group = tx),
              fill = "#9ecae1", alpha = 0.75, colour = NA) +
  geom_rect(data = tx_tab, aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = y - 0.10, ymax = y + 0.10),
            fill = "#2c7bb6", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = tx_tab, aes((x0 + x1) / 2, y, label = exon),
            size = 1.7, colour = "white") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = names(tx),
                     limits = c(0.6, 3.75), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  labs(x = "transcript coordinate (bp, exons concatenated)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

ggplot(nb, aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, y = species, fill = gene, forward = forward)) +
  gggenes::geom_gene_arrow(arrowhead_height = unit(3, "mm"),
                           arrowhead_width = unit(1, "mm")) +
  geom_text(aes((x0 + x1) / 2, species, label = gene), size = 2.1, colour = "#222222") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(sp)) +
  labs(x = "gene neighbourhood coordinate (bp)", y = NULL) +
  gggenes::theme_genes() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8))

## One gene with eight exons and three isoforms. Transcript coordinates are the
## exons concatenated with a fixed 30 bp gap; the same exon therefore has a
## different coordinate in every isoform.
exons <- data.frame(
  exon = 1:8,
  gstart = c(100, 500, 800, 1100, 1500, 1900, 2300, 2700),
  gend   = c(300, 620, 900, 1250, 1600, 2000, 2450, 2900)
)
tx <- list(T1 = 1:8, T2 = c(1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8), T3 = c(1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8))
gap <- 30

tx_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tx), function(t) {
  ids <- tx[[t]]
  e <- exons[match(ids, exons$exon), ]
  e$x0 <- cumsum(c(0, (e$gend - e$gstart + gap)[-nrow(e)]))
  e$x1 <- e$x0 + (e$gend - e$gstart)
  e$tx <- t
  e
}))
tx_tab$y <- as.numeric(factor(tx_tab$tx, levels = names(tx)))

## Coverage in each transcript's own coordinates. In genomic coordinates the
## same reads would be forced onto one axis and the isoform-specific peaks
## would overlap.
cov_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tx), function(t) {
  e <- tx_tab |> filter(tx == t)
  p <- seq(0, max(e$x1), by = 5)
  inside <- sapply(p, function(x) any(x >= e$x0 & x <= e$x1))
  peak_at <- mean(e$x0[e$exon %in% c(1, 4)])
  sig <- ifelse(inside, 0.35, 0.05) +
    0.9 * exp(-((p - peak_at)^2) / (2 * 180^2)) +
    rnorm(length(p), 0, 0.03)
  data.frame(tx = t, pos = p, cov = pmax(sig, 0), y = unique(e$y))
}))
cov_tab <- cov_tab |> group_by(tx) |> mutate(cov = cov / max(cov) * 0.62) |> ungroup()

## Gene neighbourhood in five species: g2 is inverted in sp3, g4 in sp4, g5 is
## absent in sp3 and g6 is absent in sp5.
sp <- c("sp1", "sp2", "sp3", "sp4", "sp5")
nb <- data.frame(
  species = rep(sp, each = 6),
  order = rep(1:6, 5),
  gene = c("g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","g6",
           "g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","g6",
           "g1","g3","g2","g4","g6","-",
           "g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","g6",
           "g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","-"),
  forward = c(rep(TRUE, 6), rep(TRUE, 6),
              TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE,
              TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE,
              rep(TRUE, 5), FALSE)
) |>
  filter(gene != "-") |>
  mutate(x0 = (order - 1) * 1000, x1 = x0 + 820)

ggplot() +
  ## Coverage as a ribbon from the row baseline, so each isoform keeps its own
  ## y band instead of overlapping the next one.
  geom_ribbon(data = cov_tab, aes(x = pos, ymin = y, ymax = y + cov, group = tx),
              fill = "#9ecae1", alpha = 0.75, colour = NA) +
  geom_rect(data = tx_tab, aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = y - 0.10, ymax = y + 0.10),

  geom_text(data = tx_tab, aes((x0 + x1) / 2, y, label = exon),

  labs(x = "transcript coordinate (bp, exons concatenated)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(sp)) +
  labs(x = "gene neighbourhood coordinate (bp)", y = NULL) +
  gggenes::theme_genes() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8))

## One gene with eight exons and three isoforms. Transcript coordinates are the
## exons concatenated with a fixed 30 bp gap; the same exon therefore has a
## different coordinate in every isoform.
exons <- data.frame(
  exon = 1:8,
  gstart = c(100, 500, 800, 1100, 1500, 1900, 2300, 2700),
  gend   = c(300, 620, 900, 1250, 1600, 2000, 2450, 2900)
)
tx <- list(T1 = 1:8, T2 = c(1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8), T3 = c(1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8))
gap <- 30

tx_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tx), function(t) {
  ids <- tx[[t]]
  e <- exons[match(ids, exons$exon), ]
  e$x0 <- cumsum(c(0, (e$gend - e$gstart + gap)[-nrow(e)]))
  e$x1 <- e$x0 + (e$gend - e$gstart)
  e$tx <- t
  e
}))
tx_tab$y <- as.numeric(factor(tx_tab$tx, levels = names(tx)))

## Coverage in each transcript's own coordinates. In genomic coordinates the
## same reads would be forced onto one axis and the isoform-specific peaks
## would overlap.
cov_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tx), function(t) {
  e <- tx_tab |> filter(tx == t)
  p <- seq(0, max(e$x1), by = 5)
  inside <- sapply(p, function(x) any(x >= e$x0 & x <= e$x1))
  peak_at <- mean(e$x0[e$exon %in% c(1, 4)])
  sig <- ifelse(inside, 0.35, 0.05) +
    0.9 * exp(-((p - peak_at)^2) / (2 * 180^2)) +
    rnorm(length(p), 0, 0.03)
  data.frame(tx = t, pos = p, cov = pmax(sig, 0), y = unique(e$y))
}))
cov_tab <- cov_tab |> group_by(tx) |> mutate(cov = cov / max(cov) * 0.62) |> ungroup()

## Gene neighbourhood in five species: g2 is inverted in sp3, g4 in sp4, g5 is
## absent in sp3 and g6 is absent in sp5.
sp <- c("sp1", "sp2", "sp3", "sp4", "sp5")
nb <- data.frame(
  species = rep(sp, each = 6),
  order = rep(1:6, 5),
  gene = c("g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","g6",
           "g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","g6",
           "g1","g3","g2","g4","g6","-",
           "g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","g6",
           "g1","g2","g3","g4","g5","-"),
  forward = c(rep(TRUE, 6), rep(TRUE, 6),
              TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE,
              TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE,
              rep(TRUE, 5), FALSE)
) |>
  filter(gene != "-") |>
  mutate(x0 = (order - 1) * 1000, x1 = x0 + 820)

ggplot() +
  ## Coverage as a ribbon from the row baseline, so each isoform keeps its own
  ## y band instead of overlapping the next one.
  geom_ribbon(data = cov_tab, aes(x = pos, ymin = y, ymax = y + cov, group = tx),
              fill = "#9ecae1", alpha = 0.75, colour = NA) +
  geom_rect(data = tx_tab, aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = y - 0.10, ymax = y + 0.10),
            fill = "#2c7bb6", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = tx_tab, aes((x0 + x1) / 2, y, label = exon),
            size = 1.7, colour = "white") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = names(tx),
                     limits = c(0.6, 3.75), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  labs(x = "transcript coordinate (bp, exons concatenated)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

ggplot(nb, aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, y = species, fill = gene, forward = forward)) +
  gggenes::geom_gene_arrow(arrowhead_height = unit(3, "mm"),

sentinel <- 412.6          # Mb

## Variants in a 1.2 Mb window around the sentinel. r2 decays with distance
## (the colour channel); -log10 P carries two signals, one of which is only in
## LD with the sentinel because it is physically close.
reg <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.004)) |>
  mutate(
    r2 = pmax(0, 1 - abs(pos - sentinel) / 0.62)^1.6,
    lp = -log10(pmax(1e-12, pmin(0.9,
      10^(-(2.1 + 6.4 * exp(-((pos - sentinel)^2) / (2 * 0.05^2)) +
              3.4 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.33))^2) / (2 * 0.035^2)) +
              runif(n()) * 1.6)))))
  )

genes <- data.frame(
  gene = c("GENEA", "GENEB", "GENEC", "GENED"),
  start = c(sentinel - 0.55, sentinel - 0.12, sentinel + 0.18, sentinel + 0.42),
  end   = c(sentinel - 0.35, sentinel + 0.06, sentinel + 0.40, sentinel + 0.57)
)
genes$mid <- (genes$start + genes$end) / 2
exons <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(genes)), function(i) {
  g <- genes[i, ]
  data.frame(gene = g$gene,
             x0 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3),
             x1 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3) + 0.025)
}))

rec <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.01)) |>
  mutate(
    ## a recombination hotspot sits between the two signals, which is why they
    ## are in separate LD blocks
    cmmb = 0.8 + 1.6 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.16))^2) / (2 * 0.012^2)) +
      0.35 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel - 0.3))^2) / (2 * 0.08^2))
  )

## LD bins: the five-step palette that LocusZoom made standard.
ld_cols <- c("0-0.2" = "#d9d9d9", "0.2-0.4" = "#fdd49e",
             "0.4-0.6" = "#fdbb84", "0.6-0.8" = "#e34a33",
             "0.8-1" = "#b30000")
reg <- reg |>
  mutate(ld = cut(r2, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, Inf),
                  labels = names(ld_cols), right = FALSE),
         is_sentinel = abs(pos - sentinel) < 0.0015)

xlim <- c(sentinel - 0.63, sentinel + 0.63)

  scale_colour_manual(values = ld_cols, name = expression(r^2), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(reg$lp) + 1.6), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 12, 3)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10]~italic(P))) +

set.seed(43505)
chr_len <- 620
sentinel <- 412.6          # Mb

## Variants in a 1.2 Mb window around the sentinel. r2 decays with distance
## (the colour channel); -log10 P carries two signals, one of which is only in
## LD with the sentinel because it is physically close.
reg <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.004)) |>
  mutate(
    r2 = pmax(0, 1 - abs(pos - sentinel) / 0.62)^1.6,
    lp = -log10(pmax(1e-12, pmin(0.9,
      10^(-(2.1 + 6.4 * exp(-((pos - sentinel)^2) / (2 * 0.05^2)) +
              3.4 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.33))^2) / (2 * 0.035^2)) +
              runif(n()) * 1.6)))))
  )

genes <- data.frame(
  gene = c("GENEA", "GENEB", "GENEC", "GENED"),
  start = c(sentinel - 0.55, sentinel - 0.12, sentinel + 0.18, sentinel + 0.42),
  end   = c(sentinel - 0.35, sentinel + 0.06, sentinel + 0.40, sentinel + 0.57)
)
genes$mid <- (genes$start + genes$end) / 2
exons <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(genes)), function(i) {
  g <- genes[i, ]
  data.frame(gene = g$gene,
             x0 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3),
             x1 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3) + 0.025)
}))

rec <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.01)) |>
  mutate(
    ## a recombination hotspot sits between the two signals, which is why they
    ## are in separate LD blocks
    cmmb = 0.8 + 1.6 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.16))^2) / (2 * 0.012^2)) +
      0.35 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel - 0.3))^2) / (2 * 0.08^2))
  )

## LD bins: the five-step palette that LocusZoom made standard.
ld_cols <- c("0-0.2" = "#d9d9d9", "0.2-0.4" = "#fdd49e",
             "0.4-0.6" = "#fdbb84", "0.6-0.8" = "#e34a33",
             "0.8-1" = "#b30000")
reg <- reg |>
  mutate(ld = cut(r2, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, Inf),
                  labels = names(ld_cols), right = FALSE),
         is_sentinel = abs(pos - sentinel) < 0.0015)

xlim <- c(sentinel - 0.63, sentinel + 0.63)

p_assoc <- ggplot(reg, aes(pos, lp)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = ld), size = 1.4, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = filter(reg, is_sentinel), shape = 23, size = 3,
             fill = "#4d004b", colour = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = sentinel, y = max(reg$lp) + 0.9, label = "sentinel",
           size = 2.4, colour = "#4d004b") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ld_cols, name = expression(r^2), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(reg$lp) + 1.6), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 12, 3)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10]~italic(P))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.28, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 1, 5))

p_gene <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = genes, aes(x = start, xend = end, y = 0, yend = 0),
               linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#525252") +
  geom_rect(data = exons, aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = -0.25, ymax = 0.25),
            fill = "#525252") +
  geom_text(data = genes, aes(x = mid, y = 0.52, label = gene), size = 2.1,
            colour = "#252525") +
  annotate("text", x = sentinel, y = -0.55, label = "sentinel", size = 2,
           colour = "#4d004b") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.75, 0.85), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_void(base_size = 9) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 0, 5))

p_rec <- ggplot(rec, aes(pos, cmmb)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#08519c", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = sprintf("position on chr1 (Mb; chr1 length %s Mb)", chr_len),
       y = "cM/Mb") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
        plot.margin = margin(1, 5, 5, 5))

## Variants in a 1.2 Mb window around the sentinel. r2 decays with distance
## (the colour channel); -log10 P carries two signals, one of which is only in
## LD with the sentinel because it is physically close.
reg <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.004)) |>
  mutate(
    r2 = pmax(0, 1 - abs(pos - sentinel) / 0.62)^1.6,
    lp = -log10(pmax(1e-12, pmin(0.9,
      10^(-(2.1 + 6.4 * exp(-((pos - sentinel)^2) / (2 * 0.05^2)) +
              3.4 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.33))^2) / (2 * 0.035^2)) +
              runif(n()) * 1.6)))))
  )

genes <- data.frame(
  gene = c("GENEA", "GENEB", "GENEC", "GENED"),
  start = c(sentinel - 0.55, sentinel - 0.12, sentinel + 0.18, sentinel + 0.42),
  end   = c(sentinel - 0.35, sentinel + 0.06, sentinel + 0.40, sentinel + 0.57)
)
genes$mid <- (genes$start + genes$end) / 2
exons <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(genes)), function(i) {
  g <- genes[i, ]
  data.frame(gene = g$gene,
             x0 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3),
             x1 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3) + 0.025)
}))

rec <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.01)) |>
  mutate(
    ## a recombination hotspot sits between the two signals, which is why they
    ## are in separate LD blocks
    cmmb = 0.8 + 1.6 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.16))^2) / (2 * 0.012^2)) +
      0.35 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel - 0.3))^2) / (2 * 0.08^2))
  )

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(reg$lp) + 1.6), expand = c(0, 0),

  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10]~italic(P))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

## (the colour channel); -log10 P carries two signals, one of which is only in
## LD with the sentinel because it is physically close.
reg <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.004)) |>
  mutate(
    r2 = pmax(0, 1 - abs(pos - sentinel) / 0.62)^1.6,
    lp = -log10(pmax(1e-12, pmin(0.9,
      10^(-(2.1 + 6.4 * exp(-((pos - sentinel)^2) / (2 * 0.05^2)) +
              3.4 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.33))^2) / (2 * 0.035^2)) +
              runif(n()) * 1.6)))))
  )

genes <- data.frame(
  gene = c("GENEA", "GENEB", "GENEC", "GENED"),
  start = c(sentinel - 0.55, sentinel - 0.12, sentinel + 0.18, sentinel + 0.42),
  end   = c(sentinel - 0.35, sentinel + 0.06, sentinel + 0.40, sentinel + 0.57)
)
genes$mid <- (genes$start + genes$end) / 2
exons <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(genes)), function(i) {
  g <- genes[i, ]
  data.frame(gene = g$gene,
             x0 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3),
             x1 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3) + 0.025)
}))

rec <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.01)) |>
  mutate(
    ## a recombination hotspot sits between the two signals, which is why they
    ## are in separate LD blocks
    cmmb = 0.8 + 1.6 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.16))^2) / (2 * 0.012^2)) +
      0.35 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel - 0.3))^2) / (2 * 0.08^2))
  )

             "0.4-0.6" = "#fdbb84", "0.6-0.8" = "#e34a33",

  mutate(ld = cut(r2, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, Inf),

  geom_point(data = filter(reg, is_sentinel), shape = 23, size = 3,

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(reg$lp) + 1.6), expand = c(0, 0),

  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10]~italic(P))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.75, 0.85), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_void(base_size = 9) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 0, 5))

set.seed(43505)
chr_len <- 620
sentinel <- 412.6          # Mb

## Variants in a 1.2 Mb window around the sentinel. r2 decays with distance
## (the colour channel); -log10 P carries two signals, one of which is only in
## LD with the sentinel because it is physically close.
reg <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.004)) |>
  mutate(
    r2 = pmax(0, 1 - abs(pos - sentinel) / 0.62)^1.6,
    lp = -log10(pmax(1e-12, pmin(0.9,
      10^(-(2.1 + 6.4 * exp(-((pos - sentinel)^2) / (2 * 0.05^2)) +
              3.4 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.33))^2) / (2 * 0.035^2)) +
              runif(n()) * 1.6)))))
  )

genes <- data.frame(
  gene = c("GENEA", "GENEB", "GENEC", "GENED"),
  start = c(sentinel - 0.55, sentinel - 0.12, sentinel + 0.18, sentinel + 0.42),
  end   = c(sentinel - 0.35, sentinel + 0.06, sentinel + 0.40, sentinel + 0.57)
)
genes$mid <- (genes$start + genes$end) / 2
exons <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(genes)), function(i) {
  g <- genes[i, ]
  data.frame(gene = g$gene,
             x0 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3),
             x1 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3) + 0.025)
}))

rec <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.01)) |>
  mutate(
    ## a recombination hotspot sits between the two signals, which is why they
    ## are in separate LD blocks
    cmmb = 0.8 + 1.6 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.16))^2) / (2 * 0.012^2)) +
      0.35 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel - 0.3))^2) / (2 * 0.08^2))
  )

## LD bins: the five-step palette that LocusZoom made standard.
ld_cols <- c("0-0.2" = "#d9d9d9", "0.2-0.4" = "#fdd49e",
             "0.4-0.6" = "#fdbb84", "0.6-0.8" = "#e34a33",
             "0.8-1" = "#b30000")
reg <- reg |>
  mutate(ld = cut(r2, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, Inf),
                  labels = names(ld_cols), right = FALSE),
         is_sentinel = abs(pos - sentinel) < 0.0015)

xlim <- c(sentinel - 0.63, sentinel + 0.63)

p_assoc <- ggplot(reg, aes(pos, lp)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = ld), size = 1.4, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = filter(reg, is_sentinel), shape = 23, size = 3,
             fill = "#4d004b", colour = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = sentinel, y = max(reg$lp) + 0.9, label = "sentinel",
           size = 2.4, colour = "#4d004b") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ld_cols, name = expression(r^2), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(reg$lp) + 1.6), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 12, 3)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10]~italic(P))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.28, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 1, 5))

p_gene <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = genes, aes(x = start, xend = end, y = 0, yend = 0),
               linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#525252") +
  geom_rect(data = exons, aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = -0.25, ymax = 0.25),
            fill = "#525252") +
  geom_text(data = genes, aes(x = mid, y = 0.52, label = gene), size = 2.1,
            colour = "#252525") +
  annotate("text", x = sentinel, y = -0.55, label = "sentinel", size = 2,
           colour = "#4d004b") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.75, 0.85), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_void(base_size = 9) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 0, 5))

p_rec <- ggplot(rec, aes(pos, cmmb)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#08519c", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = sprintf("position on chr1 (Mb; chr1 length %s Mb)", chr_len),
       y = "cM/Mb") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
        plot.margin = margin(1, 5, 5, 5))

p_assoc / p_gene / p_rec + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.22, 0.3))

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(patchwork)
})

set.seed(43505)
chr_len <- 620
sentinel <- 412.6          # Mb

## Variants in a 1.2 Mb window around the sentinel. r2 decays with distance
## (the colour channel); -log10 P carries two signals, one of which is only in
## LD with the sentinel because it is physically close.
reg <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.004)) |>
  mutate(
    r2 = pmax(0, 1 - abs(pos - sentinel) / 0.62)^1.6,
    lp = -log10(pmax(1e-12, pmin(0.9,
      10^(-(2.1 + 6.4 * exp(-((pos - sentinel)^2) / (2 * 0.05^2)) +
              3.4 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.33))^2) / (2 * 0.035^2)) +
              runif(n()) * 1.6)))))
  )

genes <- data.frame(
  gene = c("GENEA", "GENEB", "GENEC", "GENED"),
  start = c(sentinel - 0.55, sentinel - 0.12, sentinel + 0.18, sentinel + 0.42),
  end   = c(sentinel - 0.35, sentinel + 0.06, sentinel + 0.40, sentinel + 0.57)
)
genes$mid <- (genes$start + genes$end) / 2
exons <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(genes)), function(i) {
  g <- genes[i, ]
  data.frame(gene = g$gene,
             x0 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3),
             x1 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3) + 0.025)
}))

rec <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.01)) |>
  mutate(
    ## a recombination hotspot sits between the two signals, which is why they
    ## are in separate LD blocks
    cmmb = 0.8 + 1.6 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.16))^2) / (2 * 0.012^2)) +
      0.35 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel - 0.3))^2) / (2 * 0.08^2))
  )

## LD bins: the five-step palette that LocusZoom made standard.
ld_cols <- c("0-0.2" = "#d9d9d9", "0.2-0.4" = "#fdd49e",
             "0.4-0.6" = "#fdbb84", "0.6-0.8" = "#e34a33",
             "0.8-1" = "#b30000")
reg <- reg |>
  mutate(ld = cut(r2, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, Inf),
                  labels = names(ld_cols), right = FALSE),
         is_sentinel = abs(pos - sentinel) < 0.0015)

xlim <- c(sentinel - 0.63, sentinel + 0.63)

p_assoc <- ggplot(reg, aes(pos, lp)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = ld), size = 1.4, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = filter(reg, is_sentinel), shape = 23, size = 3,
             fill = "#4d004b", colour = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = sentinel, y = max(reg$lp) + 0.9, label = "sentinel",
           size = 2.4, colour = "#4d004b") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ld_cols, name = expression(r^2), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(reg$lp) + 1.6), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 12, 3)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10]~italic(P))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.28, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 1, 5))

p_gene <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = genes, aes(x = start, xend = end, y = 0, yend = 0),
               linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#525252") +
  geom_rect(data = exons, aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = -0.25, ymax = 0.25),
            fill = "#525252") +
  geom_text(data = genes, aes(x = mid, y = 0.52, label = gene), size = 2.1,
            colour = "#252525") +
  annotate("text", x = sentinel, y = -0.55, label = "sentinel", size = 2,
           colour = "#4d004b") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.75, 0.85), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_void(base_size = 9) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 0, 5))

p_rec <- ggplot(rec, aes(pos, cmmb)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#08519c", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = sprintf("position on chr1 (Mb; chr1 length %s Mb)", chr_len),
       y = "cM/Mb") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
        plot.margin = margin(1, 5, 5, 5))

p_assoc / p_gene / p_rec + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.22, 0.3))

# Load data
data <- read_tsv("files/DAVID.txt")

# Add a new categorical column
get_category <- function(cat) {
  if (grepl("BP", cat)) return("BP")
  if (grepl("MF", cat)) return("MF")
  if (grepl("CC", cat)) return("CC")
  if (grepl("KEGG", cat)) return("KEGG")
  return(NA)
}
data$MainCategory <- sapply(data$Category, get_category)

# Remove SMART and NA
data2 <- data %>%
  filter(!grepl("SMART", Category)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MainCategory))

# Sort each category and take the top 10
topN <- function(data, n=10) {
  data %>%
  arrange(desc(Count), PValue) %>%
  head(n)
}
result <- data2 %>%
  group_by(MainCategory) %>%
  group_modify(~topN(.x, 10)) %>%
  ungroup()

# KEGG pathway annotation
result <- result %>%
  mutate(
    Source = ifelse(MainCategory == "KEGG", "KEGG", "GO"),
    KEGG_Group = case_when(
      MainCategory == "KEGG" & str_detect(Term,"Neuro|synapse|neurodegeneration|Alzheimer|Parkinson|Prion") ~ "Nervous system",
      MainCategory == "KEGG" & str_detect(Term, "Cytokine|inflammatory") ~ "Immune system",
      MainCategory == "KEGG" & str_detect(Term, "Lipid|atherosclerosis") ~ "Lipid metabolism",
      MainCategory == "KEGG" ~ "Other KEGG",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
    GO_Group = ifelse(MainCategory != "KEGG", MainCategory, NA)
    )
alluvial_data <- result %>%
  mutate(
    Term = str_replace(Term, "^GO:\\d+~", ""), # Remove GO number
    Term = str_replace(Term, "^hsa\\d+:?", "") # Remove KEGG number
    )

# GO Section
go_links <- result %>%
  filter(Source == "GO") %>%
  transmute(
    Source = Source,
    Group = GO_Group,
    Term = Term,
    Count = Count
    )

# KEGG Section
kegg_links <- result %>%
  filter(Source == "KEGG") %>%
  transmute(
    Source = Source,
    Group = KEGG_Group,
    Term = Term,
    Count = Count
    )

# Generate Sankey diagram data
alluvial_data <- result %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(Source == "KEGG", KEGG_Group, GO_Group)) %>%
  select(Source, Group, Term, Count, FDR, FoldEnrichment, MainCategory)

# Ensure character type
alluvial_data$Source <- as.character(alluvial_data$Source)
alluvial_data$Group <- as.character(alluvial_data$Group)
alluvial_data$Term <- as.character(alluvial_data$Term)

# Bind
alluvial_data <- bind_rows(go_links, kegg_links)

# Arrange the term column in ascending order of count value, and ensure that the bubble chart and Sankey chart are in the same order
term_levels <- alluvial_data %>%
  arrange(Source, Group, desc(Count)) %>%
  pull(Term) %>%
  unique()
alluvial_data$Term <- factor(alluvial_data$Term, levels = term_levels)

# View data structure
head(alluvial_data, 5)

# Sankey diagram (the Term column does not display labels)

# Ensure Group is of character type and does not contain NA
alluvial_data$Group <- as.character(alluvial_data$Group)

  rename(log2FC = "log2 Ratio(WT0/LOG)", Pvalue = "Pvalue")
# Handle the case where the p-value is 0 (avoid calculating -Inf)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(log10P = -log10(Pvalue + 1e-300)) # Make sure to handle the case where P=0
# Convert to numeric type and handle values that fail to convert (such as invalid characters)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC = as.numeric(log2FC) # Values that fail the conversion become NA
  )

# Find the original value that caused the conversion to fail
data %>%
  filter(is.na(log2FC)) %>%
  select(log2FC) # View the raw log2FC values for these lines
# Repair the data as needed (e.g. replace or remove outliers)
# Example: Replace "Inf" with an actual value or filter out
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC = ifelse(log2FC == "Inf", 100, log2FC), # Adjust according to needs
    log2FC = as.numeric(log2FC)
    ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC)) # Delete the rows that cannot be repaired

# Defining significance (satisfying both P value < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1)
# Define significance categories (upregulated, downregulated, not significant)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    significant = case_when(
      Pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC > 2 ~ "Upregulated", # Up (red)
      Pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC < -2 ~ "Downregulated", # Down (green)
      TRUE ~ "Not significant" # Not significant (grey)
    )
  )

# View data structure
head(data, 5)

# Basic volcano plot
p <- 
  ggplot(data, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(Pvalue))) + # Plot preliminary volcano
  # Plot scatter points, colored by significant categories
  geom_point(aes(color = significant), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) + 
  # Set color mapping (up: red, down: green, no significant: gray)
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Upregulated" = "red", "Downregulated" = "green", "Not significant" = "gray"),
    name = "Significance" # Legend Title
    ) +
  # Adding a filter threshold line
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dashed", color = "green", linewidth = 0.5) + # log2FC threshold line
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", linewidth = 0.5) + # p-value threshold line
  # Adjust axes and titles
  labs(x = "log2(Fold Change)", y = "-log10(P-value)",
       title = "Volcano Plot with Thresholds") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), # Title centered bold

  gsym = paste0("G", 1:n_v2),
  logFC = rnorm(n_v2, 0, 1.4),
  adjP = 10^(-rexp(n_v2, 0.9)))
v2$adjP <- pmin(1, v2$adjP)
sel <- sample(n_v2, 10)
v2$adjP[sel[1:6]] <- 10^(-runif(6, 5, 12)); v2$logFC[sel[1:4]] <- rnorm(4, 4.5, 0.7)
v2$adjP[sel[7:10]] <- 10^(-runif(4, 5, 10)); v2$logFC[sel[7:10]] <- rnorm(4, -4.5, 0.7)
v2$pathway <- sample(c("Pathway A", "Pathway B", "Pathway C"), n_v2, TRUE,
                     prob = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.9))
v2$pathway[sel] <- rep(c("Pathway A", "Pathway B"), c(6, 4))
selected <- v2[sel, ]
selected$pathway <- factor(selected$pathway, levels = c("Pathway A", "Pathway B"))

logFCcut <- 1.5; pvalCut <- 0.05
logFCcut2 <- 2.5; pvalCut2 <- 1e-4
logFCcut3 <- 5; pvalCut3 <- 1e-5
pathcol <- c("Pathway A" = "darkgreen", "Pathway B" = "chocolate4", "Pathway C" = "blueviolet")

v2$y <- -log10(v2$adjP)
v2$tier <- 1
v2$tier[abs(v2$logFC) > logFCcut & v2$adjP < pvalCut] <- 2
v2$tier[abs(v2$logFC) > logFCcut2 & v2$adjP < pvalCut2] <- 3
v2$tier[abs(v2$logFC) > logFCcut3 & v2$adjP < pvalCut3] <- 4
v2$col <- "grey75"
v2$col[v2$tier == 2] <- "grey45"
v2$col[v2$tier == 3 & v2$logFC > 0] <- "#F49A9A"
v2$col[v2$tier == 3 & v2$logFC < 0] <- "#8FB2E0"
v2$col[v2$tier == 4 & v2$logFC > 0] <- "#D93F3C"
v2$col[v2$tier == 4 & v2$logFC < 0] <- "#184A8C"
v2$col[sel] <- pathcol[v2$pathway[sel]]
v2$size <- c(1, 1.6, 2.2, 3)[v2$tier]
lab_df <- selected
lab_df$y <- -log10(lab_df$adjP)

ggplot(v2, aes(logFC, y)) +
  geom_point(colour = v2$col, size = v2$size, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut, logFCcut), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(data = lab_df, aes(logFC, y), shape = 21, colour = "black",
             size = 3.4, fill = NA, stroke = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_label_repel(data = lab_df, aes(label = gsym, colour = pathway),
                   size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", box.padding = 0.5,
                   show.legend = FALSE, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pathcol, name = "Selected pathway") +
  labs(x = "log2 fold change", y = "-log10 adjusted P",
       title = "Tiered volcano: thresholds at 1.5/2.5/5 and 0.05/1e-4/1e-5") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(patchwork)

## A chromosome table in the shape RIdeogram expects: name, start, end,
## centromere. Lengths are a five-chromosome toy genome in Mb.
karyo <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5"),
  len = c(120, 95, 80, 60, 45),
  cen = c(48, 34, 31, 21, 17)
)
set.seed(43501)

## Cytobands: alternating stain with a density value, as G-band tables carry.
banding <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  starts <- seq(0, k$len, by = 6)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, start = starts, end = pmin(starts + 6, k$len),
             density = round(runif(length(starts), 0, 100)))
}))

## Per-window Fst with two planted peaks, so the reading order is verifiable.
win <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  mid <- seq(1, k$len - 1, by = 2)
  fst <- 0.08 + 0.05 * abs(sin(mid / 9))
  if (k$chr == "chr2") fst <- fst + 0.55 * exp(-((mid - 62)^2) / 40)
  if (k$chr == "chr4") fst <- fst + 0.42 * exp(-((mid - 20)^2) / 50)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, mid = mid,
             fst = pmin(0.95, fst + rnorm(length(mid), 0, 0.02)))
}))

markers <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr1", "chr2", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr5"),
  pos = c(12, 88, 62, 30, 41, 70, 20, 15, 38),
  type = c("tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA", "tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA",
           "QTL", "QTL", "miRNA")
)

## Cumulative coordinates: chromosomes end to end with a 4 Mb gap, so every
## panel can share a single x axis instead of relying on facet widths.
gap <- 4
offs <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr,
                   offset = c(0, cumsum(karyo$len + gap)[-nrow(karyo)]))
banding <- left_join(banding, offs, by = "chr") |>
  mutate(x0 = offset + start, x1 = offset + end)
win <- left_join(win, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + mid)
markers <- left_join(markers, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + pos)
chr_lab <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr, x = offs$offset + karyo$len / 2)
xmax <- max(win$x) + 3

p_ideo <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = banding,
            aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = 0.84, ymax = 1.16, fill = density),
            colour = "#3d3d3d", linewidth = 0.12) +
  ## Centromere: a dark tick, not a white line -- white on a near-white band
  ## is invisible, which is exactly how the pinch disappears from the figure.
  geom_segment(data = left_join(karyo, offs, by = "chr"),
               aes(x = offset + cen, xend = offset + cen, y = 0.80, yend = 1.20),
               linewidth = 0.9, colour = "#111111", lineend = "butt") +
  geom_point(data = markers, aes(x, y = 1.34, colour = type, shape = type),
             size = 2.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn("band\ndensity",
                       colours = c("#ffffff", "#c6c6c6", "#5a5a5a"),
                       limits = c(0, 100), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(tRNA = "#1b7837", rRNA = "#d95f02",
                                 miRNA = "#2166ac", QTL = "#b2182b"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(tRNA = 17, rRNA = 15, miRNA = 16, QTL = 18),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.78, 1.46), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.32, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.2),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 5, 0, 5))

p_track <- ggplot(win, aes(x, fst, group = chr)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#4292c6", alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(colour = "#08519c", linewidth = 0.32) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3,
             colour = "#b2182b") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = offs$offset[-1] - gap / 2, linewidth = 0.25,
             colour = "#dedede") +
  ## chromosome names on the track's own panel, not borrowed from above
  annotate("text", x = chr_lab$x, y = 0.93, label = chr_lab$chr,
           size = 2.6, colour = "#333333") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.96), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "cumulative position (Mb; chromosomes laid end to end)",
       y = "Fst") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 2, 5))

p_ideo / p_track + plot_layout(heights = c(0.75, 1))
