## A chromosome table in the shape RIdeogram expects: name, start, end,
## centromere. Lengths are a five-chromosome toy genome in Mb.
karyo <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5"),
  len = c(120, 95, 80, 60, 45),
  cen = c(48, 34, 31, 21, 17)
)
set.seed(43501)

## Cytobands: alternating stain with a density value, as G-band tables carry.
banding <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  starts <- seq(0, k$len, by = 6)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, start = starts, end = pmin(starts + 6, k$len),
             density = round(runif(length(starts), 0, 100)))
}))

## Per-window Fst with two planted peaks, so the reading order is verifiable.
win <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  mid <- seq(1, k$len - 1, by = 2)
  fst <- 0.08 + 0.05 * abs(sin(mid / 9))
  if (k$chr == "chr2") fst <- fst + 0.55 * exp(-((mid - 62)^2) / 40)
  if (k$chr == "chr4") fst <- fst + 0.42 * exp(-((mid - 20)^2) / 50)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, mid = mid,
             fst = pmin(0.95, fst + rnorm(length(mid), 0, 0.02)))
}))

markers <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr1", "chr2", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr5"),
  pos = c(12, 88, 62, 30, 41, 70, 20, 15, 38),
  type = c("tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA", "tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA",
           "QTL", "QTL", "miRNA")
)

## Cumulative coordinates: chromosomes end to end with a 4 Mb gap, so every
## panel can share a single x axis instead of relying on facet widths.
gap <- 4
offs <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr,
                   offset = c(0, cumsum(karyo$len + gap)[-nrow(karyo)]))
banding <- left_join(banding, offs, by = "chr") |>
  mutate(x0 = offset + start, x1 = offset + end)
win <- left_join(win, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + mid)
markers <- left_join(markers, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + pos)
chr_lab <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr, x = offs$offset + karyo$len / 2)
xmax <- max(win$x) + 3

p_ideo <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = banding,
            aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = 0.84, ymax = 1.16, fill = density),
            colour = "#3d3d3d", linewidth = 0.12) +
  ## Centromere: a dark tick, not a white line -- white on a near-white band
  ## is invisible, which is exactly how the pinch disappears from the figure.
  geom_segment(data = left_join(karyo, offs, by = "chr"),
               aes(x = offset + cen, xend = offset + cen, y = 0.80, yend = 1.20),
               linewidth = 0.9, colour = "#111111", lineend = "butt") +
  geom_point(data = markers, aes(x, y = 1.34, colour = type, shape = type),
             size = 2.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn("band\ndensity",
                       colours = c("#ffffff", "#c6c6c6", "#5a5a5a"),
                       limits = c(0, 100), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(tRNA = "#1b7837", rRNA = "#d95f02",
                                 miRNA = "#2166ac", QTL = "#b2182b"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(tRNA = 17, rRNA = 15, miRNA = 16, QTL = 18),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.78, 1.46), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.32, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.2),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 5, 0, 5))

p_track <- ggplot(win, aes(x, fst, group = chr)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#4292c6", alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(colour = "#08519c", linewidth = 0.32) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3,
             colour = "#b2182b") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = offs$offset[-1] - gap / 2, linewidth = 0.25,
             colour = "#dedede") +
  ## chromosome names on the track's own panel, not borrowed from above
  annotate("text", x = chr_lab$x, y = 0.93, label = chr_lab$chr,
           size = 2.6, colour = "#333333") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.96), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "cumulative position (Mb; chromosomes laid end to end)",
       y = "Fst") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 2, 5))

p_ideo / p_track + plot_layout(heights = c(0.75, 1))

## A chromosome table in the shape RIdeogram expects: name, start, end,
## centromere. Lengths are a five-chromosome toy genome in Mb.
karyo <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5"),
  len = c(120, 95, 80, 60, 45),
  cen = c(48, 34, 31, 21, 17)
)
set.seed(43501)

## Cytobands: alternating stain with a density value, as G-band tables carry.
banding <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  starts <- seq(0, k$len, by = 6)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, start = starts, end = pmin(starts + 6, k$len),
             density = round(runif(length(starts), 0, 100)))
}))

## Per-window Fst with two planted peaks, so the reading order is verifiable.
win <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  mid <- seq(1, k$len - 1, by = 2)
  fst <- 0.08 + 0.05 * abs(sin(mid / 9))
  if (k$chr == "chr2") fst <- fst + 0.55 * exp(-((mid - 62)^2) / 40)
  if (k$chr == "chr4") fst <- fst + 0.42 * exp(-((mid - 20)^2) / 50)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, mid = mid,
             fst = pmin(0.95, fst + rnorm(length(mid), 0, 0.02)))
}))

markers <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr1", "chr2", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr5"),
  pos = c(12, 88, 62, 30, 41, 70, 20, 15, 38),
  type = c("tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA", "tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA",
           "QTL", "QTL", "miRNA")
)

## Cumulative coordinates: chromosomes end to end with a 4 Mb gap, so every
## panel can share a single x axis instead of relying on facet widths.
gap <- 4
offs <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr,
                   offset = c(0, cumsum(karyo$len + gap)[-nrow(karyo)]))
banding <- left_join(banding, offs, by = "chr") |>
  mutate(x0 = offset + start, x1 = offset + end)
win <- left_join(win, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + mid)
markers <- left_join(markers, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + pos)
chr_lab <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr, x = offs$offset + karyo$len / 2)
xmax <- max(win$x) + 3

p_ideo <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = banding,
            aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = 0.84, ymax = 1.16, fill = density),
            colour = "#3d3d3d", linewidth = 0.12) +
  ## Centromere: a dark tick, not a white line -- white on a near-white band
  ## is invisible, which is exactly how the pinch disappears from the figure.
  geom_segment(data = left_join(karyo, offs, by = "chr"),
               aes(x = offset + cen, xend = offset + cen, y = 0.80, yend = 1.20),
               linewidth = 0.9, colour = "#111111", lineend = "butt") +
  geom_point(data = markers, aes(x, y = 1.34, colour = type, shape = type),
             size = 2.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn("band\ndensity",
                       colours = c("#ffffff", "#c6c6c6", "#5a5a5a"),
                       limits = c(0, 100), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(tRNA = "#1b7837", rRNA = "#d95f02",
                                 miRNA = "#2166ac", QTL = "#b2182b"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(tRNA = 17, rRNA = 15, miRNA = 16, QTL = 18),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.78, 1.46), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.32, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.2),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 5, 0, 5))

p_track <- ggplot(win, aes(x, fst, group = chr)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#4292c6", alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(colour = "#08519c", linewidth = 0.32) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3,
             colour = "#b2182b") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = offs$offset[-1] - gap / 2, linewidth = 0.25,
             colour = "#dedede") +
  ## chromosome names on the track's own panel, not borrowed from above
  annotate("text", x = chr_lab$x, y = 0.93, label = chr_lab$chr,
           size = 2.6, colour = "#333333") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.96), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "cumulative position (Mb; chromosomes laid end to end)",
       y = "Fst") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 2, 5))

p_ideo / p_track + plot_layout(heights = c(0.75, 1))

## A chromosome table in the shape RIdeogram expects: name, start, end,
## centromere. Lengths are a five-chromosome toy genome in Mb.
karyo <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5"),
  len = c(120, 95, 80, 60, 45),
  cen = c(48, 34, 31, 21, 17)
)
set.seed(43501)

## Cytobands: alternating stain with a density value, as G-band tables carry.
banding <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  starts <- seq(0, k$len, by = 6)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, start = starts, end = pmin(starts + 6, k$len),
             density = round(runif(length(starts), 0, 100)))
}))

## Per-window Fst with two planted peaks, so the reading order is verifiable.
win <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  mid <- seq(1, k$len - 1, by = 2)
  fst <- 0.08 + 0.05 * abs(sin(mid / 9))
  if (k$chr == "chr2") fst <- fst + 0.55 * exp(-((mid - 62)^2) / 40)
  if (k$chr == "chr4") fst <- fst + 0.42 * exp(-((mid - 20)^2) / 50)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, mid = mid,
             fst = pmin(0.95, fst + rnorm(length(mid), 0, 0.02)))
}))

markers <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr1", "chr2", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr5"),
  pos = c(12, 88, 62, 30, 41, 70, 20, 15, 38),
  type = c("tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA", "tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA",
           "QTL", "QTL", "miRNA")
)

## Cumulative coordinates: chromosomes end to end with a 4 Mb gap, so every
## panel can share a single x axis instead of relying on facet widths.
gap <- 4
offs <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr,
                   offset = c(0, cumsum(karyo$len + gap)[-nrow(karyo)]))
banding <- left_join(banding, offs, by = "chr") |>
  mutate(x0 = offset + start, x1 = offset + end)
win <- left_join(win, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + mid)
markers <- left_join(markers, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + pos)
chr_lab <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr, x = offs$offset + karyo$len / 2)
xmax <- max(win$x) + 3

p_ideo <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = banding,
            aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = 0.84, ymax = 1.16, fill = density),
            colour = "#3d3d3d", linewidth = 0.12) +
  ## Centromere: a dark tick, not a white line -- white on a near-white band
  ## is invisible, which is exactly how the pinch disappears from the figure.
  geom_segment(data = left_join(karyo, offs, by = "chr"),
               aes(x = offset + cen, xend = offset + cen, y = 0.80, yend = 1.20),
               linewidth = 0.9, colour = "#111111", lineend = "butt") +
  geom_point(data = markers, aes(x, y = 1.34, colour = type, shape = type),
             size = 2.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn("band\ndensity",
                       colours = c("#ffffff", "#c6c6c6", "#5a5a5a"),
                       limits = c(0, 100), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(tRNA = "#1b7837", rRNA = "#d95f02",
                                 miRNA = "#2166ac", QTL = "#b2182b"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(tRNA = 17, rRNA = 15, miRNA = 16, QTL = 18),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.78, 1.46), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.32, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.2),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 5, 0, 5))

p_track <- ggplot(win, aes(x, fst, group = chr)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#4292c6", alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(colour = "#08519c", linewidth = 0.32) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3,
             colour = "#b2182b") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = offs$offset[-1] - gap / 2, linewidth = 0.25,
             colour = "#dedede") +
  ## chromosome names on the track's own panel, not borrowed from above
  annotate("text", x = chr_lab$x, y = 0.93, label = chr_lab$chr,
           size = 2.6, colour = "#333333") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.96), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75),

  len = c(120, 95, 80, 60, 45),
  cen = c(48, 34, 31, 21, 17)
)
set.seed(43501)

## Cytobands: alternating stain with a density value, as G-band tables carry.
banding <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  starts <- seq(0, k$len, by = 6)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, start = starts, end = pmin(starts + 6, k$len),
             density = round(runif(length(starts), 0, 100)))
}))

## Per-window Fst with two planted peaks, so the reading order is verifiable.
win <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  mid <- seq(1, k$len - 1, by = 2)
  fst <- 0.08 + 0.05 * abs(sin(mid / 9))
  if (k$chr == "chr2") fst <- fst + 0.55 * exp(-((mid - 62)^2) / 40)
  if (k$chr == "chr4") fst <- fst + 0.42 * exp(-((mid - 20)^2) / 50)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, mid = mid,
             fst = pmin(0.95, fst + rnorm(length(mid), 0, 0.02)))
}))

  chr = c("chr1", "chr1", "chr2", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr5"),

)

## panel can share a single x axis instead of relying on facet widths.

                   offset = c(0, cumsum(karyo$len + gap)[-nrow(karyo)]))
banding <- left_join(banding, offs, by = "chr") |>
  mutate(x0 = offset + start, x1 = offset + end)
win <- left_join(win, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + mid)
markers <- left_join(markers, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + pos)

           size = 2.6, colour = "#333333") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.96), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75),

## A chromosome table in the shape RIdeogram expects: name, start, end,
## centromere. Lengths are a five-chromosome toy genome in Mb.
karyo <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5"),
  len = c(120, 95, 80, 60, 45),
  cen = c(48, 34, 31, 21, 17)
)
set.seed(43501)

## Cytobands: alternating stain with a density value, as G-band tables carry.
banding <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  starts <- seq(0, k$len, by = 6)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, start = starts, end = pmin(starts + 6, k$len),
             density = round(runif(length(starts), 0, 100)))
}))

## Per-window Fst with two planted peaks, so the reading order is verifiable.
win <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  mid <- seq(1, k$len - 1, by = 2)
  fst <- 0.08 + 0.05 * abs(sin(mid / 9))
  if (k$chr == "chr2") fst <- fst + 0.55 * exp(-((mid - 62)^2) / 40)
  if (k$chr == "chr4") fst <- fst + 0.42 * exp(-((mid - 20)^2) / 50)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, mid = mid,
             fst = pmin(0.95, fst + rnorm(length(mid), 0, 0.02)))
}))

markers <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr1", "chr2", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr5"),
  pos = c(12, 88, 62, 30, 41, 70, 20, 15, 38),
  type = c("tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA", "tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA",
           "QTL", "QTL", "miRNA")
)

## Cumulative coordinates: chromosomes end to end with a 4 Mb gap, so every
## panel can share a single x axis instead of relying on facet widths.
gap <- 4
offs <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr,
                   offset = c(0, cumsum(karyo$len + gap)[-nrow(karyo)]))
banding <- left_join(banding, offs, by = "chr") |>
  mutate(x0 = offset + start, x1 = offset + end)
win <- left_join(win, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + mid)
markers <- left_join(markers, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + pos)
chr_lab <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr, x = offs$offset + karyo$len / 2)
xmax <- max(win$x) + 3

p_ideo <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = banding,
            aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = 0.84, ymax = 1.16, fill = density),
            colour = "#3d3d3d", linewidth = 0.12) +
  ## Centromere: a dark tick, not a white line -- white on a near-white band
  ## is invisible, which is exactly how the pinch disappears from the figure.
  geom_segment(data = left_join(karyo, offs, by = "chr"),
               aes(x = offset + cen, xend = offset + cen, y = 0.80, yend = 1.20),
               linewidth = 0.9, colour = "#111111", lineend = "butt") +
  geom_point(data = markers, aes(x, y = 1.34, colour = type, shape = type),
             size = 2.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn("band\ndensity",
                       colours = c("#ffffff", "#c6c6c6", "#5a5a5a"),
                       limits = c(0, 100), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(tRNA = "#1b7837", rRNA = "#d95f02",
                                 miRNA = "#2166ac", QTL = "#b2182b"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(tRNA = 17, rRNA = 15, miRNA = 16, QTL = 18),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.78, 1.46), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.32, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.2),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 5, 0, 5))

p_track <- ggplot(win, aes(x, fst, group = chr)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#4292c6", alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(colour = "#08519c", linewidth = 0.32) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3,
             colour = "#b2182b") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = offs$offset[-1] - gap / 2, linewidth = 0.25,
             colour = "#dedede") +
  ## chromosome names on the track's own panel, not borrowed from above
  annotate("text", x = chr_lab$x, y = 0.93, label = chr_lab$chr,
           size = 2.6, colour = "#333333") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.96), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "cumulative position (Mb; chromosomes laid end to end)",
       y = "Fst") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 2, 5))

p_ideo / p_track + plot_layout(heights = c(0.75, 1))

## A chromosome table in the shape RIdeogram expects: name, start, end,
## centromere. Lengths are a five-chromosome toy genome in Mb.
karyo <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5"),
  len = c(120, 95, 80, 60, 45),
  cen = c(48, 34, 31, 21, 17)
)
set.seed(43501)

## Cytobands: alternating stain with a density value, as G-band tables carry.
banding <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  starts <- seq(0, k$len, by = 6)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, start = starts, end = pmin(starts + 6, k$len),
             density = round(runif(length(starts), 0, 100)))
}))

## Per-window Fst with two planted peaks, so the reading order is verifiable.
win <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  mid <- seq(1, k$len - 1, by = 2)
  fst <- 0.08 + 0.05 * abs(sin(mid / 9))
  if (k$chr == "chr2") fst <- fst + 0.55 * exp(-((mid - 62)^2) / 40)
  if (k$chr == "chr4") fst <- fst + 0.42 * exp(-((mid - 20)^2) / 50)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, mid = mid,
             fst = pmin(0.95, fst + rnorm(length(mid), 0, 0.02)))
}))

markers <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr1", "chr2", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr5"),
  pos = c(12, 88, 62, 30, 41, 70, 20, 15, 38),
  type = c("tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA", "tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA",
           "QTL", "QTL", "miRNA")
)

## Cumulative coordinates: chromosomes end to end with a 4 Mb gap, so every
## panel can share a single x axis instead of relying on facet widths.
gap <- 4
offs <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr,
                   offset = c(0, cumsum(karyo$len + gap)[-nrow(karyo)]))
banding <- left_join(banding, offs, by = "chr") |>
  mutate(x0 = offset + start, x1 = offset + end)
win <- left_join(win, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + mid)
markers <- left_join(markers, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + pos)
chr_lab <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr, x = offs$offset + karyo$len / 2)
xmax <- max(win$x) + 3

p_ideo <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = banding,
            aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = 0.84, ymax = 1.16, fill = density),
            colour = "#3d3d3d", linewidth = 0.12) +
  ## Centromere: a dark tick, not a white line -- white on a near-white band
  ## is invisible, which is exactly how the pinch disappears from the figure.
  geom_segment(data = left_join(karyo, offs, by = "chr"),
               aes(x = offset + cen, xend = offset + cen, y = 0.80, yend = 1.20),
               linewidth = 0.9, colour = "#111111", lineend = "butt") +
  geom_point(data = markers, aes(x, y = 1.34, colour = type, shape = type),
             size = 2.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn("band\ndensity",
                       colours = c("#ffffff", "#c6c6c6", "#5a5a5a"),
                       limits = c(0, 100), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(tRNA = "#1b7837", rRNA = "#d95f02",
                                 miRNA = "#2166ac", QTL = "#b2182b"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(tRNA = 17, rRNA = 15, miRNA = 16, QTL = 18),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.78, 1.46), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.32, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.2),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 5, 0, 5))

p_track <- ggplot(win, aes(x, fst, group = chr)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#4292c6", alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(colour = "#08519c", linewidth = 0.32) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3,
             colour = "#b2182b") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = offs$offset[-1] - gap / 2, linewidth = 0.25,
             colour = "#dedede") +
  ## chromosome names on the track's own panel, not borrowed from above
  annotate("text", x = chr_lab$x, y = 0.93, label = chr_lab$chr,
           size = 2.6, colour = "#333333") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.96), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "cumulative position (Mb; chromosomes laid end to end)",
       y = "Fst") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 2, 5))

region_start <- 0; region_end <- 120000   # a TAL1-like 120 kb locus
bins <- seq(region_start, region_end, by = 1000)
peak_at <- 45000
sig_fun <- function(amp, width) {
  exp(-((bins - peak_at)^2) / (2 * width^2)) * amp +
    pmax(0, rnorm(length(bins), 0, 0.02))
}
tracks <- data.frame(
  bin = rep(bins, 4),
  signal = c(sig_fun(0.95, 9000), sig_fun(0.75, 5000),
             sig_fun(0.6, 14000), sig_fun(0.5, 18000)),
  track = factor(rep(c("H3K27ac", "H3K4me3", "DNase", "RNA-seq"), each = length(bins))))
exons <- data.frame(start = c(43000, 47000, 52000, 58000, 64000),
                    end = c(44500, 48500, 53500, 59500, 66000))
## the gene model lives in its own facet track
gene_df <- data.frame(bin = rep(bins, 2), signal = 0, track = "Gene (TAL1, +)")
exon_df <- data.frame(track = "Gene (TAL1, +)", start = exons$start, end = exons$end)

ggplot(tracks, aes(bin, signal)) +
  geom_area(aes(fill = track), colour = NA, alpha = 0.85, linewidth = 0) +
  geom_blank(data = gene_df, aes(bin, signal), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_rect(data = exon_df, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0.15, ymax = 0.85),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "#2166AC", colour = "#2166AC") +
  geom_segment(data = data.frame(track = "Gene (TAL1, +)", x = min(exons$start),
                                 xend = max(exons$end)),
               aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = 0.5, yend = 0.5),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#2166AC") +
  facet_grid(track ~ ., switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("H3K27ac" = "#E31A1C", "H3K4me3" = "#FF7F00",
                               "DNase" = "#33A02C", "RNA-seq" = "#1F78B4"),
                    name = NULL,
                    breaks = c("RNA-seq", "DNase", "H3K4me3", "H3K27ac")) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x / 1000, " kb"),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = "chr1 position", y = NULL,
       title = "Signal tracks around the promoter of a target gene (simulated bigWig)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 8.5),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1))

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(patchwork)
})

## A chromosome table in the shape RIdeogram expects: name, start, end,
## centromere. Lengths are a five-chromosome toy genome in Mb.
karyo <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5"),
  len = c(120, 95, 80, 60, 45),
  cen = c(48, 34, 31, 21, 17)
)
set.seed(43501)

## Cytobands: alternating stain with a density value, as G-band tables carry.
banding <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  starts <- seq(0, k$len, by = 6)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, start = starts, end = pmin(starts + 6, k$len),
             density = round(runif(length(starts), 0, 100)))
}))

## Per-window Fst with two planted peaks, so the reading order is verifiable.
win <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  mid <- seq(1, k$len - 1, by = 2)
  fst <- 0.08 + 0.05 * abs(sin(mid / 9))
  if (k$chr == "chr2") fst <- fst + 0.55 * exp(-((mid - 62)^2) / 40)
  if (k$chr == "chr4") fst <- fst + 0.42 * exp(-((mid - 20)^2) / 50)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, mid = mid,
             fst = pmin(0.95, fst + rnorm(length(mid), 0, 0.02)))
}))

markers <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr1", "chr2", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr5"),
  pos = c(12, 88, 62, 30, 41, 70, 20, 15, 38),
  type = c("tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA", "tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA",
           "QTL", "QTL", "miRNA")
)

## Cumulative coordinates: chromosomes end to end with a 4 Mb gap, so every
## panel can share a single x axis instead of relying on facet widths.
gap <- 4
offs <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr,
                   offset = c(0, cumsum(karyo$len + gap)[-nrow(karyo)]))
banding <- left_join(banding, offs, by = "chr") |>
  mutate(x0 = offset + start, x1 = offset + end)
win <- left_join(win, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + mid)
markers <- left_join(markers, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + pos)
chr_lab <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr, x = offs$offset + karyo$len / 2)
xmax <- max(win$x) + 3

p_ideo <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = banding,
            aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = 0.84, ymax = 1.16, fill = density),
            colour = "#3d3d3d", linewidth = 0.12) +
  ## Centromere: a dark tick, not a white line -- white on a near-white band
  ## is invisible, which is exactly how the pinch disappears from the figure.
  geom_segment(data = left_join(karyo, offs, by = "chr"),
               aes(x = offset + cen, xend = offset + cen, y = 0.80, yend = 1.20),
               linewidth = 0.9, colour = "#111111", lineend = "butt") +
  geom_point(data = markers, aes(x, y = 1.34, colour = type, shape = type),
             size = 2.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn("band\ndensity",
                       colours = c("#ffffff", "#c6c6c6", "#5a5a5a"),
                       limits = c(0, 100), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(tRNA = "#1b7837", rRNA = "#d95f02",
                                 miRNA = "#2166ac", QTL = "#b2182b"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(tRNA = 17, rRNA = 15, miRNA = 16, QTL = 18),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.78, 1.46), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.32, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.2),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 5, 0, 5))

p_track <- ggplot(win, aes(x, fst, group = chr)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#4292c6", alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(colour = "#08519c", linewidth = 0.32) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3,
             colour = "#b2182b") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = offs$offset[-1] - gap / 2, linewidth = 0.25,
             colour = "#dedede") +
  ## chromosome names on the track's own panel, not borrowed from above
  annotate("text", x = chr_lab$x, y = 0.93, label = chr_lab$chr,
           size = 2.6, colour = "#333333") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.96), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "cumulative position (Mb; chromosomes laid end to end)",
       y = "Fst") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 2, 5))

p_ideo / p_track + plot_layout(heights = c(0.75, 1))

# Advanced plot
# Further process the data and use spatial points to infer the situation of nearby surfaces
# Reduce calculation time, the fewer points below, the closer the estimated distance, the higher the resolution, and the more accurate it is
# Parallel initialization
registerDoParallel(cores = 4)

# Data Preparation
world_proj <- st_transform(world, "+proj=eqc +units=m")
centroids <- st_centroid(world_proj) %>% 
  dplyr::select(incidence)

# Create a low-resolution grid (100x100)
grid <- st_make_grid(world_proj, n = c(100,100)) %>% 
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_join(world_proj, join = st_intersects)

# Variogram model optimization
variogram_model <- vgm(
  psill = 30,
  model = "Exp",  # Switch to an exponential model
  range = 2e6,    # 2000 km related range
  nugget = 5
)

# Block parallel computing
grid_chunks <- split(grid, cut(st_coordinates(st_centroid(grid))[,1], 4))

krige_result <- foreach(i=1:4, .combine=rbind) %dopar% {
  krige(incidence ~ 1,
        locations = centroids,
        newdata = grid_chunks[[i]],
        model = variogram_model,
        nmax = 30)
} %>% st_as_sf()

# Convert back to WGS84 coordinate system
krige_result <- st_transform(krige_result, 4326)


advanced_map <- ggplot() +
  # Spatially interpolated surfaces
  geom_sf(data = krige_result, 
          aes(fill = var1.pred, color = var1.pred),
          alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#2c7bb6", "#abd9e9", "#ffffbf", "#fdae61", "#d7191c"),
    name = "Interpolated\nIncidence"
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = c("#2c7bb6", "#abd9e9", "#ffffbf", "#fdae61", "#d7191c"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  
  # Original national borders
  geom_sf(data = world, 
          aes(fill = incidence),
          color = "white", 
          size = 0.1,
          alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#2c7bb6", "#abd9e9", "#ffffbf", "#fdae61", "#d7191c"),
    name = "Country\nIncidence",
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)
  ) +
  
  # 3D relief effect
  ggfx::with_shadow(
    geom_sf(data = world,
            aes(geometry = geometry),
            color = "grey30",
            fill = NA,
            size = 0.2),
    sigma = 5,
    x_offset = 3,
    y_offset = 3
  ) +
  
  # Hotspot annotation
  geom_sf(data = world %>% filter(incidence > quantile(incidence, 0.9)),
          color = "red",
          fill = NA,
          size = 0.5) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = world %>% filter(incidence > quantile(incidence, 0.9)),
    aes(label = name, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 2.5,
    box.padding = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    fill = alpha("white", 0.8)
  ) +
  
  # Map elements
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr",
    width = unit(1.2, "cm"),   # New width parameter
    height = unit(1.2, "cm"),  # Added height parameter
    style = north_arrow_minimal()  # Remove size parameters
  ) +
  
  # Coordinate projection
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=robin") +
  
  # Theme Settings
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.12, 0.3),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8), color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Advanced Spatial Distribution of Disease Incidence")

advanced_map

set.seed(43532)
nb <- 10
ids <- sprintf("b%02d", 1:nb)
blen <- c(6.2, 5.1, 7.4, 4.8, 6.8, 5.6, 7.9, 4.4, 6.0, 5.3)
gap <- 0.22

map1_order <- 1:nb
map2_order <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 6, 8, 9, 10)
## b04 and b08 are inverted in map 2; b06/b07 swap places.
map2_strand <- ifelse(ids %in% c("b04", "b08"), "-", "+")

layout <- function(order, strand) {
  len <- blen[order]
  x0 <- cumsum(c(0, len[-length(len)] + gap))
  data.frame(id = ids[order], len = len, x0 = x0, x1 = x0 + len,
             mid = x0 + len / 2,
             strand = strand[match(ids[order], ids)], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
m1 <- layout(map1_order, rep("+", nb)); m1$y <- 1.00
m2 <- layout(map2_order, map2_strand); m2$y <- 0.10

cls <- setNames(rep("collinear", nb), ids)
cls[c("b04", "b08")] <- "inverted"
cls[c("b06", "b07")] <- "translocated"
col_cls <- c(collinear = "#9e9e9e", inverted = "#d95f02",
             translocated = "#7570b3")

y_top <- 0.86; y_bot <- 0.24
ribs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ids, function(g) {
  a <- m1[m1$id == g, ]; b <- m2[m2$id == g, ]
  bx <- c(b$x0, b$x1); if (b$strand == "-") bx <- rev(bx)
  data.frame(grp = g, class = cls[[g]],
             x = c(a$x0, a$x1, bx[2], bx[1]),
             y = c(y_top, y_top, y_bot, y_bot))
}))
ribs$class <- factor(ribs$class, levels = names(col_cls))

trk <- rbind(m1, m2)
trk$class <- factor(cls[trk$id], levels = names(col_cls))
trk$lab <- paste0(trk$id, " ", ifelse(trk$strand == "+", ">", "<"))

  geom_polygon(data = ribs, aes(x, y, group = grp, fill = class)) +

                    breaks = names(col_cls),

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 60, 10), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.4, 61), ylim = c(0.01, 1.20), clip = "off") +

             "Genetic Info Processing", "Genetic Info Processing", "Genetic Info Processing",
             "Organismal Systems", "Human Diseases"),
  level2 = c("Cell growth and death", "Cell growth and death",
             "Signal transduction", "Signal transduction",
             "Translation", "Translation", "Replication and repair",
             "Digestive system", "Infectious disease"),

             "Ribosome", "Proteasome", "Mismatch repair",

  setNames(vapply(1:6, function(j) evolve(fam_b, 6), ""), paste0("FAM2_U", 1:6)))
aln <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seqs, function(s) strsplit(s, "")[[1]]))
rownames(aln) <- names(seqs)

n_samp <- 18
grp <- factor(rep(c("Group1", "Group2"), c(6, 12)))
expr <- matrix(rnorm(12 * n_samp, sd = 0.7), 12, n_samp,
               dimnames = list(rownames(aln), paste0("S", 1:n_samp)))
expr[grep("FAM1", rownames(expr)), grp == "Group1"] <-
  expr[grep("FAM1", rownames(expr)), grp == "Group1"] + 1.4
expr[grep("FAM2", rownames(expr)), grp == "Group2"] <-
  expr[grep("FAM2", rownames(expr)), grp == "Group2"] + 1.4

ann_col <- data.frame(group = grp); rownames(ann_col) <- colnames(expr)
pheatmap(expr, scale = "row", clustering_method = "complete",
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         annotation_colors = list(group = c(Group1 = "#F4A582", Group2 = "#92C5DE")),
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(20),
         show_colnames = FALSE, fontsize = 9)

## write the member sequences as FASTA (the real workflow aligns member FASTAs)
fa <- file.path(tempdir(), "family_msa.fasta")
con <- file(fa, "w")
for (nm in names(seqs)) writeLines(c(paste0(">", nm), seqs[[nm]]), con)
close(con)
ggmsa(fa, start = 1, end = 60, font = "DroidSansMono",
      color = "Chemistry_AA", char_width = 0.5, seq_name = TRUE)

n <- nrow(aln)
d <- matrix(0, n, n, dimnames = list(rownames(aln), rownames(aln)))
for (i in 2:n) for (j in 1:(i - 1)) {
  d[i, j] <- d[j, i] <- 1 - mean(aln[i, ] == aln[j, ])
}
tree <- nj(as.dist(d))
sub <- ifelse(grepl("FAM1", tree$tip.label), "subfamily 1", "subfamily 2")
xr <- max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(tree))
ggtree(tree, size = 0.8) %<+% data.frame(label = tree$tip.label, sub = sub) +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = sub), size = 2.6) +
  geom_tiplab(aes(color = sub), size = 3.2, offset = 0.02,
              align = TRUE, linesize = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("subfamily 1" = "#B2182B",
                                "subfamily 2" = "#2166AC"), name = NULL) +
  xlim(0, xr * 1.5) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

set.seed(43511)

## Toy genome: five chromosomes with a SNP panel every ~200 kb, laid on a
## cumulative axis so that runs can cross chromosome boundaries nowhere.
chr <- data.frame(chr = paste0("chr", 1:5), len = c(120, 95, 80, 60, 45),
                  offset = c(0, 124, 223, 307, 371))
snp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(chr)), function(i) {
  n <- round(chr$len[i] / 0.2)
  data.frame(chr = chr$chr[i], pos = sort(runif(n, 0, chr$len[i])))
}))
snp$x <- snp$pos + chr$offset[match(snp$chr, chr$chr)]

## Per-sample homozygosity at the 62% background rate, then planted patterns:
## two genome-wide (consanguinity), one focal run, one patchy intermediate set.
samples <- sprintf("S%02d", 1:12)
hz <- expand.grid(sample = samples, id = seq_len(nrow(snp))) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(chr = snp$chr[id], x = snp$x[id], hom = runif(n()) < 0.62) |>
  arrange(sample, x)

plant <- function(s, rng, frac = 1) {
  sel <- hz$sample == s & hz$chr %in% rng
  hz$hom[sel] <<- runif(sum(sel)) < frac
}
plant("S02", chr$chr); plant("S08", chr$chr)
plant("S05", "chr3"); plant("S11", c("chr1", "chr2"), 0.94)

## A run is a maximal stretch of homozygous calls, at least 20 SNPs long.
runs <- hz |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  mutate(run = cumsum(c(TRUE, hom[-1] != hom[-n()] | chr[-1] != chr[-n()]))) |>
  group_by(sample, run, chr) |>
  filter(all(hom), n() >= 20) |>
  summarise(x0 = min(x), x1 = max(x), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(len_mb = x1 - x0,
         length_class = cut(len_mb, breaks = c(0, 5, 20, Inf),
                            labels = c("< 5 Mb", "5-20 Mb", "> 20 Mb")))

## Integer rows keep blank samples on the axis (a discrete scale would drop them).
ypos <- setNames(seq_along(samples), samples)
runs$y <- ypos[runs$sample]
ymax <- length(samples)

labs <- data.frame(
  y = c(ypos[["S02"]], ypos[["S05"]], ypos[["S08"]], ypos[["S11"]]),
  lab = c("genome-wide: consanguinity", "focal chr3 run",
          "genome-wide: consanguinity", "patchy, intermediate runs")
)

ggplot(runs) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x0, xend = x1, y = y, yend = y, colour = length_class),
               linewidth = 2.6, lineend = "butt") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(chr$offset[-1], max(chr$offset + chr$len)),
             linewidth = 0.3, colour = "#d9d9d9") +
  annotate("text", x = chr$offset + chr$len / 2, y = ymax + 0.62,
           label = chr$chr, size = 2.7, colour = "#525252") +
  annotate("segment", x = 418, xend = 421, y = labs$y, yend = labs$y,
           linewidth = 0.35, colour = "#6e6e6e") +
  annotate("text", x = 424, y = labs$y, label = labs$lab, hjust = 0,
           size = 2.55, colour = "#333333") +
  scale_colour_brewer("run length", palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(samples), labels = samples,
                     limits = c(0.35, ymax + 0.95), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 512), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "cumulative position (Mb)",
       y = "sample (12 samples; runs of 20 or more homozygous SNPs)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(4, 6, 6, 4),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.32, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7))
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")

                                          'age_at_index.demographic',
                                          'ajcc_pathologic_stage.diagnoses')])
colnames(LIHC) <- c('bcr_patient_barcode','gender','status','time_death','time_followup','age','stage')
table(LIHC$status)
LIHC <- LIHC[LIHC$status != 'Not Reported',]
LIHC$status <- as.numeric(ifelse(LIHC$status=='Dead','2','1') ) # Death is 2 in nomogram
## Analysis time: dead patients use days_to_death, censored patients use
## days_to_last_follow_up. Fitting on days_to_death alone silently drops
## every censored patient (NA time), which also removes factor levels that
## regplot's model.frame re-evaluation then reports as "new levels".
LIHC$time <- ifelse(LIHC$status == 2, LIHC$time_death, LIHC$time_followup)
LIHC <- LIHC[!is.na(LIHC$time) & LIHC$time > 0, ]

options(datadist="dd")

plot(nom)

med <- Quantile(f2) # Calculate median survival time
surv <- Survival(f2) # Constructing a survival probability function

## keeps 100000/200000 from printing as 1e+05/2e+05

nom <- nomogram(f2, fun=function(x) med(lp=x),funlabel="Median Survival Time",
                fun.at=c(50000, 100000, 200000))
plot(nom)
options(old)

                funlabel=c("3-year Survival Probability", "5-year Survival Probability","Median Survival Time"),
                fun.at=list(seq(.2, .9, by=.1), seq(.1, .9, by=.1), c(50000, 100000, 200000)))

set.seed(4701)
n_hr <- 260
hrdata <- data.frame(
  age = factor(ifelse(rnorm(n_hr, 62, 10) > 62, ">=median", "<median"),
               levels = c("<median", ">=median")),
  stage = factor(sample(c("I-II", "III-IV"), n_hr, TRUE), levels = c("I-II", "III-IV")),
  invasion = factor(sample(c("no", "yes"), n_hr, TRUE, c(0.6, 0.4)), levels = c("no", "yes")),
  marker = factor(ifelse(rnorm(n_hr) > 0, ">=median", "<median"),
                  levels = c("<median", ">=median")))
lp <- -3.4 + 0.35 * (hrdata$stage == "III-IV") + 0.5 * (hrdata$invasion == "yes") -
  0.45 * (hrdata$marker == ">=median")
hrdata$time <- rexp(n_hr, exp(lp) * 0.02)
hrdata$event <- rbinom(n_hr, 1, 0.8)
vars <- c("age", "stage", "invasion", "marker")

uni_cox <- function(dat) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(vars, function(v) {
    sm <- summary(coxph(as.formula(paste0("Surv(time, event) ~ ", v)), data = dat))
    data.frame(characteristics = v,
               HR = round(sm$coefficients[, "exp(coef)"], 2),
               CI = paste0(round(sm$conf.int[, "lower .95"], 2), "-",
                           round(sm$conf.int[, "upper .95"], 2)),
               p = sm$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"])
  }))
}
set.seed(4702)
train_idx <- sample(n_hr, round(n_hr * 0.7))
tr <- hrdata[train_idx, ]; va <- hrdata[-train_idx, ]
uni_tr <- uni_cox(tr); uni_va <- uni_cox(va)
sig_vars <- uni_tr$characteristics[uni_tr$p < 0.05]

mk_rows <- function(sm, sig_vars) {
  cm <- sm$coefficients; ci <- sm$conf.int
  do.call(rbind, lapply(vars, function(v) {
    idx <- which(startsWith(rownames(cm), v))   # factor contrasts: "stageIII-IV"
    if (length(idx) == 1) {
      data.frame(characteristics = v, HR = round(cm[idx, "exp(coef)"], 2),
                 CI = paste0(round(ci[idx, "lower .95"], 2), "-",
                             round(ci[idx, "upper .95"], 2)),
                 p = ifelse(cm[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, "< 0.001",
                            round(cm[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3)))
    } else {
      data.frame(characteristics = v, HR = NA, CI = NA, p = NA)
    }
  }))
}
m_tr <- mk_rows(summary(coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(time, event) ~",
                                               paste(sig_vars, collapse = "+"))), data = tr)), sig_vars)

n_hr <- 260
hrdata <- data.frame(
  age = factor(ifelse(rnorm(n_hr, 62, 10) > 62, ">=median", "<median"),
               levels = c("<median", ">=median")),
  stage = factor(sample(c("I-II", "III-IV"), n_hr, TRUE), levels = c("I-II", "III-IV")),
  invasion = factor(sample(c("no", "yes"), n_hr, TRUE, c(0.6, 0.4)), levels = c("no", "yes")),
  marker = factor(ifelse(rnorm(n_hr) > 0, ">=median", "<median"),
                  levels = c("<median", ">=median")))
lp <- -3.4 + 0.35 * (hrdata$stage == "III-IV") + 0.5 * (hrdata$invasion == "yes") -
  0.45 * (hrdata$marker == ">=median")
hrdata$time <- rexp(n_hr, exp(lp) * 0.02)
hrdata$event <- rbinom(n_hr, 1, 0.8)
vars <- c("age", "stage", "invasion", "marker")

uni_cox <- function(dat) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(vars, function(v) {
    sm <- summary(coxph(as.formula(paste0("Surv(time, event) ~ ", v)), data = dat))
    data.frame(characteristics = v,
               HR = round(sm$coefficients[, "exp(coef)"], 2),
               CI = paste0(round(sm$conf.int[, "lower .95"], 2), "-",
                           round(sm$conf.int[, "upper .95"], 2)),
               p = sm$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"])
  }))
}
set.seed(4702)
train_idx <- sample(n_hr, round(n_hr * 0.7))
tr <- hrdata[train_idx, ]; va <- hrdata[-train_idx, ]
uni_tr <- uni_cox(tr); uni_va <- uni_cox(va)
sig_vars <- uni_tr$characteristics[uni_tr$p < 0.05]

mk_rows <- function(sm, sig_vars) {
  cm <- sm$coefficients; ci <- sm$conf.int
  do.call(rbind, lapply(vars, function(v) {
    idx <- which(startsWith(rownames(cm), v))   # factor contrasts: "stageIII-IV"
    if (length(idx) == 1) {
      data.frame(characteristics = v, HR = round(cm[idx, "exp(coef)"], 2),
                 CI = paste0(round(ci[idx, "lower .95"], 2), "-",
                             round(ci[idx, "upper .95"], 2)),
                 p = ifelse(cm[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, "< 0.001",
                            round(cm[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3)))
    } else {
      data.frame(characteristics = v, HR = NA, CI = NA, p = NA)
    }
  }))
}
m_tr <- mk_rows(summary(coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(time, event) ~",
                                               paste(sig_vars, collapse = "+"))), data = tr)), sig_vars)
m_va <- mk_rows(summary(coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(time, event) ~",
                                               paste(sig_vars, collapse = "+"))), data = va)), sig_vars)

test_data <- data.frame(id = 1:4,
                        coef1 = c(1, 1.59, 1.3, 1.24),
                        coef2 = c(1, 1.7, 1.4, 1.04),
                        low1 = c(1, 1.3, 1.1, 0.99),
                        low2 = c(1, 1.6, 1.2, 0.7),
                        high1 = c(1, 1.94, 1.6, 1.55),
                        high2 = c(1, 1.8, 1.55, 1.33))

# Convert into dplyr formatted data
out_data <- test_data |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything() & -id) |>
  mutate(group = gsub("(.+)([12])$", "\\2", name),
         name = gsub("(.+)([12])$", "\\1", name)) |>
  pivot_wider() |>
  group_by(id) |>
  mutate(col1 = lapply(id, \(x) ifelse(x < 4,
                                       paste("Category", id),
                                       expression(Category >= 4))),
         col2 = lapply(1:n(), \(i) substitute(expression(bar(x) == val),
                                              list(val = mean(coef) |> round(2)))),
         col2 = if_else(id == 1,
                        rep("ref", n()) |> as.list(),
                        col2)) |>
  group_by(group)

out_data |>
  forestplot(mean = coef,
             lower = low,
             upper = high,
             labeltext = c(col1, col2),
             title = "Cool study",
             zero = c(0.98, 1.02),
             grid = structure(c(2^-.5, 2^.5),
                              gp = gpar(col = "steelblue", lty = 2)
             ),
             boxsize = 0.25,
             xlab = "The estimates",
             new_page = TRUE,
             legend = c("Treatment", "Placebo"),
             legend_args = fpLegend(
               pos = list("topright"),
               title = "Group",
               r = unit(.1, "snpc"),
               gp = gpar(col = "#CCCCCC", lwd = 1.5)
             )) |>
  fp_set_style(box = c("royalblue", "gold"),
               line = c("darkblue", "orange"),
               summary = c("darkblue", "red"))

set.seed(5501)
mdata <- data.frame(
  Groups = c("TCGA-LUAD", "GSE30219", "GSE31225"),
  HR = c(2.83, 3.42, 2.16),
  LCI = c(1.71, 2.03, 1.15),
  HCI = c(4.68, 5.76, 4.05),
  pvalue = c(0.00002, 0.0001, 0.021),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(mdata$LCI > 1) && all(mdata$HCI > mdata$LCI))

m <- metagen(TE = log(HR), seTE = (log(HCI) - log(LCI)) / (2 * 1.96),
             sm = "HR", data = mdata, studlab = Groups)
# log-scale pooled effect; exponentiate to read the HR off the diamond
stopifnot(exp(m$TE.random) > 1 && exp(m$TE.random) < 10 && m$pval.random < 0.05)

forest(m, comb.fixed = FALSE, comb.random = TRUE,
       leftcols = "studlab",
       label.left = "Cohort",
       rightcols = c("TE", "lower", "upper"),
       print.pval.Q = TRUE, print.I2 = TRUE, print.tau2 = TRUE,
       col.square = "#8B0000", col.square.lines = "#8B0000",
       col.diamond = "#8B0000", col.diamond.lines = "#8B0000",
       xlab = "Hazard Ratio (log scale)")

data_2$GO_aspect[data_2$GO_aspect=="GO:MF"] ="MF"

# Group by GO_aspect, then sort each group by log10Padj and take the first 15 data
data_2 <- data_2 %>%  group_by(GO_aspect) %>%
  arrange(GO_aspect, desc(log10Padj)) %>%  # Sort by log10Padj in descending order
  slice_head(n = 15)  # Take the first 15


# Plot
ggdotchart(data_2, x = "GO_term", y = "log10Padj",
           color = "GO_aspect",                          # Display colors by group
           palette = c("#090886", "#F90708", "#25821F"), # Custom color palette
           sorting = "descending",                       # Sort values in descending order
           add = "segments",                             # Add a line segment from y=0 to the point
           group = "GO_aspect",                          # Sort by group
           dot.size = 8,                                 # Dot size
           label = round(data_2$count),                  # Add mpg values as point labels
           font.label = list(color = "white", size = 9, 
                             vjust = 0.5),               # Adjust label parameters
           ggtheme = theme_pubr()                        # ggplot2 theme
)+labs(x=NULL,y=expression(-log[10](Padj)),

# Using the built-in lung dataset (from the survival package)
data("lung")
# Data preprocessing
surv_data <- lung %>%
  mutate(
    status = ifelse(status == 2, 1, 0),  # Transition state code (1=event)
    sex = factor(sex, labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    group = sample(c("Treatment", "Placebo"), n(), replace = TRUE)
  )

# View data structure
glimpse(surv_data)

# Survival time distribution
summary(surv_data$time)

# Fitting survival curves
fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ group, data = surv_data)

# Extract curve data
surv_curve <- surv_summary(fit) 


# Calculate the log-rank test P value
diff <- survdiff(Surv(time, status) ~ group, data = surv_data)
p_value <- signif(1 - pchisq(diff$chisq, length(diff$n)-1), 3)

# Basic survival curve

  geom_step(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Time (Months)", y = "Survival Probability") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent)

# Generate quantile breakpoints (automatically adapt to data distribution)
custom_breaks <- quantile(surv_curve$time, 
                          probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), 
                          na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  unique()  # Ensure breakpoints are unique

# How to correctly generate interval labels
time_labels <- paste0(
  round(custom_breaks[-length(custom_breaks)]),  # Starting point (excluding the last one)
  "-",
  round(custom_breaks[-1])  # End point (excluding the first one)
)

# Generate segmented risk table data --------------------------------------------------------
risk_table_segmented <- surv_curve %>%
  mutate(
    time_interval = cut(time,
                        breaks = custom_breaks,
                        include.lowest = TRUE,
                        right = FALSE,
                        labels = time_labels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(group, time_interval) %>%
  summarise(
    n_risk = ifelse(all(is.na(n.risk)), 0, max(n.risk, na.rm = TRUE)),  # Take the maximum number of people at risk within the interval
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(group, time_interval, fill = list(n_risk = 0)) %>%
  # 4. Added total row (fixed syntax)
  bind_rows(
    group_by(., group) %>%
      summarise(
        time_interval = "Total",
        n_risk = sum(n_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Treatment", "Placebo")),
    time_interval = factor(time_interval, levels = c(time_labels, "Total") )
  )

  sd1 <- survdiff(my.surv ~ group)

  unique()  # Ensure breakpoints are unique

  "-",

)

  mutate(
    time_interval = cut(time,
                        breaks = custom_breaks,
                        include.lowest = TRUE,
                        right = FALSE,
                        labels = time_labels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(group, time_interval) %>%
  summarise(
    n_risk = ifelse(all(is.na(n.risk)), 0, max(n.risk, na.rm = TRUE)),  # Take the maximum number of people at risk within the interval
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(group, time_interval, fill = list(n_risk = 0)) %>%
  # 4. Added total row (fixed syntax)
  bind_rows(
    group_by(., group) %>%
      summarise(
        time_interval = "Total",
        n_risk = sum(n_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Treatment", "Placebo")),
    time_interval = factor(time_interval, levels = c(time_labels, "Total") )

# convert data structure

data <- data[,-1]
cb <- combn(nrow(data), 2)
final <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:ncol(cb)) {
  tmp <- data[cb[,i],]
  groups <- paste0(rownames(data)[cb[,i]], collapse = " | ")
  
  res <- tryCatch({
    chisq.test(tmp)
    }, warning = function(w) {
      tryCatch({fisher.test(tmp)}, error = function(e) {
        return(fisher.test(tmp, simulate.p.value = TRUE))
        })
  })
  val_percent <- apply(tmp, 1, function(x) {
    sprintf("%s (%s%%)", x, round(x / sum(x), 2) * 100)
  })
  val_percent1 <- paste0(colnames(tmp), ":", val_percent[,1])
  val_percent1 <- paste0(val_percent1, collapse = " | ")
  val_percent2 <- paste0(colnames(tmp), ":", val_percent[,2])
  val_percent2 <- paste0(val_percent2, collapse = " | ")
  tmp <- data.frame(
    groups = groups,
    val_percent_left = val_percent1,
    val_percent_right = val_percent2,
    statistic = ifelse(is.null(res$statistic), NA,
      as.numeric(res$statistic)),
    pvalue = as.numeric(res$p.value),
    method = res$method
  )
  final <- rbind(final, tmp)
}

connected_scatterplot <- function(data, x, y, label, label_ratio, line_color, arrow_size, label_size) {

  draw_data <- data.frame(
    x = data[[x]],
    y = data[[y]],
    label = data[[label]]
  )

  add_label_data <- draw_data %>% sample_frac(label_ratio)
  rm(data)

  p <- ggplot(draw_data, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label)) +
    geom_point(color = line_color) +
    geom_text_repel(data = add_label_data, size = label_size) +
    geom_segment(
      color = line_color,
      aes(
        xend = c(tail(x, n = -1), NA),
        yend = c(tail(y, n = -1), NA)
      ),
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(arrow_size, "mm"))
    )

  return(p)
}

for (i in 1:ncol(data)) {
  data[,i] <- as.numeric(data[,i])
}
data <- as.matrix(data)
set.seed(7)
kohmap <- xyf(scale(data), target, grid = somgrid(xdim=6, ydim=4, topo="hexagonal"), rlen=100)

color_key <- c("#A50026","#D73027","#F46D43","#FDAE61","#FEE090","#FFFFBF","#E0F3F8",
               "#ABD9E9","#74ADD1","#4575B4","#313695")
colors <- function (n, alpha, rev = FALSE) {
  colorRampPalette(color_key)(n)
}

# View data
head(data[,1:5])

# Easy SOM
p <- function () {
  par(mfrow = c(3,2))
  xyfpredictions <- classmat2classvec(getCodes(kohmap, 2))
  plot(kohmap, type="counts", col = as.integer(target),
       palette.name = colors,
       pchs = as.integer(target), 
       main = "Counts plot", shape = "straight", border = NA)
  
  som.hc <- cutree(hclust(object.distances(kohmap, "codes")), 3)
  add.cluster.boundaries(kohmap, som.hc)

  plot(kohmap, type="mapping",
       labels = as.integer(target), col = colors(3)[as.integer(target)],
       palette.name = colors,
       shape = "straight",
       main = "Mapping plot")

  ## add background colors to units according to their predicted class labels

geom_flat_violin <- function(
  mapping = NULL, data = NULL, stat = "ydensity", position = "dodge", 
  trim = TRUE, scale = "area", show.legend = NA, inherit.aes = TRUE, ...) {
  ggplot2::layer(data = data, mapping = mapping, stat = stat, 
                 geom = geom_flat_violin_proto, position = position,
                 show.legend = show.legend, inherit.aes = inherit.aes,
                 params = list(trim = trim, scale = scale, ...))
}

"%||%" <- function(a, b) {
  if (!is.null(a)) {
    a
  } else {
    b
  }
}

geom_flat_violin_proto <-
  ggproto("geom_flat_violin_proto", Geom,
          setup_data = function(data, params) {
            data$width <- data$width %||%
              params$width %||% (resolution(data$x, FALSE) * 0.9)
            
            data %>%
              dplyr::group_by(.data = ., group) %>%
              dplyr::mutate(.data = ., ymin = min(y), ymax = max(y), xmin = x,
                            xmax = x + width / 2)
          },
          
          draw_group = function(data, panel_scales, coord) {
            data <- base::transform(data, xminv = x, 
                                    xmaxv = x + violinwidth * (xmax - x))
            
            newdata <- base::rbind(
              dplyr::arrange(.data = base::transform(data, x = xminv), y),
              dplyr::arrange(.data = base::transform(data, x = xmaxv), -y))
            
            newdata <- rbind(newdata, newdata[1, ])
            
            ggplot2:::ggname("geom_flat_violin",
                             GeomPolygon$draw_panel(newdata, panel_scales, coord))
          },
          
          draw_key = draw_key_polygon,
          
          default_aes = ggplot2::aes(weight = 1, colour = "grey20", fill = "white",
                                     size = 0.5, alpha = NA, linetype = "solid"),
          required_aes = c("x", "y")
        )

  geom_flat_violin(alpha = 1, scale = "count", trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.05, fill = "white", alpha = 1, 
               outlier.colour = NA, position = position_nudge(0.05)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", fill = "white", shape = 21, size = 2,

  theme(legend.position = "none") +

  ylab(colnames(data)[1]) +
  guides(fill = F) +

data <- data.table::fread(jsonlite::read_json("https://hiplot.cn/ui/basic/pca/data.json")$exampleData[[1]]$textarea[[1]])
data <- as.data.frame(data)
group <- data.table::fread(jsonlite::read_json("https://hiplot.cn/ui/basic/pca/data.json")$exampleData[[1]]$textarea[[2]])
group <- as.data.frame(group)

# Convert data structure
rownames(data) <- data[, 1]
data <- as.matrix(data[, -1])
pca_info <- fast.prcomp(data)
## Create configuration
conf <- list(
  dataArg = list(
    list(list(value = "group")),  # Color by group
    list(list(value = ""))         # No shape group
  ),
  general = list(
    title = "Principal Component Analysis",
    palette = "Set1"
  )
)
## Perform PCA - Note: data must be transposed because PCA analyzes samples (columns)
pca_info <- prcomp(t(data), scale. = TRUE)
## Prepare plot data
axis <- sapply(conf$dataArg[[1]], function(x) x$value)
## Process color grouping
if (is.null(axis[1]) || axis[1] == "") {
  colorBy <- rep('ALL', ncol(data))
} else {
  ## Ensure sample order matches
  colorBy <- group[match(colnames(data), group$sample), axis[1]]
}
colorBy <- factor(colorBy, levels = unique(colorBy))
## Create PCA data frame
pca_data <- data.frame(
  sample = rownames(pca_info$x),
  PC1 = pca_info$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_info$x[, 2],
  colorBy = colorBy
)
## Calculate explained variance
variance_explained <- round(pca_info$sdev^2 / sum(pca_info$sdev^2) * 100, 1)

# View data
str(data)
str(group)
head(pca_data)

# PCA
p <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = colorBy)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray70") +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggtitle(conf$general$title) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", variance_explained[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", variance_explained[2], "%)"),
    color = axis[1]
  ) +
  
  # Custom color scheme
  scale_color_brewer(palette = conf$general$palette) +
  
  # Add sample labels
  geom_text(aes(label = sample), 
            hjust = 0.5, vjust = -1, size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  # Theme settings
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )

# Display plot
p

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(patchwork)
})

set.seed(43512)

## A 100 Mb chromosome at 500 kb resolution with five TADs. Contacts are drawn
## as a sparse (i, j, count) table, which is what Hi-C pipelines emit.
res <- 0.5
n_bin <- 200
tad_edges <- c(0, 22, 45, 55, 90, 100)
tad_id <- cut(seq_len(n_bin) * res - res / 2, breaks = tad_edges,
              labels = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)

contacts <- expand.grid(i = seq_len(n_bin), j = seq_len(n_bin)) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(i >= j) |>                       # x = i, y = j -> keep x >= y
  mutate(
    d = (i - j) * res,
    decay = 1 / (1 + d),                  # P(s) ~ s^-1
    same_tad = tad_id[i] == tad_id[j],
    freq = decay * ifelse(same_tad, 3.2, 0.9) * rexp(n(), 1)
  )

## Observed/expected: divide by the mean count at each contact distance.
oe <- contacts |>
  mutate(d_bin = round(d / res)) |>
  group_by(d_bin) |>
  mutate(mean_d = mean(freq)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ## The observed/expected ratio is kept at bin resolution (no distance-band
  ## smoothing); the per-distance expectation removes the s^-1 decay without
  ## touching the TAD-to-TAD contrast.
  mutate(oe = log2((freq + 0.05) / (mean_d + 0.05)),
         x = i * res, y = j * res)

bounds <- data.frame(x = tad_edges[-c(1, length(tad_edges))])
pal <- c("#313695", "#4575b4", "#abd9e9", "#ffffbf", "#fdae61", "#d73027",
         "#a50026")

p_tri <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = oe, aes(x, y, fill = oe),
              interpolate = FALSE) +
  ## A boundary b is a single point (b, b) on the diagonal, so inside the data
  ## region x >= y it can only be drawn as two segments from that point:
  ## x = b with 0 <= y <= b, and y = b with b <= x <= 100. Full rules would
  ## advertise contacts the matrix does not contain.
  geom_segment(data = bounds,
               aes(x = x, xend = x, y = 0, yend = x),
               colour = "grey10", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "22") +
  geom_segment(data = bounds,
               aes(x = x, xend = 100, y = x, yend = x),
               colour = "grey10", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "22") +
  scale_fill_gradientn("log2\nobs/exp", colours = pal, limits = c(-2.2, 2.2),
                       oob = scales::squish) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  ## scale_y_reverse() is what actually flips the axis: bin 0 at the top-left,
  ## the diagonal from top-left to bottom-right, and the data triangle filling
  ## the upper-right half -- the layout used by Hi-C browsers.
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, 100), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "position (Mb)", y = "position (Mb)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.85, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6.8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7.2))

## Shear ("rotation"): u = genomic midpoint, v = contact separation.
rot <- oe |> mutate(u = (i + j) * res / 2, v = (i - j) * res)

p_rot <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = rot, aes(u, v, fill = oe), interpolate = FALSE) +
  ## The (u, v) transform is a 2:1 shear, not a 45-degree rotation: a boundary
  ## b is an apex at (b, 0) and its flanks are the lines v = +/- 2 (u - b),
  ## i.e. slope +/- 2 through the apex. Slope +/- 1 guides would cut across
  ## the TAD triangles instead of tracing their edges.
  geom_abline(data = transform(bounds, s = +2, i = -2 * x),
              aes(slope = s, intercept = i), colour = "grey10",
              linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "22") +
  geom_abline(data = transform(bounds, s = -2, i = 2 * x),
              aes(slope = s, intercept = i), colour = "grey10",
              linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "22") +
  scale_fill_gradientn("log2\nobs/exp", colours = pal, limits = c(-2.2, 2.2),
                       oob = scales::squish, guide = "none") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  labs(x = "genomic midpoint (Mb)", y = "separation (Mb)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6.8))

p_tri + p_rot + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1))

## Define the plot function
call_pcatools <- function(datTable, sampleInfo,
                          top_var,
                          screeplotComponents, screeplotColBar,
                          pairsplotComponents,
                          biplotShapeBy, biplotColBy,
                          plotloadingsComponents,
                          plotloadingsLowCol,
                          plotloadingsMidCol,
                          plotloadingsHighCol,
                          eigencorplotMetavars,
                          eigencorplotComponents) {
  row.names(datTable) <- datTable[, 1]
  datTable <- datTable[, -1]
  row.names(sampleInfo) <- sampleInfo[, 1]
  data3 <<- pca(datTable, metadata = sampleInfo, removeVar = (100 - top_var) / 100)

  for (i in c("screeplotComponents", "pairsplotComponents",
              "plotloadingsComponents", "eigencorplotComponents")) {
    if (ncol(data3$rotated) < get(i)) {
      assign(i, ncol(data3$rotated))
    }
  }

  p1 <- PCAtools::screeplot(
    data3,
    components = getComponents(data3, 1:screeplotComponents),
    axisLabSize = 14, titleLabSize = 20,
    colBar = screeplotColBar,
    gridlines.major = FALSE, gridlines.minor = FALSE,
    returnPlot = TRUE
  )

  params_pairsplot <- list(
    data3,
    components = getComponents(data3, c(1:pairsplotComponents)),
    triangle = TRUE, trianglelabSize = 12,
    hline = 0, vline = 0,
    pointSize = 0.8, gridlines.major = FALSE, gridlines.minor = FALSE,
    title = "", plotaxes = FALSE,
    margingaps = unit(c(0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01), "cm"),
    returnPlot = TRUE,
    colkey = c("#00468BFF","#ED0000FF"),
    legendPosition = "none"
  )
  params_biplot <- list(data3,
    showLoadings = TRUE,
    lengthLoadingsArrowsFactor = 1.5,
    sizeLoadingsNames = 4,
    colLoadingsNames = "red4",
    # other parameters
    lab = NULL,
    hline = 0, vline = c(-25, 0, 25),
    vlineType = c("dotdash", "solid", "dashed"),
    gridlines.major = FALSE, gridlines.minor = FALSE,
    pointSize = 5,
    legendLabSize = 16, legendIconSize = 8.0,
    drawConnectors = FALSE,
    title = "PCA bi-plot",
    subtitle = "PC1 versus PC2",
    caption = "27 PCs ≈ 80%",
    returnPlot = TRUE,
    legendPosition = "bottom"
  )
  if (!is.null(biplotShapeBy) && biplotShapeBy != "") {
    params_biplot$shape <- biplotShapeBy
    params_pairsplot$shape <- biplotShapeBy
    t <- params_biplot[[1]]$metadata[,biplotShapeBy]
    params_biplot[[1]]$metadata[,biplotShapeBy] <- factor(t,
      levels = t[!duplicated(t)]
    )
    params_pairsplot[[1]]$metadata[,biplotShapeBy] <- factor(t,
      levels = t[!duplicated(t)]
    )
  }
  if (!is.null(biplotColBy) && biplotColBy != "") {
    params_pairsplot$colby <- biplotColBy
    params_pairsplot$colkey <- c("#00468BFF","#ED0000FF")
    params_biplot$colby <- biplotColBy
    params_biplot$colkey <- c("#00468BFF","#ED0000FF")
    t1 <- params_biplot[[1]]$metadata[,biplotColBy]
    params_biplot[[1]]$metadata[,biplotColBy] <- factor(t1,
      levels = t1[!duplicated(t1)]
    )
    params_pairsplot[[1]]$metadata[,biplotColBy] <- factor(t1,
      levels = t1[!duplicated(t1)]
    )
  }

  p2 <- do.call(PCAtools::pairsplot, params_pairsplot)
  p3 <- do.call(PCAtools::biplot, params_biplot)

  p4 <- PCAtools::plotloadings(
    data3,
    rangeRetain = 0.01, labSize = 4,
    components = getComponents(data3, c(1:plotloadingsComponents)),
    title = "Loadings plot", axisLabSize = 12,
    subtitle = "PC1, PC2, PC3, PC4, PC5",
    caption = "Top 1% variables",
    gridlines.major = FALSE, gridlines.minor = FALSE,
    shape = 24, shapeSizeRange = c(4, 8),
    col = c(plotloadingsLowCol, plotloadingsMidCol, plotloadingsHighCol),
    legendPosition = "none",
    drawConnectors = FALSE,
    returnPlot = TRUE
  )

  if (length(eigencorplotMetavars) > 0 && all(eigencorplotMetavars != "")) {
    metavars <- eigencorplotMetavars
  } else {
    metavars <- colnames(sampleInfo)[2:ncol(sampleInfo)]
  }
  if (length(metavars) == 1 && metavars != colnames(sampleInfo)[1]) {
    metavars <- c(colnames(sampleInfo)[1], metavars)
  } else if (length(metavars) == 1 && metavars == colnames(sampleInfo)[1]) {
    stop('eigencorplotMetavars need >= 2 feature')
  }

  p5 <- PCAtools::eigencorplot(
    data3,
    components = getComponents(data3, 1:eigencorplotComponents),
    metavars = metavars,
    cexCorval = 1.0,
    fontCorval = 2,
    posLab = "all",
    rotLabX = 45,
    scale = TRUE,
    main = "PC clinical correlates",
    cexMain = 1.5,
    plotRsquared = FALSE,
    corFUN = "pearson",
    corUSE = "na.or.complete",
    signifSymbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", ""),
    signifCutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
    returnPlot = TRUE
  )

  p6 <- plot_grid(
    p1, p2, p3,
    ncol = 3,
    labels = c("A", "B  Pairs plot", "C"),
    label_fontfamily = "Arial",
    label_fontface = "bold",
    label_size = 22,
    align = "h",
    rel_widths = c(1.10, 0.80, 1.10)
  )

  p7 <- plot_grid(
    p4,
    as.grob(p5),
    ncol = 2,
    labels = c("D", "E"),
    label_fontfamily = "Arial",
    label_fontface = "bold",
    label_size = 22,
    align = "h",
    rel_widths = c(0.8, 1.2)
  )

  p <- plot_grid(
    p6, p7,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(1.1, 0.9)
  )

  return(p)
}

)

## Convert the matrix to a Seurat object and filter the data
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = data,
  project = "seurat",
  min.cells = 0,
  min.features = 0,
  names.delim = "_",
)
## Calculate the percentage of mitochondrial genes using the PercentageFeatureSet function
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(
  object = pbmc,
  pattern = "^MT-"
)
## Filter the data
pbmc <- subset(
  x = pbmc,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > 50 & percent.mt < 5
)
## Normalize the data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(
  object = pbmc,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000, verbose = F
)
## Extract genes with large coefficient of variation between cells
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(
  object = pbmc,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 1500, verbose = F
)
## Standard preprocessing steps before PCA dimensionality reduction
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)
pbmc <- RunPCA(
  object = pbmc,
  npcs = 20,
  pc.genes = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc)
)
## Distribution of p-values for each PC and uniform distribution
pbmc <- JackStraw(
  object = pbmc,
  num.replicate = 100
)
pbmc <- ScoreJackStraw(
  object = pbmc,
  dims = 1:20
)
## Calculate neighbor distance
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(
  object = pbmc,
  dims = 1:20
)
## Group cells and optimize standard modularity
pbmc <- FindClusters(
  object = pbmc,
  resolution = 0.5
)
## TSNE clustering
pbmc <- RunTSNE(
  object = pbmc,
  dims = 1:20
)
## Finding differentially expressed features

adj_pval_filter <- 0.05
pbmc_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  object = pbmc,
  only.pos = FALSE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = log_fc_filter
)
pbmc_sig_markers <- pbmc_markers[(abs(as.numeric(
  as.vector(pbmc_markers$avg_logFC)
)) > log_fc_filter &
  as.numeric(as.vector(pbmc_markers$p_val_adj)) <

## main function
stacked_vln_plot <- function(obj,
                           features,
                           pt.size = 0,
                           plot.margin = unit(c(-0.75, 0, -0.75, 0), "cm"),
                           ...) {
  plot_list <- purrr::map(
    features,
    function(x) {
      modify_vlnplot(
        obj = obj,
        feature = x,
        ...
      )
    }
  )
  plot_list[[length(plot_list)]] <- plot_list[[length(plot_list)]] +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line()
    )
  p <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    plotlist = plot_list,
    ncol = 1
  )
  return(p)
}

## Defining the equation
equation <- function(x, add_p = FALSE) {
  xs <- summary(x)
  lm_coef <- list(
    a = as.numeric(round(coef(x)[1], digits = 2)),
    b = as.numeric(round(coef(x)[2], digits = 2)),
    r2 = round(xs$r.squared, digits = 2),
    pval = xs$coef[2, 4] 
  )
  if (add_p) {
    lm_eq <- substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x) * "," ~ ~
  italic(R)^2 ~ "=" ~ r2 * "," ~ ~ italic(p) ~ "=" ~ pval, lm_coef)
  } else {
    lm_eq <- substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x) * "," ~ ~
  italic(R)^2 ~ "=" ~ r2, lm_coef)
  }
  as.expression(lm_eq)
}

data <- as.data.frame(data)

# Convert data structure
dd <- datadist(data)
options(datadist = "dd")
## Build COX model and run nomogram
cox_res <- psm(
  data = data,
  as.formula(paste(
    sprintf("Surv(%s, %s) ~ ", colnames(data)[1], colnames(data)[2]),
    paste(colnames(data)[3:length(colnames(data))],
      collapse = "+"
    )
  )),
  # Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex + ph.ecog + ph.karno + pat.karno,
  dist = "lognormal"
)
## Build survival probability function
surv <- Survival(cox_res)
## Build quantile survival time function
med <- Quantile(cox_res)

cox_nomo <- nomogram(
  cox_res,
  fun = list(function(x) surv(365, x), function(x) surv(1095, x),
             function(x) surv(1825, x), function(x) med(lp = x)),
  funlabel = c("1-year Survival Probability",
               "3-year Survival Probability",
               "5-year Survival Probability",
               "Median Survival Time"),
  maxscale = 100,
  ## fun.at thins the survival-probability / Median Survival Time ticks: the
  ## default grids overlap into garbled labels on these short, nonlinear axes
  fun.at = list(seq(.1, .8, by = .1),
                c(.05, .1, .2, .3, .4),
                c(.02, .1, .2),
                c(200, 400, 600, 800))
)

# Nomogram

## replays it through gridGraphics, which cannot reproduce nomogram's mid-plot
## par(usr) changes and garbles/shifts every axis
plot(cox_nomo, scale = 1)
title(main = "Nomogram (COX)")

sroc <- lapply(mtime, function(t) {
  stroc <- survivalROC(
    Stime = surv_table$surv,
    status = surv_table$cens,
    marker = surv_table$risk,
    predict.time = t,
    method = "KM"
  )
  data.frame(
    TPF = stroc[["TP"]],
    FPF = stroc[["FP"]],
    cut = stroc[["cut.values"]],
    time = rep(
      stroc[["predict.time"]],
      length(stroc[["TP"]])
    ),
    AUC = rep(
      stroc$AUC,
      length(stroc$FP)
    )
  )
})
