## Position probability matrix for a 24-nt stem-loop: a GC-rich stem
## (4-8 paired with 17-21), an 8-nt loop (9-16) and two unpaired flanks.
pfm <- matrix(0.025, nrow = 4, ncol = 24,
              dimnames = list(c("A", "C", "G", "U"), NULL))
pfm[1, 1:3] <- c(0.7, 0.1, 0.1)
pfm[2, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.7, 0.1)
pfm[3, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.7)
pfm[4, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
for (k in 1:5) {                       # stem: G-C x 3, then A-U, G-C
  b <- list(c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("A", "U"),
            c("G", "C"))[[k]]
  pfm[, 3 + k] <- 0.025
  pfm[b[1], 3 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 16 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 3 + k] <- 0.05
  pfm[b[1], 16 + k] <- 0.05
}
for (k in 9:13) {                      # loop
  pfm[, k] <- c(0.4, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
}
pfm[, 14:15] <- c(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
pfm <- sweep(pfm, 2, colSums(pfm), "/")

## Information content per column (bits, max 2 for RNA).
ic <- apply(pfm, 2, function(p) 2 + sum(p * log2(p)))
letters_df <- as.data.frame(pfm) |>
  rownames_to_column("base") |>
  pivot_longer(-base, names_to = "col", values_to = "p") |>
  mutate(col = as.integer(sub("V", "", col)),
         ic = ic[col],
         h = p * ic) |>
  filter(p > 0.02) |>
  arrange(col, h) |>
  group_by(col) |>
  mutate(stack = cumsum(h), mid = stack - h / 2) |>
  ungroup()

## Pairing table: five supported stem pairs plus one weak candidate.
pairs <- data.frame(
  i = c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10),
  j = c(21, 20, 19, 18, 17, 15),
  support = c("supported", "supported", "supported", "supported",
              "supported", "weak")
)

arc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(k) {
  p <- pairs[k, ]
  t <- seq(0, pi, length.out = 60)
  span <- p$j - p$i
  data.frame(x = p$i + span * (1 - cos(t)) / 2,
             y = 2.9 + span * 0.08 * sin(t) + k * 0.02,
             support = p$support, id = k)
}))

base_cols <- c(A = "#1b7837", C = "#2166ac", G = "#d95f02", U = "#7570b3")

p <- ggplot() +
  ## information content
  geom_col(data = data.frame(col = 1:24, ic = ic),
           aes(col, ic), fill = "#cfcfcf", width = 0.72) +
  ## letters, stacked by information and scaled by frequency
  geom_text(data = letters_df,
            aes(col, mid, label = base, size = h * 2.4, colour = base),
            family = "mono", fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  ## Absolute size: 2.4 mm per bit, so letter size is read directly on the
  ## bits scale and is never normalised to the observed maximum.
  scale_size_identity(guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = base_cols, guide = "none") +
  ## base-pair arcs
  geom_path(data = arc, aes(x, y, group = id, linetype = support),
            colour = "#542788", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(supported = "solid", weak = "22"),
                        name = "pairing") +
  annotate("text", x = 11, y = 3.6, label = "loop (unpaired)", size = 2.3,
           colour = "#525252") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4.4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 24, 2), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = "alignment column", y = "information (bits)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

p

pfm <- matrix(0.025, nrow = 4, ncol = 24,
              dimnames = list(c("A", "C", "G", "U"), NULL))
pfm[1, 1:3] <- c(0.7, 0.1, 0.1)
pfm[2, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.7, 0.1)
pfm[3, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.7)
pfm[4, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
for (k in 1:5) {                       # stem: G-C x 3, then A-U, G-C
  b <- list(c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("A", "U"),
            c("G", "C"))[[k]]
  pfm[, 3 + k] <- 0.025
  pfm[b[1], 3 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 16 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 3 + k] <- 0.05
  pfm[b[1], 16 + k] <- 0.05
}
for (k in 9:13) {                      # loop
  pfm[, k] <- c(0.4, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
}
pfm[, 14:15] <- c(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
pfm <- sweep(pfm, 2, colSums(pfm), "/")

## Information content per column (bits, max 2 for RNA).
ic <- apply(pfm, 2, function(p) 2 + sum(p * log2(p)))
letters_df <- as.data.frame(pfm) |>
  rownames_to_column("base") |>
  pivot_longer(-base, names_to = "col", values_to = "p") |>
  mutate(col = as.integer(sub("V", "", col)),
         ic = ic[col],
         h = p * ic) |>
  filter(p > 0.02) |>
  arrange(col, h) |>
  group_by(col) |>
  mutate(stack = cumsum(h), mid = stack - h / 2) |>
  ungroup()

## Pairing table: five supported stem pairs plus one weak candidate.
pairs <- data.frame(
  i = c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10),
  j = c(21, 20, 19, 18, 17, 15),
  support = c("supported", "supported", "supported", "supported",
              "supported", "weak")
)

arc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(k) {
  p <- pairs[k, ]
  t <- seq(0, pi, length.out = 60)
  span <- p$j - p$i
  data.frame(x = p$i + span * (1 - cos(t)) / 2,
             y = 2.9 + span * 0.08 * sin(t) + k * 0.02,
             support = p$support, id = k)
}))

base_cols <- c(A = "#1b7837", C = "#2166ac", G = "#d95f02", U = "#7570b3")

p <- ggplot() +
  ## information content
  geom_col(data = data.frame(col = 1:24, ic = ic),
           aes(col, ic), fill = "#cfcfcf", width = 0.72) +
  ## letters, stacked by information and scaled by frequency
  geom_text(data = letters_df,
            aes(col, mid, label = base, size = h * 2.4, colour = base),
            family = "mono", fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  ## Absolute size: 2.4 mm per bit, so letter size is read directly on the
  ## bits scale and is never normalised to the observed maximum.
  scale_size_identity(guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = base_cols, guide = "none") +
  ## base-pair arcs
  geom_path(data = arc, aes(x, y, group = id, linetype = support),
            colour = "#542788", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(supported = "solid", weak = "22"),
                        name = "pairing") +
  annotate("text", x = 11, y = 3.6, label = "loop (unpaired)", size = 2.3,
           colour = "#525252") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4.4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 24, 2), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = "alignment column", y = "information (bits)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

p

## Position probability matrix for a 24-nt stem-loop: a GC-rich stem
## (4-8 paired with 17-21), an 8-nt loop (9-16) and two unpaired flanks.
pfm <- matrix(0.025, nrow = 4, ncol = 24,
              dimnames = list(c("A", "C", "G", "U"), NULL))
pfm[1, 1:3] <- c(0.7, 0.1, 0.1)
pfm[2, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.7, 0.1)
pfm[3, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.7)
pfm[4, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
for (k in 1:5) {                       # stem: G-C x 3, then A-U, G-C
  b <- list(c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("A", "U"),
            c("G", "C"))[[k]]
  pfm[, 3 + k] <- 0.025
  pfm[b[1], 3 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 16 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 3 + k] <- 0.05
  pfm[b[1], 16 + k] <- 0.05
}
for (k in 9:13) {                      # loop
  pfm[, k] <- c(0.4, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
}
pfm[, 14:15] <- c(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
pfm <- sweep(pfm, 2, colSums(pfm), "/")

## Information content per column (bits, max 2 for RNA).
ic <- apply(pfm, 2, function(p) 2 + sum(p * log2(p)))
letters_df <- as.data.frame(pfm) |>
  rownames_to_column("base") |>
  pivot_longer(-base, names_to = "col", values_to = "p") |>
  mutate(col = as.integer(sub("V", "", col)),
         ic = ic[col],
         h = p * ic) |>
  filter(p > 0.02) |>
  arrange(col, h) |>
  group_by(col) |>
  mutate(stack = cumsum(h), mid = stack - h / 2) |>
  ungroup()

## Pairing table: five supported stem pairs plus one weak candidate.
pairs <- data.frame(
  i = c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10),
  j = c(21, 20, 19, 18, 17, 15),
  support = c("supported", "supported", "supported", "supported",
              "supported", "weak")
)

arc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(k) {
  p <- pairs[k, ]
  t <- seq(0, pi, length.out = 60)
  span <- p$j - p$i
  data.frame(x = p$i + span * (1 - cos(t)) / 2,
             y = 2.9 + span * 0.08 * sin(t) + k * 0.02,
             support = p$support, id = k)
}))

  geom_text(data = letters_df,
            aes(col, mid, label = base, size = h * 2.4, colour = base),
            family = "mono", fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  ## Absolute size: 2.4 mm per bit, so letter size is read directly on the
  ## bits scale and is never normalised to the observed maximum.
  scale_size_identity(guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = base_cols, guide = "none") +
  ## base-pair arcs
  geom_path(data = arc, aes(x, y, group = id, linetype = support),
            colour = "#542788", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(supported = "solid", weak = "22"),
                        name = "pairing") +
  annotate("text", x = 11, y = 3.6, label = "loop (unpaired)", size = 2.3,
           colour = "#525252") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4.4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 24, 2), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = "alignment column", y = "information (bits)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

## Position probability matrix for a 24-nt stem-loop: a GC-rich stem
## (4-8 paired with 17-21), an 8-nt loop (9-16) and two unpaired flanks.
pfm <- matrix(0.025, nrow = 4, ncol = 24,
              dimnames = list(c("A", "C", "G", "U"), NULL))
pfm[1, 1:3] <- c(0.7, 0.1, 0.1)
pfm[2, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.7, 0.1)
pfm[3, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.7)
pfm[4, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
for (k in 1:5) {                       # stem: G-C x 3, then A-U, G-C
  b <- list(c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("A", "U"),
            c("G", "C"))[[k]]
  pfm[, 3 + k] <- 0.025
  pfm[b[1], 3 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 16 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 3 + k] <- 0.05
  pfm[b[1], 16 + k] <- 0.05
}
for (k in 9:13) {                      # loop
  pfm[, k] <- c(0.4, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
}
pfm[, 14:15] <- c(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
pfm <- sweep(pfm, 2, colSums(pfm), "/")

ic <- apply(pfm, 2, function(p) 2 + sum(p * log2(p)))
letters_df <- as.data.frame(pfm) |>
  rownames_to_column("base") |>
  pivot_longer(-base, names_to = "col", values_to = "p") |>
  mutate(col = as.integer(sub("V", "", col)),
         ic = ic[col],
         h = p * ic) |>
  filter(p > 0.02) |>
  arrange(col, h) |>
  group_by(col) |>
  mutate(stack = cumsum(h), mid = stack - h / 2) |>
  ungroup()

## Pairing table: five supported stem pairs plus one weak candidate.
pairs <- data.frame(
  i = c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10),
  j = c(21, 20, 19, 18, 17, 15),
  support = c("supported", "supported", "supported", "supported",
              "supported", "weak")
)

arc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(k) {
  p <- pairs[k, ]
  t <- seq(0, pi, length.out = 60)
  span <- p$j - p$i
  data.frame(x = p$i + span * (1 - cos(t)) / 2,
             y = 2.9 + span * 0.08 * sin(t) + k * 0.02,
             support = p$support, id = k)
}))

  ## information content
  geom_col(data = data.frame(col = 1:24, ic = ic),
           aes(col, ic), fill = "#cfcfcf", width = 0.72) +
  ## letters, stacked by information and scaled by frequency
  geom_text(data = letters_df,
            aes(col, mid, label = base, size = h * 2.4, colour = base),
            family = "mono", fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  ## Absolute size: 2.4 mm per bit, so letter size is read directly on the

  scale_size_identity(guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = base_cols, guide = "none") +
  ## base-pair arcs
  geom_path(data = arc, aes(x, y, group = id, linetype = support),
            colour = "#542788", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(supported = "solid", weak = "22"),
                        name = "pairing") +
  annotate("text", x = 11, y = 3.6, label = "loop (unpaired)", size = 2.3,
           colour = "#525252") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4.4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 24, 2), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = "alignment column", y = "information (bits)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

pfm[3, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.7)
pfm[4, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
for (k in 1:5) {                       # stem: G-C x 3, then A-U, G-C
  b <- list(c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("A", "U"),
            c("G", "C"))[[k]]
  pfm[, 3 + k] <- 0.025
  pfm[b[1], 3 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 16 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 3 + k] <- 0.05
  pfm[b[1], 16 + k] <- 0.05
}
for (k in 9:13) {                      # loop
  pfm[, k] <- c(0.4, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
}
pfm[, 14:15] <- c(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
pfm <- sweep(pfm, 2, colSums(pfm), "/")

## Information content per column (bits, max 2 for RNA).
ic <- apply(pfm, 2, function(p) 2 + sum(p * log2(p)))
letters_df <- as.data.frame(pfm) |>
  rownames_to_column("base") |>
  pivot_longer(-base, names_to = "col", values_to = "p") |>
  mutate(col = as.integer(sub("V", "", col)),
         ic = ic[col],
         h = p * ic) |>
  filter(p > 0.02) |>
  arrange(col, h) |>
  group_by(col) |>
  mutate(stack = cumsum(h), mid = stack - h / 2) |>
  ungroup()

## Pairing table: five supported stem pairs plus one weak candidate.
pairs <- data.frame(
  i = c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10),
  j = c(21, 20, 19, 18, 17, 15),
  support = c("supported", "supported", "supported", "supported",
              "supported", "weak")
)

arc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(k) {
  p <- pairs[k, ]
  t <- seq(0, pi, length.out = 60)
  span <- p$j - p$i
  data.frame(x = p$i + span * (1 - cos(t)) / 2,
             y = 2.9 + span * 0.08 * sin(t) + k * 0.02,
             support = p$support, id = k)
}))

base_cols <- c(A = "#1b7837", C = "#2166ac", G = "#d95f02", U = "#7570b3")

p <- ggplot() +
  ## information content
  geom_col(data = data.frame(col = 1:24, ic = ic),
           aes(col, ic), fill = "#cfcfcf", width = 0.72) +
  ## letters, stacked by information and scaled by frequency
  geom_text(data = letters_df,
            aes(col, mid, label = base, size = h * 2.4, colour = base),
            family = "mono", fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  ## Absolute size: 2.4 mm per bit, so letter size is read directly on the

  scale_colour_manual(values = base_cols, guide = "none") +

            colour = "#542788", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(supported = "solid", weak = "22"),
                        name = "pairing") +
  annotate("text", x = 11, y = 3.6, label = "loop (unpaired)", size = 2.3,

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4.4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 24, 2), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = "alignment column", y = "information (bits)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

## Position probability matrix for a 24-nt stem-loop: a GC-rich stem
## (4-8 paired with 17-21), an 8-nt loop (9-16) and two unpaired flanks.
pfm <- matrix(0.025, nrow = 4, ncol = 24,
              dimnames = list(c("A", "C", "G", "U"), NULL))
pfm[1, 1:3] <- c(0.7, 0.1, 0.1)
pfm[2, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.7, 0.1)
pfm[3, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.7)
pfm[4, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
for (k in 1:5) {                       # stem: G-C x 3, then A-U, G-C
  b <- list(c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("A", "U"),
            c("G", "C"))[[k]]
  pfm[, 3 + k] <- 0.025
  pfm[b[1], 3 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 16 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 3 + k] <- 0.05
  pfm[b[1], 16 + k] <- 0.05
}
for (k in 9:13) {                      # loop
  pfm[, k] <- c(0.4, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
}
pfm[, 14:15] <- c(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
pfm <- sweep(pfm, 2, colSums(pfm), "/")

## Information content per column (bits, max 2 for RNA).
ic <- apply(pfm, 2, function(p) 2 + sum(p * log2(p)))
letters_df <- as.data.frame(pfm) |>
  rownames_to_column("base") |>
  pivot_longer(-base, names_to = "col", values_to = "p") |>
  mutate(col = as.integer(sub("V", "", col)),
         ic = ic[col],
         h = p * ic) |>
  filter(p > 0.02) |>
  arrange(col, h) |>
  group_by(col) |>
  mutate(stack = cumsum(h), mid = stack - h / 2) |>
  ungroup()

## Pairing table: five supported stem pairs plus one weak candidate.
pairs <- data.frame(
  i = c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10),
  j = c(21, 20, 19, 18, 17, 15),
  support = c("supported", "supported", "supported", "supported",
              "supported", "weak")
)

arc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(k) {
  p <- pairs[k, ]
  t <- seq(0, pi, length.out = 60)
  span <- p$j - p$i
  data.frame(x = p$i + span * (1 - cos(t)) / 2,
             y = 2.9 + span * 0.08 * sin(t) + k * 0.02,
             support = p$support, id = k)
}))

base_cols <- c(A = "#1b7837", C = "#2166ac", G = "#d95f02", U = "#7570b3")

p <- ggplot() +
  ## information content
  geom_col(data = data.frame(col = 1:24, ic = ic),
           aes(col, ic), fill = "#cfcfcf", width = 0.72) +
  ## letters, stacked by information and scaled by frequency
  geom_text(data = letters_df,
            aes(col, mid, label = base, size = h * 2.4, colour = base),
            family = "mono", fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  ## Absolute size: 2.4 mm per bit, so letter size is read directly on the
  ## bits scale and is never normalised to the observed maximum.
  scale_size_identity(guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = base_cols, guide = "none") +
  ## base-pair arcs
  geom_path(data = arc, aes(x, y, group = id, linetype = support),
            colour = "#542788", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(supported = "solid", weak = "22"),
                        name = "pairing") +
  annotate("text", x = 11, y = 3.6, label = "loop (unpaired)", size = 2.3,
           colour = "#525252") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4.4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 24, 2), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = "alignment column", y = "information (bits)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

p

## Position probability matrix for a 24-nt stem-loop: a GC-rich stem
## (4-8 paired with 17-21), an 8-nt loop (9-16) and two unpaired flanks.
pfm <- matrix(0.025, nrow = 4, ncol = 24,
              dimnames = list(c("A", "C", "G", "U"), NULL))
pfm[1, 1:3] <- c(0.7, 0.1, 0.1)
pfm[2, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.7, 0.1)
pfm[3, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.7)
pfm[4, 1:3] <- c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
for (k in 1:5) {                       # stem: G-C x 3, then A-U, G-C
  b <- list(c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("G", "C"), c("A", "U"),
            c("G", "C"))[[k]]
  pfm[, 3 + k] <- 0.025
  pfm[b[1], 3 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 16 + k] <- 0.85
  pfm[b[2], 3 + k] <- 0.05
  pfm[b[1], 16 + k] <- 0.05
}
for (k in 9:13) {                      # loop
  pfm[, k] <- c(0.4, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
}
pfm[, 14:15] <- c(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
pfm <- sweep(pfm, 2, colSums(pfm), "/")

## Information content per column (bits, max 2 for RNA).
ic <- apply(pfm, 2, function(p) 2 + sum(p * log2(p)))
letters_df <- as.data.frame(pfm) |>
  rownames_to_column("base") |>
  pivot_longer(-base, names_to = "col", values_to = "p") |>
  mutate(col = as.integer(sub("V", "", col)),
         ic = ic[col],
         h = p * ic) |>
  filter(p > 0.02) |>
  arrange(col, h) |>
  group_by(col) |>
  mutate(stack = cumsum(h), mid = stack - h / 2) |>
  ungroup()

## Pairing table: five supported stem pairs plus one weak candidate.
pairs <- data.frame(
  i = c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10),
  j = c(21, 20, 19, 18, 17, 15),
  support = c("supported", "supported", "supported", "supported",
              "supported", "weak")
)

arc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(k) {
  p <- pairs[k, ]
  t <- seq(0, pi, length.out = 60)
  span <- p$j - p$i
  data.frame(x = p$i + span * (1 - cos(t)) / 2,
             y = 2.9 + span * 0.08 * sin(t) + k * 0.02,
             support = p$support, id = k)
}))

base_cols <- c(A = "#1b7837", C = "#2166ac", G = "#d95f02", U = "#7570b3")

p <- ggplot() +
  ## information content
  geom_col(data = data.frame(col = 1:24, ic = ic),
           aes(col, ic), fill = "#cfcfcf", width = 0.72) +
  ## letters, stacked by information and scaled by frequency
  geom_text(data = letters_df,
            aes(col, mid, label = base, size = h * 2.4, colour = base),
            family = "mono", fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  ## Absolute size: 2.4 mm per bit, so letter size is read directly on the
  ## bits scale and is never normalised to the observed maximum.
  scale_size_identity(guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = base_cols, guide = "none") +
  ## base-pair arcs
  geom_path(data = arc, aes(x, y, group = id, linetype = support),
            colour = "#542788", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(supported = "solid", weak = "22"),
                        name = "pairing") +
  annotate("text", x = 11, y = 3.6, label = "loop (unpaired)", size = 2.3,
           colour = "#525252") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4.4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 24, 2), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = "alignment column", y = "information (bits)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

# 1. Environment Preparation
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# 2. Run Enrichment Analysis
# Assume gene_list is a vector of Entrez IDs for differentially expressed genes

# 2.1 GO Enrichment Analysis (Get BP/CC/MF simultaneously)
ego <- enrichGO(
  gene     = gene_list,
  OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db,
  ont      = "ALL",
  readable = TRUE  # Automatically convert IDs in results to Symbols
)

# 2.2 KEGG Enrichment Analysis
ekegg <- enrichKEGG(
  gene     = gene_list,
  organism = 'hsa'
)
# KEGG results default to Entrez ID; manually convert to Symbol to match plotting data format
ekegg <- setReadable(ekegg, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", keyType = "ENTREZID")

# 3. Data Cleaning and Merging
# Extract GO results (Rename ONTOLOGY to Category)
df_go <- as.data.frame(ego) %>% 
  select(Category = ONTOLOGY, Description, p.adjust, Count, geneID)

# Extract KEGG results (Manually add Category column and assign as "KEGG")
df_kegg <- as.data.frame(ekegg) %>% 
  mutate(Category = "KEGG") %>% 
  select(Category, Description, p.adjust, Count, geneID)

# Merge all results -> Get raw_data for plotting
raw_data <- rbind(df_go, df_kegg)

# 1. Read Data
raw_data <- read_tsv("files/cos/DAVID.txt")

# 2. Data Cleaning
# Convert DAVID format to the standard format required for plotting
raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  # 2.1 Extract Category Labels
  mutate(Category = case_when(
    grepl("BP_DIRECT", Category) ~ "BP",
    grepl("CC_DIRECT", Category) ~ "CC",
    grepl("MF_DIRECT", Category) ~ "MF",
    grepl("KEGG_PATHWAY", Category) ~ "KEGG",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  # Keep only GO and KEGG results
  filter(Category %in% c("BP", "CC", "MF", "KEGG")) %>%
  
  # 2.2 Clean Pathway Names (Remove IDs, e.g., "GO:001~Name" -> "Name")
  mutate(Description = sub("^.*~|.*:", "", Term)) %>%
  
  # 2.3 Rename Columns (Unified variable names for plotting code)
  # FDR -> p.adjust (Significance)
  # Genes -> geneID (Gene List)
  rename(
    p.adjust = FDR,
    geneID = Genes
  ) %>%
  
  # 2.4 Format Gene Lists (Replace commas with slashes)
  mutate(geneID = gsub(", ", "/", geneID))

# 1. Select the Top 5 most significant pathways for each category
use_pathway <- raw_data %>%
  arrange(p.adjust) %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Construct Auxiliary Plotting Columns
use_pathway <- use_pathway %>%
  # Set factor levels: determines the vertical order of legend and plot (BP -> CC -> MF -> KEGG)
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = rev(c('BP', 'CC', 'MF', 'KEGG')))) %>%
  # Secondary sorting
  arrange(Category, p.adjust) %>%
  # Fix Y-axis order

    a <- scores_ctl$cell == ct; b <- scores_tr$cell == ct
    data.frame(Celltypes = ct, Pathway = pw,
               logFC = mean(scores_tr[[pw]][b]) - mean(scores_ctl[[pw]][a]),
               p.val = wilcox.test(scores_tr[[pw]][b], scores_ctl[[pw]][a])$p.value)
  }))
})

library(rstatix)
set.seed(7301)
clust <- c("OO", "GC", "SC", "EC")
genes7 <- c("DDX4", "AMH", "COL1A2", "CDH5")
rows <- list()
for (cl in seq_along(clust)) {
  for (gn in seq_along(genes7)) {
    for (ag in seq_along(c("Y", "O"))) {
      base <- rnorm(24, mean = 2.2 + 0.4 * cl + 0.3 * gn, sd = 0.9)
      # marker gene: one cluster expresses high; old shifts up on the top marker
      if (gn == cl) base <- base + 2.3
      if (gn == 1 && cl == 1 && ag == 2) base <- base + 1.9
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        aging = c("Y", "O")[ag], cluster_short = clust[cl], gene = genes7[gn],
        expression = base, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
  }
}
dfc <- do.call(rbind, rows)
dfc$aging <- factor(dfc$aging, levels = c("Y", "O"))
dfc$cluster_short <- factor(dfc$cluster_short, levels = clust)
dfc$gene <- factor(dfc$gene, levels = genes7)
# gate: the DDX4/OO facet is significantly higher in Old (the designed effect)
sub <- dfc[dfc$gene == "DDX4" & dfc$cluster_short == "OO", ]
wt <- wilcox.test(expression ~ aging, data = sub)
stopifnot(wt$p.value < 0.01 &&
          mean(sub$expression[sub$aging == "O"]) > mean(sub$expression[sub$aging == "Y"]))
stat_test <- dfc %>% group_by(cluster_short, gene) %>%
  wilcox_test(formula = expression ~ aging) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%
  add_significance(p.col = "p.adj", cutpoints = c(0, 1e-4, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
                   symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns")) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "aging")
p_c <- ggviolin(dfc, x = "aging", y = "expression", fill = "aging", color = "aging",
                facet.by = c("gene", "cluster_short"), trim = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2874C5", "#EABF00"), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#2874C5", "#EABF00"), guide = "none") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_test, hide.ns = TRUE, tip.length = 0,
                     label = "{p.adj} {p.adj.signif}", label.size = 2.6, vjust = -0.4) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 8),

        strip.background.y = element_rect(fill = "grey88", linewidth = 0, colour = NA),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") +

  tumor <- rnorm(n_per, tp53_base[t] + 0.9, 0.75)
  normal <- rnorm(n_per, tp53_base[t] - 0.4, 0.6)
  rbind(data.frame(tissue = t, type2 = "tumor", tpm = tumor),
        data.frame(tissue = t, type2 = "normal", tpm = normal))
}))

  if (upper) data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 0, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 1, 1))   # upper-left triangle

}))

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors <- list(Cluster = c(C1 = "#B31E22", C2 = "#529B40", C3 = "#020105"))
ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         annotation_legend = FALSE,          # legends crowd out the body otherwise
         show_colnames = FALSE,              # 30 sample names would overprint
         cutree_cols = 3,

         fontsize_row = 8)

               dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_samp))))

  LumA  = list(up = 1:10,  dn = NULL,  eff = 1.1),
  LumB  = list(up = 11:20, dn = NULL,  eff = 1.2),
  Basal = list(up = 21:30, dn = 31:40, eff = 1.3))
for (st in subtypes) {
  idx <- which(sub_lab == st)
  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
}

  corrs <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(cent)), function(k) cor(x, cent[, k]))

})

fc_thresh = 1.0
p_thresh = 0.05

conditions = [
    (df['log2FC'] > fc_thresh) & (df['pvalue'] < p_thresh),
    (df['log2FC'] < -fc_thresh) & (df['pvalue'] < p_thresh),
]
choices = ['Up', 'Down']
df['regulation'] = np.select(conditions, choices, default='NS')

colors = {'Up': '#e63946', 'Down': '#457b9d', 'NS': '#cccccc'}

    subset = df[df['regulation'] == reg]
    ax.scatter(subset['log2FC'], subset['neg_log10p'],
               c=color, s=8, alpha=0.6, label=f'{reg} ({len(subset)})')
ax.axhline(-np.log10(p_thresh), color='grey', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8)
ax.axvline(fc_thresh, color='grey', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8)
ax.axvline(-fc_thresh, color='grey', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel('log₂(Fold Change)')
ax.set_ylabel('-log₁₀(P-value)')

set.seed(2026)

genes <- c("TP53", "EGFR", "KRAS", "STK11", "KEAP1", "PIK3CA", "PTEN", "RB1",
           "APC", "ARID1A", "NF1", "NOTCH1", "BRAF", "CDKN2A", "SMAD4", "FBXW7",
           "ATM", "BRCA2", "ERBB2", "MET")
cohort <- rep(c("Subtype A", "Subtype B"), c(35, 25))
samples <- sprintf("S%02d", 1:60)

# Subtype-specific mutation probabilities per gene
p_a <- c(.52, .34, .10, .14, .10, .10, .12, .10, .06, .22, .08, .06, .04, .10, .05, .06, .06, .05, .05, .04)
p_b <- c(.22, .08, .42, .40, .36, .14, .10, .10, .10, .06, .10, .06, .06, .10, .10, .08, .05, .05, .06, .08)
mut_types <- c("Missense", "Nonsense", "Frameshift", "Splice_Site", "In_Frame")
type_p <- c(.58, .14, .12, .08, .08)

mutations <- map_dfr(seq_along(samples), function(i) {
  p <- if (cohort[i] == "Subtype A") p_a else p_b
  hit <- genes[runif(length(genes)) < p]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NULL)
  type <- sample(mut_types, length(hit), replace = TRUE, prob = type_p)
  # Tumor suppressors such as TP53 can receive a second hit, shown as Multi_Hit
  if (runif(1) < .15 && "TP53" %in% hit) {
    type[hit == "TP53"] <- "Multi_Hit"
  }
  tibble(sample = samples[i], gene = hit, type = type)
})

head(mutations)

# Reshape the mutation table into a gene x sample matrix; a cell holds one or
# several alteration types separated by ";"
gene_levels <- names(sort(table(factor(mutations$gene, levels = genes)), decreasing = TRUE))
mat <- matrix("", nrow = length(genes), ncol = length(samples),
              dimnames = list(genes, samples))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(mutations))) {
  cell <- mat[mutations$gene[i], mutations$sample[i]]
  mat[mutations$gene[i], mutations$sample[i]] <-
    if (cell == "") mutations$type[i] else paste(cell, mutations$type[i], sep = ";")
}

# Order samples: by subtype, then by mutation count (waterfall look)
mut_count <- colSums(mat != "")
ord <- order(factor(cohort, levels = c("Subtype A", "Subtype B")), -mut_count)
mat <- mat[gene_levels, ord]

# Annotation vectors aligned with the reordered matrix
cohort_ordered <- factor(cohort[ord], levels = c("Subtype A", "Subtype B"))
tmb <- mut_count[ord]

# Colors for alteration types
mutation_colors <- c(
  Missense = "#3690C0", Nonsense = "#A50F15", Frameshift = "#F16913",
  Splice_Site = "#6A51A3", In_Frame = "#31A354", Multi_Hit = "#252525"
)

# One drawing function per alteration type
rect_fun <- function(color) {
  function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w * 0.9, h * 0.9, gp = gpar(fill = color, col = NA))
}
alter_fun <- list(
  background = rect_fun("#F2F2F2"),
  Missense = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Missense"]),
  Nonsense = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Nonsense"]),
  Frameshift = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Frameshift"]),
  Splice_Site = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Splice_Site"]),
  In_Frame = rect_fun(mutation_colors["In_Frame"]),
  Multi_Hit = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Multi_Hit"])
)

# Expand explicit Multi_Hit cells into two individual events
mutations_long <- bind_rows(
  mutations |> filter(type != "Multi_Hit"),
  mutations |> filter(type == "Multi_Hit") |> mutate(type = "Missense"),
  mutations |> filter(type == "Multi_Hit") |> mutate(type = "Nonsense"))

# Our short type names -> the MAF Variant_Classification vocabulary
maf_class <- c(Missense = "Missense_Mutation", Nonsense = "Nonsense_Mutation",
               Frameshift = "Frame_Shift_Del", Splice_Site = "Splice_Site",
               In_Frame = "In_Frame_Del")
variant_type <- c(Missense = "SNP", Nonsense = "SNP", Frameshift = "DEL",
                  Splice_Site = "SNP", In_Frame = "DEL")

set.seed(7)
maf_data <- mutations_long |>
  mutate(
    Hugo_Symbol = gene,
    Variant_Classification = maf_class[type],
    Variant_Type = variant_type[type],
    Chromosome = paste0("chr", (match(gene, genes) %% 22) + 1),
    Start_Position = 100000L + as.integer(match(gene, genes)) * 54321L +
      row_number() * 37L + sample(1:99L, n(), replace = TRUE),
    End_Position = Start_Position,
    Reference_Allele = "A",
    Tumor_Seq_Allele2 = "G",
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode = sample) |>
  select(Hugo_Symbol, Chromosome, Start_Position, End_Position,
         Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele2, Variant_Classification,
         Variant_Type, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)

# Sample-level annotation (kept alongside the MAF)
clin_data <- tibble(Tumor_Sample_Barcode = samples, Subtype = cohort)

# Read everything into a maftools MAF object
maf <- read.maf(maf = as.data.frame(maf_data),
                clinicalData = as.data.frame(clin_data), verbose = FALSE)

head(maf_data)

p1 <- oncoPrint(mat,
  alter_fun = alter_fun, alter_fun_is_vectorized = FALSE, col = mutation_colors,
  column_order = samples[ord], show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "italic"), pct_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Mutation type"))
draw(p1)

top_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  TMB = anno_barplot(tmb, height = unit(1.1, "cm"),
                     gp = gpar(fill = "#6A51A3", col = NA)),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9))

p2 <- oncoPrint(mat,
  alter_fun = alter_fun, alter_fun_is_vectorized = FALSE, col = mutation_colors,
  column_order = samples[ord], show_column_names = FALSE,
  column_split = cohort_ordered, column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  top_annotation = top_annotation,
  bottom_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
    Subtype = as.character(cohort_ordered),
    col = list(Subtype = c("Subtype A" = "#E08214", "Subtype B" = "#5E3C99")),
    annotation_name_side = "left", annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "italic"), pct_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Mutation type"))
draw(p2)

  EGFR = "RTK/RAS", ERBB2 = "RTK/RAS", MET = "RTK/RAS", KRAS = "RTK/RAS",

           "ATM", "BRCA2", "ERBB2", "MET")
cohort <- rep(c("Subtype A", "Subtype B"), c(35, 25))
samples <- sprintf("S%02d", 1:60)

# Subtype-specific mutation probabilities per gene
p_a <- c(.52, .34, .10, .14, .10, .10, .12, .10, .06, .22, .08, .06, .04, .10, .05, .06, .06, .05, .05, .04)
p_b <- c(.22, .08, .42, .40, .36, .14, .10, .10, .10, .06, .10, .06, .06, .10, .10, .08, .05, .05, .06, .08)
mut_types <- c("Missense", "Nonsense", "Frameshift", "Splice_Site", "In_Frame")
type_p <- c(.58, .14, .12, .08, .08)

mutations <- map_dfr(seq_along(samples), function(i) {
  p <- if (cohort[i] == "Subtype A") p_a else p_b
  hit <- genes[runif(length(genes)) < p]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NULL)
  type <- sample(mut_types, length(hit), replace = TRUE, prob = type_p)
  # Tumor suppressors such as TP53 can receive a second hit, shown as Multi_Hit
  if (runif(1) < .15 && "TP53" %in% hit) {
    type[hit == "TP53"] <- "Multi_Hit"
  }
  tibble(sample = samples[i], gene = hit, type = type)
})

head(mutations)

# Reshape the mutation table into a gene x sample matrix; a cell holds one or
# several alteration types separated by ";"
gene_levels <- names(sort(table(factor(mutations$gene, levels = genes)), decreasing = TRUE))
mat <- matrix("", nrow = length(genes), ncol = length(samples),
              dimnames = list(genes, samples))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(mutations))) {
  cell <- mat[mutations$gene[i], mutations$sample[i]]
  mat[mutations$gene[i], mutations$sample[i]] <-
    if (cell == "") mutations$type[i] else paste(cell, mutations$type[i], sep = ";")
}

# Order samples: by subtype, then by mutation count (waterfall look)
mut_count <- colSums(mat != "")
ord <- order(factor(cohort, levels = c("Subtype A", "Subtype B")), -mut_count)

)

}

p_b <- c(.22, .08, .42, .40, .36, .14, .10, .10, .10, .06, .10, .06, .06, .10, .10, .08, .05, .05, .06, .08)
mut_types <- c("Missense", "Nonsense", "Frameshift", "Splice_Site", "In_Frame")
type_p <- c(.58, .14, .12, .08, .08)

mutations <- map_dfr(seq_along(samples), function(i) {
  p <- if (cohort[i] == "Subtype A") p_a else p_b
  hit <- genes[runif(length(genes)) < p]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NULL)
  type <- sample(mut_types, length(hit), replace = TRUE, prob = type_p)
  # Tumor suppressors such as TP53 can receive a second hit, shown as Multi_Hit
  if (runif(1) < .15 && "TP53" %in% hit) {
    type[hit == "TP53"] <- "Multi_Hit"
  }
  tibble(sample = samples[i], gene = hit, type = type)
})

circular_annotation_plot <- function(data, id_col, sort_col,
                                     numeric_tracks, category_tracks,
                                     category_order = list(), legend_order = list(),
                                     category_colors = c(), legend_labels = c(),
                                     tick_values = list(), panel_height = 2.95,
                                     gap_degrees = 90, font_scale = 1,
                                     show_summary = TRUE, show_unknown = FALSE) {
  for (column in category_tracks$column) {
    data[[column]] <- coalesce(na_if(as.character(data[[column]]), ""), "Unknown")
  }
  data <- data |>
    arrange(.data[[sort_col]]) |>
    mutate(.i = row_number(),
           .step = (360 - gap_degrees) * pi / 180 / n(),
           .start = pi / 2 - (.i - 1) * .step,
           .end = pi / 2 - .i * .step,
           .angle = (.start + .end) / 2)

  sector_polygons <- function(inner, outer) {
    map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(data)), function(i) {
      a <- seq(data$.start[i], data$.end[i], length.out = 10)
      tibble(.i = i,
             x = c(outer * cos(a), inner * cos(rev(a))),
             y = c(outer * sin(a), inner * sin(rev(a))))
    })
  }
  numeric_rings <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(numeric_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- numeric_tracks[i, ]
    sector_polygons(tb$inner, tb$outer) |> mutate(.track = tb$name)
  })
  category_rings <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(category_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- category_tracks[i, ]
    sector_polygons(tb$inner, tb$outer) |>
      mutate(.track = tb$name, value = data[[tb$column]][.i])
  })

  all_values <- unique(category_rings$value)
  missing_values <- setdiff(all_values, names(category_colors))
  if (length(missing_values) > 0) {
    category_colors <- c(category_colors,
      rlang::set_names(scales::hue_pal()(length(missing_values)), missing_values))
  }
  key_colors <- category_rings |>
    distinct(.track, value) |>
    mutate(key = paste(.track, value, sep = "::"), color = unname(category_colors[value]))
  key_pal <- rlang::set_names(key_colors$color, key_colors$key)

  lollipops <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(numeric_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- numeric_tracks[i, ]
    r <- scales::rescale(data[[tb$column]], to = c(tb$inner, tb$outer), from = c(tb$min, tb$max))
    tibble(.track = tb$name,
           x0 = tb$inner * cos(data$.angle), y0 = tb$inner * sin(data$.angle),
           x1 = r * cos(data$.angle), y1 = r * sin(data$.angle))
  })

  # gap summary: numeric points/quartiles
  numeric_points <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(numeric_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- numeric_tracks[i, ]
    tibble(.track = tb$name, x = -(tb$inner + tb$outer) / 2,
           y = scales::rescale(data[[tb$column]], to = c(0, panel_height), from = c(tb$min, tb$max)))
  })
  quartiles <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(numeric_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- numeric_tracks[i, ]
    q <- quantile(data[[tb$column]], c(.25, .5, .75))
    tibble(x = rep(-(tb$inner + tb$outer) / 2, 3),
           y = scales::rescale(q, to = c(0, panel_height), from = c(tb$min, tb$max)),
           label = sprintf("%.1f", q))
  })
  panel_boxes <- numeric_tracks |>
    transmute(xmin = -outer, xmax = -inner, ymin = 0, ymax = panel_height, .track = name)

  bars <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(category_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- category_tracks[i, ]
    observed <- unique(data[[tb$column]])
    preferred <- category_order[[tb$column]]
    if (is.null(preferred)) preferred <- character()
    lv <- c(preferred[preferred %in% observed], sort(setdiff(observed, preferred)))
    tibble(value = factor(data[[tb$column]], levels = lv)) |>
      count(value, .drop = FALSE) |>
      mutate(fraction = n / sum(n),
             ymin = lag(cumsum(fraction * panel_height), default = 0),
             ymax = cumsum(fraction * panel_height),
             xmin = -tb$outer, xmax = -tb$inner,
             x = -(tb$inner + tb$outer) / 2, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
             .track = tb$name, key = paste(.track, value, sep = "::"))
  })

  outer_radius <- max(numeric_tracks$outer, category_tracks$outer) + 0.21
  sample_labels <- data |>
    mutate(x = outer_radius * cos(.angle), y = outer_radius * sin(.angle),
           text_angle = .angle * 180 / pi,
           flip = text_angle < -90,
           text_angle = if_else(flip, text_angle + 180, text_angle),
           hjust = if_else(flip, 1, 0))

  panel_titles <- bind_rows(
    numeric_tracks |> transmute(x = -(inner + outer) / 2, y = panel_height + .22,
                                label = title, angle = 0, hjust = .5),
    if (show_summary) category_tracks |> transmute(x = -outer, y = panel_height + .10,
                                label = title, angle = 50, hjust = 0))

  axis_labels <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(numeric_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- numeric_tracks[i, ]
    v <- tick_values[[tb$name]]
    if (is.null(v)) v <- round(seq(tb$min, tb$max, length.out = 3))
    tibble(label = v, y = scales::rescale(v, to = c(tb$inner, tb$outer), from = c(tb$min, tb$max)))
  })
  axis_lines <- numeric_tracks |> transmute(x = 0, xend = 0, y = inner, yend = outer)

  # legend table: one row per category track (header + items + spacers)
  legend_items <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(category_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- category_tracks[i, ]
    observed <- unique(data[[tb$column]])
    preferred <- legend_order[[tb$column]]
    if (is.null(preferred)) preferred <- character()
    ord <- c(preferred[preferred %in% observed], sort(setdiff(observed, preferred)))
    tibble(.track = tb$name, .track_no = i, value = ord,
           key = paste(.track, ord, sep = "::"))
  })
  if (!show_unknown) legend_items <- filter(legend_items, value != "Unknown")
  legend_items <- legend_items |> mutate(label = value)
  if (length(legend_labels) > 0) {
    hit <- legend_items$value %in% names(legend_labels)
    legend_items$label[hit] <- unname(legend_labels[legend_items$value[hit]])
  }
  legend_cols <- max(count(legend_items, .track_no)$n) + 1
  legend_table <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(category_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- category_tracks[i, ]
    items <- filter(legend_items, .track_no == i) |>
      transmute(.track_no, .track, value, key, label)
    hdr <- tibble(.track_no = i, .track = tb$name, value = NA_character_,
                  key = paste0(".h", i), label = tb$name)
    pad <- tibble(.track_no = rep(i, legend_cols - nrow(items) - 1),
                  .track = tb$name, value = NA_character_,
                  key = paste0(".s", i, "_", seq_len(legend_cols - nrow(items) - 1)), label = "")
    bind_rows(hdr, items, pad)
  })
  transparent <- legend_table$key[is.na(legend_table$value)]
  legend_pal <- c(key_pal, rlang::set_names(rep("#00000000", length(transparent)), transparent))

  p <- ggplot() +
    if (show_summary) geom_rect(data = panel_boxes, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
        fill = "white", colour = "grey15", linewidth = .52) else NULL
  p <- p +
    geom_polygon(data = numeric_rings, aes(x, y, group = interaction(.track, .i)),
                 fill = "white", colour = "grey15", linewidth = .30) +
    geom_polygon(data = category_rings, aes(x, y, group = interaction(.track, .i), fill = paste(.track, value, sep = "::")),
                 colour = "grey15", linewidth = .30) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = legend_pal,
                      limits = legend_table$key, breaks = legend_table$key,
                      labels = legend_table$label, name = NULL, drop = FALSE,
                      guide = guide_legend(nrow = nrow(category_tracks), byrow = TRUE,
                                           override.aes = list(colour = NA))) +
    geom_segment(data = lollipops, aes(x0, y0, xend = x1, yend = y1),
                 colour = lollipops$.track |> map_chr(~ numeric_tracks$color[numeric_tracks$name == .x]), linewidth = .38) +
    geom_point(data = lollipops, aes(x1, y1),
               colour = lollipops$.track |> map_chr(~ numeric_tracks$color[numeric_tracks$name == .x]), size = 1.15) +
    geom_text(data = sample_labels, aes(x, y, label = .data[[id_col]], angle = text_angle, hjust = hjust),
              size = 2.5 * font_scale) +
    if (show_summary) geom_boxplot(data = numeric_points, aes(x, y, group = .track),
        width = .53, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", colour = "grey35", linewidth = .40) else NULL
  p <- p +
    { if (show_summary) geom_beeswarm(data = numeric_points, aes(x, y, colour = .track, group = .track),
                  cex = 0.7, size = 1.15, alpha = .95, show.legend = FALSE) } +
    scale_colour_manual(values = rlang::set_names(numeric_tracks$color, numeric_tracks$name), guide = "none") +
    { if (show_summary) geom_label(data = quartiles, aes(x, y, label = label), fill = "grey50", colour = "white",
               linewidth = 0, size = 2.45 * font_scale) } +
    { if (show_summary) geom_rect(data = bars, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = key), colour = "grey25", linewidth = .40) } +
    { if (show_summary) geom_text(data = bars, aes(x, y, label = sprintf("%.1f", 100 * fraction)),
              colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 2.55 * font_scale) } +
    { if (show_summary) geom_segment(data = axis_lines, aes(x, y, xend = xend, yend = yend), linewidth = .34) } +
    { if (show_summary) geom_text(data = axis_labels, aes(x = -.07, y, label = label), hjust = 1, size = 2.7 * font_scale) } +
    { if (show_summary) geom_text(data = panel_titles, aes(x, y, label = label, angle = angle, hjust = hjust),
              lineheight = .88, size = 4 * font_scale) } +
    { if (show_summary) annotate("text", x = -max(numeric_tracks$outer) - .51, y = .62, label = "Participant ID",
             angle = 90, size = 4 * font_scale) } +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(-outer_radius - .55, outer_radius + .41),
                ylim = c(-outer_radius - .31, outer_radius + .28), ratio = 1, clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_size = 12 * font_scale) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 10), legend.position = "top",
          legend.justification = "left",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 11 * font_scale),
          legend.key.size = grid::unit(.45 * font_scale, "cm"))
  p
}

  p <- p +

circular_annotation_plot <- function(data, id_col, sort_col,
                                     numeric_tracks, category_tracks,
                                     category_order = list(), legend_order = list(),
                                     category_colors = c(), legend_labels = c(),
                                     tick_values = list(), panel_height = 2.95,
                                     gap_degrees = 90, font_scale = 1,
                                     show_summary = TRUE, show_unknown = FALSE) {
  for (column in category_tracks$column) {
    data[[column]] <- coalesce(na_if(as.character(data[[column]]), ""), "Unknown")
  }
  data <- data |>
    arrange(.data[[sort_col]]) |>
    mutate(.i = row_number(),
           .step = (360 - gap_degrees) * pi / 180 / n(),
           .start = pi / 2 - (.i - 1) * .step,
           .end = pi / 2 - .i * .step,
           .angle = (.start + .end) / 2)

  sector_polygons <- function(inner, outer) {
    map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(data)), function(i) {
      a <- seq(data$.start[i], data$.end[i], length.out = 10)
      tibble(.i = i,
             x = c(outer * cos(a), inner * cos(rev(a))),
             y = c(outer * sin(a), inner * sin(rev(a))))
    })
  }
  numeric_rings <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(numeric_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- numeric_tracks[i, ]
    sector_polygons(tb$inner, tb$outer) |> mutate(.track = tb$name)
  })
  category_rings <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(category_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- category_tracks[i, ]
    sector_polygons(tb$inner, tb$outer) |>
      mutate(.track = tb$name, value = data[[tb$column]][.i])
  })

  all_values <- unique(category_rings$value)
  missing_values <- setdiff(all_values, names(category_colors))
  if (length(missing_values) > 0) {
    category_colors <- c(category_colors,
      rlang::set_names(scales::hue_pal()(length(missing_values)), missing_values))
  }
  key_colors <- category_rings |>
    distinct(.track, value) |>
    mutate(key = paste(.track, value, sep = "::"), color = unname(category_colors[value]))
  key_pal <- rlang::set_names(key_colors$color, key_colors$key)

  lollipops <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(numeric_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- numeric_tracks[i, ]
    r <- scales::rescale(data[[tb$column]], to = c(tb$inner, tb$outer), from = c(tb$min, tb$max))
    tibble(.track = tb$name,
           x0 = tb$inner * cos(data$.angle), y0 = tb$inner * sin(data$.angle),
           x1 = r * cos(data$.angle), y1 = r * sin(data$.angle))
  })

  # gap summary: numeric points/quartiles
  numeric_points <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(numeric_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- numeric_tracks[i, ]
    tibble(.track = tb$name, x = -(tb$inner + tb$outer) / 2,
           y = scales::rescale(data[[tb$column]], to = c(0, panel_height), from = c(tb$min, tb$max)))
  })
  quartiles <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(numeric_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- numeric_tracks[i, ]
    q <- quantile(data[[tb$column]], c(.25, .5, .75))
    tibble(x = rep(-(tb$inner + tb$outer) / 2, 3),
           y = scales::rescale(q, to = c(0, panel_height), from = c(tb$min, tb$max)),
           label = sprintf("%.1f", q))
  })
  panel_boxes <- numeric_tracks |>
    transmute(xmin = -outer, xmax = -inner, ymin = 0, ymax = panel_height, .track = name)

  bars <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(category_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- category_tracks[i, ]
    observed <- unique(data[[tb$column]])
    preferred <- category_order[[tb$column]]
    if (is.null(preferred)) preferred <- character()
    lv <- c(preferred[preferred %in% observed], sort(setdiff(observed, preferred)))
    tibble(value = factor(data[[tb$column]], levels = lv)) |>
      count(value, .drop = FALSE) |>
      mutate(fraction = n / sum(n),
             ymin = lag(cumsum(fraction * panel_height), default = 0),
             ymax = cumsum(fraction * panel_height),
             xmin = -tb$outer, xmax = -tb$inner,
             x = -(tb$inner + tb$outer) / 2, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
             .track = tb$name, key = paste(.track, value, sep = "::"))
  })

  outer_radius <- max(numeric_tracks$outer, category_tracks$outer) + 0.21
  sample_labels <- data |>
    mutate(x = outer_radius * cos(.angle), y = outer_radius * sin(.angle),
           text_angle = .angle * 180 / pi,
           flip = text_angle < -90,
           text_angle = if_else(flip, text_angle + 180, text_angle),
           hjust = if_else(flip, 1, 0))

  panel_titles <- bind_rows(
    numeric_tracks |> transmute(x = -(inner + outer) / 2, y = panel_height + .22,
                                label = title, angle = 0, hjust = .5),
    if (show_summary) category_tracks |> transmute(x = -outer, y = panel_height + .10,
                                label = title, angle = 50, hjust = 0))

  axis_labels <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(numeric_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- numeric_tracks[i, ]
    v <- tick_values[[tb$name]]
    if (is.null(v)) v <- round(seq(tb$min, tb$max, length.out = 3))
    tibble(label = v, y = scales::rescale(v, to = c(tb$inner, tb$outer), from = c(tb$min, tb$max)))
  })
  axis_lines <- numeric_tracks |> transmute(x = 0, xend = 0, y = inner, yend = outer)

  # legend table: one row per category track (header + items + spacers)
  legend_items <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(category_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- category_tracks[i, ]
    observed <- unique(data[[tb$column]])
    preferred <- legend_order[[tb$column]]
    if (is.null(preferred)) preferred <- character()
    ord <- c(preferred[preferred %in% observed], sort(setdiff(observed, preferred)))
    tibble(.track = tb$name, .track_no = i, value = ord,
           key = paste(.track, ord, sep = "::"))
  })
  if (!show_unknown) legend_items <- filter(legend_items, value != "Unknown")
  legend_items <- legend_items |> mutate(label = value)
  if (length(legend_labels) > 0) {
    hit <- legend_items$value %in% names(legend_labels)
    legend_items$label[hit] <- unname(legend_labels[legend_items$value[hit]])
  }
  legend_cols <- max(count(legend_items, .track_no)$n) + 1
  legend_table <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(category_tracks)), function(i) {
    tb <- category_tracks[i, ]
    items <- filter(legend_items, .track_no == i) |>
      transmute(.track_no, .track, value, key, label)
    hdr <- tibble(.track_no = i, .track = tb$name, value = NA_character_,
                  key = paste0(".h", i), label = tb$name)
    pad <- tibble(.track_no = rep(i, legend_cols - nrow(items) - 1),
                  .track = tb$name, value = NA_character_,
                  key = paste0(".s", i, "_", seq_len(legend_cols - nrow(items) - 1)), label = "")
    bind_rows(hdr, items, pad)
  })
  transparent <- legend_table$key[is.na(legend_table$value)]
  legend_pal <- c(key_pal, rlang::set_names(rep("#00000000", length(transparent)), transparent))

  p <- ggplot() +
    if (show_summary) geom_rect(data = panel_boxes, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
        fill = "white", colour = "grey15", linewidth = .52) else NULL
  p <- p +
    geom_polygon(data = numeric_rings, aes(x, y, group = interaction(.track, .i)),
                 fill = "white", colour = "grey15", linewidth = .30) +
    geom_polygon(data = category_rings, aes(x, y, group = interaction(.track, .i), fill = paste(.track, value, sep = "::")),
                 colour = "grey15", linewidth = .30) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = legend_pal,
                      limits = legend_table$key, breaks = legend_table$key,
                      labels = legend_table$label, name = NULL, drop = FALSE,
                      guide = guide_legend(nrow = nrow(category_tracks), byrow = TRUE,
                                           override.aes = list(colour = NA))) +
    geom_segment(data = lollipops, aes(x0, y0, xend = x1, yend = y1),
                 colour = lollipops$.track |> map_chr(~ numeric_tracks$color[numeric_tracks$name == .x]), linewidth = .38) +
    geom_point(data = lollipops, aes(x1, y1),
               colour = lollipops$.track |> map_chr(~ numeric_tracks$color[numeric_tracks$name == .x]), size = 1.15) +
    geom_text(data = sample_labels, aes(x, y, label = .data[[id_col]], angle = text_angle, hjust = hjust),
              size = 2.5 * font_scale) +
    if (show_summary) geom_boxplot(data = numeric_points, aes(x, y, group = .track),
        width = .53, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", colour = "grey35", linewidth = .40) else NULL
  p <- p +
    { if (show_summary) geom_beeswarm(data = numeric_points, aes(x, y, colour = .track, group = .track),
                  cex = 0.7, size = 1.15, alpha = .95, show.legend = FALSE) } +
    scale_colour_manual(values = rlang::set_names(numeric_tracks$color, numeric_tracks$name), guide = "none") +
    { if (show_summary) geom_label(data = quartiles, aes(x, y, label = label), fill = "grey50", colour = "white",
               linewidth = 0, size = 2.45 * font_scale) } +
    { if (show_summary) geom_rect(data = bars, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = key), colour = "grey25", linewidth = .40) } +
    { if (show_summary) geom_text(data = bars, aes(x, y, label = sprintf("%.1f", 100 * fraction)),
              colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 2.55 * font_scale) } +
    { if (show_summary) geom_segment(data = axis_lines, aes(x, y, xend = xend, yend = yend), linewidth = .34) } +
    { if (show_summary) geom_text(data = axis_labels, aes(x = -.07, y, label = label), hjust = 1, size = 2.7 * font_scale) } +
    { if (show_summary) geom_text(data = panel_titles, aes(x, y, label = label, angle = angle, hjust = hjust),
              lineheight = .88, size = 4 * font_scale) } +
    { if (show_summary) annotate("text", x = -max(numeric_tracks$outer) - .51, y = .62, label = "Participant ID",
             angle = 90, size = 4 * font_scale) } +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(-outer_radius - .55, outer_radius + .41),
                ylim = c(-outer_radius - .31, outer_radius + .28), ratio = 1, clip = "off") +

set.seed(2026)

genes <- c("TP53", "EGFR", "KRAS", "STK11", "KEAP1", "PIK3CA", "PTEN", "RB1",
           "APC", "ARID1A", "NF1", "NOTCH1", "BRAF", "CDKN2A", "SMAD4", "FBXW7",
           "ATM", "BRCA2", "ERBB2", "MET")
cohort <- rep(c("Subtype A", "Subtype B"), c(35, 25))
samples <- sprintf("S%02d", 1:60)

# Subtype-specific mutation probabilities per gene
p_a <- c(.52, .34, .10, .14, .10, .10, .12, .10, .06, .22, .08, .06, .04, .10, .05, .06, .06, .05, .05, .04)
p_b <- c(.22, .08, .42, .40, .36, .14, .10, .10, .10, .06, .10, .06, .06, .10, .10, .08, .05, .05, .06, .08)
mut_types <- c("Missense", "Nonsense", "Frameshift", "Splice_Site", "In_Frame")
type_p <- c(.58, .14, .12, .08, .08)

mutations <- map_dfr(seq_along(samples), function(i) {
  p <- if (cohort[i] == "Subtype A") p_a else p_b
  hit <- genes[runif(length(genes)) < p]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NULL)
  type <- sample(mut_types, length(hit), replace = TRUE, prob = type_p)
  # Tumor suppressors such as TP53 can receive a second hit, shown as Multi_Hit
  if (runif(1) < .15 && "TP53" %in% hit) {
    type[hit == "TP53"] <- "Multi_Hit"
  }
  tibble(sample = samples[i], gene = hit, type = type)
})

head(mutations)

# Reshape the mutation table into a gene x sample matrix; a cell holds one or
# several alteration types separated by ";"
gene_levels <- names(sort(table(factor(mutations$gene, levels = genes)), decreasing = TRUE))
mat <- matrix("", nrow = length(genes), ncol = length(samples),
              dimnames = list(genes, samples))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(mutations))) {
  cell <- mat[mutations$gene[i], mutations$sample[i]]
  mat[mutations$gene[i], mutations$sample[i]] <-
    if (cell == "") mutations$type[i] else paste(cell, mutations$type[i], sep = ";")
}

# Order samples: by subtype, then by mutation count (waterfall look)
mut_count <- colSums(mat != "")
ord <- order(factor(cohort, levels = c("Subtype A", "Subtype B")), -mut_count)
mat <- mat[gene_levels, ord]

# Annotation vectors aligned with the reordered matrix
cohort_ordered <- factor(cohort[ord], levels = c("Subtype A", "Subtype B"))
tmb <- mut_count[ord]

# Colors for alteration types
mutation_colors <- c(
  Missense = "#3690C0", Nonsense = "#A50F15", Frameshift = "#F16913",
  Splice_Site = "#6A51A3", In_Frame = "#31A354", Multi_Hit = "#252525"
)

# One drawing function per alteration type
rect_fun <- function(color) {
  function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w * 0.9, h * 0.9, gp = gpar(fill = color, col = NA))
}
alter_fun <- list(
  background = rect_fun("#F2F2F2"),
  Missense = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Missense"]),
  Nonsense = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Nonsense"]),
  Frameshift = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Frameshift"]),
  Splice_Site = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Splice_Site"]),
  In_Frame = rect_fun(mutation_colors["In_Frame"]),
  Multi_Hit = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Multi_Hit"])
)

# Expand explicit Multi_Hit cells into two individual events
mutations_long <- bind_rows(
  mutations |> filter(type != "Multi_Hit"),
  mutations |> filter(type == "Multi_Hit") |> mutate(type = "Missense"),
  mutations |> filter(type == "Multi_Hit") |> mutate(type = "Nonsense"))

# Our short type names -> the MAF Variant_Classification vocabulary
maf_class <- c(Missense = "Missense_Mutation", Nonsense = "Nonsense_Mutation",

  if (runif(1) < .15 && "TP53" %in% hit) {

  tibble(sample = samples[i], gene = hit, type = type)

set.seed(7001)
n_sm2 <- 220

              function(f) sample(c(0, 1), n_sm2, TRUE, c(1 - f, f)))
colnames(mut) <- genes2
## plant one mutual-exclusivity pair (TP53-KRAS) and one co-occurrence pair (APC-EGFR)

                   sample(c(0, 1), n_sm2, TRUE, c(0.35, 0.65)))

set.seed(123)
n_group <- 50
group <- factor(rep(c("High expression", "Low expression"), each = n_group),
                levels = c("High expression", "Low expression"))
features   <- c("AJCC stage III", "Tumor size > 5 cm", "Serosal invasion", "Perineural invasion")
p_high     <- c(0.70, 0.65, 0.80, 0.35)   # feature more common in the high-expression group
p_low      <- c(0.25, 0.25, 0.30, 0.45)

tile_df <- do.call(rbind, c(
  list(data.frame(patient = seq_len(2 * n_group), row = "Expression group",
                  state = as.character(group))),
  lapply(seq_along(features), function(k) {
    yes <- c(rbinom(n_group, 1, p_high[k]), rbinom(n_group, 1, p_low[k]))
    data.frame(patient = seq_len(2 * n_group), row = features[k],
               state = ifelse(yes == 1, "yes", "no"))
  })
))
tile_df$row     <- factor(tile_df$row, levels = c("Expression group", features))
tile_df$patient <- factor(tile_df$patient, levels = seq_len(2 * n_group))

# Chi-square test of each feature against the expression group
pvals <- sapply(features, function(f) {
  chisq.test(table(tile_df$state[tile_df$row == f], group))$p.value
})
# P values go into the y-axis labels: they can never be clipped there
row_labels <- c("Expression group",
                sprintf("%s\nP %s", features,
                        ifelse(pvals < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", pvals)))))
names(row_labels) <- levels(tile_df$row)

ggplot(tile_df, aes(x = patient, y = row, fill = state)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "grey85", linewidth = .3) +
  geom_tile(data = subset(tile_df, row == "Expression group"), colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("High expression" = "#292C7C", "Low expression" = "#97B9D7",
                               "yes" = "#4582B5", "no" = "white")) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = row_labels) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(.6, .6))) +
  labs(x = "Patients (ordered by expression group)", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +

n_group <- 50
group <- factor(rep(c("High expression", "Low expression"), each = n_group),
                levels = c("High expression", "Low expression"))
features   <- c("AJCC stage III", "Tumor size > 5 cm", "Serosal invasion", "Perineural invasion")
p_high     <- c(0.70, 0.65, 0.80, 0.35)   # feature more common in the high-expression group
p_low      <- c(0.25, 0.25, 0.30, 0.45)

tile_df <- do.call(rbind, c(
  list(data.frame(patient = seq_len(2 * n_group), row = "Expression group",
                  state = as.character(group))),
  lapply(seq_along(features), function(k) {
    yes <- c(rbinom(n_group, 1, p_high[k]), rbinom(n_group, 1, p_low[k]))
    data.frame(patient = seq_len(2 * n_group), row = features[k],
               state = ifelse(yes == 1, "yes", "no"))
  })
))

pvals <- sapply(features, function(f) {
  chisq.test(table(tile_df$state[tile_df$row == f], group))$p.value
})
# P values go into the y-axis labels: they can never be clipped there
row_labels <- c("Expression group",
                sprintf("%s\nP %s", features,
                        ifelse(pvals < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", pvals)))))
names(row_labels) <- levels(tile_df$row)

ggplot(tile_df, aes(x = patient, y = row, fill = state)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "grey85", linewidth = .3) +
  geom_tile(data = subset(tile_df, row == "Expression group"), colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("High expression" = "#292C7C", "Low expression" = "#97B9D7",
                               "yes" = "#4582B5", "no" = "white")) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = row_labels) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(.6, .6))) +
  labs(x = "Patients (ordered by expression group)", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +

rng = np.random.default_rng(196)
features = ['Sex', 'Stage', 'ECOG']
cats = {'Sex': ['Male', 'Female'], 'Stage': ['I-II', 'III-IV'],
        'ECOG': ['0', '>=1']}
n_arm = {'Arm A': 120, 'Arm B': 120}
# Arm B is slightly sicker: shift Stage/ECOG mixes
probs = {'Arm A': {'Stage': [0.65, 0.35], 'ECOG': [0.5, 0.5]},
         'Arm B': {'Stage': [0.5, 0.5], 'ECOG': [0.6, 0.4]}}
pat = pd.DataFrame([
    (arm, rng.choice(cats['Sex'], p=[0.55, 0.45]),
     rng.choice(cats['Stage'], p=probs[arm]['Stage']),
     rng.choice(cats['ECOG'], p=probs[arm]['ECOG']))
    for arm in n_arm for _ in range(n_arm[arm])],
    columns=['Arm'] + features)

from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency, fisher_exact
arms = list(n_arm)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(8, 5),
                         subplot_kw=dict(aspect='equal'),
                         gridspec_kw=dict(wspace=0.5, hspace=0.75))
col_colors = {'Sex': ['#8da0cb', '#e78ac3'],
              'Stage': ['#66c2a5', '#fc8d62'],
              'ECOG': ['#a6d854', '#ffd92f']}
for j, f in enumerate(features):
    axes[0, j].set_title(f, fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
    for i, arm in enumerate(arms):
        shares = pat.loc[pat.Arm == arm, f].value_counts(
            normalize=True).reindex(cats[f], fill_value=0)
        axes[i, j].pie(shares, labels=cats[f],
                       colors=col_colors[f], labeldistance=1.18,
                       autopct='%.0f%%', pctdistance=0.76,
                       startangle=90, counterclock=False,
                       wedgeprops=dict(width=0.45, edgecolor='white', linewidth=2),
                       textprops=dict(fontsize=7.5))
        axes[i, j].text(0, 0, f'{arm}\nn = {n_arm[arm]}', ha='center',
                        va='center', fontsize=8)
        tbl = pd.crosstab(pat.Arm, pat[f])[cats[f]].values
        p = (fisher_exact(tbl)[1] if tbl.shape == (2, 2)
             else chi2_contingency(tbl).pvalue)
        axes[1, j].text(0, -1.55, f'p = {p:.2e}', ha='center',
                        fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')
plt.show()

np.random.seed(91)

cohorts = ['Healthy', 'Benign', 'Tumor']
n_per = 20
base = np.random.normal(0, 1, (n_per * 3, 20))
shifts = np.concatenate([
    np.zeros((n_per, 20)),
    np.tile(np.r_[np.full(5, 1.2), np.zeros(15)], (n_per, 1)),
    np.tile(np.r_[np.zeros(5), np.full(5, 1.6), np.full(10, 0.5)], (n_per, 1)),
])
expr = base + shifts + np.random.normal(0, 0.6, base.shape)

genes = [f'GENE{i:02d}' for i in range(1, 21)]
X = StandardScaler().fit_transform(expr)
df = pd.DataFrame(X, columns=genes)
df['Cohort'] = np.repeat(cohorts, n_per)

pca = PCA(n_components=5).fit(X)
scores = pd.DataFrame(pca.transform(X), columns=[f'PC{i+1}' for i in range(5)])
scores['Cohort'] = df['Cohort']
loadings = pca.components_.T * np.sqrt(pca.explained_variance_)

palette = {'Healthy': '#66c2a5', 'Benign': '#8da0cb', 'Tumor': '#e63946'}
pc1 = pca.explained_variance_ratio_[0] * 100
pc2 = pca.explained_variance_ratio_[1] * 100

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.8, 4.6))
for cohort, sub in scores.groupby('Cohort'):
    ax.scatter(sub['PC1'], sub['PC2'], s=42, alpha=0.85,
               color=palette[cohort], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,
               label=cohort)
ax.axhline(0, color='0.85', linewidth=0.8, zorder=0)
ax.axvline(0, color='0.85', linewidth=0.8, zorder=0)
ax.set_xlabel(f'PC1 ({pc1:.0f}% variance)')
ax.set_ylabel(f'PC2 ({pc2:.0f}% variance)')
ax.legend(frameon=False)
ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

top_genes = np.argsort(np.abs(loadings[:, :2]).sum(axis=1))[-8:]
scale = 2.2
radii = np.linspace(1.10, 1.40, len(top_genes))  # stagger labels along arrows

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.2, 5))
for cohort, sub in scores.groupby('Cohort'):
    ax.scatter(sub['PC1'], sub['PC2'], s=30, alpha=0.55,
               color=palette[cohort], edgecolor='none', label=cohort)
for j, i in enumerate(top_genes):
    ax.annotate('', xy=(loadings[i, 0] * scale, loadings[i, 1] * scale),
                xytext=(0, 0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='0.3', lw=1.1))
    ax.text(loadings[i, 0] * scale * radii[j], loadings[i, 1] * scale * radii[j],
            genes[i], fontsize=8, color='0.25', ha='center')
ax.axhline(0, color='0.85', linewidth=0.8, zorder=0)
ax.axvline(0, color='0.85', linewidth=0.8, zorder=0)
ax.set_xlabel(f'PC1 ({pc1:.0f}% variance)')
ax.set_ylabel(f'PC2 ({pc2:.0f}% variance)')
ax.legend(frameon=False, loc='upper left')
ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

def add_p_bracket(ax, x1, x2, y, h, text):
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x1, y), xytext=(x2, y),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='0.15', lw=1.1))
    ax.plot([x1, x1], [y, y + h], color='0.15', lw=1.1)
    ax.plot([x2, x2], [y, y + h], color='0.15', lw=1.1)
    ax.text((x1 + x2) / 2, y + h, text, ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=10, color='0.1')

cohorts = ['Healthy', 'Benign', 'Tumor']
n_per = 20
base = np.random.normal(0, 1, (n_per * 3, 20))
shifts = np.concatenate([
    np.zeros((n_per, 20)),
    np.tile(np.r_[np.full(5, 1.2), np.zeros(15)], (n_per, 1)),
    np.tile(np.r_[np.zeros(5), np.full(5, 1.6), np.full(10, 0.5)], (n_per, 1)),
])
expr = base + shifts + np.random.normal(0, 0.6, base.shape)

genes = [f'GENE{i:02d}' for i in range(1, 21)]
X = StandardScaler().fit_transform(expr)
df = pd.DataFrame(X, columns=genes)
df['Cohort'] = np.repeat(cohorts, n_per)

pca = PCA(n_components=5).fit(X)

np.random.seed(131)

chr_sizes = np.full(10, 6_000)
rows = []
snp_id = 0
for chr_id in range(1, 11):
    pos = np.sort(np.random.uniform(1, chr_sizes[chr_id - 1], 6_000))
    chisq = np.random.chisquare(1, 6_000)
    if chr_id == 3:
        chisq[1500:1512] = np.random.chisquare(30, 12)      # strong peak
    if chr_id == 7:
        chisq[4200:4206] = np.random.chisquare(14, 6)       # modest peak
    p = chi2.sf(chisq, 1)
    rows.append(pd.DataFrame({
        'CHR': chr_id, 'POS': pos, 'P': p,
        'SNP': [f'rs{snp_id + j}' for j in range(6_000)]}))
    snp_id += 6_000
gwas = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
gwas['minus_log_p'] = -np.log10(gwas.P)

# cumulative offset for genome-linear coordinates
offsets = {c: i * chr_sizes[i] for i, c in enumerate(range(1, 11))}
gwas['POS_cum'] = gwas.POS + gwas.CHR.map(offsets)
tick_df = gwas.groupby('CHR').POS_cum.agg(['min', 'max'])
chr_ticks = (tick_df['min'] + tick_df['max']) / 2
BONF = -np.log10(0.05 / len(gwas))
SUGG = -np.log10(1e-5)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 3.8))
chr_colors = np.where(gwas.CHR % 2 == 1, '#8da0cb', '#66c2a5')
ax.scatter(gwas.POS_cum, gwas.minus_log_p, s=1.6, c=chr_colors,
           alpha=0.75, linewidths=0, rasterized=True)
ax.axhline(BONF, color='#e63946', linewidth=0.9, linestyle='--')
ax.axhline(SUGG, color='0.5', linewidth=0.8, linestyle=':')
ax.text(len(gwas) * 1.005, BONF, f'Bonferroni ({BONF:.1f})',
        va='center', fontsize=8, color='#e63946')
ax.set_xticks(chr_ticks, [f'chr{c}' for c in chr_ticks.index])

    return pd.DataFrame({
        'Months': np.minimum(true_time, censor),
        'Event': (true_time <= censor).astype(int),

function simulate_arm(rng, median; n = 60)
    true_time = -median / log(2) .* log.(rand(rng, n))
    censor = 10 .+ 62 .* rand(rng, n)
    DataFrame(Months = min.(true_time, censor),
              Event = true_time .<= censor)
end

function km_fit(times, events)
    order = sortperm(times)
    t = times[order]; e = events[order]
    n = length(t)
    s = 1.0
    ts = Float64[0.0]; ss = Float64[1.0]
    for tt in sort(unique(t))
        d = count(j -> t[j] == tt && e[j], 1:n)
        atrisk = count(j -> t[j] >= tt, 1:n)
        if d > 0
            s *= 1 - d / atrisk
            push!(ts, tt); push!(ss, s)
        end
    end
    (ts, ss)
end

function km_fit_ci(times, events)
    order = sortperm(times)
    t = times[order]; e = events[order]
    n = length(t)
    s = 1.0; cum = 0.0
    ts = Float64[0.0]; ss = Float64[1.0]; lo = Float64[1.0]; hi = Float64[1.0]
    for tt in sort(unique(t))
        d = count(j -> t[j] == tt && e[j], 1:n)
        atrisk = count(j -> t[j] >= tt, 1:n)
        if d > 0
            s *= 1 - d / atrisk
            cum += d / (atrisk * (atrisk - d))
            se = s * sqrt(cum)
            push!(ts, tt); push!(ss, s)
            push!(lo, max(s - 1.96 * se, 0.0)); push!(hi, min(s + 1.96 * se, 1.0))
        end
    end

function roc_pr_curve(label, scores)
    order = sortperm(scores; rev = true)
    y = label[order]
    tp = cumsum(y); fp = cumsum(.!y)
    P = sum(y); N = length(y) - P
    tpr = tp ./ P
    fpr = fp ./ N
    recall = tpr
    precision = tp ./ (tp .+ fp)
    auc = sum(diff(fpr) .* (tpr[1:end-1] .+ tpr[2:end]) ./ 2)
    ap = sum(precision[i] * (recall[i-1] - recall[i]) for i in 2:length(recall))
    (tpr, fpr, auc, precision, recall, ap)
end

})

    'logOR': np.average(studies.logOR, weights=studies.Weight),
    'SE': np.sqrt(1 / studies.Weight.sum()),
})

pooled['CI_high'] = pooled.logOR + 1.96 * pooled.SE

ax.hlines(y, studies.CI_low, studies.CI_high, color='0.25', linewidth=1.1)
ax.scatter(studies.logOR, y, s=studies.Weight * 90 / studies.Weight.max(),
           color='#457b9d', zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
diamond_y = -1.2
diamond = Polygon([[pooled.CI_low, diamond_y], [pooled.logOR, diamond_y + 0.32],
                   [pooled.CI_high, diamond_y], [pooled.logOR, diamond_y - 0.32]],

            transform=ax.get_yaxis_transform(), fontsize=8.5, va='center')
ax.text(1.02, diamond_y, f'{np.exp(pooled.logOR):.2f} '
        f'[{np.exp(pooled.CI_low):.2f}, {np.exp(pooled.CI_high):.2f}]',
        transform=ax.get_yaxis_transform(), fontsize=8.5, va='center',

n = 5000
de = pd.DataFrame({
    'baseMean_log': np.random.uniform(-2, 8, n),
})
de['log2FC'] = np.random.normal(0, 0.18, n)
de.loc[de.index[:60], 'log2FC'] = np.random.uniform(0.9, 3.0, 60)
de['padj'] = np.clip(
    10 ** (-np.abs(de.log2FC) * 9 - np.random.exponential(1.0, n)), 0, 1)
de.loc[de.log2FC.abs() < 0.5, 'padj'] = np.maximum(
    de.loc[de.log2FC.abs() < 0.5, 'padj'], 0.05)
de['sig'] = de.padj < 0.05

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.2, 4.4))
ax.scatter(de.loc[~de.sig, 'baseMean_log'], de.loc[~de.sig, 'log2FC'],
           s=4, color='#b8c4d0', alpha=0.5, label='ns', rasterized=True)
sig = de.sig & (de.log2FC > 0)
ax.scatter(de.loc[sig, 'baseMean_log'], de.loc[sig, 'log2FC'],
           s=6, color='#e63946', alpha=0.8, label='up (padj < 0.05)',
           rasterized=True)
sig_dn = de.sig & (de.log2FC < 0)
ax.scatter(de.loc[sig_dn, 'baseMean_log'], de.loc[sig_dn, 'log2FC'],
           s=6, color='#457b9d', alpha=0.8, label='down (padj < 0.05)',
           rasterized=True)
ax.axhline(0, color='0.4', linewidth=0.9)
for fc in (1, -1):
    ax.axhline(fc, color='0.6', linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--')
ax.set_xlabel('A: mean expression (log$_{2}$ scale)')
ax.set_ylabel('M: log$_{2}$ fold change')
ax.legend(frameon=False, markerscale=3, loc='upper left')
ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)

n = 2000
stats = np.random.normal(0, 1.2, n)
set_members = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
set_members[5:65] = True                      # 60 set genes near the top
stats[set_members] += np.random.normal(2.4, 0.8, 60)

ranked = pd.DataFrame({'Stat': stats},
                      index=[f'GENE{i:04d}' for i in range(1, n + 1)])
ranked = ranked.sort_values('Stat', ascending=False)

hit = set_members[np.argsort(-stats)]
# walking score: +1/|set| at a set gene, -1/(N-|set|) elsewhere
es = np.cumsum(np.where(hit, 1 / np.sum(hit), -1 / (n - np.sum(hit))))
peak = int(np.argmax(np.abs(es)))

positions = np.arange(n)

fig, (ax_stat, ax_es, ax_hit) = plt.subplots(
    3, 1, figsize=(7, 4.8), sharex=True,
    gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [2, 2, 0.5], 'hspace': 0.08})

ax_stat.bar(positions, ranked.Stat, color=np.where(hit, '#e63946', '#b8c4d0'),
            width=1.0, linewidth=0)
ax_stat.axhline(0, color='0.4', linewidth=0.7)
ax_stat.set_ylabel('Ranked statistic')

ax_es.plot(positions, es, color='#457b9d', linewidth=1.8)
ax_es.axhline(0, color='0.6', linewidth=0.8, linestyle=':')
ax_es.plot(peak, es[peak], marker='v', color='#e63946', markersize=7)
ax_es.annotate(f'peak ES = {es[peak]:.2f}', xy=(peak, es[peak]),
               xytext=(peak + 120, es[peak] - 0.06), fontsize=9,
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='0.5', lw=0.7))
ax_es.set_ylabel('Running ES')

ax_hit.vlines(positions[hit], 0, 1, color='#e63946', linewidth=0.8)
ax_hit.set_ylabel('Hits')

for ax in (ax_stat, ax_es, ax_hit):
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()

set2 = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
