np.random.seed(251)

n = 2000
stats = np.random.normal(0, 1.2, n)
set_members = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
set_members[5:65] = True                      # 60 set genes near the top
stats[set_members] += np.random.normal(2.4, 0.8, 60)

ranked = pd.DataFrame({'Stat': stats},
                      index=[f'GENE{i:04d}' for i in range(1, n + 1)])
ranked = ranked.sort_values('Stat', ascending=False)

hit = set_members[np.argsort(-stats)]
# walking score: +1/|set| at a set gene, -1/(N-|set|) elsewhere
es = np.cumsum(np.where(hit, 1 / np.sum(hit), -1 / (n - np.sum(hit))))
peak = int(np.argmax(np.abs(es)))

positions = np.arange(n)

fig, (ax_stat, ax_es, ax_hit) = plt.subplots(
    3, 1, figsize=(7, 4.8), sharex=True,
    gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [2, 2, 0.5], 'hspace': 0.08})

ax_stat.bar(positions, ranked.Stat, color=np.where(hit, '#e63946', '#b8c4d0'),
            width=1.0, linewidth=0)
ax_stat.axhline(0, color='0.4', linewidth=0.7)
ax_stat.set_ylabel('Ranked statistic')

ax_es.plot(positions, es, color='#457b9d', linewidth=1.8)
ax_es.axhline(0, color='0.6', linewidth=0.8, linestyle=':')
ax_es.plot(peak, es[peak], marker='v', color='#e63946', markersize=7)
ax_es.annotate(f'peak ES = {es[peak]:.2f}', xy=(peak, es[peak]),
               xytext=(peak + 120, es[peak] - 0.06), fontsize=9,
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='0.5', lw=0.7))
ax_es.set_ylabel('Running ES')

ax_hit.vlines(positions[hit], 0, 1, color='#e63946', linewidth=0.8)
ax_hit.set_ylabel('Hits')

for ax in (ax_stat, ax_es, ax_hit):
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
ax_hit.set_xlabel('Genes ranked by statistic')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

set2 = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
set2[800:900] = True
hit2 = set2[np.argsort(-stats)]
es2 = np.cumsum(np.where(hit2, 1 / 100, -1 / (n - 100)))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.6))
ax.plot(positions, es, color='#e63946', linewidth=1.8,

ax.set_ylabel('Running ES')
ax.legend(frameon=False)
ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()

type_sizes <- c("CD4 T cell" = 500, "CD8 T cell" = 460, "NK cell" = 300,

n_gene <- 1200
markers_per <- 40

gene_names <- paste0("Gene", 1:n_gene)

counts <- matrix(as.integer(pmin(counts, 30)), n_gene, n_cell)

# Add a marker block for each cell type
celltype <- factor(rep(cell_types, times = type_sizes), levels = cell_types)
for (i in seq_len(n_type)) {
  block <- ((i - 1) * markers_per + 1):(i * markers_per)
  idx_i <- which(celltype == cell_types[i])
  boost <- rnbinom(length(block) * length(idx_i), size = 8, prob = 0.2)
  counts[block, idx_i] <- pmin(counts[block, idx_i] + as.integer(boost), 120)
}
rownames(counts) <- gene_names

# Sample-level metadata: 6 samples map to 6 condition groups
groups <- c("Control", "4hours", "12hours", "2days", "14days", "6weeks")
site_lv <- c("Tumor", "Normal", "Margin")
orig.ident_raw <- sample(paste0("Sample_", 1:6), n_cell, TRUE)
lut <- setNames(rep(groups, length.out = 6), sort(unique(orig.ident_raw)))
Group <- factor(lut[orig.ident_raw], levels = groups)
site <- factor(sample(site_lv, n_cell, TRUE), levels = site_lv)

# Cell barcodes carry the sample name, as in merged Seurat objects
colnames(counts) <- paste0(sprintf("%04d", seq_len(n_cell)), "-1_", orig.ident_raw)

  celltype = celltype, Group = Group, orig.ident_raw = orig.ident_raw, site = site,
  row.names = colnames(counts)
)

sce <- NormalizeData(sce, verbose = FALSE)

sce <- ScaleData(sce, verbose = FALSE)
sce <- RunPCA(sce, npcs = 20, verbose = FALSE)

sce <- RunTSNE(sce, dims = 1:15, verbose = FALSE)
Idents(sce) <- "celltype"

# The lung data set ships with the survival package
data(lung, package = "survival")

lung2 <- lung %>%
  filter(complete.cases(age, sex, ph.ecog, ph.karno, pat.karno, meal.cal, wt.loss)) %>%
  mutate(y1y = as.integer(time < 365 & status == 2))  # death within 365 days
  # Caveat: patients censored before day 365 are counted as non-events; for
  # real analyses prefer restricting to >=365 days of follow-up or using
  # censoring-aware methods (cf. the time-dependent ROC below).

cat("Patients:", nrow(lung2), " 1-year deaths:", sum(lung2$y1y), "\n")

# Two logistic models for 1-year mortality
m_full   <- glm(y1y ~ age + sex + ph.ecog + meal.cal + wt.loss,
                data = lung2, family = binomial)
m_simple <- glm(y1y ~ ph.ecog, data = lung2, family = binomial)

# A continuous risk score from a Cox model (used for time-dependent ROC)
cph0 <- coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex + ph.ecog + wt.loss, data = lung2)
lung2$risk_score <- as.numeric(predict(cph0, type = "risk"))

# Store each model's predicted probability as a column (required by melt_roc)
lung2$risk_full <- fitted(m_full)
lung2$risk_ecog <- fitted(m_simple)

roc_full <- roc(lung2$y1y, fitted(m_full), quiet = TRUE)
set.seed(2026)  # keep the bootstrap CI reproducible across renders
ci_full  <- ci.auc(roc_full, method = "bootstrap", boot.n = 1000)

plot(roc_full, col = "#2166AC", lwd = 2,
     main = sprintf("ROC curve (AUC = %.2f, 95%% CI %.2f-%.2f)",
                    as.numeric(auc(roc_full)),
                    ci_full[1], ci_full[3]))

roc_simple <- roc(lung2$y1y, fitted(m_simple), quiet = TRUE)
roc_test <- roc.test(roc_full, roc_simple, method = "delong")

plot(roc_full, col = "#2166AC", lwd = 2,
     main = sprintf("Full vs simple model (DeLong p = %.3f)", roc_test$p.value))
plot(roc_simple, col = "#B2182B", lwd = 2, lty = 2, add = TRUE)
legend("bottomright",
       legend = c(sprintf("Full model (AUC = %.2f)", auc(roc_full)),
                  sprintf("ECOG only (AUC = %.2f)", auc(roc_simple))),
       col = c("#2166AC", "#B2182B"), lwd = 2, lty = c(1, 2))

best <- coords(roc_full, x = "best", input = "threshold",
               best.method = "youden", ret = c("threshold", "specificity", "sensitivity"))
print(best)

plot(roc_full, col = "#2166AC", lwd = 2, print.thres = "best",

# build one cohort: signal genes carry a class effect, noise genes do not
mk_cohort <- function(coef, sd, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  ex <- matrix(rnorm(n_gene * n_s), n_gene)
  cls <- sample(0:1, n_s, replace = TRUE)
  ex[truth, ] <- sweep(ex[truth, ], 2, cls * coef, `+`)
  ex <- ex + rnorm(n_gene * n_s, sd = sd)
  list(ex = ex, cls = cls)

  pos <- g[cls == 1]; neg <- g[cls == 0]
  u <- sum(sapply(pos, function(p) sum(neg < p) + 0.5 * sum(neg == p)))
  u / (length(pos) * length(neg))
})

library(patchwork)
set.seed(4302)
n_gene <- 60; n_s <- 90
genes <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%03d", 1:n_gene))
truth <- sample(n_gene, 12)                    # genes with real prognostic signal

# build one cohort: signal genes carry a class effect, noise genes do not
mk_cohort <- function(coef, sd, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  ex <- matrix(rnorm(n_gene * n_s), n_gene)
  cls <- sample(0:1, n_s, replace = TRUE)
  ex[truth, ] <- sweep(ex[truth, ], 2, cls * coef, `+`)
  ex <- ex + rnorm(n_gene * n_s, sd = sd)
  list(ex = ex, cls = cls)
}
c1 <- mk_cohort(1.3, 0.7, 4302)
c2 <- mk_cohort(1.1, 0.8, 4402)

# AUC via the Mann-Whitney rank statistic (equivalent to pROC::roc()$auc)
auc_of <- function(ex, cls) apply(ex, 1, function(g) {
  pos <- g[cls == 1]; neg <- g[cls == 0]
  u <- sum(sapply(pos, function(p) sum(neg < p) + 0.5 * sum(neg == p)))
  u / (length(pos) * length(neg))
})
auc1 <- auc_of(c1$ex, c1$cls); auc2 <- auc_of(c2$ex, c2$cls)
auc_df <- data.frame(gene = genes, auc1 = auc1, auc2 = auc2)
set.seed(4309)
auc_df$detected <- runif(n_gene) > 0.3         # "protein-detected" filter
cutoff <- 0.6
auc_df$hit <- auc_df$auc1 > cutoff & auc_df$auc2 > cutoff & auc_df$detected

pL <- ggplot(auc_df, aes(auc1, auc2)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = detected), size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#445EAD", `FALSE` = "grey75"),
                      labels = c(`TRUE` = "Protein-detected", `FALSE` = "Not detected"),
                      name = NULL) +
  geom_rect(xmin = cutoff, xmax = max(auc_df$auc1) + 0.02,
            ymin = cutoff, ymax = max(auc_df$auc2) + 0.02,
            fill = NA, colour = "grey40", linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("point", x = auc_df$auc1[1], y = auc_df$auc2[1],
           colour = "#B2182B", size = 2.5) +
  labs(x = "AUC in cohort 1", y = "AUC in cohort 2", title = "Cross-cohort AUC") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

hits <- auc_df[auc_df$hit, ]
hits$gene <- factor(hits$gene, levels = hits$gene[order((hits$auc1 + hits$auc2) / 2)])
pR <- ggplot(hits, aes(reorder(gene, (auc1 + auc2) / 2), (auc1 + auc2) / 2)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#445EAD", width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean AUC", title = "Hit genes") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

pL + pR + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

hoslem_p <- function(y, p, g = 10) {
  brk <- unique(quantile(p, seq(0, 1, length.out = g + 1)))
  grp <- cut(p, breaks = brk, include.lowest = TRUE)
  obs <- tapply(y, grp, sum)
  expd <- tapply(p, grp, sum)
  nn <- tapply(y, grp, length)
  chi <- sum((obs - expd)^2 / (expd * (1 - expd / nn)))
  pchisq(chi, df = length(levels(grp)) - 2, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

hoslem_p <- function(y, p, g = 10) {
  brk <- unique(quantile(p, seq(0, 1, length.out = g + 1)))
  grp <- cut(p, breaks = brk, include.lowest = TRUE)
  obs <- tapply(y, grp, sum)
  expd <- tapply(p, grp, sum)
  nn <- tapply(y, grp, length)
  chi <- sum((obs - expd)^2 / (expd * (1 - expd / nn)))
  pchisq(chi, df = length(levels(grp)) - 2, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

# GiViTI 路线：分箱观测率、加权多项式、前向选择阶数
fit_giviti <- function(xv, yv, nbins = 14, maxDeg = 3, thres = 0.05) {
  br <- unique(quantile(xv, seq(0, 1, length.out = nbins + 1)))
  bi <- as.integer(cut(xv, br, include.lowest = TRUE))
  bx <- tapply(xv, bi, mean); by <- tapply(yv, bi, mean); bw <- tapply(yv, bi, length)
  keep <- !is.na(bx) & bw >= 8
  bx <- bx[keep]; by <- by[keep]; bw <- bw[keep]
  best <- 1
  for (d in 2:maxDeg) {   # forward selection: keep the extra term if it pays off
    f0 <- lm(by ~ poly(bx, best, raw = TRUE), weights = bw)
    f1 <- lm(by ~ poly(bx, d, raw = TRUE), weights = bw)
    pv <- tryCatch(anova(f0, f1)[["Pr(>F)"]][2], error = function(e) NA)
    if (!is.na(pv) && pv < thres) best <- d else break
  }
  list(deg = best, coef = coef(lm(by ~ poly(bx, best, raw = TRUE), weights = bw)))
}
eval_curve <- function(cf, gridv) {
  d <- length(cf) - 1
  as.numeric(outer(gridv, 0:d, `^`) %*% cf)
}
gf <- fit_giviti(pred, obs)
grid <- seq(quantile(pred, 0.02), quantile(pred, 0.98), length.out = 60)
m <- eval_curve(gf$coef, grid)
# bootstrap 重抽按相同阶数重拟合，否则带内混入选择噪声
boot <- matrix(NA, nrow = 400, ncol = length(grid))
for (b in seq_len(400)) {
  ii <- sample.int(n, replace = TRUE)
  gb <- tryCatch(fit_giviti(pred[ii], obs[ii], maxDeg = gf$deg), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(gb) && gb$deg == gf$deg) boot[b, ] <- eval_curve(gb$coef, grid)
}
lo80 <- apply(boot, 2, quantile, probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)
lo95 <- apply(boot, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
ok <- complete.cases(cbind(m, lo80, lo95)) & m > -0.02 & m < 1.02
m <- m[ok]; lo80 <- lo80[ok]; lo95 <- lo95[ok]; grid_ <- grid[ok]
# 校准带合理性：带居拟合之下；对恒等线的偏差给出 bootstrap p
boot_dev <- rowMeans(abs(boot[, ok, drop = FALSE] -
              matrix(grid_, nrow = 400, ncol = sum(ok), byrow = TRUE)), na.rm = TRUE)
obs_dev <- mean(abs(m - grid_))
pval <- mean(boot_dev >= obs_dev, na.rm = TRUE)
stopifnot(obs_dev < 0.05)
dfb <- data.frame(pred = grid_, fit = m, lo80 = lo80, lo95 = lo95)

  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey45", linetype = 2) +
  geom_ribbon(data = dfb, aes(pred, ymin = lo95, ymax = fit), fill = "#B2182B", alpha = 0.16) +
  geom_ribbon(data = dfb, aes(pred, ymin = lo80, ymax = fit), fill = "#B2182B", alpha = 0.34) +
  geom_line(data = dfb, aes(pred, fit), colour = "#8A1B24", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Predicted probability", y = "Observed event rate",
       title = "GiViTI-style calibration belt (inner 80%, outer 95% one-sided bands)",
       subtitle = paste0("mean |f(x) - x| = ", round(obs_dev, 3),
                         ", bootstrap p = ", round(pval, 3),
                         ", selected degree = ", gf$deg)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

  age = rnorm(n_dc, 60, 9),
  stage = factor(sample(c("I", "II", "III"), n_dc, TRUE)),
  ecog = sample(0:2, n_dc, TRUE, prob = c(0.5, 0.35, 0.15)))
lp <- -0.9 + 0.024 * (lc$age - 60) + c(0, 0.4, 0.8)[as.integer(lc$stage)] + 0.25 * lc$ecog
H <- exp(lp) * 0.4                       # cumulative hazard at 730 days
S730 <- exp(-H)
event_time <- -log(runif(n_dc)) / H * 730
cens <- rexp(n_dc, 1 / 1500)
lc$time <- pmin(event_time, cens, 1095)
lc$event <- as.integer(event_time <= lc$time)
## name the columns what the legend should say (dcurves uses variable names)
lc$`Full model` <- 1 - S730
lc$`Clinical only` <- 1 - exp(-exp(-0.9 + 0.024 * (lc$age - 60) +
                                     c(0, 0.4, 0.8)[as.integer(lc$stage)]) * 0.4)
lc$`Biomarker only` <- pmin(0.95, pmax(0.01, 0.2 + 0.14 * lc$ecog + rnorm(n_dc, 0, 0.12)))
lc$`Age only (weak)` <- pmin(0.9, pmax(0.01, (lc$age - 40) / 60))

dca4 <- dca(Surv(time, event) ~ `Full model` + `Clinical only` +
              `Biomarker only` + `Age only (weak)`,
            data = lc, time = 730, thresholds = seq(0, 0.5, 0.01))
plot(dca4, smooth = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Threshold probability (2-year mortality)", y = "Net benefit") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

nia4 <- net_intervention_avoided(dca4, nper = 100)
plot(nia4, smooth = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Threshold probability (2-year mortality)",
       y = "Interventions avoided per 100 (vs treat all)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

n <- 40

response <- sample(c("CR", "PR", "SD", "PD"), n,
                   prob = c(0.05, 0.40, 0.30, 0.25), replace = TRUE)

  response == "CR" ~ -runif(n, 95, 100),   # complete response: almost full shrinkage
  response == "PR" ~ -runif(n, 30, 92),    # partial response: 30-90% shrinkage
  response == "SD" ~ runif(n, -25, 18),    # stable disease
  response == "PD" ~ runif(n, 22, 120)     # progressive disease
), 1)

wf <- data.frame(
  patient     = paste0("P", sprintf("%02d", seq_len(n))),
  best_change = best_change,
  response    = response
)

head(wf)

set.seed(2027)
weeks <- seq(0, 48, 6)

spider <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(wf)), function(i) {
  k <- length(weeks)
  endpoint <- wf$best_change[i]
  base <- approx(x = c(1, k), y = c(0, endpoint), xout = 1:k)$y
  noise <- runif(k, -4, 4)
  if (wf$response[i] == "PD") noise <- noise + seq(0, 12, length.out = k)  # acceleration
  data.frame(patient = wf$patient[i], week = weeks,
             change = round(pmin(base + noise, 130), 1),

}))

  ggplot(aes(patient, best_change)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4393C3", width = 0.75) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Best % change from baseline") +
  theme_bw()
p1

recist_colors <- c(CR = "#1B7837", PR = "#66BD63", SD = "#FFB300", PD = "#C51B7D")

p2 <- wf %>%
  mutate(patient = fct_reorder(patient, best_change)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(patient, best_change, fill = response)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-30, 20), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = recist_colors, name = "RECIST") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Best % change from baseline") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
p2

p3 <- spider %>%
  ggplot(aes(week, change, group = patient, color = response)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-30, 20), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.75, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = recist_colors, name = "RECIST") +
  labs(x = "Weeks on treatment", y = "% change from baseline") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
p3

p2 + p3 + plot_annotation(
  title = "Best tumor response and its longitudinal trajectories",
  tag_levels = "A"
)

set.seed(2026)

n <- 120
# Right-skewed biomarker concentrations, as tumor markers typically are
true_conc <- rgamma(n, shape = 2, scale = 20)

method_data <- data.frame(
  ref = true_conc * (1 + rnorm(n, 0, 0.05)),      # reference method, ~5% CV
  new = true_conc * (1 + rnorm(n, 0.06, 0.09))    # new method: +6% proportional bias, ~9% CV
) |>
  mutate(
    avg  = (ref + new) / 2,   # best available estimate of the true value
    diff = ref - new          # reference minus new
  )

head(method_data)

r <- cor(method_data$ref, method_data$new)

ggplot(method_data, aes(x = ref, y = new)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2166AC", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = max(method_data$ref) * 0.72, y = min(method_data$new) * 1.6,
           label = sprintf("Pearson r = %.2f", r), size = 4.2) +
  labs(x = "Reference method (mg/L)", y = "New method (mg/L)",
       title = "High correlation does not imply agreement")

bias    <- mean(method_data$diff)
sd_diff <- sd(method_data$diff)
loa     <- c(bias - 1.96 * sd_diff, bias + 1.96 * sd_diff)
n       <- nrow(method_data)

# Exact standard errors (Bland & Altman 1986): the limits are estimated
# quantities and carry their own uncertainty, especially in small samples.
se_bias <- sd_diff / sqrt(n)
se_loa  <- sqrt(sd_diff^2 * (1 / n + 1.96^2 / (2 * (n - 1))))

ggplot(method_data, aes(x = avg, y = diff)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2166AC", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = bias - 1.96 * se_bias, ymax = bias + 1.96 * se_bias),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = bias, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = loa, color = "#B2182B", linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = max(method_data$avg), y = bias, vjust = -1, hjust = 1,
           label = sprintf("Bias = %.2f", bias), size = 3.6) +
  annotate("text", x = max(method_data$avg), y = loa[2], vjust = -0.8, hjust = 1,
           label = sprintf("+1.96 SD = %.2f", loa[2]), size = 3.6, color = "#B2182B") +
  annotate("text", x = max(method_data$avg), y = loa[1], vjust = 1.7, hjust = 1,
           label = sprintf("-1.96 SD = %.2f", loa[1]), size = 3.6, color = "#B2182B") +
  labs(x = "Mean of both methods (mg/L)", y = "Difference (Reference − New)",
       title = "Bland-Altman plot with 95% limits of agreement")

blandr.draw(method_data$ref, method_data$new,
            plotTitle = "blandr package output")

method_data <- method_data |>
  mutate(pct_diff = diff / avg * 100)

pct_bias <- mean(method_data$pct_diff)
pct_loa  <- c(pct_bias - 1.96 * sd(method_data$pct_diff),
              pct_bias + 1.96 * sd(method_data$pct_diff))

ggplot(method_data, aes(x = avg, y = pct_diff)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2166AC", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = pct_bias, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = pct_loa, color = "#B2182B", linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = max(method_data$avg), y = pct_bias, vjust = -1, hjust = 1,
           label = sprintf("Bias = %.1f%%", pct_bias), size = 3.6) +
  annotate("text", x = max(method_data$avg), y = pct_loa[2], vjust = -0.8, hjust = 1,
           label = sprintf("+1.96 SD = %.1f%%", pct_loa[2]), size = 3.6, color = "#B2182B") +
  annotate("text", x = max(method_data$avg), y = pct_loa[1], vjust = 1.7, hjust = 1,
           label = sprintf("-1.96 SD = %.1f%%", pct_loa[1]), size = 3.6, color = "#B2182B") +
  labs(x = "Mean of both methods (mg/L)", y = "Difference (% of mean)",
       title = "Percentage difference plot")

set.seed(2301)
n_ba <- 60
method_a <- rnorm(n_ba, 50, 10)
method_b <- method_a * 1.1 + rnorm(n_ba, sd = 5)
ba_diff <- method_b - method_a
ba_mean <- (method_a + method_b) / 2

fit_ba <- lm(ba_diff ~ ba_mean)
slope_p <- summary(fit_ba)$coefficients[2, 4]

ba_mean_of <- mean(ba_mean)
ba_sd_of <- sd(ba_diff)
upper <- ba_mean_of + 1.96 * ba_sd_of
lower <- ba_mean_of - 1.96 * ba_sd_of

plot(ba_mean, ba_diff, pch = 19, col = "#2874C5",
     xlab = "Mean of two methods", ylab = "Difference (B - A)",
     main = sprintf("Bland-Altman with slope test (P %s)",
     ifelse(slope_p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", slope_p))))
abline(fit_ba, col = "#B2182B", lwd = 2)
abline(h = c(upper, lower), col = "grey40", lty = 2)
abline(h = ba_mean_of, col = "grey40")
legend("topleft", bty = "n", cex = 0.8,
       legend = c("Regression line", "95% limits of agreement", "Mean difference"),
       col = c("#B2182B", "grey40", "grey40"), lwd = c(2, 1, 1), lty = c(1, 2, 1))

data(veteran, package = "survival")

vet <- veteran |>
  mutate(
    Age       = factor(ifelse(age >= 60, ">= 60", "< 60"), levels = c("< 60", ">= 60")),
    Karnofsky = factor(ifelse(karno <= 50, "<= 50", "> 50"), levels = c("<= 50", "> 50")),
    PriorTx   = factor(ifelse(prior == 0, "No", "Yes"), levels = c("No", "Yes")),
    Histology = relevel(factor(celltype), ref = "squamous")
  )

# Hazard ratio of the test vs standard arm within a subset of patients
sub_haz <- function(df) {
  fit <- coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ trt, data = df)
  s <- summary(fit)
  c(est = unname(s$coefficients["trt", "exp(coef)"]),
    lo  = unname(s$conf.int["trt", "lower .95"]),
    hi  = unname(s$conf.int["trt", "upper .95"]),
    n   = nrow(df),
    p   = unname(s$coefficients["trt", "Pr(>|z|)"]))
}

# Interaction p-value per subgroup variable: likelihood-ratio test of
# Cox(Surv ~ trt) vs Cox(Surv ~ trt * subgroup)
int_p <- function(var) {
  a <- anova(coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ trt, data = vet),
             coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(time, status) ~ trt *", var)), data = vet))
  unname(a[2, "Pr(>|Chi|)"])
}

subgroups <- data.frame(
  label  = c("Age", "Karnofsky score", "Prior therapy", "Histology"),
  column = c("Age", "Karnofsky", "PriorTx", "Histology"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rows <- list(); hdr_p <- c()
add_row <- function(name, est = NA_real_, lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_,
                    n = NA_real_, p = NA_real_) {
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(Subgroup = name, est = est, lo = lo, hi = hi,
                                          n = n, p = p, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

r <- sub_haz(vet); add_row("Overall", r[["est"]], r[["lo"]], r[["hi"]], r[["n"]], r[["p"]])
for (i in seq_len(nrow(subgroups))) {
  v <- subgroups$column[i]
  add_row(subgroups$label[i])                       # header row: no estimate
  for (l in levels(vet[[v]])) {
    rr <- sub_haz(vet[vet[[v]] == l, ])
    add_row(paste0("   ", l), rr[["est"]], rr[["lo"]], rr[["hi"]], rr[["n"]], rr[["p"]])
  }
  hdr_p <- c(hdr_p, int_p(v))
}
sg <- dplyr::bind_rows(rows)

# Interaction p-values sit on the variable header rows
hdr_idx <- which(is.na(sg$est) & seq_len(nrow(sg)) > 1)
sg$`P interaction` <- ""
sg$`P interaction`[hdr_idx] <- ifelse(hdr_p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", hdr_p))

                           sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)", sg$est, sg$lo, sg$hi))

sg$se <- (log(sg$hi) - log(sg$lo)) / (2 * 1.96)   # box size ~ CI width

data(veteran, package = "survival")

vet <- veteran |>
  mutate(
    Age       = factor(ifelse(age >= 60, ">= 60", "< 60"), levels = c("< 60", ">= 60")),
    Karnofsky = factor(ifelse(karno <= 50, "<= 50", "> 50"), levels = c("<= 50", "> 50")),
    PriorTx   = factor(ifelse(prior == 0, "No", "Yes"), levels = c("No", "Yes")),
    Histology = relevel(factor(celltype), ref = "squamous")
  )

# Hazard ratio of the test vs standard arm within a subset of patients
sub_haz <- function(df) {
  fit <- coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ trt, data = df)
  s <- summary(fit)
  c(est = unname(s$coefficients["trt", "exp(coef)"]),
    lo  = unname(s$conf.int["trt", "lower .95"]),
    hi  = unname(s$conf.int["trt", "upper .95"]),
    n   = nrow(df),
    p   = unname(s$coefficients["trt", "Pr(>|z|)"]))
}

# Interaction p-value per subgroup variable: likelihood-ratio test of
# Cox(Surv ~ trt) vs Cox(Surv ~ trt * subgroup)
int_p <- function(var) {
  a <- anova(coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ trt, data = vet),
             coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(time, status) ~ trt *", var)), data = vet))
  unname(a[2, "Pr(>|Chi|)"])
}

subgroups <- data.frame(
  label  = c("Age", "Karnofsky score", "Prior therapy", "Histology"),
  column = c("Age", "Karnofsky", "PriorTx", "Histology"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rows <- list(); hdr_p <- c()
add_row <- function(name, est = NA_real_, lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_,
                    n = NA_real_, p = NA_real_) {
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(Subgroup = name, est = est, lo = lo, hi = hi,
                                          n = n, p = p, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

r <- sub_haz(vet); add_row("Overall", r[["est"]], r[["lo"]], r[["hi"]], r[["n"]], r[["p"]])
for (i in seq_len(nrow(subgroups))) {
  v <- subgroups$column[i]
  add_row(subgroups$label[i])                       # header row: no estimate
  for (l in levels(vet[[v]])) {
    rr <- sub_haz(vet[vet[[v]] == l, ])
    add_row(paste0("   ", l), rr[["est"]], rr[["lo"]], rr[["hi"]], rr[["n"]], rr[["p"]])
  }
  hdr_p <- c(hdr_p, int_p(v))
}
sg <- dplyr::bind_rows(rows)

# Interaction p-values sit on the variable header rows
hdr_idx <- which(is.na(sg$est) & seq_len(nrow(sg)) > 1)
sg$`P interaction` <- ""
sg$`P interaction`[hdr_idx] <- ifelse(hdr_p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", hdr_p))

sg$`HR (95% CI)` <- ifelse(is.na(sg$est), "",
                           sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)", sg$est, sg$lo, sg$hi))

sg$n <- ifelse(is.na(sg$n), "", as.character(sg$n))
sg$se <- (log(sg$hi) - log(sg$lo)) / (2 * 1.96)   # box size ~ CI width

set.seed(251)
## Simulated expression matrix: 3 subtypes x 15 replicates x 1200 genes
genes   <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%04d", 1:1200))
subtype <- rep(c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC"), each = 15)
signal  <- matrix(0, nrow = length(genes), ncol = 3,
                  dimnames = list(genes, c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC")))
pool <- genes
for (s in colnames(signal)) {          # 60 subtype-specific genes per subtype
  pick <- sample(pool, 60); signal[pick, s] <- 2; pool <- setdiff(pool, pick)
}
expr <- t(signal[, subtype]) +
  matrix(rnorm(length(subtype) * length(genes), sd = 0.6),
         nrow = length(subtype), ncol = length(genes))
colnames(expr) <- genes

## One-vs-rest log2FC per gene, per subtype (a t-test/limma loop can replace this)
lfc <- sapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  colMeans(expr[subtype == s, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(expr[subtype != s, , drop = FALSE])
})

## Signature gene sets: 5 sets of 30 genes per subtype
term2gene_sub <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, function(k)
    data.frame(term = paste0(s, "_signature_", k),
               gene = sample(genes[signal[, s] > 0], 30))))
}))

## GSEA per subtype on its own ranked list
gsea_res <- lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  GSEA(sort(lfc[, s], decreasing = TRUE), TERM2GENE = term2gene_sub,
       minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 100, pvalueCutoff = 1,
       eps = 0, seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
})
names(gsea_res) <- colnames(signal)

## Top-5 up-regulated pathways per subtype
top_gs <- lapply(gsea_res, function(r) {
  res <- as.data.frame(r)
  res <- res[res$NES > 0, ]
  head(rownames(res[order(res$NES, decreasing = TRUE), ]), 5)
})

## Specificity score: mean log2FC of each top set's genes in EVERY subtype
score <- t(sapply(unlist(top_gs, use.names = FALSE), function(gs) {
  gs_genes <- term2gene_sub$gene[term2gene_sub$term == gs]
  colMeans(lfc[gs_genes, , drop = FALSE])
}))
ann <- data.frame(Subtype = gsub("_signature_[0-9]+$", "", rownames(score)),
                  row.names = rownames(score))
jco <- c("#F2CCCC", "#E6D8CF", "#D5E3F0")
pheatmap(score, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         border_color = NA, annotation_row = ann,
         annotation_colors = list(Subtype = c(SubtypeA = jco[1], SubtypeB = jco[2],
                                              SubtypeC = jco[3])),
         main = "Subtype-specific top pathways")

set.seed(251)
## Simulated expression matrix: 3 subtypes x 15 replicates x 1200 genes
genes   <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%04d", 1:1200))
subtype <- rep(c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC"), each = 15)
signal  <- matrix(0, nrow = length(genes), ncol = 3,
                  dimnames = list(genes, c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC")))
pool <- genes
for (s in colnames(signal)) {          # 60 subtype-specific genes per subtype
  pick <- sample(pool, 60); signal[pick, s] <- 2; pool <- setdiff(pool, pick)
}
expr <- t(signal[, subtype]) +
  matrix(rnorm(length(subtype) * length(genes), sd = 0.6),
         nrow = length(subtype), ncol = length(genes))
colnames(expr) <- genes

## One-vs-rest log2FC per gene, per subtype (a t-test/limma loop can replace this)
lfc <- sapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  colMeans(expr[subtype == s, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(expr[subtype != s, , drop = FALSE])
})

## Signature gene sets: 5 sets of 30 genes per subtype
term2gene_sub <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, function(k)
    data.frame(term = paste0(s, "_signature_", k),
               gene = sample(genes[signal[, s] > 0], 30))))
}))

## GSEA per subtype on its own ranked list
gsea_res <- lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  GSEA(sort(lfc[, s], decreasing = TRUE), TERM2GENE = term2gene_sub,
       minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 100, pvalueCutoff = 1,
       eps = 0, seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
})
names(gsea_res) <- colnames(signal)

## Top-5 up-regulated pathways per subtype
top_gs <- lapply(gsea_res, function(r) {
  res <- as.data.frame(r)
  res <- res[res$NES > 0, ]
  head(rownames(res[order(res$NES, decreasing = TRUE), ]), 5)
})

## Specificity score: mean log2FC of each top set's genes in EVERY subtype
score <- t(sapply(unlist(top_gs, use.names = FALSE), function(gs) {
  gs_genes <- term2gene_sub$gene[term2gene_sub$term == gs]
  colMeans(lfc[gs_genes, , drop = FALSE])
}))
ann <- data.frame(Subtype = gsub("_signature_[0-9]+$", "", rownames(score)),
                  row.names = rownames(score))
jco <- c("#F2CCCC", "#E6D8CF", "#D5E3F0")

         border_color = NA, annotation_row = ann,

set.seed(251)
## Simulated expression matrix: 3 subtypes x 15 replicates x 1200 genes
genes   <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%04d", 1:1200))
subtype <- rep(c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC"), each = 15)
signal  <- matrix(0, nrow = length(genes), ncol = 3,
                  dimnames = list(genes, c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC")))
pool <- genes
for (s in colnames(signal)) {          # 60 subtype-specific genes per subtype
  pick <- sample(pool, 60); signal[pick, s] <- 2; pool <- setdiff(pool, pick)
}
expr <- t(signal[, subtype]) +
  matrix(rnorm(length(subtype) * length(genes), sd = 0.6),
         nrow = length(subtype), ncol = length(genes))
colnames(expr) <- genes

## One-vs-rest log2FC per gene, per subtype (a t-test/limma loop can replace this)
lfc <- sapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  colMeans(expr[subtype == s, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(expr[subtype != s, , drop = FALSE])
})

## Signature gene sets: 5 sets of 30 genes per subtype
term2gene_sub <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, function(k)
    data.frame(term = paste0(s, "_signature_", k),
               gene = sample(genes[signal[, s] > 0], 30))))
}))

## GSEA per subtype on its own ranked list
gsea_res <- lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  GSEA(sort(lfc[, s], decreasing = TRUE), TERM2GENE = term2gene_sub,
       minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 100, pvalueCutoff = 1,
       eps = 0, seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
})
names(gsea_res) <- colnames(signal)

## Top-5 up-regulated pathways per subtype
top_gs <- lapply(gsea_res, function(r) {
  res <- as.data.frame(r)
  res <- res[res$NES > 0, ]
  head(rownames(res[order(res$NES, decreasing = TRUE), ]), 5)
})

## Specificity score: mean log2FC of each top set's genes in EVERY subtype
score <- t(sapply(unlist(top_gs, use.names = FALSE), function(gs) {
  gs_genes <- term2gene_sub$gene[term2gene_sub$term == gs]
  colMeans(lfc[gs_genes, , drop = FALSE])
}))
ann <- data.frame(Subtype = gsub("_signature_[0-9]+$", "", rownames(score)),
                  row.names = rownames(score))
jco <- c("#F2CCCC", "#E6D8CF", "#D5E3F0")
pheatmap(score, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         border_color = NA, annotation_row = ann,
         annotation_colors = list(Subtype = c(SubtypeA = jco[1], SubtypeB = jco[2],

                        labels = c("censored", "pcm", "death"))

cat("Patients:", nrow(mgus2),
    "| progression:", sum(mgus2$event == 1),
    "| death (competing):", sum(mgus2$event == 2), "\n")

  add_confidence_interval() +
  add_risktable(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(pcm = "#B2182B", death = "#2166AC"), name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(pcm = "#B2182B", death = "#2166AC"), guide = "none") +
  xlab("Months since diagnosis") +
  ylab("Cumulative incidence") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

            gt$statistic_1, gt$df_1, gt$p.value_1))
cat(sprintf("Gray's test, death:       chi-square = %.2f, df = %d, p = %.3f\n",

  scale_color_manual(values = c(F = "#1B9E77", M = "#7570B3"), name = "Sex") +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(pcm = "#B2182B", death = "#2166AC"), name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(pcm = "#B2182B", death = "#2166AC"), guide = "none") +
  xlab("Months since diagnosis") +
  ylab("Cumulative incidence") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

ci2 <- cuminc(Surv(etime, event_f) ~ sex, data = mgus2)
gt <- glance(ci2)
cat(sprintf("Gray's test, progression: chi-square = %.2f, df = %d, p = %.3f\n",
            gt$statistic_1, gt$df_1, gt$p.value_1))
cat(sprintf("Gray's test, death:       chi-square = %.2f, df = %d, p = %.3f\n",
            gt$statistic_2, gt$df_2, gt$p.value_2))

  add_confidence_interval() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(F = "#1B9E77", M = "#7570B3"), name = "Sex") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(F = "#1B9E77", M = "#7570B3"), guide = "none") +
  xlab("Months since diagnosis") +
  ylab("Cumulative incidence of progression") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

  mutate(term_lbl = recode(term, sexM = "Sex: M vs F", age = "Age (per year)"))

ggplot(fgdf, aes(x = estimate, y = term_lbl)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), orientation = "y",
                width = 0.12, color = "#B2182B") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#B2182B") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Subdistribution hazard ratio (log scale)", y = NULL,

  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

  geom_hline(yintercept = tail(cidf$cif, 1), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = 250, y = tail(cidf$cif, 1) + 0.025, size = 3.4, color = "#B2182B",

  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 420), ylim = c(0, 0.65)) +
  labs(x = "Months since diagnosis", y = "Incidence of progression",
       title = "1 − KM overestimates incidence when deaths compete") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "top")

set.seed(2026)

n <- 24
pain <- data.frame(
  patient = paste0("P", sprintf("%02d", 1:n)),
  before  = round(rgamma(n, shape = 6, scale = 1.1), 1)
) |>
  mutate(after    = pmin(10, pmax(0, round(before - 2.2 + rnorm(n, 0, 1.6), 1))),
         change   = after - before,
         direction = ifelse(change <= 0, "Improved", "Worsened"))

pal <- c(Improved = "#1B7837", Worsened = "#B2182B")
head(pain)

ggplot(pain, aes(x = before, xend = after, y = reorder(patient, -change),
                 color = direction)) +
  geom_segment(arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "inches"), type = "closed"),
               linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(x = before, y = reorder(patient, -change)),
             size = 2.4, color = "grey35") +
  geom_point(aes(x = after, y = reorder(patient, -change)),
             size = 2.4, color = "grey35") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Pain score (NRS 0-10)", y = "Patient", title = "Before-after plot") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

long <- pain |>
  select(patient, direction, before, after) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(patient, direction), names_to = "Time", values_to = "score") |>
  mutate(Time = recode(Time, before = "Before", after = "After"))

ggplot(long, aes(Time, score, group = patient)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = direction), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, color = "grey30") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Pain score (NRS 0-10)", title = "Slope chart") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

ggplot(pain, aes(y = reorder(patient, change))) +
  geom_dumbbell(aes(x = after, xend = before),
                colour_x = "#1B7837", colour_xend = "grey45",
                size = 1.3, size_x = 2.4, size_xend = 2.4) +
  labs(x = "Pain score (green = after treatment, grey = baseline)", y = NULL,
       title = "Paired dumbbell chart") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

tt <- t.test(pain$after, pain$before, paired = TRUE)
md <- mean(pain$change)
se <- sd(pain$change) / sqrt(nrow(pain))
lo <- md - qt(0.975, nrow(pain) - 1) * se
hi <- md + qt(0.975, nrow(pain) - 1) * se
xlim <- range(c(pain$change, lo, hi))

p4a <- ggplot(pain, aes(x = change, y = reorder(patient, change), fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey25") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Individual changes with mean 95% CI") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

p4b <- ggplot(data.frame(x = "Mean"), aes(x = md, y = x)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), orientation = "y", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, color = "#B2182B") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey25", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim) +
  annotate("text", x = md, y = 1.42, vjust = 1.1, size = 3.2,
           label = sprintf("Mean %.2f (95%% CI %.2f to %.2f), paired t p = %.2g",

set.seed(251)

n <- 500
skew_sample  <- rlnorm(n, meanlog = 1.2, sdlog = 0.8)  # right-skewed biomarker
norm_sample  <- rnorm(n, 50, 8)                        # well-behaved control
control_g <- rnorm(400, 42, 9)
case_g    <- rgamma(450, shape = 12, scale = 3.4)

pvals <- runif(10000)
idx <- sample(1:10000, 40)
pvals[idx] <- 10^(-rnorm(40, 3, 0.7))                  # association signals

qq <- qqnorm(skew_sample, plot.it = FALSE)
# qqnorm returns theoretical quantiles paired with the data IN DATA ORDER;
# sort both by the plotting position for a clean line
ord <- order(qq$x)
df1 <- data.frame(theoretical = qq$x[ord], sample = qq$y[ord])

ggplot(df1, aes(theoretical, sample)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2166AC", alpha = 0.65, size = 1.9) +
  geom_abline(slope = sd(skew_sample), intercept = mean(skew_sample),
              linetype = "dashed", color = "#B2182B") +
  labs(x = "Theoretical N(0,1) quantiles", y = "Sample quantiles",
       title = "Right-skewed sample: convex departure") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

M <- 500
srt <- matrix(rnorm(n * M, mean(norm_sample), sd(norm_sample)), nrow = n) |>
  apply(2, sort)
band <- t(apply(srt, 1, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)))
theory <- qnorm(ppoints(n))                # ascending plotting positions
samp  <- sort(norm_sample)
env <- data.frame(theory, lo = band[, 1], hi = band[, 2], samp)

ggplot(env, aes(theory)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = "#2166AC", alpha = 0.18) +
  geom_point(aes(y = samp), color = "#2166AC", size = 1.8) +
  geom_abline(slope = sd(norm_sample), intercept = mean(norm_sample),
              linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "Theoretical quantiles", y = "Sample quantiles",
       title = "Normal sample with 95% simulation envelope") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

probs <- seq(0.01, 0.99, 0.01)
qx <- quantile(control_g, probs = probs, type = 7)
qy <- quantile(case_g, probs = probs, type = 7)

ggplot(data.frame(x = qx, y = qy), aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2166AC", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#B2182B") +
  labs(x = "Quantiles: Control biomarker", y = "Quantiles: Case biomarker",
       title = "Two-sample Q-Q plot") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

chisq <- qchisq(1 - pvals, 1)
lambda <- median(chisq) / qchisq(0.5, 1)
cat(sprintf("Genomic inflation factor lambda_GC = %.3f\n", lambda))
qq(pvals, main = sprintf("GWAS Q-Q plot (lambda_GC = %.2f)", lambda))

set.seed(251)

dates <- seq(as.Date("2025-01-01"), as.Date("2025-12-31"), by = "day")
base_adm <- 42 + 12 * sin(2 * pi * (yday(dates) - 15) / 365)  # winter peak
weekend  <- ifelse(wday(dates) %in% c(1, 7), -8, 0)           # weekend dip
flu      <- ifelse(dates >= as.Date("2025-01-20") &
                   dates <= as.Date("2025-02-10"), 18, 0)     # flu surge

adm <- data.frame(date = dates,
                  admissions = pmax(5, round(base_adm + weekend + flu +
                                               rnorm(length(dates), 0, 5)))) |>
  mutate(wday_n    = wday(date, week_start = 1),
         dom       = day(date),
         month_n   = month(date),
         month_lab = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE))

# weekday of each month's 1st (Mon-based), shifted so day 1 sits in its true column
offsets <- sapply(1:12, function(m) wday(as.Date(sprintf("2025-%02d-01", m)),
                                         week_start = 1) - 1)
adm <- adm |>
  mutate(week_row = ceiling((dom + offsets[month_n]) / 7))

cat("Days:", nrow(adm), "| range:", min(adm$admissions), "-", max(adm$admissions), "\n")

wd_lab <- c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")

ggplot(adm, aes(wday_n, week_row, fill = admissions)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:7, labels = wd_lab, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = NULL, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7FBFF", high = "#08306B", name = "Admissions") +
  facet_wrap(~month_lab, ncol = 4) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Daily hospital admissions, 2025 (simulated)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

avg = (ref + new) / 2      # best estimate of the true value

bias, sd = diff.mean(), diff.std(ddof=1)

se_bias = sd / np.sqrt(n)
se_loa = np.sqrt(sd**2 * (1 / n + 1.96**2 / (2 * (n - 1))))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4.8))
ax.axhspan(bias - 1.96 * se_bias, bias + 1.96 * se_bias, color="grey", alpha=0.25)
ax.axhline(bias, color="black", lw=1)
ax.axhline(loa[0], color="#B2182B", ls="--", lw=1)
ax.axhline(loa[1], color="#B2182B", ls="--", lw=1)

ax.text(avg.max(), bias, f"  Bias = {bias:.2f}", va="bottom", ha="right", fontsize=9)

ax.set_xlabel("Mean of both methods (mg/L)")

marker = rng.normal(0, 1, m)
lp = -1.2 + 0.03 * (age - 60) + 0.5 * ecog + 0.8 * marker
y1y = rng.binomial(1, 1 / (1 + np.exp(-lp)))

df = pd.DataFrame({"age": age, "ecog": ecog, "marker": marker, "y": y1y})
tr, te = train_test_split(df, test_size=0.4, random_state=251, stratify=df.y)

m_full = LogisticRegression().fit(tr[["age", "ecog", "marker"]], tr.y)
m_simple = LogisticRegression().fit(tr[["ecog"]], tr.y)
te = te.assign(p_full=m_full.predict_proba(te[["age", "ecog", "marker"]])[:, 1],
               p_simple=m_simple.predict_proba(te[["ecog"]])[:, 1])
te.y.mean().round(3)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.6, 4.6))
for name, col, c in [("Full model", "p_full", "#2166AC"),
                     ("Simple model", "p_simple", "#B2182B")]:
    prob_true, prob_pred = calibration_curve(te.y, te[col], n_bins=8,
                                             strategy="quantile")
    ax.plot(prob_pred, prob_true, "o-", color=c, label=name, markersize=4)
ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], "k--", lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel("Predicted probability")
ax.set_ylabel("Observed proportion")
ax.set_title("Calibration curves (quantile bins)")
ax.legend(loc="upper left")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

d = dca(data=te, outcome="y", modelnames=["p_full", "p_simple"],
        thresholds=np.arange(0.01, 0.99, 0.01))
net = d  # tidy frame: model / threshold / net_benefit / net_intervention_avoided

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.8, 4.6))
for label, c in [("p_full", "#2166AC"), ("p_simple", "#B2182B")]:
    sub = net[net.model == label]
    ax.plot(sub.threshold, sub.net_benefit, color=c, label=label)
ax.axhline(0, color="grey", lw=0.8)
allpos = net[net.model == "all"]

ax.set_xlabel("Threshold probability")
ax.set_ylabel("Net benefit")
ax.set_title("Decision curve analysis (dcurves)")
ax.set_ylim(-0.05, 0.45)
ax.legend()
fig.tight_layout()

rng = np.random.default_rng(9)

def simulate_arm(n, lam_cancer, lam_other, lam_cens, horizon):
    t_cancer = rng.exponential(1 / lam_cancer, n)
    t_other = rng.exponential(1 / lam_other, n)
    t_censor = rng.exponential(1 / lam_cens, n)
    t_admin = np.full(n, horizon)
    time = np.minimum.reduce([t_cancer, t_other, t_censor, t_admin])
    cause = np.where(time == t_cancer, 1,
             np.where(time == t_other, 2, 0))   # 0 = censored
    return time, cause

t_ctl, c_ctl = simulate_arm(n_per_arm, 0.030, 0.020, 0.012, 60)

                   "cause": np.concatenate([c_ctl, c_trt]),

def aalen_johansen(time, cause, max_cause=2):
    """Aalen-Johansen CIF per cause. Invariant: sum_k CIF_k = 1 - KM."""
    utime = np.unique(time[time > 0])
    at_risk = np.array([(time >= t).sum() for t in utime], dtype=float)
    d_all = np.array([((time == t) & (cause > 0)).sum() for t in utime],
                     dtype=float)
    surv_prev = surv = 1.0
    cif = {k: np.zeros(len(utime)) for k in range(1, max_cause + 1)}
    for i in range(len(utime)):
        if at_risk[i] == 0:
            continue
        if d_all[i] > 0:                  # all-cause KM step
            surv_prev = surv
            surv *= 1 - d_all[i] / at_risk[i]
        for k in range(1, max_cause + 1):
            d_k = ((time == utime[i]) & (cause == k)).sum()
            if d_k:                        # jump: S(t-) * hazard of cause k
                cif[k][i:] += surv_prev * d_k / at_risk[i]
    return utime, cif

def one_minus_km(time, event_flag):
    utime = np.unique(time[event_flag])
    surv, out_t, out_s = 1.0, [0.0], [1.0]
    for t in utime:
        y = (time >= t).sum()
        d = ((time == t) & event_flag).sum()
        if d:
            surv *= 1 - d / y
        out_t.append(t); out_s.append(surv)
    return np.array(out_t), 1 - np.array(out_s)

           init="pca").fit_transform(Xs)

        ax.scatter(e[m, 0], e[m, 1], s=8, alpha=0.65, color=palette[t],
                   label=t, linewidths=0)

             dimnames = list(genes, paste0("cell", 1:n_cell)))

## nested covariance ellipses at two coverage levels
ell <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0.9, 0.95), function(pro) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(grp2), function(g) {
    d <- scores_pg[scores_pg$grp == g, 1:2]
    ctr <- colMeans(d); eg <- eigen(cov(d))
    ang <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 120)
    r <- sqrt(qchisq(pro, df = 2))
    data.frame(
      x = ctr[1] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[1, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[1, 2]),
      y = ctr[2] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[2, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[2, 2]),
      grp = g, pro = pro)
  }))
}))

## Simulated expression matrix: 3 subtypes x 15 replicates x 1200 genes
genes   <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%04d", 1:1200))
subtype <- rep(c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC"), each = 15)
signal  <- matrix(0, nrow = length(genes), ncol = 3,
                  dimnames = list(genes, c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC")))
pool <- genes
for (s in colnames(signal)) {          # 60 subtype-specific genes per subtype
  pick <- sample(pool, 60); signal[pick, s] <- 2; pool <- setdiff(pool, pick)
}
expr <- t(signal[, subtype]) +
  matrix(rnorm(length(subtype) * length(genes), sd = 0.6),
         nrow = length(subtype), ncol = length(genes))
colnames(expr) <- genes

## One-vs-rest log2FC per gene, per subtype (a t-test/limma loop can replace this)
lfc <- sapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  colMeans(expr[subtype == s, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(expr[subtype != s, , drop = FALSE])
})

## Signature gene sets: 5 sets of 30 genes per subtype
term2gene_sub <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, function(k)
    data.frame(term = paste0(s, "_signature_", k),
               gene = sample(genes[signal[, s] > 0], 30))))
}))

  GSEA(sort(lfc[, s], decreasing = TRUE), TERM2GENE = term2gene_sub,
       minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 100, pvalueCutoff = 1,
       eps = 0, seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
})

})

}))

  filter(complete.cases(age, sex, ph.ecog, ph.karno, pat.karno, meal.cal, wt.loss)) %>%
  mutate(y1y = as.integer(time < 365 & status == 2))  # death within 365 days

  # real analyses prefer restricting to >=365 days of follow-up or using
  # censoring-aware methods (cf. the time-dependent ROC below).

                data = lung2, family = binomial)

library(patchwork)
set.seed(4302)
n_gene <- 60; n_s <- 90
genes <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%03d", 1:n_gene))
truth <- sample(n_gene, 12)                    # genes with real prognostic signal

# build one cohort: signal genes carry a class effect, noise genes do not
mk_cohort <- function(coef, sd, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  ex <- matrix(rnorm(n_gene * n_s), n_gene)
  cls <- sample(0:1, n_s, replace = TRUE)
  ex[truth, ] <- sweep(ex[truth, ], 2, cls * coef, `+`)
  ex <- ex + rnorm(n_gene * n_s, sd = sd)
  list(ex = ex, cls = cls)
}
c1 <- mk_cohort(1.3, 0.7, 4302)
c2 <- mk_cohort(1.1, 0.8, 4402)

# AUC via the Mann-Whitney rank statistic (equivalent to pROC::roc()$auc)
auc_of <- function(ex, cls) apply(ex, 1, function(g) {
  pos <- g[cls == 1]; neg <- g[cls == 0]
  u <- sum(sapply(pos, function(p) sum(neg < p) + 0.5 * sum(neg == p)))
  u / (length(pos) * length(neg))
})
auc1 <- auc_of(c1$ex, c1$cls); auc2 <- auc_of(c2$ex, c2$cls)
auc_df <- data.frame(gene = genes, auc1 = auc1, auc2 = auc2)
set.seed(4309)
auc_df$detected <- runif(n_gene) > 0.3         # "protein-detected" filter
cutoff <- 0.6

                levels = c("High expression", "Low expression"))
features   <- c("AJCC stage III", "Tumor size > 5 cm", "Serosal invasion", "Perineural invasion")
p_high     <- c(0.70, 0.65, 0.80, 0.35)   # feature more common in the high-expression group
p_low      <- c(0.25, 0.25, 0.30, 0.45)

tile_df <- do.call(rbind, c(
  list(data.frame(patient = seq_len(2 * n_group), row = "Expression group",
                  state = as.character(group))),
  lapply(seq_along(features), function(k) {
    yes <- c(rbinom(n_group, 1, p_high[k]), rbinom(n_group, 1, p_low[k]))
    data.frame(patient = seq_len(2 * n_group), row = features[k],
               state = ifelse(yes == 1, "yes", "no"))
  })
))

           paste0("M_M", 1:n_genes_per), paste0("NK_M", 1:n_genes_per))
# cluster-mean marker expression: each marker set peaks only in its own cluster
avg <- matrix(rnorm(length(genes) * n_clust, sd = 0.4), nrow = length(genes),
              dimnames = list(genes, clusters))
for (k in 1:n_clust) {
  idx <- ((k - 1) * n_genes_per + 1):(k * n_genes_per)

}
clip_scale <- function(x, lo = -2, hi = 2)
  matrix(pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi), nrow = nrow(x), dimnames = dimnames(x))
# per-gene z-score, clipped to +-2 so one loud gene cannot saturate the scale
ph_data <- clip_scale(t(scale(t(avg))))

mk_enrich <- function(prefix, n) {
  data.frame(
    Term = sprintf("%s pathway %d", prefix, 1:n),
    PValue = 10^(-runif(n, 1.3, 6)),
    Count = sample(5:60, n),
    Pop.Hits = sample(80:200, n)
  )
}
enrich <- rbind(cbind(direction = "Down", mk_enrich("Down", 8)),
                cbind(direction = "Up",   mk_enrich("Up", 8)))
enrich$GeneRatio <- enrich$Pop.Hits / enrich$Count

enrich_bubble <- function(dat, legend_pos, term_side = "left") {
  dat <- dat[order(dat$GeneRatio), ]
  dat$Term <- factor(dat$Term, levels = dat$Term)      # keep the sorted order
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(GeneRatio, Term, colour = PValue)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = Count)) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10)) +
    scale_color_gradientn(colours = c("red", "yellow")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    ylab(NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = legend_pos, legend.justification = legend_pos,
          legend.background = element_blank(), legend.key = element_blank())
  if (term_side == "right") p <- p + scale_y_discrete(position = "right")
  p
}

make_tri <- function(i, j, upper) {
  x0 <- j - 0.5; y0 <- i - 0.5
  if (upper) data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 0, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 1, 1))   # upper-left triangle
  else data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 1, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 0, 1))         # lower-right triangle
}

}))

library(patchwork)
set.seed(4302)
n_gene <- 60; n_s <- 90
genes <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%03d", 1:n_gene))
truth <- sample(n_gene, 12)                    # genes with real prognostic signal

# build one cohort: signal genes carry a class effect, noise genes do not
mk_cohort <- function(coef, sd, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  ex <- matrix(rnorm(n_gene * n_s), n_gene)
  cls <- sample(0:1, n_s, replace = TRUE)
  ex[truth, ] <- sweep(ex[truth, ], 2, cls * coef, `+`)
  ex <- ex + rnorm(n_gene * n_s, sd = sd)
  list(ex = ex, cls = cls)
}
c1 <- mk_cohort(1.3, 0.7, 4302)
c2 <- mk_cohort(1.1, 0.8, 4402)

# AUC via the Mann-Whitney rank statistic (equivalent to pROC::roc()$auc)
auc_of <- function(ex, cls) apply(ex, 1, function(g) {
  pos <- g[cls == 1]; neg <- g[cls == 0]
  u <- sum(sapply(pos, function(p) sum(neg < p) + 0.5 * sum(neg == p)))
  u / (length(pos) * length(neg))
})
auc1 <- auc_of(c1$ex, c1$cls); auc2 <- auc_of(c2$ex, c2$cls)
auc_df <- data.frame(gene = genes, auc1 = auc1, auc2 = auc2)

set.seed(404)
clusters <- c("C1", "C2", "C3")
n_per <- 30
sig_sets <- list(
  `Immune checkpoint` = paste0("ICG", 1:15),
  `Antigen processing` = paste0("APM", 1:15),
  `TGF-beta response` = paste0("TGF", 1:15)
)
all_genes <- unlist(sig_sets)
meta <- data.frame(sample = paste0("S", 1:90),
                   cluster = rep(clusters, each = n_per))

expr10 <- matrix(rnorm(45 * 90, sd = 1), nrow = 45, dimnames = list(all_genes, meta$sample))
shift <- c(0, 0.7, 1.6)[match(meta$cluster, clusters)]      # C3 strongest
for (gs in c("Immune checkpoint", "Antigen processing")) {
  expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ] <- sweep(expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], ], 2, shift, "+")  # shift applies per sample (column)
}
expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] <-
  expr10[sig_sets[["TGF-beta response"]], meta$cluster == "C3"] - 1.2

## sign-corrected PC1 score per signature (the reference workflow's core step)
score_of <- function(gs) {
  m <- expr10[sig_sets[[gs]], , drop = FALSE]
  pc <- prcomp(t(m), retx = TRUE)
  pc$x[, 1] * sign(cor(pc$x[, 1], colMeans(m)))
}
scores <- sapply(names(sig_sets), score_of)

long10 <- data.frame(sample = meta$sample, cluster = meta$cluster, scores) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(sample, cluster), names_to = "Signature", values_to = "Score") |>
  mutate(Score = as.numeric(scale(Score)))

ggplot(long10, aes(Signature, Score, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
  stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif", method = "kruskal.test") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E31A1C", "#E7B800", "#2E9FDF")) +
  labs(y = "Signature score (scaled)", fill = "TME cluster") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

gene_d <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%02d", 1:10))
cancer_d <- c("BRCA", "LUAD", "COAD", "STAD", "KIRC", "HNSC", "LUSC", "PRAD")
amp <- matrix(runif(80, 0, 0.55), 10, 8, dimnames = list(gene_d, cancer_d))
del <- matrix(runif(80, 0, 0.55), 10, 8, dimnames = list(gene_d, cancer_d))
amp[1:4, ] <- amp[1:4, ] + 0.25      # oncogene-like: amplified
del[5:10, ] <- del[5:10, ] + 0.30    # tumour-suppressor-like: deleted
amp <- pmin(amp, 0.95); del <- pmin(del, 0.95)

make_tri <- function(i, j, upper) {
  x0 <- j - 0.5; y0 <- i - 0.5
  if (upper) data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 0, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 1, 1))   # upper-left triangle
  else data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 1, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 0, 1))         # lower-right triangle
}
cells <- expand.grid(i = seq_len(10), j = seq_len(8))
tri_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(cells)), function(k) {
  i <- cells$i[k]; j <- cells$j[k]
  rbind(cbind(make_tri(i, j, TRUE),  value =  amp[i, j], id = k, tri = "up",   gi = i, cj = j),
        cbind(make_tri(i, j, FALSE), value = -del[i, j], id = k, tri = "dn",   gi = i, cj = j))
}))
tri_df$gene <- factor(gene_d[tri_df$gi], levels = rev(gene_d))
tri_df$cancer <- factor(cancer_d[tri_df$cj], levels = cancer_d)

## polygons need NUMERIC x/y — a discrete aes would collapse the vertices
ggplot(tri_df, aes(x, y, group = interaction(id, tri), fill = value)) +
  geom_polygon(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(8) - 0.5, labels = cancer_d, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_len(10) - 0.5, labels = gene_d, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#3878C1", mid = "#FFFADD", high = "#AB221F",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = NULL,
                       labels = function(v) sprintf("%.1f", v)) +

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

set.seed(251)
## Simulated expression matrix: 3 subtypes x 15 replicates x 1200 genes
genes   <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%04d", 1:1200))
subtype <- rep(c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC"), each = 15)
signal  <- matrix(0, nrow = length(genes), ncol = 3,
                  dimnames = list(genes, c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC")))
pool <- genes
for (s in colnames(signal)) {          # 60 subtype-specific genes per subtype
  pick <- sample(pool, 60); signal[pick, s] <- 2; pool <- setdiff(pool, pick)
}
expr <- t(signal[, subtype]) +
  matrix(rnorm(length(subtype) * length(genes), sd = 0.6),
         nrow = length(subtype), ncol = length(genes))
colnames(expr) <- genes

## One-vs-rest log2FC per gene, per subtype (a t-test/limma loop can replace this)
lfc <- sapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  colMeans(expr[subtype == s, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(expr[subtype != s, , drop = FALSE])
})

## Signature gene sets: 5 sets of 30 genes per subtype
term2gene_sub <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, function(k)
    data.frame(term = paste0(s, "_signature_", k),
               gene = sample(genes[signal[, s] > 0], 30))))
}))

## GSEA per subtype on its own ranked list
gsea_res <- lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  GSEA(sort(lfc[, s], decreasing = TRUE), TERM2GENE = term2gene_sub,
       minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 100, pvalueCutoff = 1,
       eps = 0, seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
})
names(gsea_res) <- colnames(signal)

## Top-5 up-regulated pathways per subtype
top_gs <- lapply(gsea_res, function(r) {
  res <- as.data.frame(r)
  res <- res[res$NES > 0, ]
  head(rownames(res[order(res$NES, decreasing = TRUE), ]), 5)
})

## Specificity score: mean log2FC of each top set's genes in EVERY subtype
score <- t(sapply(unlist(top_gs, use.names = FALSE), function(gs) {
  gs_genes <- term2gene_sub$gene[term2gene_sub$term == gs]
  colMeans(lfc[gs_genes, , drop = FALSE])
}))
ann <- data.frame(Subtype = gsub("_signature_[0-9]+$", "", rownames(score)),
                  row.names = rownames(score))
jco <- c("#F2CCCC", "#E6D8CF", "#D5E3F0")
pheatmap(score, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         border_color = NA, annotation_row = ann,
         annotation_colors = list(Subtype = c(SubtypeA = jco[1], SubtypeB = jco[2],
                                              SubtypeC = jco[3])),

## Simulated expression matrix: 3 subtypes x 15 replicates x 1200 genes
genes   <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%04d", 1:1200))
subtype <- rep(c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC"), each = 15)
signal  <- matrix(0, nrow = length(genes), ncol = 3,
                  dimnames = list(genes, c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC")))
pool <- genes
for (s in colnames(signal)) {          # 60 subtype-specific genes per subtype
  pick <- sample(pool, 60); signal[pick, s] <- 2; pool <- setdiff(pool, pick)
}
expr <- t(signal[, subtype]) +
  matrix(rnorm(length(subtype) * length(genes), sd = 0.6),
         nrow = length(subtype), ncol = length(genes))
colnames(expr) <- genes

## One-vs-rest log2FC per gene, per subtype (a t-test/limma loop can replace this)
lfc <- sapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  colMeans(expr[subtype == s, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(expr[subtype != s, , drop = FALSE])
})

## Signature gene sets: 5 sets of 30 genes per subtype
term2gene_sub <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, function(k)
    data.frame(term = paste0(s, "_signature_", k),
               gene = sample(genes[signal[, s] > 0], 30))))
}))

## GSEA per subtype on its own ranked list
gsea_res <- lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  GSEA(sort(lfc[, s], decreasing = TRUE), TERM2GENE = term2gene_sub,
       minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 100, pvalueCutoff = 1,
       eps = 0, seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
})
names(gsea_res) <- colnames(signal)

## Top-5 up-regulated pathways per subtype
top_gs <- lapply(gsea_res, function(r) {
  res <- as.data.frame(r)
  res <- res[res$NES > 0, ]
  head(rownames(res[order(res$NES, decreasing = TRUE), ]), 5)
})

## Specificity score: mean log2FC of each top set's genes in EVERY subtype
score <- t(sapply(unlist(top_gs, use.names = FALSE), function(gs) {
  gs_genes <- term2gene_sub$gene[term2gene_sub$term == gs]
  colMeans(lfc[gs_genes, , drop = FALSE])
}))
ann <- data.frame(Subtype = gsub("_signature_[0-9]+$", "", rownames(score)),
                  row.names = rownames(score))
jco <- c("#F2CCCC", "#E6D8CF", "#D5E3F0")

         border_color = NA, annotation_row = ann,

hoslem_p <- function(y, p, g = 10) {
  brk <- unique(quantile(p, seq(0, 1, length.out = g + 1)))
  grp <- cut(p, breaks = brk, include.lowest = TRUE)
  obs <- tapply(y, grp, sum)
  expd <- tapply(p, grp, sum)
  nn <- tapply(y, grp, length)
  chi <- sum((obs - expd)^2 / (expd * (1 - expd / nn)))
  pchisq(chi, df = length(levels(grp)) - 2, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

lin <- -2.0 + 0.09 * (age - 65) + 1.20 * sten + 1.00 * hyd
obs <- rbinom(n, 1, plogis(lin))
dfl <- data.frame(obs = obs, age = age, sten = sten, hyd = hyd)
mod <- glm(obs ~ age + sten + hyd, family = binomial, data = dfl)
pred <- as.numeric(fitted(mod))
# GiViTI 路线：分箱观测率、加权多项式、前向选择阶数
fit_giviti <- function(xv, yv, nbins = 14, maxDeg = 3, thres = 0.05) {
  br <- unique(quantile(xv, seq(0, 1, length.out = nbins + 1)))
  bi <- as.integer(cut(xv, br, include.lowest = TRUE))
  bx <- tapply(xv, bi, mean); by <- tapply(yv, bi, mean); bw <- tapply(yv, bi, length)
  keep <- !is.na(bx) & bw >= 8
  bx <- bx[keep]; by <- by[keep]; bw <- bw[keep]
  best <- 1
  for (d in 2:maxDeg) {   # forward selection: keep the extra term if it pays off
    f0 <- lm(by ~ poly(bx, best, raw = TRUE), weights = bw)
    f1 <- lm(by ~ poly(bx, d, raw = TRUE), weights = bw)
    pv <- tryCatch(anova(f0, f1)[["Pr(>F)"]][2], error = function(e) NA)
    if (!is.na(pv) && pv < thres) best <- d else break
  }
  list(deg = best, coef = coef(lm(by ~ poly(bx, best, raw = TRUE), weights = bw)))
}
eval_curve <- function(cf, gridv) {
  d <- length(cf) - 1
  as.numeric(outer(gridv, 0:d, `^`) %*% cf)
}
gf <- fit_giviti(pred, obs)
grid <- seq(quantile(pred, 0.02), quantile(pred, 0.98), length.out = 60)
m <- eval_curve(gf$coef, grid)
# bootstrap 重抽按相同阶数重拟合，否则带内混入选择噪声
boot <- matrix(NA, nrow = 400, ncol = length(grid))
for (b in seq_len(400)) {
  ii <- sample.int(n, replace = TRUE)
  gb <- tryCatch(fit_giviti(pred[ii], obs[ii], maxDeg = gf$deg), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(gb) && gb$deg == gf$deg) boot[b, ] <- eval_curve(gb$coef, grid)
}
lo80 <- apply(boot, 2, quantile, probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)
lo95 <- apply(boot, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
ok <- complete.cases(cbind(m, lo80, lo95)) & m > -0.02 & m < 1.02
m <- m[ok]; lo80 <- lo80[ok]; lo95 <- lo95[ok]; grid_ <- grid[ok]
# 校准带合理性：带居拟合之下；对恒等线的偏差给出 bootstrap p
boot_dev <- rowMeans(abs(boot[, ok, drop = FALSE] -
              matrix(grid_, nrow = 400, ncol = sum(ok), byrow = TRUE)), na.rm = TRUE)
obs_dev <- mean(abs(m - grid_))
pval <- mean(boot_dev >= obs_dev, na.rm = TRUE)
stopifnot(obs_dev < 0.05)
dfb <- data.frame(pred = grid_, fit = m, lo80 = lo80, lo95 = lo95)
ggplot() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey45", linetype = 2) +
  geom_ribbon(data = dfb, aes(pred, ymin = lo95, ymax = fit), fill = "#B2182B", alpha = 0.16) +
  geom_ribbon(data = dfb, aes(pred, ymin = lo80, ymax = fit), fill = "#B2182B", alpha = 0.34) +
  geom_line(data = dfb, aes(pred, fit), colour = "#8A1B24", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Predicted probability", y = "Observed event rate",
       title = "GiViTI-style calibration belt (inner 80%, outer 95% one-sided bands)",
       subtitle = paste0("mean |f(x) - x| = ", round(obs_dev, 3),
                         ", bootstrap p = ", round(pval, 3),
                         ", selected degree = ", gf$deg)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

make_tri <- function(i, j, upper) {
  x0 <- j - 0.5; y0 <- i - 0.5
  if (upper) data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 0, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 1, 1))   # upper-left triangle
  else data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 1, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 0, 1))         # lower-right triangle
}

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors <- list(Cluster = c(C1 = "#B31E22", C2 = "#529B40", C3 = "#020105"))
ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         annotation_legend = FALSE,          # legends crowd out the body otherwise
         show_colnames = FALSE,              # 30 sample names would overprint
         cutree_cols = 3,
         legend_breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
         legend_labels = c("mRNA\ndown-regulation", "mRNA\nno-change", "mRNA\nup-regulation"),
         fontsize_row = 8)

set.seed(3110)
subtypes <- c("LumA", "LumB", "Basal")
n_per <- 20
genes <- paste0("PAM50_", sprintf("%02d", 1:50))
n_samp <- length(subtypes) * n_per
sub_lab <- factor(rep(subtypes, each = n_per), levels = subtypes)
base <- matrix(rnorm(50 * n_samp, sd = 0.6), 50, n_samp,
               dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_samp))))
sig_blocks <- list(
  LumA  = list(up = 1:10,  dn = NULL,  eff = 1.1),
  LumB  = list(up = 11:20, dn = NULL,  eff = 1.2),
  Basal = list(up = 21:30, dn = 31:40, eff = 1.3))
for (st in subtypes) {
  idx <- which(sub_lab == st)
  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
}
## proliferation genes: high in LumB only
base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] <- base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] + 1.2

## nearest-centroid classification from a training split (SSP stand-in)
train <- c(TRUE, FALSE)[rep(1:2, length.out = n_samp)]
cent <- sapply(subtypes, function(st) rowMeans(base[, train & sub_lab == st]))
pred <- apply(base[, !train], 2, function(x) {
  corrs <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(cent)), function(k) cor(x, cent[, k]))
  subtypes[which.max(corrs)] })
pred <- factor(pred, levels = subtypes)
cat("held-out accuracy:", round(mean(pred == sub_lab[!train]), 2), "\n")

sig_scores <- rbind(
  `AR score`  = colMeans(base[21:30, ]) - colMeans(base[31:40, ]),  # Basal-high
  `Prolif score` = colMeans(base[41:50, ]))                          # LumB-high
pheno <- ifelse(sig_scores["AR score", ] > 0, "AR-high", "AR-low")

## mean-centre each gene (no scaling, the reference's fold-difference scale) and clip
mat <- t(scale(t(base), center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
mat[mat > 4] <- 4; mat[mat < -4] <- -4
ord <- order(pred)
pred_o <- pred[ord]; mat_o <- mat[, ord]
pheno_o <- factor(pheno[ord], levels = c("AR-low", "AR-high"))
ar_o <- sig_scores["AR score", ord]; pro_o <- sig_scores["Prolif score", ord]

col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#170B88", "#FFFFFF", "#D23C30"))

set.seed(503)
gene_r <- paste0("MMP", sprintf("%02d", 1:24))
cancer_r <- c("BRCA", "LUAD", "COAD", "STAD", "KIRC", "HNSC", "LUSC", "PRAD")
logfc_r <- matrix(rnorm(24 * 8, sd = 1.5), 24, 8,
                  dimnames = list(gene_r, cancer_r))
logfc_r[1:6, ] <- logfc_r[1:6, ] + 1.8      # up-regulated block
logfc_r[7:12, ] <- logfc_r[7:12, ] - 1.8    # down-regulated block
## explicit P-value design: strong bands significant, weak genes mostly not
p_low <- ifelse(runif(24 * 8) < 0.25, runif(24 * 8, 1e-3, 0.045),
                                       runif(24 * 8, 0.06, 0.9))
pval_r <- ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 2, runif(24 * 8, 1e-8, 1e-3),
          ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 1, runif(24 * 8, 1e-4, 0.04), p_low))
gene_type <- rep(c("Collagen-binding", "Membrane-type", "Gelatin-binding",
                   "Secreted", "Matrisome", "Other"),
                 each = 4)

## bin into 5 fold-change bands; P >= 0.05 overrides to a 6th (white) band
logfc_cat <- apply(logfc_r, 2, function(x)
  cut(x, breaks = c(-Inf, -2, -1, 1, 2, Inf),
      labels = c("< -2", "-2 - -1", "-1 - 1", "1 - 2", "> 2")))
rownames(logfc_cat) <- gene_r
logfc_cat[pval_r >= 0.05] <- "P >= 0.05"

col_cat <- c("> 2" = "#A80C3A", "1 - 2" = "#ED5E57", "-1 - 1" = "#DDD3D2",
             "-2 - -1" = "#6B9AB7", "< -2" = "#2F5B89", "P >= 0.05" = "white")

cell_fun <- function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
  dark <- logfc_cat[i, j] %in% c("> 2", "1 - 2", "< -2", "-2 - -1")
  val <- logfc_r[i, j]; if (abs(val) < 0.05) val <- 0
  grid::grid.text(sprintf("%.1f", val), x, y,
                  gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8,
                                  col = if (dark) "white" else "black"))
}

row_an <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Type = gene_type, show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  col = list(Type = c("Collagen-binding" = "#ED1450", "Membrane-type" = "#FCCA02",

                      "Matrisome" = "#59574A", "Other" = "#BCBDBF")),
  annotation_legend_param = list(title = "Gene class"), which = "row")

Heatmap(logfc_cat, name = "logFC band",

        col = col_cat,

dend_sorted <- sort(as.dendrogram(d_hc))          # tidy the leaves
leaf_order <- order.dendrogram(dend_sorted)

jco <- c("#2874C5", "#EABF00"); cherry <- "#700353"; lightgrey <- "#dcddde"
clust_col  <- ifelse(clust[leaf_order] == 1, jco[1], jco[2])
status_col <- ifelse(meta_status[leaf_order] == "LN+", cherry, lightgrey)

col_dend <- dendextend::color_branches(dend_sorted, k = 2, col = jco)

set.seed(251)
## Simulated expression matrix: 3 subtypes x 15 replicates x 1200 genes
genes   <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%04d", 1:1200))
subtype <- rep(c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC"), each = 15)
signal  <- matrix(0, nrow = length(genes), ncol = 3,
                  dimnames = list(genes, c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC")))
pool <- genes
for (s in colnames(signal)) {          # 60 subtype-specific genes per subtype
  pick <- sample(pool, 60); signal[pick, s] <- 2; pool <- setdiff(pool, pick)
}
expr <- t(signal[, subtype]) +
  matrix(rnorm(length(subtype) * length(genes), sd = 0.6),
         nrow = length(subtype), ncol = length(genes))
colnames(expr) <- genes

## One-vs-rest log2FC per gene, per subtype (a t-test/limma loop can replace this)
lfc <- sapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  colMeans(expr[subtype == s, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(expr[subtype != s, , drop = FALSE])
})

## Signature gene sets: 5 sets of 30 genes per subtype
term2gene_sub <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, function(k)
    data.frame(term = paste0(s, "_signature_", k),
               gene = sample(genes[signal[, s] > 0], 30))))
}))

## GSEA per subtype on its own ranked list
gsea_res <- lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  GSEA(sort(lfc[, s], decreasing = TRUE), TERM2GENE = term2gene_sub,
       minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 100, pvalueCutoff = 1,
       eps = 0, seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
})
names(gsea_res) <- colnames(signal)

## Top-5 up-regulated pathways per subtype
top_gs <- lapply(gsea_res, function(r) {
  res <- as.data.frame(r)
  res <- res[res$NES > 0, ]
  head(rownames(res[order(res$NES, decreasing = TRUE), ]), 5)
})

## Specificity score: mean log2FC of each top set's genes in EVERY subtype
score <- t(sapply(unlist(top_gs, use.names = FALSE), function(gs) {
  gs_genes <- term2gene_sub$gene[term2gene_sub$term == gs]
  colMeans(lfc[gs_genes, , drop = FALSE])
}))
ann <- data.frame(Subtype = gsub("_signature_[0-9]+$", "", rownames(score)),
                  row.names = rownames(score))
jco <- c("#F2CCCC", "#E6D8CF", "#D5E3F0")
pheatmap(score, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         border_color = NA, annotation_row = ann,
         annotation_colors = list(Subtype = c(SubtypeA = jco[1], SubtypeB = jco[2],
                                              SubtypeC = jco[3])),
         main = "Subtype-specific top pathways")

  depth * (0.4 + shape) + rnorm(n_bin, sd = 0.05)))
knockdown <- t(sapply(1.6 ^ rnorm(n_gene, 0, 0.35), function(depth)
  depth * (0.4 + 0.5 * shape) + rnorm(n_bin, sd = 0.05)))

colnames(ctrl) <- paste0("ctrl_b", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_bin))
colnames(knockdown) <- paste0("kd_b", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_bin))

## travel ratio: promoter signal (first 10 bins) / total signal over the window
tr <- function(m) rowSums(m[, 1:10]) / rowSums(m)
tr_df <- data.frame(gene = rep(genes, times = 2),
                    Condition = rep(factor(c("Control", "MYCN off"),
                                           levels = c("Control", "MYCN off")),
                                    each = n_gene),
                    TR = c(tr(ctrl), tr(knockdown)))

  bin = seq_len(n_bin),
  ctrl_mean = colMeans(ctrl),

  kd_mean = colMeans(knockdown),
  kd_se = apply(knockdown, 2, function(x) sd(x) / sqrt(n_gene)),

    t.test(ctrl[, b], knockdown[, b], var.equal = FALSE)$p.value))

  depth * (0.4 + 0.5 * shape) + rnorm(n_bin, sd = 0.05)))

colnames(knockdown) <- paste0("kd_b", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_bin))
