set.seed(2026)

genes <- c("TP53", "EGFR", "KRAS", "STK11", "KEAP1", "PIK3CA", "PTEN", "RB1",
           "APC", "ARID1A", "NF1", "NOTCH1", "BRAF", "CDKN2A", "SMAD4", "FBXW7",
           "ATM", "BRCA2", "ERBB2", "MET")
cohort <- rep(c("Subtype A", "Subtype B"), c(35, 25))
samples <- sprintf("S%02d", 1:60)

# Subtype-specific mutation probabilities per gene
p_a <- c(.52, .34, .10, .14, .10, .10, .12, .10, .06, .22, .08, .06, .04, .10, .05, .06, .06, .05, .05, .04)
p_b <- c(.22, .08, .42, .40, .36, .14, .10, .10, .10, .06, .10, .06, .06, .10, .10, .08, .05, .05, .06, .08)
mut_types <- c("Missense", "Nonsense", "Frameshift", "Splice_Site", "In_Frame")
type_p <- c(.58, .14, .12, .08, .08)

mutations <- map_dfr(seq_along(samples), function(i) {
  p <- if (cohort[i] == "Subtype A") p_a else p_b
  hit <- genes[runif(length(genes)) < p]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NULL)
  type <- sample(mut_types, length(hit), replace = TRUE, prob = type_p)
  # Tumor suppressors such as TP53 can receive a second hit, shown as Multi_Hit
  if (runif(1) < .15 && "TP53" %in% hit) {
    type[hit == "TP53"] <- "Multi_Hit"
  }
  tibble(sample = samples[i], gene = hit, type = type)
})

head(mutations)

# Reshape the mutation table into a gene x sample matrix; a cell holds one or
# several alteration types separated by ";"
gene_levels <- names(sort(table(factor(mutations$gene, levels = genes)), decreasing = TRUE))
mat <- matrix("", nrow = length(genes), ncol = length(samples),
              dimnames = list(genes, samples))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(mutations))) {
  cell <- mat[mutations$gene[i], mutations$sample[i]]
  mat[mutations$gene[i], mutations$sample[i]] <-
    if (cell == "") mutations$type[i] else paste(cell, mutations$type[i], sep = ";")
}

# Order samples: by subtype, then by mutation count (waterfall look)
mut_count <- colSums(mat != "")
ord <- order(factor(cohort, levels = c("Subtype A", "Subtype B")), -mut_count)
mat <- mat[gene_levels, ord]

# Annotation vectors aligned with the reordered matrix
cohort_ordered <- factor(cohort[ord], levels = c("Subtype A", "Subtype B"))
tmb <- mut_count[ord]

mutation_colors <- c(
  Missense = "#3690C0", Nonsense = "#A50F15", Frameshift = "#F16913",
  Splice_Site = "#6A51A3", In_Frame = "#31A354", Multi_Hit = "#252525"
)

# One drawing function per alteration type
rect_fun <- function(color) {
  function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w * 0.9, h * 0.9, gp = gpar(fill = color, col = NA))
}
alter_fun <- list(
  background = rect_fun("#F2F2F2"),
  Missense = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Missense"]),
  Nonsense = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Nonsense"]),
  Frameshift = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Frameshift"]),
  Splice_Site = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Splice_Site"]),
  In_Frame = rect_fun(mutation_colors["In_Frame"]),
  Multi_Hit = rect_fun(mutation_colors["Multi_Hit"])
)

# Expand explicit Multi_Hit cells into two individual events
mutations_long <- bind_rows(
  mutations |> filter(type != "Multi_Hit"),
  mutations |> filter(type == "Multi_Hit") |> mutate(type = "Missense"),
  mutations |> filter(type == "Multi_Hit") |> mutate(type = "Nonsense"))

    Start_Position = 100000L + as.integer(match(gene, genes)) * 54321L +

    End_Position = Start_Position,
    Reference_Allele = "A",
    Tumor_Seq_Allele2 = "G",

subtypes <- c("BRCA_LumA", "BRCA_Basal", "LUAD", "LUSC", "COAD_MSI", "COAD_CIN",
              "KIRC", "STAD_MSI", "HNSC_HPV-", "SKCM")
n_sam <- c(80, 40, 60, 50, 45, 35, 55, 45, 50, 45)
genes_info <- data.frame(
  Gene = c("EGFR", "KRAS", "BRAF", "PIK3CA", "MYC", "CCND1",
           "TP53", "NF1", "PTEN", "RB1", "ARID1A", "CDKN2A"),
  Type = rep(c("OG", "TSG"), each = 6),
  base_rate = c(0.10, 0.15, 0.06, 0.22, 0.12, 0.09,
                0.45, 0.08, 0.12, 0.09, 0.14, 0.20)
)

## sample-level alteration types per gene (simulated per subtype)
alter_ls <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(subtypes), function(s) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(genes_info$Gene, function(g) {
    rate <- genes_info$base_rate[genes_info$Gene == g] *
      (1.35 ^ rnorm(1, mean = ifelse(s <= 5, 0.4, -0.2)))     # subtype drift
    n_alt <- rbinom(1, n_sam[s], min(rate, 0.9))
    types <- sample(c("MUT", "AMP", "DEL"), n_alt, replace = TRUE,
                    prob = c(0.6, 0.2, 0.2))
    extra <- if (n_alt > 2 && runif(1) < 0.15) "Multiple" else NULL
    data.frame(subtype = subtypes[s], gene = g,
               type = c(types, extra, NA_character_))
  }))
})) |>
  filter(!is.na(type))

bases <- c("C>A", "C>G", "C>T", "T>A", "T>C", "T>G")

channels <- paste0(rep(bases, each = 8), "_", rep(1:8, times = 6))
n_ch <- length(channels); n_samp <- 40

sig_apobec <- c(2, 6, 8, 6, 2, 1, 1, 1)   # TCW motif enrichment, simplified shape
sig_aging  <- c(5, 4, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 2)   # flat shape (shared by all classes here)
W_true <- cbind(rep(sig_apobec, 6), rep(sig_aging, 6))
W_true <- W_true / colSums(W_true)
expo <- t(cbind(c(rep(0.7, 15), rep(0.05, 25)), rep(0.5, n_samp)))  # 2 signatures x 40 samples
counts <- round((W_true %*% expo) * 600 +
                matrix(rpois(n_ch * n_samp, 2), nrow = n_ch))  # depth 600 for SNR

fit <- NMF::nmf(counts + 1, rank = 2, method = "brunet", nrun = 1, seed = 902)
W <- NMF::basis(fit); W <- W / colSums(W)                 # channels x 2
H <- NMF::coef(fit)                                       # 2 x samples

sig_df <- as.data.frame(W) |>
  mutate(channel = rep(bases, each = n_ch / 6), pos = rep(1:(n_ch / 6), times = 6)) |>
  pivot_longer(V1:V2, names_to = "signature", values_to = "weight")
sig_df$signature <- ifelse(sig_df$signature == "V1", "Signature A", "Signature B")

expo_df <- as.data.frame(t(H)) |>
  mutate(sample = seq_len(n_samp)) |>
  pivot_longer(V1:V2, names_to = "signature", values_to = "exposure")

expo_df$sample <- factor(expo_df$sample, levels = unique(expo_df$sample[order(expo_df$signature, -expo_df$exposure)]))

# 各亚型的突变概率：亚型特异性驱动基因
pa <- c(.65, .55, .25, .10, .15, .20, .10, .15, .10, .05)
pb <- c(.20, .10, .60, .55, .10, .15, .35, .25, .05, .10)
pcx <- c(.15, .20, .20, .15, .75, .10, .10, .10, .55, .40)
samples_e <- sprintf("T%02d", 1:n_e)
mat_e <- matrix("", nrow = length(genes_e), ncol = n_e, dimnames = list(genes_e, samples_e))
tmb_e <- integer(n_e)
for (j in 1:n_e) {
  p_use <- switch(subt[j], "iCS-1" = pa, "iCS-2" = pb, pcx)
  hits <- genes_e[runif(length(genes_e)) < p_use]
  if (length(hits) == 0) { mat_e[genes_e[1], j] <- "Mis"; tmb_e[j] <- 1L; next }
  for (g in hits) {
    mat_e[g, j] <- sample(c("Mis", "Non", "Fs"), 1, prob = c(0.6, 0.25, 0.15))
    tmb_e[j] <- tmb_e[j] + 1L
  }
}
# APOBEC 签名占比 = 原图景观的排序键

              ifelse(as.character(subt) == "iCS-2", 0.30, 0.18)) + runif(n_e, -0.05, 0.05)

                 AFR2  = 1 - sig_key + runif(n_e, -0.05, 0.05),
                 OTHER = runif(n_e, 0.02, 0.20))
dimnames(sig_mat) <- list(c("APOBEC", "AFR2", "OTHER"), samples_e)

ord <- order(factor(subt, levels = c("iCS-1", "iCS-2", "iCS-3")), -sig_key)
mat_e <- mat_e[, ord]; sig_mat <- sig_mat[, ord]; tmb_e <- tmb_e[ord]
subt_o <- factor(subt[ord], levels = c("iCS-1", "iCS-2", "iCS-3"))

set.seed(7301)
clust <- c("OO", "GC", "SC", "EC")
genes7 <- c("DDX4", "AMH", "COL1A2", "CDH5")
rows <- list()
for (cl in seq_along(clust)) {
  for (gn in seq_along(genes7)) {
    for (ag in seq_along(c("Y", "O"))) {
      base <- rnorm(24, mean = 2.2 + 0.4 * cl + 0.3 * gn, sd = 0.9)
      # marker gene: one cluster expresses high; old shifts up on the top marker
      if (gn == cl) base <- base + 2.3
      if (gn == 1 && cl == 1 && ag == 2) base <- base + 1.9
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        aging = c("Y", "O")[ag], cluster_short = clust[cl], gene = genes7[gn],
        expression = base, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
  }
}
dfc <- do.call(rbind, rows)
dfc$aging <- factor(dfc$aging, levels = c("Y", "O"))
dfc$cluster_short <- factor(dfc$cluster_short, levels = clust)
dfc$gene <- factor(dfc$gene, levels = genes7)
# gate: the DDX4/OO facet is significantly higher in Old (the designed effect)
sub <- dfc[dfc$gene == "DDX4" & dfc$cluster_short == "OO", ]
wt <- wilcox.test(expression ~ aging, data = sub)
stopifnot(wt$p.value < 0.01 &&
          mean(sub$expression[sub$aging == "O"]) > mean(sub$expression[sub$aging == "Y"]))

base_genes <- paste0("G", sprintf("%03d", 1:40))
mark_up <- c("ZP1", "BMP15", "GDF9")   # folliculogenesis genes rising with C1 -> C4
mark_dn <- c("WEE2", "AURKA", "DNMT3A")  # meiosis/methylation genes falling along it
genes <- c(base_genes, mark_up, mark_dn)
mu <- matrix(rnorm(length(genes) * n_cell, sd = 0.5), nrow = length(genes),
             dimnames = list(genes, paste0("cell", 1:n_cell)))
# 标记基因随发育梯度变化：整个矩阵即是
for (g in mark_up) mu[g, ] <- mu[g, ] + 3.6 * (prog / max(prog))
for (g in mark_dn) mu[g, ] <- mu[g, ] - 3.6 * (prog / max(prog))

# 主成分轴的符号是任意的：调向使上调组占据正载荷一侧

  mat[blk, grp == lab4[k]] <- mat[blk, grp == lab4[k]] + 3.2

                  rownames = sprintf("S%02d", 1:n_s))
# 可恢复性门槛：每个真实组的多数成员须落入同一簇
tb <- table(grp, dat$cluster)

var2 <- round(pa$sdev[2]^2 / sum(pa$sdev^2) * 100, 1)

for (k in levels(dat$cluster)) {

  hull_rows[[k]] <- data.frame(PC1 = d$PC1[hi], PC2 = d$PC2[hi],
                               cluster = factor(k, levels = levels(dat$cluster)))
}
hulls <- do.call(rbind, hull_rows)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(c(hulls$PC1, hulls$PC2))) && nrow(hulls) >= 12)
tag <- dat[!duplicated(dat$cluster), ]       # one labelled representative per cluster
tag <- tag[order(as.numeric(factor(tag$cluster))), ]

set.seed(3801)
grp2 <- factor(rep(c("BRCA", "OV", "LUSC"), each = 20))
expr_pg <- matrix(rnorm(30 * 60, 5, 1), 60, 30)
expr_pg[grp2 == "BRCA", 1:2] <- expr_pg[grp2 == "BRCA", 1:2] + 2.4
expr_pg[grp2 == "OV", 3:4] <- expr_pg[grp2 == "OV", 3:4] + 2.2
expr_pg[grp2 == "LUSC", 5] <- expr_pg[grp2 == "LUSC", 5] + 2.0
colnames(expr_pg) <- c("GATA3", "XBP1", "MUC1", "FOLR1", "KRT17",
                       paste0("G", sprintf("%02d", 6:30)))
pca_pg <- prcomp(expr_pg, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
pv_pg <- summary(pca_pg)$importance[2, ]
contrib <- rowSums(abs(pca_pg$rotation[, 1:2]) * pv_pg[1:2])
top_genes <- names(sort(contrib, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
scores_pg <- as.data.frame(pca_pg$x[, 1:2])
scores_pg$grp <- grp2

## nested covariance ellipses at two coverage levels
ell <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0.9, 0.95), function(pro) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(grp2), function(g) {
    d <- scores_pg[scores_pg$grp == g, 1:2]
    ctr <- colMeans(d); eg <- eigen(cov(d))
    ang <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 120)
    r <- sqrt(qchisq(pro, df = 2))
    data.frame(
      x = ctr[1] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[1, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[1, 2]),
      y = ctr[2] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[2, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[2, 2]),
      grp = g, pro = pro)
  }))
}))

sc_arrow <- max(abs(scores_pg[, 1:2])) * 0.32
load_top <- pca_pg$rotation[top_genes, 1:2]
load_top <- load_top / apply(abs(load_top), 1, max) * sc_arrow

ggplot(scores_pg, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = grp)) +

  geom_path(data = ell, aes(x, y, colour = grp, linetype = factor(pro)),

  geom_segment(data = as.data.frame(load_top),

            colour = "brown", size = 3.4, fontface = "bold", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("0.9" = 2, "0.95" = 1), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.0f%%)", 100 * pv_pg[1]),

       title = "PCA with top-3 loading arrows and 90/95% ellipses",

set.seed(1301)
mk_group <- function(n, r, offset) {
  age <- sample(20:70, n, replace = TRUE)
  dnam <- age * r + rnorm(n, sd = 12 * sqrt(1 - r^2)) + offset
  data.frame(age = age, dnam = pmax(dnam, 0))
}
norm <- mk_group(150, 0.90, 8)
tum <- mk_group(150, 0.55, 4)
norm$group <- "Normal"; tum$group <- "Tumour"
df_sc <- rbind(norm, tum)

test2cor <- function(x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  r1 <- cor(x1, y1); r2 <- cor(x2, y2)
  n1 <- length(x1); n2 <- length(x2)
  z1 <- atanh(r1); z2 <- atanh(r2)
  se <- sqrt(1/(n1 - 3) + 1/(n2 - 3))
  z <- (z1 - z2)/se
  p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))
  list(r1 = r1, r2 = r2, p = p)
}
cor_cmp <- test2cor(norm$age, norm$dnam, tum$age, tum$dnam)

ggplot(df_sc, aes(age, dnam, colour = group, size = abs(dnam - age))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Normal = "#2874C5", Tumour = "#B2182B")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 4), name = "|age − DNAmAge|") +
  labs(title = sprintf("Normal r = %.2f vs Tumour r = %.2f (Fisher z p %s)",
       cor_cmp$r1, cor_cmp$r2,
       ifelse(cor_cmp$p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", cor_cmp$p))),
       x = "Chronological age", y = "DNAm age", colour = NULL) +

  theme(legend.position = "top")

make_tri <- function(i, j, upper) {
  x0 <- j - 0.5; y0 <- i - 0.5
  if (upper) data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 0, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 1, 1))   # upper-left triangle
  else data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 1, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 0, 1))         # lower-right triangle
}

}))

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors <- list(Cluster = c(C1 = "#B31E22", C2 = "#529B40", C3 = "#020105"))
ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         annotation_legend = FALSE,          # legends crowd out the body otherwise
         show_colnames = FALSE,              # 30 sample names would overprint
         cutree_cols = 3,
         legend_breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
         legend_labels = c("mRNA\ndown-regulation", "mRNA\nno-change", "mRNA\nup-regulation"),
         fontsize_row = 8)

expr_p[5:8, grade_v == "G4"] <- expr_p[5:8, grade_v == "G4"] - 1.2

## one Kruskal-Wallis per gene, BH-adjusted (the reference's cross_subtype_compr)

  col = list(`KW P (BH)` = p_col),

subtypes <- c("LumA", "LumB", "Basal")

n_samp <- length(subtypes) * n_per
sub_lab <- factor(rep(subtypes, each = n_per), levels = subtypes)
base <- matrix(rnorm(50 * n_samp, sd = 0.6), 50, n_samp,
               dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_samp))))
sig_blocks <- list(
  LumA  = list(up = 1:10,  dn = NULL,  eff = 1.1),
  LumB  = list(up = 11:20, dn = NULL,  eff = 1.2),
  Basal = list(up = 21:30, dn = 31:40, eff = 1.3))
for (st in subtypes) {
  idx <- which(sub_lab == st)
  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
}
## proliferation genes: high in LumB only
base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] <- base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] + 1.2

## nearest-centroid classification from a training split (SSP stand-in)
train <- c(TRUE, FALSE)[rep(1:2, length.out = n_samp)]
cent <- sapply(subtypes, function(st) rowMeans(base[, train & sub_lab == st]))
pred <- apply(base[, !train], 2, function(x) {
  corrs <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(cent)), function(k) cor(x, cent[, k]))
  subtypes[which.max(corrs)] })
pred <- factor(pred, levels = subtypes)
cat("held-out accuracy:", round(mean(pred == sub_lab[!train]), 2), "\n")

sig_scores <- rbind(
  `AR score`  = colMeans(base[21:30, ]) - colMeans(base[31:40, ]),  # Basal-high
  `Prolif score` = colMeans(base[41:50, ]))                          # LumB-high
pheno <- ifelse(sig_scores["AR score", ] > 0, "AR-high", "AR-low")

gene_r <- paste0("MMP", sprintf("%02d", 1:24))

logfc_r <- matrix(rnorm(24 * 8, sd = 1.5), 24, 8,
                  dimnames = list(gene_r, cancer_r))
logfc_r[1:6, ] <- logfc_r[1:6, ] + 1.8      # up-regulated block
logfc_r[7:12, ] <- logfc_r[7:12, ] - 1.8    # down-regulated block
## explicit P-value design: strong bands significant, weak genes mostly not
p_low <- ifelse(runif(24 * 8) < 0.25, runif(24 * 8, 1e-3, 0.045),
                                       runif(24 * 8, 0.06, 0.9))
pval_r <- ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 2, runif(24 * 8, 1e-8, 1e-3),
          ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 1, runif(24 * 8, 1e-4, 0.04), p_low))
gene_type <- rep(c("Collagen-binding", "Membrane-type", "Gelatin-binding",
                   "Secreted", "Matrisome", "Other"),
                 each = 4)

## bin into 5 fold-change bands; P >= 0.05 overrides to a 6th (white) band
logfc_cat <- apply(logfc_r, 2, function(x)
  cut(x, breaks = c(-Inf, -2, -1, 1, 2, Inf),
      labels = c("< -2", "-2 - -1", "-1 - 1", "1 - 2", "> 2")))
rownames(logfc_cat) <- gene_r
logfc_cat[pval_r >= 0.05] <- "P >= 0.05"

             "-2 - -1" = "#6B9AB7", "< -2" = "#2F5B89", "P >= 0.05" = "white")

  dark <- logfc_cat[i, j] %in% c("> 2", "1 - 2", "< -2", "-2 - -1")
  val <- logfc_r[i, j]; if (abs(val) < 0.05) val <- 0
  grid::grid.text(sprintf("%.1f", val), x, y,
                  gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8,
                                  col = if (dark) "white" else "black"))
}

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation

mut_types <- c("Missense", "Nonsense", "Frameshift", "Splice_Site", "In_Frame")
type_p <- c(.58, .14, .12, .08, .08)

mutations <- map_dfr(seq_along(samples), function(i) {
  p <- if (cohort[i] == "Subtype A") p_a else p_b
  hit <- genes[runif(length(genes)) < p]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NULL)
  type <- sample(mut_types, length(hit), replace = TRUE, prob = type_p)
  # Tumor suppressors such as TP53 can receive a second hit, shown as Multi_Hit
  if (runif(1) < .15 && "TP53" %in% hit) {
    type[hit == "TP53"] <- "Multi_Hit"
  }
  tibble(sample = samples[i], gene = hit, type = type)
})

    baf = case_when(

n_gene <- 50
genes <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%04d", 1:n_gene))

mk <- function(n, stage) {
  stage_z <- switch(stage, normal = 0, fibrosis = 0.8, dysplasia = 1.6, hcc = 2.5)
  sweep(t(matrix(rnorm(n_gene * n, sd = 1), nrow = n_gene)), 2,
        stage_z * c(rep(1, 15), rep(-1, 15), rep(0.3, 20)), "+")
}

train_expr <- rbind(mk(50, "normal"), mk(50, "hcc"))
train_lab  <- factor(rep(c("control", "tumour"), each = 50),
                     levels = c("control", "tumour"))
colnames(train_expr) <- paste0("TR_", sprintf("%04d", 1:n_gene))

stages <- c("Normal", "Fibrosis", "Dysplasia", "HCC")
val_expr <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stages, function(st) mk(30, tolower(st))))
val_lab  <- factor(rep(stages, each = 30), levels = stages)
colnames(val_expr) <- paste0("VA_", sprintf("%04d", 1:n_gene))

## Elastic-net logistic on the training split (the reference uses random
## forest; cv.glmnet handles p > n and avoids perfect separation)
## glm with . uses column names; val_expr columns differ, so extract
## coefficients and score manually (equivalent to predict type="response")
## A signature-score TI is more robust than an overfit glm for p ~ n:
## up-gene mean minus down-gene mean (the reference's random forest gives
## the same ordering; glmnet::cv.glmnet is the regularised alternative)
sig_up <- 1:15; sig_down <- 16:30
TI <- function(expr_mat) rowMeans(expr_mat[, sig_up]) - rowMeans(expr_mat[, sig_down])

val_df <- data.frame(stage = val_lab, TI = TI(val_expr))
head(val_df, 3)

p_kw <- kruskal.test(TI ~ stage, data = val_df)$p.value

ggplot(val_df, aes(stage, TI, fill = stage)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label.y = max(val_df$TI) + 0.06) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Normal = "#4D4D4D", Fibrosis = "#445EAD",
                               Dysplasia = "#EABF00", HCC = "#B2182B")) +
  labs(x = "Pathological stage", y = "Tumor index (mean of up genes − mean of down genes)",
       fill = "Stage") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"))

set.seed(2101)
major <- c("Group A", "Group B", "Group C")
subgrp <- list(c("A1", "A2", "A3"), c("B1", "B2"), c("C1", "C2", "C3"))
base_col <- c("Group A" = "#2874C5", "Group B" = "#B2182B", "Group C" = "#4D9342")

df_b <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(major), function(k) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(subgrp[[k]]), function(j) {
    n <- 25
    val <- rnorm(n, mean = 20 + k * 8 + j * 2, sd = 5)
    data.frame(major = major[k], subgroup = subgrp[[k]][j], value = val)
  }))
}))
summ_b <- df_b |>
  group_by(major, subgroup) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(value), se = sd(value) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

major_of <- setNames(rep(major, sapply(subgrp, length)), unlist(subgrp))
summ_b$major_col <- base_col[major_of[summ_b$subgroup]]
# lighter shades for subgroup index within each major group
shade_fac <- c(0.5, 0.75, 1.0)
summ_b$idx <- as.integer(factor(summ_b$subgroup, levels = unlist(subgrp)))
summ_b$shade <- shade_fac[summ_b$idx]

subgroup_cols <- c(
  "A1" = "#7BA7D6", "A2" = "#5288CC", "A3" = "#2874C5",
  "B1" = "#CE6B6B", "B2" = "#B2182B",
  "C1" = "#7BC17B", "C2" = "#4D9342", "C3" = "#3D7A35")

ggplot(summ_b, aes(subgroup, mean, fill = subgroup)) +

  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = subgroup_cols) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean ± SE") +

set.seed(2900)
clusters <- paste0("C", 1:8)
p0 <- c(0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.11, 0.10, 0.10, 0.09)
# KO proportions: unaffected clusters keep p0 exactly; only C2/C6/C8 are reallocated
p_ko <- p0
p_ko[2] <- 0.05; p_ko[6] <- 0.22; p_ko[8] <- 0.08
stopifnot(abs(sum(p_ko) - 1) < 1e-12)
n_wt <- 900; n_ko <- 900
mk_cells <- function(n, p, grp) {
  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}
cellinfo <- rbind(mk_cells(n_wt, p0, "WT"), mk_cells(n_ko, p_ko, "KO"))
cellinfo$cluster <- factor(cellinfo$cluster, levels = clusters)

tbl <- table(cellinfo$cluster, cellinfo$group)
ft <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
post <- rstatix::row_wise_fisher_test(tbl)

cell.col <- c(WT = "#1A63A8", KO = "#FC6910")
prop_df <- as.data.frame(tbl, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(prop_df) <- c("cluster", "group", "n")
prop_df$cluster <- factor(prop_df$cluster, levels = clusters)
prop_df$group <- factor(prop_df$group, levels = c("WT", "KO"))
sig_df <- as.data.frame(post)
sig_df$cluster <- factor(sig_df$group, levels = clusters)
sig_df$lab <- ifelse(sig_df$p.adj.signif == "ns", "", sig_df$p.adj.signif)

ggplot(prop_df, aes(cluster, n, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.72,
           colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = sig_df, aes(x = cluster, y = 1.05, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.4, colour = "grey10") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell.col, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), labels = scales::percent,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Fraction of cells",
       title = "Cell-type composition per cluster (KO vs WT)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(size = 11))

# same cells as the chunk above, now split by sequencing run
ggplot(cellinfo, aes(run, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.85, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~cluster, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell.col, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.5), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Replicate", y = "Fraction of cells") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +

## One gene with eight exons and three isoforms. Transcript coordinates are the
## exons concatenated with a fixed 30 bp gap; the same exon therefore has a
## different coordinate in every isoform.
exons <- data.frame(
  exon = 1:8,
  gstart = c(100, 500, 800, 1100, 1500, 1900, 2300, 2700),
  gend   = c(300, 620, 900, 1250, 1600, 2000, 2450, 2900)
)
tx <- list(T1 = 1:8, T2 = c(1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8), T3 = c(1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8))
gap <- 30

tx_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tx), function(t) {
  ids <- tx[[t]]
  e <- exons[match(ids, exons$exon), ]
  e$x0 <- cumsum(c(0, (e$gend - e$gstart + gap)[-nrow(e)]))
  e$x1 <- e$x0 + (e$gend - e$gstart)
  e$tx <- t
  e
}))
tx_tab$y <- as.numeric(factor(tx_tab$tx, levels = names(tx)))

## Coverage in each transcript's own coordinates. In genomic coordinates the
## same reads would be forced onto one axis and the isoform-specific peaks
## would overlap.
cov_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tx), function(t) {
  e <- tx_tab |> filter(tx == t)
  p <- seq(0, max(e$x1), by = 5)
  inside <- sapply(p, function(x) any(x >= e$x0 & x <= e$x1))
  peak_at <- mean(e$x0[e$exon %in% c(1, 4)])
  sig <- ifelse(inside, 0.35, 0.05) +
    0.9 * exp(-((p - peak_at)^2) / (2 * 180^2)) +
    rnorm(length(p), 0, 0.03)
  data.frame(tx = t, pos = p, cov = pmax(sig, 0), y = unique(e$y))
}))
cov_tab <- cov_tab |> group_by(tx) |> mutate(cov = cov / max(cov) * 0.62) |> ungroup()

# Hazard ratio of the test vs standard arm within a subset of patients
sub_haz <- function(df) {
  fit <- coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ trt, data = df)
  s <- summary(fit)
  c(est = unname(s$coefficients["trt", "exp(coef)"]),
    lo  = unname(s$conf.int["trt", "lower .95"]),
    hi  = unname(s$conf.int["trt", "upper .95"]),
    n   = nrow(df),
    p   = unname(s$coefficients["trt", "Pr(>|z|)"]))
}

# Interaction p-value per subgroup variable: likelihood-ratio test of
# Cox(Surv ~ trt) vs Cox(Surv ~ trt * subgroup)
int_p <- function(var) {
  a <- anova(coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ trt, data = vet),
             coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(time, status) ~ trt *", var)), data = vet))
  unname(a[2, "Pr(>|Chi|)"])
}

subgroups <- data.frame(
  label  = c("Age", "Karnofsky score", "Prior therapy", "Histology"),
  column = c("Age", "Karnofsky", "PriorTx", "Histology"),

)

add_row <- function(name, est = NA_real_, lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_,
                    n = NA_real_, p = NA_real_) {
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(Subgroup = name, est = est, lo = lo, hi = hi,
                                          n = n, p = p, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

    rr <- sub_haz(vet[vet[[v]] == l, ])
    add_row(paste0("   ", l), rr[["est"]], rr[["lo"]], rr[["hi"]], rr[["n"]], rr[["p"]])
  }
  hdr_p <- c(hdr_p, int_p(v))
}

set.seed(2026)

n <- 120
# Right-skewed biomarker concentrations, as tumor markers typically are
true_conc <- rgamma(n, shape = 2, scale = 20)

method_data <- data.frame(
  ref = true_conc * (1 + rnorm(n, 0, 0.05)),      # reference method, ~5% CV
  new = true_conc * (1 + rnorm(n, 0.06, 0.09))    # new method: +6% proportional bias, ~9% CV
) |>
  mutate(
    avg  = (ref + new) / 2,   # best available estimate of the true value
    diff = ref - new          # reference minus new
  )

head(method_data)

r <- cor(method_data$ref, method_data$new)

ggplot(method_data, aes(x = ref, y = new)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2166AC", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = max(method_data$ref) * 0.72, y = min(method_data$new) * 1.6,
           label = sprintf("Pearson r = %.2f", r), size = 4.2) +
  labs(x = "Reference method (mg/L)", y = "New method (mg/L)",
       title = "High correlation does not imply agreement")

bias    <- mean(method_data$diff)
sd_diff <- sd(method_data$diff)
loa     <- c(bias - 1.96 * sd_diff, bias + 1.96 * sd_diff)
n       <- nrow(method_data)

# Exact standard errors (Bland & Altman 1986): the limits are estimated
# quantities and carry their own uncertainty, especially in small samples.
se_bias <- sd_diff / sqrt(n)
se_loa  <- sqrt(sd_diff^2 * (1 / n + 1.96^2 / (2 * (n - 1))))

ggplot(method_data, aes(x = avg, y = diff)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2166AC", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = bias - 1.96 * se_bias, ymax = bias + 1.96 * se_bias),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = bias, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = loa, color = "#B2182B", linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = max(method_data$avg), y = bias, vjust = -1, hjust = 1,
           label = sprintf("Bias = %.2f", bias), size = 3.6) +
  annotate("text", x = max(method_data$avg), y = loa[2], vjust = -0.8, hjust = 1,
           label = sprintf("+1.96 SD = %.2f", loa[2]), size = 3.6, color = "#B2182B") +
  annotate("text", x = max(method_data$avg), y = loa[1], vjust = 1.7, hjust = 1,
           label = sprintf("-1.96 SD = %.2f", loa[1]), size = 3.6, color = "#B2182B") +
  labs(x = "Mean of both methods (mg/L)", y = "Difference (Reference − New)",
       title = "Bland-Altman plot with 95% limits of agreement")

                        right = FALSE,
                        labels = time_labels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(group, time_interval) %>%
  summarise(
    n_risk = ifelse(all(is.na(n.risk)), 0, max(n.risk, na.rm = TRUE)),  # Take the maximum number of people at risk within the interval
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(group, time_interval, fill = list(n_risk = 0)) %>%
  # 4. Added total row (fixed syntax)
  bind_rows(
    group_by(., group) %>%
      summarise(
        time_interval = "Total",
        n_risk = sum(n_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

g_expr[, 1] <- g_expr[, 1] + (svdata$futime < quantile(svdata$futime, 0.45)) * 2.2
g_expr[, 3] <- g_expr[, 3] - (svdata$futime < quantile(svdata$futime, 0.45)) * 2.0
svdata <- cbind(svdata, as.data.frame(g_expr))

res.cut <- surv_cutpoint(svdata, time = "futime", event = "fustat",
                         variables = paste0("GENE", 1:8), minprop = 0.3)
res.cat <- surv_categorize(res.cut)
cuts <- summary(res.cut)$cutpoint

my.surv <- with(res.cat, Surv(futime, fustat))
pl <- list()
for (i in paste0("GENE", 1:8)) {
  group <- factor(res.cat[[i]], levels = c("low", "high"))
  sd1 <- survdiff(my.surv ~ group)
  p.val <- 1 - pchisq(sd1$chisq, length(sd1$n) - 1)
  HR <- (sd1$obs[2] / sd1$exp[2]) / (sd1$obs[1] / sd1$exp[1])
  up95 <- exp(log(HR) + qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(1 / sd1$exp[2] + 1 / sd1$exp[1]))
  low95 <- exp(log(HR) - qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(1 / sd1$exp[2] + 1 / sd1$exp[1]))
  if (p.val > 0.05) next
  fit <- survfit(my.surv ~ group)
  svsort <- svdata[order(svdata[, i]), ]
  pl[[i]] <- ggsurvplot(fit, data = data.frame(group = group),
                        conf.int = FALSE, censor = FALSE,
                        palette = c("#D95F02", "#1B9E77"),
                        legend.title = i,
                        legend.labs = c(paste0("high >", round(svsort[fit$n[2], i], 2), " (n=", fit$n[1], ")"),
                                        paste0("low  <=", round(svsort[fit$n[2], i], 2), " (n=", fit$n[2], ")")),
                        pval = paste(ifelse(p.val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", round(p.val, 3))),
                                     paste0("HR = ", round(HR, 2)),
                                     paste0("95% CI: ", round(low95, 2), "-", round(up95, 2)), sep = "\n"))
}
patchwork::wrap_plots(lapply(pl, function(x) x$plot), ncol = 2, guides = "collect")

pvals <- c(); hrs <- c()
for (n in 1:(nrow(sortsv) - 1)) {

  d1 <- survdiff(Surv(futime, fustat) ~ gp, data = sortsv, rho = 0)
  pvals <- c(pvals, pchisq(d1$chisq, length(d1$n) - 1, lower.tail = FALSE))
  hrs <- c(hrs, d1$obs[1] * d1$exp[2] / (d1$obs[2] * d1$exp[1]))
}
fd <- data.frame(Tag = 1:(nrow(sortsv) - 1), HR = hrs, Pvalue = pvals)

  geom_point(shape = 21, aes(fill = Tag), colour = "grey25", size = 2.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#4477AA", "#77AADD", "#FFFFFF", "#EE9988", "#BB4444"),

  annotate("text", x = log2(hrs[best]), y = -log10(pvals[best]) + 0.6,
           label = "min-P split", size = 3.2, colour = "#BB4444") +
  geom_point(data = fd[best, ], aes(log2(HR), -log10(Pvalue)),
             shape = 21, fill = "#BB4444", colour = "black", size = 3.4) +
  labs(x = "log2 hazard ratio at each split",

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

# Generate quantile breakpoints (automatically adapt to data distribution)

                          probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), 
                          na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  unique()  # Ensure breakpoints are unique

# How to correctly generate interval labels
time_labels <- paste0(
  round(custom_breaks[-length(custom_breaks)]),  # Starting point (excluding the last one)
  "-",
  round(custom_breaks[-1])  # End point (excluding the first one)
)

# Generate segmented risk table data --------------------------------------------------------
risk_table_segmented <- surv_curve %>%
  mutate(
    time_interval = cut(time,
                        breaks = custom_breaks,
                        include.lowest = TRUE,
                        right = FALSE,
                        labels = time_labels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(group, time_interval) %>%
  summarise(
    n_risk = ifelse(all(is.na(n.risk)), 0, max(n.risk, na.rm = TRUE)),  # Take the maximum number of people at risk within the interval
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(group, time_interval, fill = list(n_risk = 0)) %>%
  # 4. Added total row (fixed syntax)
  bind_rows(
    group_by(., group) %>%
      summarise(
        time_interval = "Total",
        n_risk = sum(n_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Treatment", "Placebo")),
    time_interval = factor(time_interval, levels = c(time_labels, "Total") )
  )

set.seed(4302)
n_gene <- 60; n_s <- 90
genes <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%03d", 1:n_gene))
truth <- sample(n_gene, 12)                    # genes with real prognostic signal

# build one cohort: signal genes carry a class effect, noise genes do not
mk_cohort <- function(coef, sd, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  ex <- matrix(rnorm(n_gene * n_s), n_gene)
  cls <- sample(0:1, n_s, replace = TRUE)
  ex[truth, ] <- sweep(ex[truth, ], 2, cls * coef, `+`)
  ex <- ex + rnorm(n_gene * n_s, sd = sd)
  list(ex = ex, cls = cls)
}
c1 <- mk_cohort(1.3, 0.7, 4302)
c2 <- mk_cohort(1.1, 0.8, 4402)

# AUC via the Mann-Whitney rank statistic (equivalent to pROC::roc()$auc)
auc_of <- function(ex, cls) apply(ex, 1, function(g) {
  pos <- g[cls == 1]; neg <- g[cls == 0]
  u <- sum(sapply(pos, function(p) sum(neg < p) + 0.5 * sum(neg == p)))
  u / (length(pos) * length(neg))
})
auc1 <- auc_of(c1$ex, c1$cls); auc2 <- auc_of(c2$ex, c2$cls)
auc_df <- data.frame(gene = genes, auc1 = auc1, auc2 = auc2)

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors <- list(Cluster = c(C1 = "#B31E22", C2 = "#529B40", C3 = "#020105"))
ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         annotation_legend = FALSE,          # legends crowd out the body otherwise
         show_colnames = FALSE,              # 30 sample names would overprint
         cutree_cols = 3,
         legend_breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
         legend_labels = c("mRNA\ndown-regulation", "mRNA\nno-change", "mRNA\nup-regulation"),
         fontsize_row = 8)

               dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_samp))))
sig_blocks <- list(
  LumA  = list(up = 1:10,  dn = NULL,  eff = 1.1),
  LumB  = list(up = 11:20, dn = NULL,  eff = 1.2),
  Basal = list(up = 21:30, dn = 31:40, eff = 1.3))
for (st in subtypes) {
  idx <- which(sub_lab == st)
  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
}
## proliferation genes: high in LumB only

  corrs <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(cent)), function(k) cor(x, cent[, k]))

# 2.1 GO Enrichment Analysis (Get BP/CC/MF simultaneously)

  OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db,

)

# Extract GO results (Rename ONTOLOGY to Category)

  select(Category = ONTOLOGY, Description, p.adjust, Count, geneID)

# Extract KEGG results (Manually add Category column and assign as "KEGG")
df_kegg <- as.data.frame(ekegg) %>% 
  mutate(Category = "KEGG") %>% 
  select(Category, Description, p.adjust, Count, geneID)

  mutate(Category = case_when(

    grepl("MF_DIRECT", Category) ~ "MF",
    grepl("KEGG_PATHWAY", Category) ~ "KEGG",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  # Keep only GO and KEGG results
  filter(Category %in% c("BP", "CC", "MF", "KEGG")) %>%
  
  # 2.2 Clean Pathway Names (Remove IDs, e.g., "GO:001~Name" -> "Name")
  mutate(Description = sub("^.*~|.*:", "", Term)) %>%
  
  # 2.3 Rename Columns (Unified variable names for plotting code)
  # FDR -> p.adjust (Significance)
  # Genes -> geneID (Gene List)
  rename(
    p.adjust = FDR,
    geneID = Genes
  ) %>%
  
  # 2.4 Format Gene Lists (Replace commas with slashes)
  mutate(geneID = gsub(", ", "/", geneID))

subtype <- factor(rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = n_s / 3),
                  levels = c("A", "B", "C"))

# signature-A genes (up in subtype A) and signature-B genes (up in subtype C)
exprA <- matrix(rnorm(12 * n_s, sd = 0.6), 12)
exprB <- matrix(rnorm(12 * n_s, sd = 0.6), 12)
exprA[, subtype == "A"] <- exprA[, subtype == "A"] + 1.6
exprB[, subtype == "C"] <- exprB[, subtype == "C"] + 1.6

# z-score per gene (rows = genes), then PC1 of each signature
exprA <- t(scale(t(exprA)))
exprB <- t(scale(t(exprB)))
pcA <- prcomp(t(exprA), scale. = FALSE)$x[, 1]
pcB <- prcomp(t(exprB), scale. = FALSE)$x[, 1]

score <- pcA - pcB
# PC1 sign is arbitrary; orient so the A-signature subtype scores highest
if (median(score[subtype == "A"]) < median(score[subtype == "C"])) score <- -score
score_df <- data.frame(subtype = subtype, score = score)
p_kw <- kruskal.test(score ~ subtype, data = score_df)$p.value

  geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),

  labs(title = sprintf("Signature score by subtype (Kruskal-Wallis %s)",

library(patchwork)
set.seed(6101)
subtypes <- c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4")
n_cell <- 120
cls <- rep(subtypes, each = n_cell / 4)
prog <- as.numeric(factor(cls, levels = subtypes))      # differentiation score 1..4
base_genes <- paste0("G", sprintf("%03d", 1:40))
mark_up <- c("ZP1", "BMP15", "GDF9")   # folliculogenesis genes rising with C1 -> C4
mark_dn <- c("WEE2", "AURKA", "DNMT3A")  # meiosis/methylation genes falling along it
genes <- c(base_genes, mark_up, mark_dn)
mu <- matrix(rnorm(length(genes) * n_cell, sd = 0.5), nrow = length(genes),
             dimnames = list(genes, paste0("cell", 1:n_cell)))
# 标记基因随发育梯度变化：整个矩阵即是
for (g in mark_up) mu[g, ] <- mu[g, ] + 3.6 * (prog / max(prog))
for (g in mark_dn) mu[g, ] <- mu[g, ] - 3.6 * (prog / max(prog))
pc <- prcomp(t(mu), scale. = TRUE)
score <- pc$x[, 1]; load1 <- pc$rotation[, 1]
# 主成分轴的符号是任意的：调向使上调组占据正载荷一侧
if (mean(load1[mark_up]) < mean(load1[mark_dn])) { load1 <- -load1; score <- -score }
stopifnot(min(load1[mark_up]) > max(load1[mark_dn]))
var_pct <- round(pc$sdev^2 / sum(pc$sdev^2) * 100, 1)
df_cells <- data.frame(PC1 = score, PC2 = pc$x[, 2], subtype = cls)
p_a <- ggplot(df_cells, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = subtype)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(C1 = "#8E3189", C2 = "#4C72B4", C3 = "#85B846", C4 = "#C64941")) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var_pct[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", var_pct[2], "%)")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
df_genes <- rbind(data.frame(gene = mark_up, load = load1[mark_up], set = "up"),
                  data.frame(gene = mark_dn, load = load1[mark_dn], set = "down"))
p_b <- ggplot(df_genes, aes(load, reorder(gene, load))) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = 0), colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = set), size = 3.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(up = "#B2182B", down = "#2166AC"), guide = "none") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "PC1 loading", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
print(p_a + p_b + plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect"))

      grp = g, pro = pro)

hoslem_p <- function(y, p, g = 10) {
  brk <- unique(quantile(p, seq(0, 1, length.out = g + 1)))
  grp <- cut(p, breaks = brk, include.lowest = TRUE)
  obs <- tapply(y, grp, sum)
  expd <- tapply(p, grp, sum)
  nn <- tapply(y, grp, length)
  chi <- sum((obs - expd)^2 / (expd * (1 - expd / nn)))
  pchisq(chi, df = length(levels(grp)) - 2, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

n <- 600

# GiViTI 路线：分箱观测率、加权多项式、前向选择阶数
fit_giviti <- function(xv, yv, nbins = 14, maxDeg = 3, thres = 0.05) {
  br <- unique(quantile(xv, seq(0, 1, length.out = nbins + 1)))
  bi <- as.integer(cut(xv, br, include.lowest = TRUE))
  bx <- tapply(xv, bi, mean); by <- tapply(yv, bi, mean); bw <- tapply(yv, bi, length)
  keep <- !is.na(bx) & bw >= 8
  bx <- bx[keep]; by <- by[keep]; bw <- bw[keep]
  best <- 1
  for (d in 2:maxDeg) {   # forward selection: keep the extra term if it pays off
    f0 <- lm(by ~ poly(bx, best, raw = TRUE), weights = bw)
    f1 <- lm(by ~ poly(bx, d, raw = TRUE), weights = bw)
    pv <- tryCatch(anova(f0, f1)[["Pr(>F)"]][2], error = function(e) NA)
    if (!is.na(pv) && pv < thres) best <- d else break
  }
  list(deg = best, coef = coef(lm(by ~ poly(bx, best, raw = TRUE), weights = bw)))
}
eval_curve <- function(cf, gridv) {
  d <- length(cf) - 1
  as.numeric(outer(gridv, 0:d, `^`) %*% cf)
}
gf <- fit_giviti(pred, obs)
grid <- seq(quantile(pred, 0.02), quantile(pred, 0.98), length.out = 60)
m <- eval_curve(gf$coef, grid)
# bootstrap 重抽按相同阶数重拟合，否则带内混入选择噪声
boot <- matrix(NA, nrow = 400, ncol = length(grid))
for (b in seq_len(400)) {
  ii <- sample.int(n, replace = TRUE)
  gb <- tryCatch(fit_giviti(pred[ii], obs[ii], maxDeg = gf$deg), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(gb) && gb$deg == gf$deg) boot[b, ] <- eval_curve(gb$coef, grid)
}
lo80 <- apply(boot, 2, quantile, probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)
lo95 <- apply(boot, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
ok <- complete.cases(cbind(m, lo80, lo95)) & m > -0.02 & m < 1.02
m <- m[ok]; lo80 <- lo80[ok]; lo95 <- lo95[ok]; grid_ <- grid[ok]
# 校准带合理性：带居拟合之下；对恒等线的偏差给出 bootstrap p
boot_dev <- rowMeans(abs(boot[, ok, drop = FALSE] -
              matrix(grid_, nrow = 400, ncol = sum(ok), byrow = TRUE)), na.rm = TRUE)
obs_dev <- mean(abs(m - grid_))
pval <- mean(boot_dev >= obs_dev, na.rm = TRUE)
stopifnot(obs_dev < 0.05)
dfb <- data.frame(pred = grid_, fit = m, lo80 = lo80, lo95 = lo95)
ggplot() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey45", linetype = 2) +
  geom_ribbon(data = dfb, aes(pred, ymin = lo95, ymax = fit), fill = "#B2182B", alpha = 0.16) +
  geom_ribbon(data = dfb, aes(pred, ymin = lo80, ymax = fit), fill = "#B2182B", alpha = 0.34) +
  geom_line(data = dfb, aes(pred, fit), colour = "#8A1B24", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Predicted probability", y = "Observed event rate",
       title = "GiViTI-style calibration belt (inner 80%, outer 95% one-sided bands)",
       subtitle = paste0("mean |f(x) - x| = ", round(obs_dev, 3),
                         ", bootstrap p = ", round(pval, 3),
                         ", selected degree = ", gf$deg)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

library(patchwork)
set.seed(6101)
subtypes <- c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4")
n_cell <- 120
cls <- rep(subtypes, each = n_cell / 4)
prog <- as.numeric(factor(cls, levels = subtypes))      # differentiation score 1..4
base_genes <- paste0("G", sprintf("%03d", 1:40))
mark_up <- c("ZP1", "BMP15", "GDF9")   # folliculogenesis genes rising with C1 -> C4
mark_dn <- c("WEE2", "AURKA", "DNMT3A")  # meiosis/methylation genes falling along it
genes <- c(base_genes, mark_up, mark_dn)
mu <- matrix(rnorm(length(genes) * n_cell, sd = 0.5), nrow = length(genes),
             dimnames = list(genes, paste0("cell", 1:n_cell)))
# 标记基因随发育梯度变化：整个矩阵即是
for (g in mark_up) mu[g, ] <- mu[g, ] + 3.6 * (prog / max(prog))
for (g in mark_dn) mu[g, ] <- mu[g, ] - 3.6 * (prog / max(prog))
pc <- prcomp(t(mu), scale. = TRUE)
score <- pc$x[, 1]; load1 <- pc$rotation[, 1]
# 主成分轴的符号是任意的：调向使上调组占据正载荷一侧
if (mean(load1[mark_up]) < mean(load1[mark_dn])) { load1 <- -load1; score <- -score }
stopifnot(min(load1[mark_up]) > max(load1[mark_dn]))
var_pct <- round(pc$sdev^2 / sum(pc$sdev^2) * 100, 1)
df_cells <- data.frame(PC1 = score, PC2 = pc$x[, 2], subtype = cls)

  geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.8) +

  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var_pct[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", var_pct[2], "%)")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
df_genes <- rbind(data.frame(gene = mark_up, load = load1[mark_up], set = "up"),
                  data.frame(gene = mark_dn, load = load1[mark_dn], set = "down"))
p_b <- ggplot(df_genes, aes(load, reorder(gene, load))) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = 0), colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = set), size = 3.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(up = "#B2182B", down = "#2166AC"), guide = "none") +

## nested covariance ellipses at two coverage levels
ell <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0.9, 0.95), function(pro) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(grp2), function(g) {
    d <- scores_pg[scores_pg$grp == g, 1:2]
    ctr <- colMeans(d); eg <- eigen(cov(d))
    ang <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 120)
    r <- sqrt(qchisq(pro, df = 2))
    data.frame(
      x = ctr[1] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[1, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[1, 2]),
      y = ctr[2] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[2, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[2, 2]),
      grp = g, pro = pro)
  }))
}))

  p <- if (cohort[i] == "Subtype A") p_a else p_b
  hit <- genes[runif(length(genes)) < p]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NULL)
  type <- sample(mut_types, length(hit), replace = TRUE, prob = type_p)

  if (runif(1) < .15 && "TP53" %in% hit) {

})

data(lung, package = "survival")

lung2 <- lung %>%
  filter(complete.cases(age, sex, ph.ecog, ph.karno, pat.karno, meal.cal, wt.loss)) %>%
  mutate(y1y = as.integer(time < 365 & status == 2))  # death within 365 days
  # Caveat: patients censored before day 365 are counted as non-events; for
  # real analyses prefer restricting to >=365 days of follow-up or using
  # censoring-aware methods (cf. the time-dependent ROC below).

cat("Patients:", nrow(lung2), " 1-year deaths:", sum(lung2$y1y), "\n")

# Two logistic models for 1-year mortality
m_full   <- glm(y1y ~ age + sex + ph.ecog + meal.cal + wt.loss,
                data = lung2, family = binomial)
m_simple <- glm(y1y ~ ph.ecog, data = lung2, family = binomial)

# A continuous risk score from a Cox model (used for time-dependent ROC)
cph0 <- coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex + ph.ecog + wt.loss, data = lung2)
lung2$risk_score <- as.numeric(predict(cph0, type = "risk"))

lung2$risk_ecog <- fitted(m_simple)

roc_full <- roc(lung2$y1y, fitted(m_full), quiet = TRUE)
set.seed(2026)  # keep the bootstrap CI reproducible across renders

     main = sprintf("ROC curve (AUC = %.2f, 95%% CI %.2f-%.2f)",
                    as.numeric(auc(roc_full)),
                    ci_full[1], ci_full[3]))

roc_test <- roc.test(roc_full, roc_simple, method = "delong")

  cvfit <- cv.glmnet(x_mat, surv_obj, nfolds = 10, alpha = 1, family = "cox")
  r <- as.matrix(coef(cvfit, s = "lambda.min"))
  rownames(r)[r != 0]
}

# build one cohort: signal genes carry a class effect, noise genes do not
mk_cohort <- function(coef, sd, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  ex <- matrix(rnorm(n_gene * n_s), n_gene)
  cls <- sample(0:1, n_s, replace = TRUE)
  ex[truth, ] <- sweep(ex[truth, ], 2, cls * coef, `+`)
  ex <- ex + rnorm(n_gene * n_s, sd = sd)
  list(ex = ex, cls = cls)
}
c1 <- mk_cohort(1.3, 0.7, 4302)
c2 <- mk_cohort(1.1, 0.8, 4402)

# AUC via the Mann-Whitney rank statistic (equivalent to pROC::roc()$auc)
auc_of <- function(ex, cls) apply(ex, 1, function(g) {
  pos <- g[cls == 1]; neg <- g[cls == 0]
  u <- sum(sapply(pos, function(p) sum(neg < p) + 0.5 * sum(neg == p)))
  u / (length(pos) * length(neg))
})
auc1 <- auc_of(c1$ex, c1$cls); auc2 <- auc_of(c2$ex, c2$cls)
auc_df <- data.frame(gene = genes, auc1 = auc1, auc2 = auc2)

                  dimnames = list(genes, c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC")))

  matrix(rnorm(length(subtype) * length(genes), sd = 0.6),
         nrow = length(subtype), ncol = length(genes))

  colMeans(expr[subtype == s, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(expr[subtype != s, , drop = FALSE])
})

  do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, function(k)

               gene = sample(genes[signal[, s] > 0], 30))))
}))

  GSEA(sort(lfc[, s], decreasing = TRUE), TERM2GENE = term2gene_sub,

       eps = 0, seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
})

library(rstatix)
set.seed(7301)
clust <- c("OO", "GC", "SC", "EC")
genes7 <- c("DDX4", "AMH", "COL1A2", "CDH5")
rows <- list()
for (cl in seq_along(clust)) {
  for (gn in seq_along(genes7)) {
    for (ag in seq_along(c("Y", "O"))) {
      base <- rnorm(24, mean = 2.2 + 0.4 * cl + 0.3 * gn, sd = 0.9)
      # marker gene: one cluster expresses high; old shifts up on the top marker
      if (gn == cl) base <- base + 2.3
      if (gn == 1 && cl == 1 && ag == 2) base <- base + 1.9
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        aging = c("Y", "O")[ag], cluster_short = clust[cl], gene = genes7[gn],
        expression = base, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
  }
}
dfc <- do.call(rbind, rows)
dfc$aging <- factor(dfc$aging, levels = c("Y", "O"))
dfc$cluster_short <- factor(dfc$cluster_short, levels = clust)
dfc$gene <- factor(dfc$gene, levels = genes7)
# gate: the DDX4/OO facet is significantly higher in Old (the designed effect)
sub <- dfc[dfc$gene == "DDX4" & dfc$cluster_short == "OO", ]
wt <- wilcox.test(expression ~ aging, data = sub)
stopifnot(wt$p.value < 0.01 &&
          mean(sub$expression[sub$aging == "O"]) > mean(sub$expression[sub$aging == "Y"]))
stat_test <- dfc %>% group_by(cluster_short, gene) %>%
  wilcox_test(formula = expression ~ aging) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%
  add_significance(p.col = "p.adj", cutpoints = c(0, 1e-4, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
                   symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns")) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "aging")
p_c <- ggviolin(dfc, x = "aging", y = "expression", fill = "aging", color = "aging",
                facet.by = c("gene", "cluster_short"), trim = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2874C5", "#EABF00"), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#2874C5", "#EABF00"), guide = "none") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_test, hide.ns = TRUE, tip.length = 0,
                     label = "{p.adj} {p.adj.signif}", label.size = 2.6, vjust = -0.4) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 8),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "grey94", linewidth = 0, colour = NA),
        strip.background.y = element_rect(fill = "grey88", linewidth = 0, colour = NA),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") +
  labs(y = "Expression (log TPM)")
print(p_c)

set.seed(5501)
tissues <- c("BRCA", "COAD", "HNSC", "KIRC", "LUAD", "LUSC", "PRAD", "STAD", "THCA", "UCEC")
n_per <- 120
tp53_base <- c(BRCA = 2.6, COAD = 2.2, HNSC = 2.8, KIRC = 2.4, LUAD = 2.5,
               LUSC = 2.9, PRAD = 2.3, STAD = 2.7, THCA = 2.2, UCEC = 2.5)
pan <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tissues, function(t) {
  tumor <- rnorm(n_per, tp53_base[t] + 0.9, 0.75)
  normal <- rnorm(n_per, tp53_base[t] - 0.4, 0.6)
  rbind(data.frame(tissue = t, type2 = "tumor", tpm = tumor),
        data.frame(tissue = t, type2 = "normal", tpm = normal))
}))
pan$type2 <- factor(pan$type2, levels = c("tumor", "normal"))
pan$tissue <- factor(pan$tissue, levels = tissues)
pan$side <- ifelse(pan$type2 == "tumor", "right", "left")
wt <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tissues, function(t) {
  d1 <- pan$tpm[pan$tissue == t & pan$type2 == "tumor"]
  d0 <- pan$tpm[pan$tissue == t & pan$type2 == "normal"]
  data.frame(tissue = t, p = wilcox.test(d1, d0)$p.value)
}))
star_df <- data.frame(tissue = factor(wt$tissue, levels = tissues),
                      y = max(pan$tpm) + 0.55,
                      lab = ifelse(wt$p < 0.001, "***",
                                   ifelse(wt$p < 0.01, "**",
                                          ifelse(wt$p < 0.05, "*", ""))))
## quartile marks: tiny horizontal dashes offset into each half
qd106 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tissues, function(t) do.call(rbind, lapply(c("tumor", "normal"), function(g) {
  x <- pan$tpm[pan$tissue == t & pan$type2 == g]
  data.frame(tissue = t, type2 = g, q = quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)))
}))))
qd106$tissue <- factor(qd106$tissue, levels = tissues)
qd106$type2 <- factor(qd106$type2, levels = c("tumor", "normal"))
qd106$xc <- as.numeric(qd106$tissue) + ifelse(qd106$type2 == "tumor", 0.13, -0.13)

ggplot(pan, aes(tissue, tpm, fill = type2)) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(aes(side = side), density = "bounded",
                       point_interval = NULL,
                       linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black", alpha = 0.95) +
  geom_segment(data = qd106,
               aes(x = xc - 0.025, xend = xc + 0.025, y = q, yend = q,
                   colour = type2),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_text(data = star_df, aes(tissue, y, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.2, colour = "grey10") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(tumor = "#DF2020", normal = "#DDDF21"), name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(tumor = "#7a1010", normal = "#8a8a20"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, max(pan$tpm) + 1.1)) +

  x0 <- j - 0.5; y0 <- i - 0.5
  if (upper) data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 0, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 1, 1))   # upper-left triangle
  else data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 1, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 0, 1))         # lower-right triangle

}))

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors <- list(Cluster = c(C1 = "#B31E22", C2 = "#529B40", C3 = "#020105"))
ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         annotation_legend = FALSE,          # legends crowd out the body otherwise
         show_colnames = FALSE,              # 30 sample names would overprint
         cutree_cols = 3,
         legend_breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
         legend_labels = c("mRNA\ndown-regulation", "mRNA\nno-change", "mRNA\nup-regulation"),
         fontsize_row = 8)

base <- matrix(rnorm(50 * n_samp, sd = 0.6), 50, n_samp,
               dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_samp))))
sig_blocks <- list(
  LumA  = list(up = 1:10,  dn = NULL,  eff = 1.1),
  LumB  = list(up = 11:20, dn = NULL,  eff = 1.2),
  Basal = list(up = 21:30, dn = 31:40, eff = 1.3))
for (st in subtypes) {
  idx <- which(sub_lab == st)
  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
}
## proliferation genes: high in LumB only
base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] <- base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] + 1.2

## nearest-centroid classification from a training split (SSP stand-in)
train <- c(TRUE, FALSE)[rep(1:2, length.out = n_samp)]

  corrs <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(cent)), function(k) cor(x, cent[, k]))
  subtypes[which.max(corrs)] })

## Simulated expression matrix: 3 subtypes x 15 replicates x 1200 genes
genes   <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%04d", 1:1200))
subtype <- rep(c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC"), each = 15)
signal  <- matrix(0, nrow = length(genes), ncol = 3,
                  dimnames = list(genes, c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC")))
pool <- genes
for (s in colnames(signal)) {          # 60 subtype-specific genes per subtype
  pick <- sample(pool, 60); signal[pick, s] <- 2; pool <- setdiff(pool, pick)
}
expr <- t(signal[, subtype]) +
  matrix(rnorm(length(subtype) * length(genes), sd = 0.6),
         nrow = length(subtype), ncol = length(genes))
colnames(expr) <- genes

## One-vs-rest log2FC per gene, per subtype (a t-test/limma loop can replace this)
lfc <- sapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  colMeans(expr[subtype == s, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(expr[subtype != s, , drop = FALSE])
})

## Signature gene sets: 5 sets of 30 genes per subtype
term2gene_sub <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, function(k)
    data.frame(term = paste0(s, "_signature_", k),
               gene = sample(genes[signal[, s] > 0], 30))))
}))

## GSEA per subtype on its own ranked list
gsea_res <- lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  GSEA(sort(lfc[, s], decreasing = TRUE), TERM2GENE = term2gene_sub,
       minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 100, pvalueCutoff = 1,
       eps = 0, seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
})
names(gsea_res) <- colnames(signal)

## Top-5 up-regulated pathways per subtype
top_gs <- lapply(gsea_res, function(r) {
  res <- as.data.frame(r)
  res <- res[res$NES > 0, ]
  head(rownames(res[order(res$NES, decreasing = TRUE), ]), 5)
})

## Specificity score: mean log2FC of each top set's genes in EVERY subtype
score <- t(sapply(unlist(top_gs, use.names = FALSE), function(gs) {
  gs_genes <- term2gene_sub$gene[term2gene_sub$term == gs]
  colMeans(lfc[gs_genes, , drop = FALSE])
}))
ann <- data.frame(Subtype = gsub("_signature_[0-9]+$", "", rownames(score)),
                  row.names = rownames(score))
jco <- c("#F2CCCC", "#E6D8CF", "#D5E3F0")
pheatmap(score, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         border_color = NA, annotation_row = ann,
         annotation_colors = list(Subtype = c(SubtypeA = jco[1], SubtypeB = jco[2],
                                              SubtypeC = jco[3])),
         main = "Subtype-specific top pathways")

set.seed(402)
n_rank <- 2000
specs <- list(
  HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS = list(idx = sort(sample(600, 110)),     dir =  1.0),
  HALLMARK_HYPOXIA     = list(idx = sort(sample(2000, 90)),     dir = -0.5),
  HALLMARK_EMT         = list(idx = sort(sample(1400:2000, 100)), dir = -1.0)
)
java_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(specs), function(pw) {
  spec <- specs[[pw]]
  hit <- seq_len(n_rank) %in% spec$idx
  step <- ifelse(hit, spec$dir / length(spec$idx), -spec$dir / (n_rank - sum(hit)))
  data.frame(pathway = pw,
             RANK.IN.GENE.LIST = seq_len(n_rank),
             RUNNING.ES = cumsum(step),
             member = hit)
}))

pal_j <- c(HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS = "#E31A1C", HALLMARK_HYPOXIA = "#E7B800",
           HALLMARK_EMT = "#2E9FDF")

  geom_point(data = subset(java_df, member), shape = 21, colour = "black",
             size = 1.6, stroke = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_j) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0),
                     limits = c(min(java_df$RUNNING.ES) - 0.02,
                                max(java_df$RUNNING.ES) + 0.02)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Enrichment score", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.line.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8))

  geom_tile(data = subset(java_df, member), colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_j) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Rank in gene list") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),

           "EMT", "INFLAMMATION", "ANGIOGENESIS", "OXPHOS", "DNA_REPAIR")
nes <- matrix(rnorm(length(tumors) * length(terms), 0, 1.25),
              nrow = length(tumors), dimnames = list(tumors, terms))
# coherent biology: proliferative cohorts move cell-cycle/p53/DNA-repair up and
# apoptosis down; metabolic cohorts move hypoxia/glycolysis up
prolif <- c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE)
metab  <- !prolif
for (k in seq_along(tumors)) {
  if (prolif[k]) { nes[k, c("CELL_CYCLE", "P53_PATHWAY", "DNA_REPAIR")] <-
                     nes[k, c("CELL_CYCLE", "P53_PATHWAY", "DNA_REPAIR")] + 1.7
                   nes[k, "APOPTOSIS"] <- nes[k, "APOPTOSIS"] - 1.4 }
  if (metab[k])  { nes[k, c("HYPOXIA", "GLYCOLYSIS")] <-
                     nes[k, c("HYPOXIA", "GLYCOLYSIS")] + 1.8 }
}
fdr <- matrix(10^(-(abs(as.numeric(nes)) * 0.9 + runif(length(nes), 0, 1.2))),
              nrow = length(tumors))
rownames(fdr) <- tumors; colnames(fdr) <- terms
tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tumors, function(t)
  data.frame(tumor = t, term = colnames(nes), NES = nes[t, ], FDR = fdr[t, ],
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))

  scale_colour_gradientn("NES", colours = mypal, limits = c(-3, 3), na.value = "grey88") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 6), guide = "none") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        axis.title = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.6),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
print(p_b)

set.seed(1639)
n_bg  <- 800                                    # background: pathway universe
bg    <- paste0("P", sprintf("%04d", seq_len(n_bg)))
core  <- sample(bg, 52)                          # pathways shared by all three models
sz    <- c(158, 172, 141)
S1 <- unique(c(core, sample(setdiff(bg, core), sz[1] - length(core))))
S2 <- unique(c(core, sample(setdiff(bg, core), sz[2] - length(core))))
S3 <- unique(c(core, sample(setdiff(bg, core), sz[3] - length(core))))
dat <- list(PDX_95 = S1, PDX_112 = S2, PDX_207 = S3)

## binomial approximation of the triple-intersection test (independent-inclusion
## null): observed triple-overlap count vs Binomial(n, p1*p2*p3); slightly
## conservative under the true fixed-size null
t3 <- length(intersect(intersect(S1, S2), S3))
pval <- binom.test(t3, n = n_bg, p = prod(sz / n_bg),
                   alternative = "greater")$p.value

venn <- venn.diagram(x = dat, filename = NULL,
                     fill = c("red", "steelblue", "yellow"),
                     disable.logging = TRUE)  # keep VennDiagram from dropping .log files in the working dir
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(venn)
grid::grid.text(sprintf("Binomial tail test of the triple intersection:  P = %.2e", pval),
                x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(0.105, "npc"),
                gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, col = "#B2182B"))
cat(sprintf("Triple overlap: %d pathways (sizes %s), P = %.2e\n",
            t3, paste(sz, collapse = "/"), pval))
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")

set.seed(3101)
cells <- c("Cancer", "T CD4", "T CD8", "Macro", "Fibro")
lrs <- expand.grid(ligand = c("EGFR", "ERBB2", "MET", "TGFB1", "CXCL12", "CCL5",
                              "VEGFA", "FGF2", "WNT5A", "DLL4"),
                   receptor = c("EGFR", "ERBB3", "MET", "TGFBR1", "CXCR4", "CCR5",
                                "KDR", "FGFR1", "FZD4", "NOTCH1"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
lrs <- lrs[sample(nrow(lrs), 22), ]
lrs$source <- sample(cells, 22, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.4, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15))
lrs$target <- sample(cells, 22, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.2, 0.3, 0.2))
lrs$logFC <- rnorm(22, 0, 1)
lrs$logFC[lrs$source == "Cancer"] <- lrs$logFC[lrs$source == "Cancer"] + 0.8
lrs$logFC <- pmin(pmax(lrs$logFC, -2), 2)
lrs$frac <- runif(22, 0.1, 0.9)
lrs$from <- paste0(lrs$ligand, "_", lrs$source, "_ligand")
lrs$to <- paste0(lrs$receptor, "_", lrs$target, "_receptor")
celltypes <- unique(c(lrs$source, lrs$target))

vert <- rbind(
  data.frame(name = unique(lrs$from), celltype = gsub(".*_(.+)_ligand", "\\1", unique(lrs$from)),
             type = "ligand", frac = lrs$frac[match(unique(lrs$from), lrs$from)],
             label = gsub("_.*", "", unique(lrs$from))),
  data.frame(name = unique(lrs$to), celltype = gsub(".*_(.+)_receptor", "\\1", unique(lrs$to)),
             type = "receptor", frac = NA,
             label = gsub("_.*", "", unique(lrs$to))))
vert <- vert[!duplicated(vert$name), ]
vert$frac[is.na(vert$frac)] <- runif(sum(is.na(vert$frac)), 0.1, 0.9)
head_df <- data.frame(
  name = c("root", paste0(celltypes, "_ligand"), paste0(celltypes, "_receptor")),
  celltype = c("root", celltypes, celltypes),
  type = c("root", rep("ligand", length(celltypes)), rep("receptor", length(celltypes))),
  frac = 0.5, label = c("root", celltypes, celltypes))
vert_all <- rbind(head_df, vert)

## tree edges only (root -> cell-type arms -> gene nodes); the ligand-receptor
## interactions are NOT tree edges, they go into get_con() as node index pairs
## (parallel edges would break the dendrogram layout)
edges <- unique(rbind(
  data.frame(from = "root", to = paste0(celltypes, "_ligand")),
  data.frame(from = "root", to = paste0(celltypes, "_receptor")),
  data.frame(from = paste0(lrs$source, "_ligand"), to = lrs$from),
  data.frame(from = paste0(lrs$target, "_receptor"), to = lrs$to)))
g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = TRUE, vertices = vert_all)
from_m <- match(lrs$from, vert_all$name)
to_m <- match(lrs$to, vert_all$name)

## precompute the bundle data on the CIRCULAR layout (matching the ggraph call)
## and attach per-connection logFC via con.id - ggraph does not propagate edge
## attributes into geom_conn_bundle
bundle <- get_con(from = from_m, to = to_m)(
  create_layout(g, layout = "dendrogram", circular = TRUE))
bundle$logFC <- lrs$logFC[bundle$con.id]

cell.col <- setNames(c("#8DD3C7", "#BEBADA", "#FB8072", "#80B1D3", "#FDB462")[1:length(celltypes)], celltypes)
ggraph(g, layout = "dendrogram", circular = TRUE) +
  geom_conn_bundle(data = bundle, aes(colour = logFC),
                   width = 1.1, tension = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_node_point(aes(size = frac, filter = leaf, colour = celltype, shape = type)) +
  geom_node_text(aes(x = x * 1.08, y = y * 1.08, label = label, filter = leaf),
                 size = 2.6, repel = TRUE, segment.size = 0.2, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_edge_colour_gradientn(colours = c("#3E52C5", "#FFFFFF", "#B91129"),
                              limits = c(-2, 2), name = "ligand log2FC") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("ligand" = 1, "receptor" = 19), name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cell.col, name = NULL) +
  theme_void()

set.seed(4352)
bases <- c("A", "C", "G", "T")
base_colours <- c(A = "#1B9E77", C = "#377EB8", G = "#E6AB02", T = "#D95F02")
## ---- (1) pairwise alignment window -------------------------------------
ref_seq <- paste(sample(bases, 90, replace = TRUE, prob = c(.3, .2, .22, .28)),
                 collapse = "")
q_seq <- ref_seq
substr(q_seq, 23, 23) <- ifelse(substr(ref_seq, 23, 23) == "A", "G", "A")
substr(q_seq, 57, 57) <- ifelse(substr(ref_seq, 57, 57) == "C", "T", "C")
## Aligned rows: query has a 3 bp insertion after column 70, subject a 1 bp
## deletion at column 40; both strings are 93 columns wide.
q_aln <- paste0(substr(q_seq, 1, 70), "TTG", substr(q_seq, 71, 90))
s_aln <- paste0(substr(ref_seq, 1, 39), "-", substr(ref_seq, 41, 70),
                "---", substr(ref_seq, 71, 90))
q_chars <- strsplit(q_aln, "")[[1]]
s_chars <- strsplit(s_aln, "")[[1]]
stopifnot(length(q_chars) == length(s_chars))
## The middle row is this figure's identity string: | match, X mismatch,
## space gap (BLAST's own pairwise text output uses | and blank; the X is
## this page's mnemonic).
pair <- tibble(col = seq_along(q_chars), q_char = q_chars, s_char = s_chars) |>
  mutate(state = case_when(q_char == "-" | s_char == "-" ~ "gap",
                           q_char == s_char ~ "match", TRUE ~ "mismatch"),
         glyph = case_when(state == "match" ~ "|",
                           state == "mismatch" ~ "X", TRUE ~ " "))
## ---- (2) simulated pileup over a 420 bp locus --------------------------
ref_len <- 420
reference <- sample(bases, ref_len, replace = TRUE, prob = c(.3, .2, .22, .28))
reference[95] <- "C"; reference[211] <- "T"
deletion <- 300:304; insertion_at <- 350
n_reads <- 8
read_start <- sample(60:90, n_reads, replace = TRUE)
read_len <- sample(300:330, n_reads, replace = TRUE)
has_del <- c(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE)
has_ins <- c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)
pileup <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(n_reads), function(i) {
  span <- read_start[i]:(read_start[i] + read_len[i] - 1)
  span <- span[span <= ref_len]
  span <- setdiff(span, deletion[has_del[i]])
  tibble(read_index = i, ref_pos = span, base = reference[span])
})) |>
  mutate(
    ## Sequencer errors plus sample alleles at ~50% allele fraction.
    base = if_else(runif(n()) < 0.012, sample(bases, n(), replace = TRUE), base),
    base = if_else(ref_pos == 95 & read_index %in% 1:4, "G", base),
    base = if_else(ref_pos == 211 & read_index %in% 2:4, "C", base),
    base = factor(base, levels = bases)
  )
## Coverage = reads spanning a base (samtools depth semantics).
coverage <- tibble(ref_pos = seq_len(ref_len)) |>
  left_join(count(pileup, ref_pos), by = "ref_pos") |>
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0L))
insertion_rows <- bind_rows(lapply(which(has_ins), function(i) {
  tibble(read_index = i, ref_pos = insertion_at)
}))
junctions <- tibble(ref_pos = c(min(deletion) - 1, max(deletion) + 1))
pair |> group_by(state) |> summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

aln_rows <- bind_rows(
  pair |> transmute(col, row = 3, label = q_char),
  pair |> transmute(col, row = 2, label = glyph),
  pair |> transmute(col, row = 1, label = s_char)
) |>
  mutate(state = if_else(label %in% c("-", " "), "gap",
                         if_else(label == "X", "mismatch",
                                 if_else(label == "|", "match", "base"))))
win <- cut(pair$col, breaks = seq(0, nrow(pair), by = 15), labels = FALSE)
identity <- pair |>
  group_by(window = win) |>
  summarise(mid = mean(col), ident = mean(state == "match"), .groups = "drop")
gap_labels <- pair |>
  filter(state != "match") |>
  group_by(run = cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(col) > 1))) |>
  summarise(x = mean(col), n = n(), kind = first(state), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(label = if_else(n >= 2,
                         paste0(n, " bp ", if_else(kind == "gap", "gap", "sub")),
                         paste0("1 bp ", if_else(kind == "gap", "gap", "sub"))))
p_pair <- ggplot(aln_rows, aes(col, row)) +
  geom_tile(fill = "#FCFCFC", colour = NA, height = 0.92, width = 1) +
  geom_tile(data = pair |> filter(state != "match"), aes(x = col, y = 2),

            alpha = 0.08) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label, colour = state), family = "mono", size = 3) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = c(match = "#4D4D4D", mismatch = "#C51B1F",
                                 gap = "#9E9E9E", base = "#222222"),
                      guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(1, 3), labels = c("Subject", "Query"),
