set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors <- list(Cluster = c(C1 = "#B31E22", C2 = "#529B40", C3 = "#020105"))
ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up
         annotation_col = ann_col,

         legend_breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
         legend_labels = c("mRNA\ndown-regulation", "mRNA\nno-change", "mRNA\nup-regulation"),
         fontsize_row = 8)

subtypes <- c("LumA", "LumB", "Basal")
n_per <- 20
genes <- paste0("PAM50_", sprintf("%02d", 1:50))
n_samp <- length(subtypes) * n_per
sub_lab <- factor(rep(subtypes, each = n_per), levels = subtypes)
base <- matrix(rnorm(50 * n_samp, sd = 0.6), 50, n_samp,
               dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_samp))))
sig_blocks <- list(
  LumA  = list(up = 1:10,  dn = NULL,  eff = 1.1),
  LumB  = list(up = 11:20, dn = NULL,  eff = 1.2),
  Basal = list(up = 21:30, dn = 31:40, eff = 1.3))
for (st in subtypes) {
  idx <- which(sub_lab == st)
  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
}
## proliferation genes: high in LumB only
base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] <- base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] + 1.2

## nearest-centroid classification from a training split (SSP stand-in)
train <- c(TRUE, FALSE)[rep(1:2, length.out = n_samp)]
cent <- sapply(subtypes, function(st) rowMeans(base[, train & sub_lab == st]))
pred <- apply(base[, !train], 2, function(x) {
  corrs <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(cent)), function(k) cor(x, cent[, k]))
  subtypes[which.max(corrs)] })
pred <- factor(pred, levels = subtypes)
cat("held-out accuracy:", round(mean(pred == sub_lab[!train]), 2), "\n")

sig_scores <- rbind(
  `AR score`  = colMeans(base[21:30, ]) - colMeans(base[31:40, ]),  # Basal-high
  `Prolif score` = colMeans(base[41:50, ]))                          # LumB-high
pheno <- ifelse(sig_scores["AR score", ] > 0, "AR-high", "AR-low")

## mean-centre each gene (no scaling, the reference's fold-difference scale) and clip
mat <- t(scale(t(base), center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
mat[mat > 4] <- 4; mat[mat < -4] <- -4
ord <- order(pred)
pred_o <- pred[ord]; mat_o <- mat[, ord]

ar_o <- sig_scores["AR score", ord]; pro_o <- sig_scores["Prolif score", ord]

                  dimnames = list(gene_r, cancer_r))
logfc_r[1:6, ] <- logfc_r[1:6, ] + 1.8      # up-regulated block
logfc_r[7:12, ] <- logfc_r[7:12, ] - 1.8    # down-regulated block
## explicit P-value design: strong bands significant, weak genes mostly not
p_low <- ifelse(runif(24 * 8) < 0.25, runif(24 * 8, 1e-3, 0.045),
                                       runif(24 * 8, 0.06, 0.9))
pval_r <- ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 2, runif(24 * 8, 1e-8, 1e-3),
          ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 1, runif(24 * 8, 1e-4, 0.04), p_low))

                   "Secreted", "Matrisome", "Other"),
                 each = 4)

## bin into 5 fold-change bands; P >= 0.05 overrides to a 6th (white) band
logfc_cat <- apply(logfc_r, 2, function(x)
  cut(x, breaks = c(-Inf, -2, -1, 1, 2, Inf),
      labels = c("< -2", "-2 - -1", "-1 - 1", "1 - 2", "> 2")))

logfc_cat[pval_r >= 0.05] <- "P >= 0.05"

                  gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8,

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

corr_test <- function(expr_vec, score_mat) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(pathways, function(p) {
    ct <- cor.test(expr_vec, score_mat[, p])
    data.frame(pathway = p, r = as.numeric(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value)
  }))
}

library(patchwork)
set.seed(6101)
subtypes <- c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4")
n_cell <- 120
cls <- rep(subtypes, each = n_cell / 4)
prog <- as.numeric(factor(cls, levels = subtypes))      # differentiation score 1..4
base_genes <- paste0("G", sprintf("%03d", 1:40))
mark_up <- c("ZP1", "BMP15", "GDF9")   # folliculogenesis genes rising with C1 -> C4
mark_dn <- c("WEE2", "AURKA", "DNMT3A")  # meiosis/methylation genes falling along it
genes <- c(base_genes, mark_up, mark_dn)
mu <- matrix(rnorm(length(genes) * n_cell, sd = 0.5), nrow = length(genes),
             dimnames = list(genes, paste0("cell", 1:n_cell)))
# 标记基因随发育梯度变化：整个矩阵即是
for (g in mark_up) mu[g, ] <- mu[g, ] + 3.6 * (prog / max(prog))
for (g in mark_dn) mu[g, ] <- mu[g, ] - 3.6 * (prog / max(prog))
pc <- prcomp(t(mu), scale. = TRUE)
score <- pc$x[, 1]; load1 <- pc$rotation[, 1]
# 主成分轴的符号是任意的：调向使上调组占据正载荷一侧
if (mean(load1[mark_up]) < mean(load1[mark_dn])) { load1 <- -load1; score <- -score }
stopifnot(min(load1[mark_up]) > max(load1[mark_dn]))
var_pct <- round(pc$sdev^2 / sum(pc$sdev^2) * 100, 1)
df_cells <- data.frame(PC1 = score, PC2 = pc$x[, 2], subtype = cls)
p_a <- ggplot(df_cells, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = subtype)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(C1 = "#8E3189", C2 = "#4C72B4", C3 = "#85B846", C4 = "#C64941")) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var_pct[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", var_pct[2], "%)")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
df_genes <- rbind(data.frame(gene = mark_up, load = load1[mark_up], set = "up"),
                  data.frame(gene = mark_dn, load = load1[mark_dn], set = "down"))
p_b <- ggplot(df_genes, aes(load, reorder(gene, load))) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = 0), colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = set), size = 3.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(up = "#B2182B", down = "#2166AC"), guide = "none") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "PC1 loading", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

set.seed(6201)

lab4 <- c("G1", "G2", "G3", "G4")

n_feat <- 32
mat <- matrix(rnorm(n_feat * n_s, sd = 0.65), nrow = n_feat,
              dimnames = list(paste0("Gene", 1:n_feat), NULL))
# 每个真实簇携带一个高表达标记块 -> 簇间分离干净可审
for (k in 1:4) {
  blk <- ((k - 1) * 8 + 1):(k * 8)          # eight-gene marker block per cluster
  mat[blk, grp == lab4[k]] <- mat[blk, grp == lab4[k]] + 3.2
}
set.seed(6202)
km <- kmeans(t(mat), centers = 4, nstart = 25)   # k-means clusters the rows of x
pa <- prcomp(t(mat), scale. = TRUE)
dat <- data.frame(PC1 = pa$x[, 1], PC2 = pa$x[, 2],
                  cluster = factor(paste0("C", km$cluster), levels = paste0("C", 1:4)),
                  rownames = sprintf("S%02d", 1:n_s))
# 可恢复性门槛：每个真实组的多数成员须落入同一簇
tb <- table(grp, dat$cluster)
hit <- sum(tb[cbind(seq_len(nrow(tb)), apply(tb, 1, which.max))])
stopifnot(hit / n_s >= 0.90)
var1 <- round(pa$sdev[1]^2 / sum(pa$sdev^2) * 100, 1)
var2 <- round(pa$sdev[2]^2 / sum(pa$sdev^2) * 100, 1)
hull_rows <- list()
for (k in levels(dat$cluster)) {
  d <- dat[dat$cluster == k, ]
  hi <- chull(d$PC1, d$PC2)                 # base grDevices function
  hull_rows[[k]] <- data.frame(PC1 = d$PC1[hi], PC2 = d$PC2[hi],
                               cluster = factor(k, levels = levels(dat$cluster)))
}
hulls <- do.call(rbind, hull_rows)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(c(hulls$PC1, hulls$PC2))) && nrow(hulls) >= 12)
tag <- dat[!duplicated(dat$cluster), ]       # one labelled representative per cluster
tag <- tag[order(as.numeric(factor(tag$cluster))), ]
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls, aes(PC1, PC2, group = cluster, fill = cluster),
               alpha = 0.22, colour = NA) +
  geom_point(data = dat, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = cluster), size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(data = tag, aes(PC1, PC2, label = rownames),

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(C1 = "#B2182B", C2 = "#2166AC", C3 = "#4D9342", C4 = "#EABF00")) +

  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var1, "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", var2, "%)"),

## nested covariance ellipses at two coverage levels
ell <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0.9, 0.95), function(pro) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(grp2), function(g) {
    d <- scores_pg[scores_pg$grp == g, 1:2]
    ctr <- colMeans(d); eg <- eigen(cov(d))
    ang <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 120)
    r <- sqrt(qchisq(pro, df = 2))
    data.frame(
      x = ctr[1] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[1, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[1, 2]),
      y = ctr[2] + r * (cos(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[1]) * eg$vectors[2, 1] -
                          sin(ang) * sqrt(eg$values[2]) * eg$vectors[2, 2]),
      grp = g, pro = pro)
  }))
}))

expr_te[lab_te == "B", 21:40] <- expr_te[lab_te == "B", 21:40] + 1.2

  cs <- apply(cent, 2, function(cen) cor(x, cen))

set.seed(2900)
clusters <- paste0("C", 1:8)
p0 <- c(0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.11, 0.10, 0.10, 0.09)
# KO proportions: unaffected clusters keep p0 exactly; only C2/C6/C8 are reallocated
p_ko <- p0
p_ko[2] <- 0.05; p_ko[6] <- 0.22; p_ko[8] <- 0.08
stopifnot(abs(sum(p_ko) - 1) < 1e-12)
n_wt <- 900; n_ko <- 900
mk_cells <- function(n, p, grp) {
  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}
cellinfo <- rbind(mk_cells(n_wt, p0, "WT"), mk_cells(n_ko, p_ko, "KO"))
cellinfo$cluster <- factor(cellinfo$cluster, levels = clusters)

tbl <- table(cellinfo$cluster, cellinfo$group)
ft <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
post <- rstatix::row_wise_fisher_test(tbl)

cell.col <- c(WT = "#1A63A8", KO = "#FC6910")
prop_df <- as.data.frame(tbl, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(prop_df) <- c("cluster", "group", "n")
prop_df$cluster <- factor(prop_df$cluster, levels = clusters)
prop_df$group <- factor(prop_df$group, levels = c("WT", "KO"))
sig_df <- as.data.frame(post)
sig_df$cluster <- factor(sig_df$group, levels = clusters)
sig_df$lab <- ifelse(sig_df$p.adj.signif == "ns", "", sig_df$p.adj.signif)

ggplot(prop_df, aes(cluster, n, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.72,
           colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = sig_df, aes(x = cluster, y = 1.05, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.4, colour = "grey10") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell.col, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), labels = scales::percent,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Fraction of cells",
       title = "Cell-type composition per cluster (KO vs WT)") +

df_b <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(major), function(k) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(subgrp[[k]]), function(j) {
    n <- 25
    val <- rnorm(n, mean = 20 + k * 8 + j * 2, sd = 5)
    data.frame(major = major[k], subgroup = subgrp[[k]][j], value = val)
  }))
}))
summ_b <- df_b |>
  group_by(major, subgroup) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(value), se = sd(value) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

summ_b$major_col <- base_col[major_of[summ_b$subgroup]]
# lighter shades for subgroup index within each major group

summ_b$idx <- as.integer(factor(summ_b$subgroup, levels = unlist(subgrp)))
summ_b$shade <- shade_fac[summ_b$idx]

p0 <- c(0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.11, 0.10, 0.10, 0.09)
# KO proportions: unaffected clusters keep p0 exactly; only C2/C6/C8 are reallocated
p_ko <- p0
p_ko[2] <- 0.05; p_ko[6] <- 0.22; p_ko[8] <- 0.08
stopifnot(abs(sum(p_ko) - 1) < 1e-12)
n_wt <- 900; n_ko <- 900
mk_cells <- function(n, p, grp) {
  data.frame(cluster = sample(clusters, n, replace = TRUE, prob = p),
             group = grp,
             run = sample(c("R1", "R2"), n, replace = TRUE))
}
cellinfo <- rbind(mk_cells(n_wt, p0, "WT"), mk_cells(n_ko, p_ko, "KO"))
cellinfo$cluster <- factor(cellinfo$cluster, levels = clusters)

tbl <- table(cellinfo$cluster, cellinfo$group)
ft <- fisher.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
post <- rstatix::row_wise_fisher_test(tbl)

cell.col <- c(WT = "#1A63A8", KO = "#FC6910")
prop_df <- as.data.frame(tbl, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(prop_df) <- c("cluster", "group", "n")
prop_df$cluster <- factor(prop_df$cluster, levels = clusters)
prop_df$group <- factor(prop_df$group, levels = c("WT", "KO"))
sig_df <- as.data.frame(post)
sig_df$cluster <- factor(sig_df$group, levels = clusters)
sig_df$lab <- ifelse(sig_df$p.adj.signif == "ns", "", sig_df$p.adj.signif)

ggplot(prop_df, aes(cluster, n, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.72,
           colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = sig_df, aes(x = cluster, y = 1.05, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.4, colour = "grey10") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell.col, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), labels = scales::percent,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Fraction of cells",
       title = "Cell-type composition per cluster (KO vs WT)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(size = 11))

# same cells as the chunk above, now split by sequencing run
ggplot(cellinfo, aes(run, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.85, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~cluster, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell.col, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.5), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Replicate", y = "Fraction of cells") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +

        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

set.seed(2101)
major <- c("Group A", "Group B", "Group C")
subgrp <- list(c("A1", "A2", "A3"), c("B1", "B2"), c("C1", "C2", "C3"))
base_col <- c("Group A" = "#2874C5", "Group B" = "#B2182B", "Group C" = "#4D9342")

df_b <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(major), function(k) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(subgrp[[k]]), function(j) {
    n <- 25
    val <- rnorm(n, mean = 20 + k * 8 + j * 2, sd = 5)
    data.frame(major = major[k], subgroup = subgrp[[k]][j], value = val)
  }))
}))
summ_b <- df_b |>
  group_by(major, subgroup) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(value), se = sd(value) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

set.seed(4401)
n_gene <- 3000
resol <- 100
span <- 3000
gb_win <- 20
up_win <- span / resol
w_up <- seq_len(up_win)
w_gb <- seq_len(gb_win)
w_dn <- seq_len(up_win)
pos_lab <- c(paste0("-", seq(span, resol, -resol)),
             rep("gene body", gb_win),
             paste0("+", seq(resol, span, resol)))
axis_at <- c(1, up_win, up_win + gb_win, length(pos_lab))
axis_lab <- c("-3 kb", "TSS", "TTS", "+3 kb")
mk_profile <- function(amp_tss, amp_gb, noise) {
  up <- exp(-(w_up - max(w_up))^2 / (2 * (up_win / 2.2)^2)) * amp_tss
  gb <- (0.25 + 0.5 * seq(0, 1, length.out = gb_win)) * amp_gb
  dn <- exp(-(w_dn - 1)^2 / (2 * (up_win / 2.5)^2)) * (amp_tss * 0.35)
  pmax(0, c(up, gb, dn) + rnorm(length(up) + length(gb) + length(dn), 0, noise))
}
prof <- data.frame(
  window = seq_along(pos_lab),
  Cxxc1 = mk_profile(1.0, 0.55, 0.012),
  Input = mk_profile(0.30, 0.18, 0.010))
prof_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(prof, cols = c(Cxxc1, Input),
                                 names_to = "sample", values_to = "signal")
ggplot(prof_long, aes(window, signal, colour = sample)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(up_win + 0.5, up_win + gb_win + 0.5),
             linetype = 2, colour = "grey55") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = up_win + 0.5, xmax = up_win + gb_win + 0.5,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.06, fill = "#2166AC") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "3 kb upstream", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win + gb_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "gene body (compressed)", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win + gb_win + up_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "3 kb downstream", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = axis_at, labels = axis_lab,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean tag density (simulated, 3,000 genes)",
       title = "Metagene profile: IP vs Input over extended gene bodies",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

set.seed(4401)
n_gene <- 3000
resol <- 100
span <- 3000
gb_win <- 20
up_win <- span / resol
w_up <- seq_len(up_win)
w_gb <- seq_len(gb_win)
w_dn <- seq_len(up_win)
pos_lab <- c(paste0("-", seq(span, resol, -resol)),
             rep("gene body", gb_win),
             paste0("+", seq(resol, span, resol)))
axis_at <- c(1, up_win, up_win + gb_win, length(pos_lab))
axis_lab <- c("-3 kb", "TSS", "TTS", "+3 kb")
mk_profile <- function(amp_tss, amp_gb, noise) {
  up <- exp(-(w_up - max(w_up))^2 / (2 * (up_win / 2.2)^2)) * amp_tss
  gb <- (0.25 + 0.5 * seq(0, 1, length.out = gb_win)) * amp_gb
  dn <- exp(-(w_dn - 1)^2 / (2 * (up_win / 2.5)^2)) * (amp_tss * 0.35)
  pmax(0, c(up, gb, dn) + rnorm(length(up) + length(gb) + length(dn), 0, noise))
}
prof <- data.frame(
  window = seq_along(pos_lab),
  Cxxc1 = mk_profile(1.0, 0.55, 0.012),
  Input = mk_profile(0.30, 0.18, 0.010))
prof_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(prof, cols = c(Cxxc1, Input),
                                 names_to = "sample", values_to = "signal")

  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(up_win + 0.5, up_win + gb_win + 0.5),

           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.06, fill = "#2166AC") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "3 kb upstream", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win + gb_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "gene body (compressed)", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = up_win + gb_win + up_win / 2, y = max(prof_long$signal) * 1.02,
           label = "3 kb downstream", size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = axis_at, labels = axis_lab,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +

  set.seed(14001 + seed_shift)
  m <- pmin(0.98, as.vector(gene_eff) * rep(cancer_eff, each = 18) * runif(18 * 8, 0.1, 1.6))
  dim(m) <- c(18, 8); dimnames(m) <- list(genes, cancers); m
}

  d$value <- as.vector(m)          # matrix fills column-major: gene within cancer
  d$type <- type
  d[!is.na(d$value), ]
}

## ELN (examined lymph node) count vs HR of an exposure, planted break at ELN=10
eln_count <- 1:20
true_hr <- c(seq(2.6, 1.0, length.out = 10), seq(1.0, 0.55, length.out = 10))
Coxoutput <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(eln_count), function(i) {
  k <- eln_count[i]
  x <- rbinom(80, 1, 0.4)
  t <- pmin(90, pmax(2, qweibull(runif(80), 1, 50 / exp(log(true_hr[i]) * x))))
  sub <- data.frame(x = x, t = t, e = rbinom(80, 1, 0.7))
  m <- coxph(Surv(t, e) ~ x, data = sub)
  ci <- summary(m)$conf.int
  data.frame(ELN = k, HR = ci[1, "exp(coef)"], lower = ci[1, "lower .95"], upper = ci[1, "upper .95"])
}))
jco <- c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#F39B7F")
hr.lowess <- lowess(Coxoutput$HR ~ Coxoutput$ELN, f = 2/3)

f <- Fstats(hr.lowess$y ~ Coxoutput$ELN)
bk <- breakpoints(f)$breakpoints
cat("breakpoint at ELN =", Coxoutput$ELN[bk], "\n")

par(mfrow = c(2, 1))
par(bty = "o", mgp = c(1.5, .33, 0), mar = c(3, 4, 2, 1), las = 1, tcl = -0.25)
plot(Coxoutput$ELN, Coxoutput$HR, pch = 19, cex = 0.9, col = jco[1],
     xlab = "ELN count", ylab = "Hazard Ratio",
     main = "HR vs ELN with lowess + breakpoint", ylim = c(0, max(Coxoutput$upper)))

set.seed(3101)
cells <- c("Cancer", "T CD4", "T CD8", "Macro", "Fibro")
lrs <- expand.grid(ligand = c("EGFR", "ERBB2", "MET", "TGFB1", "CXCL12", "CCL5",
                              "VEGFA", "FGF2", "WNT5A", "DLL4"),
                   receptor = c("EGFR", "ERBB3", "MET", "TGFBR1", "CXCR4", "CCR5",
                                "KDR", "FGFR1", "FZD4", "NOTCH1"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
lrs <- lrs[sample(nrow(lrs), 22), ]
lrs$source <- sample(cells, 22, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.4, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15))
lrs$target <- sample(cells, 22, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.2, 0.3, 0.2))
lrs$logFC <- rnorm(22, 0, 1)
lrs$logFC[lrs$source == "Cancer"] <- lrs$logFC[lrs$source == "Cancer"] + 0.8
lrs$logFC <- pmin(pmax(lrs$logFC, -2), 2)
lrs$frac <- runif(22, 0.1, 0.9)
lrs$from <- paste0(lrs$ligand, "_", lrs$source, "_ligand")
lrs$to <- paste0(lrs$receptor, "_", lrs$target, "_receptor")
celltypes <- unique(c(lrs$source, lrs$target))

vert <- rbind(
  data.frame(name = unique(lrs$from), celltype = gsub(".*_(.+)_ligand", "\\1", unique(lrs$from)),
             type = "ligand", frac = lrs$frac[match(unique(lrs$from), lrs$from)],
             label = gsub("_.*", "", unique(lrs$from))),
  data.frame(name = unique(lrs$to), celltype = gsub(".*_(.+)_receptor", "\\1", unique(lrs$to)),
             type = "receptor", frac = NA,
             label = gsub("_.*", "", unique(lrs$to))))
vert <- vert[!duplicated(vert$name), ]
vert$frac[is.na(vert$frac)] <- runif(sum(is.na(vert$frac)), 0.1, 0.9)
head_df <- data.frame(
  name = c("root", paste0(celltypes, "_ligand"), paste0(celltypes, "_receptor")),
  celltype = c("root", celltypes, celltypes),
  type = c("root", rep("ligand", length(celltypes)), rep("receptor", length(celltypes))),
  frac = 0.5, label = c("root", celltypes, celltypes))
vert_all <- rbind(head_df, vert)

## tree edges only (root -> cell-type arms -> gene nodes); the ligand-receptor
## interactions are NOT tree edges, they go into get_con() as node index pairs
## (parallel edges would break the dendrogram layout)
edges <- unique(rbind(
  data.frame(from = "root", to = paste0(celltypes, "_ligand")),
  data.frame(from = "root", to = paste0(celltypes, "_receptor")),
  data.frame(from = paste0(lrs$source, "_ligand"), to = lrs$from),
  data.frame(from = paste0(lrs$target, "_receptor"), to = lrs$to)))
g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = TRUE, vertices = vert_all)
from_m <- match(lrs$from, vert_all$name)
to_m <- match(lrs$to, vert_all$name)

## precompute the bundle data on the CIRCULAR layout (matching the ggraph call)
## and attach per-connection logFC via con.id - ggraph does not propagate edge
## attributes into geom_conn_bundle
bundle <- get_con(from = from_m, to = to_m)(
  create_layout(g, layout = "dendrogram", circular = TRUE))
bundle$logFC <- lrs$logFC[bundle$con.id]

cell.col <- setNames(c("#8DD3C7", "#BEBADA", "#FB8072", "#80B1D3", "#FDB462")[1:length(celltypes)], celltypes)
ggraph(g, layout = "dendrogram", circular = TRUE) +
  geom_conn_bundle(data = bundle, aes(colour = logFC),
                   width = 1.1, tension = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_node_point(aes(size = frac, filter = leaf, colour = celltype, shape = type)) +
  geom_node_text(aes(x = x * 1.08, y = y * 1.08, label = label, filter = leaf),
                 size = 2.6, repel = TRUE, segment.size = 0.2, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_edge_colour_gradientn(colours = c("#3E52C5", "#FFFFFF", "#B91129"),
                              limits = c(-2, 2), name = "ligand log2FC") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("ligand" = 1, "receptor" = 19), name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cell.col, name = NULL) +
  theme_void()

## A chromosome table in the shape RIdeogram expects: name, start, end,
## centromere. Lengths are a five-chromosome toy genome in Mb.
karyo <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5"),
  len = c(120, 95, 80, 60, 45),
  cen = c(48, 34, 31, 21, 17)
)
set.seed(43501)

## Cytobands: alternating stain with a density value, as G-band tables carry.
banding <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  starts <- seq(0, k$len, by = 6)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, start = starts, end = pmin(starts + 6, k$len),
             density = round(runif(length(starts), 0, 100)))
}))

## Per-window Fst with two planted peaks, so the reading order is verifiable.
win <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  mid <- seq(1, k$len - 1, by = 2)
  fst <- 0.08 + 0.05 * abs(sin(mid / 9))
  if (k$chr == "chr2") fst <- fst + 0.55 * exp(-((mid - 62)^2) / 40)
  if (k$chr == "chr4") fst <- fst + 0.42 * exp(-((mid - 20)^2) / 50)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, mid = mid,
             fst = pmin(0.95, fst + rnorm(length(mid), 0, 0.02)))
}))

markers <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr1", "chr2", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr5"),
  pos = c(12, 88, 62, 30, 41, 70, 20, 15, 38),
  type = c("tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA", "tRNA", "rRNA", "miRNA",
           "QTL", "QTL", "miRNA")
)

## Cumulative coordinates: chromosomes end to end with a 4 Mb gap, so every
## panel can share a single x axis instead of relying on facet widths.
gap <- 4
offs <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr,
                   offset = c(0, cumsum(karyo$len + gap)[-nrow(karyo)]))
banding <- left_join(banding, offs, by = "chr") |>
  mutate(x0 = offset + start, x1 = offset + end)
win <- left_join(win, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + mid)
markers <- left_join(markers, offs, by = "chr") |> mutate(x = offset + pos)
chr_lab <- data.frame(chr = karyo$chr, x = offs$offset + karyo$len / 2)
xmax <- max(win$x) + 3

p_ideo <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = banding,
            aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = 0.84, ymax = 1.16, fill = density),
            colour = "#3d3d3d", linewidth = 0.12) +
  ## Centromere: a dark tick, not a white line -- white on a near-white band
  ## is invisible, which is exactly how the pinch disappears from the figure.
  geom_segment(data = left_join(karyo, offs, by = "chr"),
               aes(x = offset + cen, xend = offset + cen, y = 0.80, yend = 1.20),
               linewidth = 0.9, colour = "#111111", lineend = "butt") +
  geom_point(data = markers, aes(x, y = 1.34, colour = type, shape = type),
             size = 2.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn("band\ndensity",
                       colours = c("#ffffff", "#c6c6c6", "#5a5a5a"),
                       limits = c(0, 100), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(tRNA = "#1b7837", rRNA = "#d95f02",
                                 miRNA = "#2166ac", QTL = "#b2182b"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(tRNA = 17, rRNA = 15, miRNA = 16, QTL = 18),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.78, 1.46), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.32, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.2),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 5, 0, 5))

p_track <- ggplot(win, aes(x, fst, group = chr)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#4292c6", alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(colour = "#08519c", linewidth = 0.32) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3,
             colour = "#b2182b") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = offs$offset[-1] - gap / 2, linewidth = 0.25,

  ## chromosome names on the track's own panel, not borrowed from above
  annotate("text", x = chr_lab$x, y = 0.93, label = chr_lab$chr,
           size = 2.6, colour = "#333333") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.96), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75),

  labs(x = "cumulative position (Mb; chromosomes laid end to end)",

                   Subtype = factor(rep(subtypes, each = n / 3), levels = subtypes))
## per-sample altered-feature count from a GISTIC-style value vector
burden_of <- function(n_feat, amp_p, del_p) {
  v <- sample(c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), n_feat,
              TRUE, prob = c(del_p, del_p * 2, 1 - 4 * del_p, amp_p * 2, amp_p))
  sum(v != 0)
}
## planted subtype effects: A.I. high focal amp, M.T. high focal/broad del
focal <- sapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
  st <- pdat$Subtype[i]
  burden_of(300, if (st == "A.I.") 0.045 else 0.012, if (st == "M.T.") 0.045 else 0.012)
})
broad <- sapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
  st <- pdat$Subtype[i]
  burden_of(23, if (st == "A.S.") 0.11 else 0.045, if (st == "M.T.") 0.13 else 0.05)
})
load_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(sample = pdat$sample, Subtype = pdat$Subtype,
             burden = focal, level = "Focal"),
  data.frame(sample = pdat$sample, Subtype = pdat$Subtype,
             burden = broad, level = "Broad (arm)"))

pairs <- combn(subtypes, 2, simplify = FALSE)
sym <- function(p) ifelse(p > 0.05, "ns", ifelse(p <= 0.001, "***", ifelse(p <= 0.01, "**", ifelse(p <= 0.05, "*", "ns"))))
ann <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Focal", "Broad (arm)"), function(lv) {
  d <- load_df[load_df$level == lv, ]
  raw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pairs, function(pr) {
    p <- wilcox.test(burden ~ Subtype, data = d[d$Subtype %in% pr, ])$p.value
    data.frame(level = lv, g1 = pr[1], g2 = pr[2], p = p)
  }))
  raw$p <- p.adjust(raw$p, method = "BH")   # BH across the 3 pairwise tests
  raw$sym <- sym(raw$p)
  raw
}))
ymax <- tapply(load_df$burden, load_df$level, max)

set.seed(18001)
## 60 patients, CNV segments with planted subgroup burden
n_pat <- 60
clin <- data.frame(
  Patient = sprintf("P%02d", 1:n_pat),
  Gender  = factor(rep(c("Female", "Male"), each = n_pat / 2)),
  Stage   = factor(rep(c("Stage I-II", "Stage III-IV"), times = n_pat / 2)))
seg <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:n_pat, function(i) {
  n_seg <- sample(18, 1)
  len <- sample(2e6, n_seg)
  start <- c(1, head(cumsum(len), -1))
  data.frame(sample = clin$Patient[i],
             chr = paste0("chr", sample(1:22, n_seg, TRUE)),
             start = start, end = start + len,
             value = rnorm(n_seg, 0, 0.12))
}))
## planted alterations: every patient gets a few subclonal CNVs, stage III-IV
## patients get many more strong ones
for (i in seq_len(n_pat)) {
  rows <- which(seg$sample == clin$Patient[i])
  n_alt <- 2 + if (clin$Stage[i] == "Stage III-IV") sample(4:8, 1) else 0
  sel <- sample(rows, min(n_alt, length(rows)))
  seg$value[sel] <- seg$value[sel] +
    sample(c(-1, 1), length(sel), TRUE) * runif(length(sel), 0.22, if (clin$Stage[i] == "Stage III-IV") 0.7 else 0.32)
}
## per-patient FGA/FGG/FGL (cBioPortal algorithm, |log2R| > 0.2)
fg <- do.call(rbind, lapply(clin$Patient, function(p) {
  s <- seg[seg$sample == p, ]; s$bases <- s$end - s$start
  tot <- sum(s$bases)
  data.frame(Patient = p,
             FGA = if (nrow(s)) sum(s$bases[abs(s$value) > 0.2]) / tot else 0,
             FGG = sum(s$bases[s$value > 0.2]) / tot,
             FGL = sum(s$bases[s$value < -0.2]) / tot)
}))
fg <- merge(fg, clin, by = "Patient")

summ <- fg %>% pivot_longer(c(FGA, FGG, FGL), names_to = "metric", values_to = "frac") %>%

set.seed(251)
## Simulated expression matrix: 3 subtypes x 15 replicates x 1200 genes
genes   <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%04d", 1:1200))
subtype <- rep(c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC"), each = 15)
signal  <- matrix(0, nrow = length(genes), ncol = 3,
                  dimnames = list(genes, c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC")))
pool <- genes
for (s in colnames(signal)) {          # 60 subtype-specific genes per subtype
  pick <- sample(pool, 60); signal[pick, s] <- 2; pool <- setdiff(pool, pick)
}
expr <- t(signal[, subtype]) +
  matrix(rnorm(length(subtype) * length(genes), sd = 0.6),
         nrow = length(subtype), ncol = length(genes))
colnames(expr) <- genes

## One-vs-rest log2FC per gene, per subtype (a t-test/limma loop can replace this)
lfc <- sapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  colMeans(expr[subtype == s, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(expr[subtype != s, , drop = FALSE])
})

## Signature gene sets: 5 sets of 30 genes per subtype
term2gene_sub <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, function(k)
    data.frame(term = paste0(s, "_signature_", k),
               gene = sample(genes[signal[, s] > 0], 30))))
}))

## GSEA per subtype on its own ranked list
gsea_res <- lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  GSEA(sort(lfc[, s], decreasing = TRUE), TERM2GENE = term2gene_sub,
       minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 100, pvalueCutoff = 1,
       eps = 0, seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
})
names(gsea_res) <- colnames(signal)

## Top-5 up-regulated pathways per subtype
top_gs <- lapply(gsea_res, function(r) {
  res <- as.data.frame(r)
  res <- res[res$NES > 0, ]
  head(rownames(res[order(res$NES, decreasing = TRUE), ]), 5)
})

## Specificity score: mean log2FC of each top set's genes in EVERY subtype
score <- t(sapply(unlist(top_gs, use.names = FALSE), function(gs) {
  gs_genes <- term2gene_sub$gene[term2gene_sub$term == gs]
  colMeans(lfc[gs_genes, , drop = FALSE])
}))
ann <- data.frame(Subtype = gsub("_signature_[0-9]+$", "", rownames(score)),
                  row.names = rownames(score))
jco <- c("#F2CCCC", "#E6D8CF", "#D5E3F0")
pheatmap(score, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         border_color = NA, annotation_row = ann,
         annotation_colors = list(Subtype = c(SubtypeA = jco[1], SubtypeB = jco[2],
                                              SubtypeC = jco[3])),
         main = "Subtype-specific top pathways")

## Simulated expression matrix: 3 subtypes x 15 replicates x 1200 genes
genes   <- paste0("Gene", sprintf("%04d", 1:1200))
subtype <- rep(c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC"), each = 15)
signal  <- matrix(0, nrow = length(genes), ncol = 3,
                  dimnames = list(genes, c("SubtypeA", "SubtypeB", "SubtypeC")))
pool <- genes
for (s in colnames(signal)) {          # 60 subtype-specific genes per subtype
  pick <- sample(pool, 60); signal[pick, s] <- 2; pool <- setdiff(pool, pick)
}
expr <- t(signal[, subtype]) +
  matrix(rnorm(length(subtype) * length(genes), sd = 0.6),
         nrow = length(subtype), ncol = length(genes))
colnames(expr) <- genes

## One-vs-rest log2FC per gene, per subtype (a t-test/limma loop can replace this)
lfc <- sapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  colMeans(expr[subtype == s, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(expr[subtype != s, , drop = FALSE])
})

## Signature gene sets: 5 sets of 30 genes per subtype
term2gene_sub <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, function(k)
    data.frame(term = paste0(s, "_signature_", k),
               gene = sample(genes[signal[, s] > 0], 30))))
}))

## GSEA per subtype on its own ranked list
gsea_res <- lapply(colnames(signal), function(s) {
  GSEA(sort(lfc[, s], decreasing = TRUE), TERM2GENE = term2gene_sub,
       minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 100, pvalueCutoff = 1,
       eps = 0, seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
})
names(gsea_res) <- colnames(signal)

  res <- as.data.frame(r)
  res <- res[res$NES > 0, ]
  head(rownames(res[order(res$NES, decreasing = TRUE), ]), 5)
})

  gs_genes <- term2gene_sub$gene[term2gene_sub$term == gs]
  colMeans(lfc[gs_genes, , drop = FALSE])
}))

                  row.names = rownames(score))

## 3 transcripts x 160 windows (100 bp); regions: 5'UTR 1-20, CDS 21-110, 3'UTR 111-160
n_tr <- 3; n_w <- 160
lib_in <- 9.4e6; lib_ip <- 9.0e6
regions <- c(rep("5'UTR", 20), rep("CDS", 90), rep("3'UTR", 50))
tr_names <- sprintf("Transcript_%s", c("A", "B", "C"))
enrich <- list(
  A = c(rep(1, 95), rep(3.2, 15), rep(5.5, 25), rep(1, 25)),  # stop-codon shoulder + 3'UTR peak
  B = c(rep(1, 20), rep(1.5, 80), rep(5.0, 40), rep(1, 20)),  # modest CDS, strong 3'UTR
  C = c(rep(1, 4), rep(3.2, 8), rep(1, 148)))                  # rare 5'UTR peak
win <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_tr), function(t) {
  base <- pmax(1, rnbinom(n_w, size = 2, mu = 6))
  inp  <- base + rpois(n_w, 2)
  ip   <- rpois(n_w, inp * enrich[[t]] * (lib_ip / lib_in))
  data.frame(transcript = tr_names[t], window = 1:n_w,
             start = 1:n_w * 100 - 99, end = 1:n_w * 100,
             region = regions, input = inp, ip = ip)
}))
## per-window Fisher exact (IP vs input counts against library sizes)
win$p <- mapply(function(i, n) fisher.test(matrix(c(i, lib_ip - i, n, lib_in - n), 2))$p.value,
                win$ip, win$input)
win$padj <- p.adjust(win$p, "BH")
win$sig <- win$padj < 0.05 & win$ip / pmax(win$input, 1) > 2
## merge adjacent significant windows into peaks (gap <= 5 windows)
peaks <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tr_names, function(tr) {
  d <- win[win$transcript == tr & win$sig, ]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(data.frame(transcript = character(0), ps = integer(0), pe = integer(0)))
  brk <- c(0, which(diff(d$window) > 5), nrow(d))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(length(brk) - 1), function(k) {
    seg <- d[seq(brk[k] + 1, brk[k + 1]), ]
    data.frame(transcript = tr, ps = min(seg$start), pe = max(seg$end))
  }))
}))
cat("peaks called:", nrow(peaks), "\n"); print(peaks)

set.seed(43505)
chr_len <- 620
sentinel <- 412.6          # Mb

## Variants in a 1.2 Mb window around the sentinel. r2 decays with distance
## (the colour channel); -log10 P carries two signals, one of which is only in
## LD with the sentinel because it is physically close.
reg <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.004)) |>
  mutate(
    r2 = pmax(0, 1 - abs(pos - sentinel) / 0.62)^1.6,
    lp = -log10(pmax(1e-12, pmin(0.9,
      10^(-(2.1 + 6.4 * exp(-((pos - sentinel)^2) / (2 * 0.05^2)) +
              3.4 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.33))^2) / (2 * 0.035^2)) +
              runif(n()) * 1.6)))))
  )

genes <- data.frame(
  gene = c("GENEA", "GENEB", "GENEC", "GENED"),
  start = c(sentinel - 0.55, sentinel - 0.12, sentinel + 0.18, sentinel + 0.42),
  end   = c(sentinel - 0.35, sentinel + 0.06, sentinel + 0.40, sentinel + 0.57)
)
genes$mid <- (genes$start + genes$end) / 2
exons <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(genes)), function(i) {
  g <- genes[i, ]
  data.frame(gene = g$gene,
             x0 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3),
             x1 = seq(g$start, g$end - 0.02, length.out = 3) + 0.025)
}))

rec <- data.frame(pos = seq(sentinel - 0.6, sentinel + 0.6, by = 0.01)) |>
  mutate(
    ## a recombination hotspot sits between the two signals, which is why they
    ## are in separate LD blocks
    cmmb = 0.8 + 1.6 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel + 0.16))^2) / (2 * 0.012^2)) +
      0.35 * exp(-((pos - (sentinel - 0.3))^2) / (2 * 0.08^2))
  )

## LD bins: the five-step palette that LocusZoom made standard.
ld_cols <- c("0-0.2" = "#d9d9d9", "0.2-0.4" = "#fdd49e",
             "0.4-0.6" = "#fdbb84", "0.6-0.8" = "#e34a33",
             "0.8-1" = "#b30000")
reg <- reg |>
  mutate(ld = cut(r2, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, Inf),
                  labels = names(ld_cols), right = FALSE),
         is_sentinel = abs(pos - sentinel) < 0.0015)

xlim <- c(sentinel - 0.63, sentinel + 0.63)

p_assoc <- ggplot(reg, aes(pos, lp)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = ld), size = 1.4, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = filter(reg, is_sentinel), shape = 23, size = 3,
             fill = "#4d004b", colour = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = sentinel, y = max(reg$lp) + 0.9, label = "sentinel",
           size = 2.4, colour = "#4d004b") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ld_cols, name = expression(r^2), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(reg$lp) + 1.6), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 12, 3)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10]~italic(P))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.28, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7),

  geom_rect(data = exons, aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = -0.25, ymax = 0.25),

# MultiCohortImmSubtypePlot prototype: 3-cohort feature heatmap + KM
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ggplot2); library(pheatmap); library(survival); library(survminer); library(patchwork)})
set.seed(21101)
cohorts <- c("TCGA", "GSE41613", "GSE65858")
n_coh <- c(110, 70, 60)
feats <- c(paste0("Cell", sprintf("%02d", 1:22)), "ImmuneScore", "StromalScore")
## latent 3-cluster structure + cohort batch shifts
lat <- rep(sample(1:3, 3), c(110, 70, 60))  # cluster label per sample
mat <- matrix(0, length(feats), sum(n_coh))
for (i in seq_along(feats)) {
  eff <- rnorm(3, 0, 0.6)[lat]          # cluster effect
  batch <- rnorm(3, 0, 0.3)             # cohort batch effect
  bidx <- rep(seq_along(cohorts), n_coh)
  mat[i, ] <- eff + batch[bidx] + rnorm(sum(n_coh), 0, 0.5)
}
colnames(mat) <- paste0(rep(cohorts, n_coh), "_", sequence(n_coh))
batch <- rep(cohorts, n_coh)
## ICIcluster via kmeans on the scaled feature matrix (ConsensusClusterPlus surrogate)
indata <- scale(t(mat))
km3 <- kmeans(indata, centers = 3, nstart = 10)
ici <- paste0("ICIcluster", km3$cluster)
## survival: one cluster is high-risk
hr_eff <- c(1.0, 1.5, 0.7)[km3$cluster]
OS.time <- pmin(120, pmax(2, qweibull(runif(sum(n_coh)), 1, 70 / hr_eff)))
OS <- rbinom(sum(n_coh), 1, 0.6)
ann_col <- data.frame(ICIcluster = ici, Project = batch)
rownames(ann_col) <- colnames(mat)
## Fig A: standardized feature heatmap (clip ±2), samples sorted by cluster then cohort
ord <- order(ici, batch)
std <- t(scale(t(mat)))          # feature z across samples
std[] <- pmin(2, pmax(-2, std))  # in-place clamp preserves dims (pmin strips them)
## sort features by their cluster-1 vs cluster-2 mean difference (block coherence)
fdir <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(std)), function(i)
  mean(std[i, ici == unique(ici)[1]]) - mean(std[i, ici == unique(ici)[2]]))
std <- std[order(fdir), ]

pheatmap(std[, ord], color = colorRampPalette(c("#282B71", "white", "#CF2221"))(64),
         cluster_cols = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE,
         annotation_col = ann_col[ord, ],
         annotation_colors = list(ICIcluster = c(ICIcluster1 = "#E21F26", ICIcluster2 = "#2874C5", ICIcluster3 = "#EABF00"),
                                  Project = setNames(c("#999999", "#666666", "#333333"), cohorts)),
         treeheight_row = 0, treeheight_col = 0,
         show_colnames = FALSE, border_color = NA,
         main = "Standardized immune features by ICI cluster (simulated)")

## Fig B: KM + risk table (ggsurvplot returns list; print separately)
sdf <- data.frame(OS.time = OS.time, OS = OS, ICIcluster = factor(ici))
fitd <- survdiff(Surv(OS.time, OS) ~ ICIcluster, data = sdf)
pval <- 1 - pchisq(fitd$chisq, length(fitd$n) - 1)
ggs <- survminer::ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(OS.time, OS) ~ ICIcluster, data = sdf),
                             risk.table = TRUE, risk.table.col = "strata",
                             palette = c("#E21F26", "#2874C5", "#EABF00"),
                             xlim = c(0, 120), break.time.by = 20,
                             surv.median.line = "hv", pval = FALSE,
                             legend.labs = levels(sdf$ICIcluster),
                             risk.table.height = 0.3)
print(ggs)
cat("log-rank P =", signif(pval, 3), "\n")

set.seed(43513)

## Eight orthologues of a 60-residue fragment: positions 1-25 and 40-52 are
## conserved (the two secondary-structure elements the strip will mark).
aa <- strsplit("ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY", "")[[1]]
classes <- c(A = "h", V = "h", I = "h", L = "h", M = "h", F = "a", W = "a",
             Y = "a", S = "p", T = "p", N = "p", Q = "p", C = "p", G = "t",
             P = "t", D = "n", E = "n", K = "b", R = "b", H = "b")

prot <- matrix(sample(aa, 8 * 60, replace = TRUE), nrow = 8)
conserved <- c(1:25, 40:52)
for (p in conserved) {
  keep <- sample(aa, 1)
  prot[, p] <- keep                            # fully conserved columns
}
## two columns are conserved only at class level
for (p in c(28, 55)) {
  cls <- sample(c("h", "p", "b"), 1)
  prot[, p] <- sample(names(classes)[classes == cls], 8, replace = TRUE)
}
rownames(prot) <- sprintf("SPECIES_%d", 1:8)

long <- as.data.frame(prot, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  rownames_to_column("seq") |>
  pivot_longer(-seq, names_to = "col", values_to = "residue") |>
  mutate(col = as.integer(sub("V", "", col)),
         row = as.integer(sub("SPECIES_", "", seq)))

## Conservation per column: identity (all residues equal) or class identity.
cons <- long |>
  group_by(col) |>
  summarise(n_res = n_distinct(residue),
            n_cls = n_distinct(classes[residue]), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(level = case_when(n_res == 1 ~ "identical",
                           n_cls == 1 ~ "class",
                           TRUE ~ "none"))

long <- left_join(long, cons |> select(col, level), by = "col") |>
  mutate(is_ident = !is.na(level) & level == "identical")

## Secondary-structure assignment for the strip.
ss <- data.frame(col = seq_len(60)) |>
  mutate(element = case_when(
    col %in% 4:12 ~ "helix H1",
    col %in% 18:24 ~ "strand S1",
    col %in% 41:48 ~ "helix H2",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_))

p <- ggplot(long, aes(col, row)) +
  ## Boxshade-style shading layer, drawn behind the letters.
  geom_tile(data = filter(cons, level != "none"),
            aes(x = col, y = 4.5, fill = level, width = 1, height = 8),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = NA) +
  geom_text(aes(colour = is_ident), label = long$residue,
            size = 1.7, family = "mono") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(identical = "#222222", class = "#9db8d2"),
                    name = "conservation") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "#252525"),
                      guide = "none") +
  ## secondary-structure strip on top of the alignment rows
  geom_segment(data = filter(ss, !is.na(element) & grepl("helix", element)),
               aes(x = col - 0.4, xend = col + 0.4, y = 0.55, yend = 0.55),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "#b2182b", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(data = filter(ss, !is.na(element) & grepl("strand", element)),
               aes(x = col - 0.4, xend = col + 0.4, y = 0.55, yend = 0.55),

               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.06, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
  annotate("text", x = c(8, 21, 44), y = 0.28,
           label = c("H1", "S1", "H2"), size = 2.2,
           colour = c("#b2182b", "#2166ac", "#b2182b")) +
  ## row 1 at the top, as alignments are always printed

                     trans = "reverse", limits = c(0.2, 9.7),

set.seed(2186)
aas <- strsplit("ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV", "")[[1]]
anc <- paste(sample(aas, 140, replace = TRUE), collapse = "")

evolve <- function(seq, n_sub) {
  s <- strsplit(seq, "")[[1]]
  pos <- sample(length(s), n_sub)
  s[pos] <- sample(aas, length(pos), replace = TRUE)
  paste(s, collapse = "")
}
## two subfamilies: 22 substitutions shared within each lineage, 6 private per member
fam_a <- anc; fam_b <- anc
for (j in 1:22) { fam_a <- evolve(fam_a, 1); fam_b <- evolve(fam_b, 1) }
seqs <- c(
  setNames(vapply(1:6, function(j) evolve(fam_a, 6), ""), paste0("FAM1_M", 1:6)),
  setNames(vapply(1:6, function(j) evolve(fam_b, 6), ""), paste0("FAM2_U", 1:6)))
aln <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seqs, function(s) strsplit(s, "")[[1]]))
rownames(aln) <- names(seqs)

n_samp <- 18
grp <- factor(rep(c("Group1", "Group2"), c(6, 12)))
expr <- matrix(rnorm(12 * n_samp, sd = 0.7), 12, n_samp,
               dimnames = list(rownames(aln), paste0("S", 1:n_samp)))
expr[grep("FAM1", rownames(expr)), grp == "Group1"] <-
  expr[grep("FAM1", rownames(expr)), grp == "Group1"] + 1.4
expr[grep("FAM2", rownames(expr)), grp == "Group2"] <-
  expr[grep("FAM2", rownames(expr)), grp == "Group2"] + 1.4

ann_col <- data.frame(group = grp); rownames(ann_col) <- colnames(expr)
pheatmap(expr, scale = "row", clustering_method = "complete",
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         annotation_colors = list(group = c(Group1 = "#F4A582", Group2 = "#92C5DE")),
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(20),
         show_colnames = FALSE, fontsize = 9)

## write the member sequences as FASTA (the real workflow aligns member FASTAs)
fa <- file.path(tempdir(), "family_msa.fasta")
con <- file(fa, "w")
for (nm in names(seqs)) writeLines(c(paste0(">", nm), seqs[[nm]]), con)
close(con)
ggmsa(fa, start = 1, end = 60, font = "DroidSansMono",
      color = "Chemistry_AA", char_width = 0.5, seq_name = TRUE)

n <- nrow(aln)
d <- matrix(0, n, n, dimnames = list(rownames(aln), rownames(aln)))
for (i in 2:n) for (j in 1:(i - 1)) {
  d[i, j] <- d[j, i] <- 1 - mean(aln[i, ] == aln[j, ])
}
tree <- nj(as.dist(d))
sub <- ifelse(grepl("FAM1", tree$tip.label), "subfamily 1", "subfamily 2")
xr <- max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(tree))
ggtree(tree, size = 0.8) %<+% data.frame(label = tree$tip.label, sub = sub) +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = sub), size = 2.6) +
  geom_tiplab(aes(color = sub), size = 3.2, offset = 0.02,
              align = TRUE, linesize = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("subfamily 1" = "#B2182B",
                                "subfamily 2" = "#2166AC"), name = NULL) +
  xlim(0, xr * 1.5) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

n_mut_genes <- 220

## covariate-adjusted binomial test: expected mutations = genome-wide rate

  pbinom(n_mut[i] - 1, size = 180,
         prob = pmin(0.15, covariate[i] * 0.015), lower.tail = FALSE)
})
qvals <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")

                    significant = qvals < 0.1, gene = paste0("GENE", sprintf("%03d", 1:n_mut_genes)))

  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.2, 5), guide = "none") +

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

  p <- if (cohort[i] == "Subtype A") p_a else p_b

  type <- sample(mut_types, length(hit), replace = TRUE, prob = type_p)
  # Tumor suppressors such as TP53 can receive a second hit, shown as Multi_Hit
  if (runif(1) < .15 && "TP53" %in% hit) {
    type[hit == "TP53"] <- "Multi_Hit"
  }
  tibble(sample = samples[i], gene = hit, type = type)
})

n_sm4 <- 60

expo <- expo / rowSums(expo)
## observed 96-channel counts: multinomial draws from each sample's mixture
counts <- t(apply(expo, 1, function(e) as.vector(rmultinom(1, 120, W %*% e))))

nnls_fit <- function(x, W) {
  coef <- lm(x ~ W - 1)$coefficients
  coef[coef < 0] <- 0                      # non-negativity, as deconstructSigs
  coef / sum(coef)
}
expo_fit <- t(apply(counts, 1, nnls_fit, W = W))
colnames(expo_fit) <- colnames(W)

sig_exp2 <- sig_exp[order(sig_exp$APOBEC), ]

  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "signature", values_to = "exposure") %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = sig_exp2$sample))

ggplot(sig_long, aes(sample, exposure, fill = signature)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Aging = "#B2182B", APOBEC = "#2166AC"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Samples (sorted by APOBEC exposure)", y = "Signature exposure (share)",

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 5),

pred <- t(apply(expo_fit, 1, function(e) 120 * as.vector(W %*% e)))
cs <- apply(cbind(counts, pred), 1, function(r) cosine(r[1:96], r[97:192]))
extremes <- c(which.min(sig_exp$APOBEC), which.max(sig_exp$APOBEC))

  m <- sapply(paths, function(pw) rnorm(n_pc, path_mean[pw], 0.12))
  data.frame(cell = ct, m, check.names = FALSE)
}))
scores_tr <- scores_ctl
immune_hit <- scores_tr$cell %in% c("CD8 T", "Macro")

  scores_tr$HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA[immune_hit] + 0.28

  scores_tr$HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING[immune_hit] + 0.32

  off <- rnorm(length(cts), 0, 0.07); names(off) <- cts

# 1. Environment Preparation
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# 2. Run Enrichment Analysis
# Assume gene_list is a vector of Entrez IDs for differentially expressed genes

# 2.1 GO Enrichment Analysis (Get BP/CC/MF simultaneously)
ego <- enrichGO(
  gene     = gene_list,
  OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db,
  ont      = "ALL",
  readable = TRUE  # Automatically convert IDs in results to Symbols
)

# 2.2 KEGG Enrichment Analysis
ekegg <- enrichKEGG(
  gene     = gene_list,
  organism = 'hsa'
)
# KEGG results default to Entrez ID; manually convert to Symbol to match plotting data format
ekegg <- setReadable(ekegg, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", keyType = "ENTREZID")

# 3. Data Cleaning and Merging
# Extract GO results (Rename ONTOLOGY to Category)
df_go <- as.data.frame(ego) %>% 
  select(Category = ONTOLOGY, Description, p.adjust, Count, geneID)

# Extract KEGG results (Manually add Category column and assign as "KEGG")
df_kegg <- as.data.frame(ekegg) %>% 
  mutate(Category = "KEGG") %>% 
  select(Category, Description, p.adjust, Count, geneID)

# Merge all results -> Get raw_data for plotting
raw_data <- rbind(df_go, df_kegg)

# 1. Read Data
raw_data <- read_tsv("files/cos/DAVID.txt")

# 2. Data Cleaning
# Convert DAVID format to the standard format required for plotting
raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  # 2.1 Extract Category Labels
  mutate(Category = case_when(
    grepl("BP_DIRECT", Category) ~ "BP",
    grepl("CC_DIRECT", Category) ~ "CC",
    grepl("MF_DIRECT", Category) ~ "MF",
    grepl("KEGG_PATHWAY", Category) ~ "KEGG",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  # Keep only GO and KEGG results
  filter(Category %in% c("BP", "CC", "MF", "KEGG")) %>%
  
  # 2.2 Clean Pathway Names (Remove IDs, e.g., "GO:001~Name" -> "Name")
  mutate(Description = sub("^.*~|.*:", "", Term)) %>%
  
  # 2.3 Rename Columns (Unified variable names for plotting code)
  # FDR -> p.adjust (Significance)
  # Genes -> geneID (Gene List)
  rename(
    p.adjust = FDR,
    geneID = Genes
  ) %>%
  
  # 2.4 Format Gene Lists (Replace commas with slashes)
  mutate(geneID = gsub(", ", "/", geneID))

# 1. Select the Top 5 most significant pathways for each category
use_pathway <- raw_data %>%
  arrange(p.adjust) %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Construct Auxiliary Plotting Columns
use_pathway <- use_pathway %>%
  # Set factor levels: determines the vertical order of legend and plot (BP -> CC -> MF -> KEGG)
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = rev(c('BP', 'CC', 'MF', 'KEGG')))) %>%
  # Secondary sorting
  arrange(Category, p.adjust) %>%
  # Fix Y-axis order
  mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = Description)) %>%
  # Add index column as Y-axis coordinates
  tibble::rowid_to_column('index')

# 3. Construct Data for Left Category Blocks (rect.data)
# Layout parameters
width <- 0.5 
# Calculate max X-axis length for drawing the bottom line
xaxis_max <- max(-log10(use_pathway$p.adjust)) + 1

rect.data <- use_pathway %>%
  arrange(Category) %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = -3 * width,          # Block left boundary
    xmax = -2 * width,          # Block right boundary
    ymax = cumsum(n),           # Block top boundary (based on cumulative count)
    ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0) + 0.6, # Block bottom boundary (leave a small gap)
    ymax = ymax + 0.4           # Adjust top boundary
  )

# DrugTargetPlot prototype: ridge-predicted AUC vs PPS (pRRophetic-equivalent via glmnet)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(forcats); library(cowplot)})
set.seed(21201)
n_patient <- 120; n_gene <- 200; n_drug <- 6
genes <- sprintf("G%04d", 1:n_gene)
drugs <- c("DrugA", "DrugB", "DrugC", "DrugD", "DrugE", "DrugF")
## planted: AUC correlates negatively with a PPS-like signature (genes 1-10)
pps_w <- runif(10, 0.5, 1.5)
patient_expr <- matrix(rnorm(n_patient * n_gene), n_patient, n_gene, dimnames = list(NULL, genes))
PPS <- as.vector(scale(patient_expr[, 1:10] %*% pps_w))
PPS <- pmin(1, pmax(0, (PPS - min(PPS)) / diff(range(PPS))))
## simulate predicted AUC directly (skip ridge: the tutorial is about the
## VISUALISATION; in production the ridge/pRRophetic route is documented in
## the reference paper and its text)
pred_auc <- do.call(cbind, lapply(seq_len(n_drug), function(d) {
  effect <- -(0.15 + 0.45 * d / n_drug)   # DrugF strongest negative
  pmax(0.02, 0.8 + effect * PPS + rnorm(n_patient, 0, 0.08))
}))
colnames(pred_auc) <- drugs
## per-drug Spearman with PPS
cors <- apply(pred_auc, 2, function(v) cor.test(v, PPS, method = "spearman"))
corr_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_drug), function(d) {
  ct <- cors[[d]]
  data.frame(drug = drugs[d], r = as.numeric(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value)
}))
corr_df$nlp <- -log10(pmax(corr_df$p, 1e-8))
corr_df <- corr_df[order(corr_df$r), ]
corr_df$drug <- factor(corr_df$drug, levels = corr_df$drug)

## high vs low PPS deciles
q <- quantile(PPS, probs = c(0.1, 0.9))
grp <- ifelse(PPS >= q[2], "High PPS", ifelse(PPS <= q[1], "Low PPS", NA))
box_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_drug), function(d)
  data.frame(drug = drugs[d], auc = pred_auc[!is.na(grp), d], grp = factor(grp[!is.na(grp)], c("Low PPS", "High PPS")))))
stars_df <- box_df %>% group_by(drug) %>%

# Generate quantile breakpoints (automatically adapt to data distribution)

                          na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  unique()  # Ensure breakpoints are unique

# How to correctly generate interval labels
time_labels <- paste0(
  round(custom_breaks[-length(custom_breaks)]),  # Starting point (excluding the last one)
  "-",
  round(custom_breaks[-1])  # End point (excluding the first one)
)

# Generate segmented risk table data --------------------------------------------------------

  mutate(
    time_interval = cut(time,
                        breaks = custom_breaks,
                        include.lowest = TRUE,
                        right = FALSE,
                        labels = time_labels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(group, time_interval) %>%
  summarise(
    n_risk = ifelse(all(is.na(n.risk)), 0, max(n.risk, na.rm = TRUE)),  # Take the maximum number of people at risk within the interval
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(group, time_interval, fill = list(n_risk = 0)) %>%
  # 4. Added total row (fixed syntax)
  bind_rows(
    group_by(., group) %>%
      summarise(
        time_interval = "Total",
        n_risk = sum(n_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Treatment", "Placebo")),
    time_interval = factor(time_interval, levels = c(time_labels, "Total") )

n_km <- 160
svdata <- data.frame(futime = rexp(n_km, 0.02), fustat = rbinom(n_km, 1, 0.75))
g_expr <- matrix(rnorm(n_km * 8, 5, 1.2), n_km, 8,
                 dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("GENE", 1:8)))
## plant effects: GENE1 high = worse, GENE3 high = protective, GENE5 = no effect
g_expr[, 1] <- g_expr[, 1] + (svdata$futime < quantile(svdata$futime, 0.45)) * 2.2
g_expr[, 3] <- g_expr[, 3] - (svdata$futime < quantile(svdata$futime, 0.45)) * 2.0
svdata <- cbind(svdata, as.data.frame(g_expr))

res.cut <- surv_cutpoint(svdata, time = "futime", event = "fustat",
                         variables = paste0("GENE", 1:8), minprop = 0.3)
res.cat <- surv_categorize(res.cut)
cuts <- summary(res.cut)$cutpoint

my.surv <- with(res.cat, Surv(futime, fustat))
pl <- list()
for (i in paste0("GENE", 1:8)) {
  group <- factor(res.cat[[i]], levels = c("low", "high"))
  sd1 <- survdiff(my.surv ~ group)
  p.val <- 1 - pchisq(sd1$chisq, length(sd1$n) - 1)
  HR <- (sd1$obs[2] / sd1$exp[2]) / (sd1$obs[1] / sd1$exp[1])
  up95 <- exp(log(HR) + qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(1 / sd1$exp[2] + 1 / sd1$exp[1]))
  low95 <- exp(log(HR) - qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(1 / sd1$exp[2] + 1 / sd1$exp[1]))
  if (p.val > 0.05) next
  fit <- survfit(my.surv ~ group)
  svsort <- svdata[order(svdata[, i]), ]
  pl[[i]] <- ggsurvplot(fit, data = data.frame(group = group),
                        conf.int = FALSE, censor = FALSE,
                        palette = c("#D95F02", "#1B9E77"),
                        legend.title = i,
                        legend.labs = c(paste0("high >", round(svsort[fit$n[2], i], 2), " (n=", fit$n[1], ")"),
                                        paste0("low  <=", round(svsort[fit$n[2], i], 2), " (n=", fit$n[2], ")")),
                        pval = paste(ifelse(p.val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", round(p.val, 3))),
                                     paste0("HR = ", round(HR, 2)),
                                     paste0("95% CI: ", round(low95, 2), "-", round(up95, 2)), sep = "\n"))
}

# Data preprocessing
surv_data <- lung %>%
  mutate(
    status = ifelse(status == 2, 1, 0),  # Transition state code (1=event)
    sex = factor(sex, labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    group = sample(c("Treatment", "Placebo"), n(), replace = TRUE)
  )

# View data structure
glimpse(surv_data)

# Survival time distribution
summary(surv_data$time)

# Fitting survival curves
fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ group, data = surv_data)

# Extract curve data
surv_curve <- surv_summary(fit) 


# Calculate the log-rank test P value
diff <- survdiff(Surv(time, status) ~ group, data = surv_data)
p_value <- signif(1 - pchisq(diff$chisq, length(diff$n)-1), 3)

# Basic survival curve
p1 <- ggplot(surv_curve, aes(x = time, y = surv, color = strata)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Time (Months)", y = "Survival Probability") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent)
p1

# ----------------------------
# Risk table data generation
# ----------------------------
# Generate quantile breakpoints (automatically adapt to data distribution)
custom_breaks <- quantile(surv_curve$time, 
                          probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), 
                          na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  unique()  # Ensure breakpoints are unique

# How to correctly generate interval labels
time_labels <- paste0(
  round(custom_breaks[-length(custom_breaks)]),  # Starting point (excluding the last one)
  "-",
  round(custom_breaks[-1])  # End point (excluding the first one)
)

# Generate segmented risk table data --------------------------------------------------------
risk_table_segmented <- surv_curve %>%
  mutate(
    time_interval = cut(time,
                        breaks = custom_breaks,
                        include.lowest = TRUE,
                        right = FALSE,
                        labels = time_labels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(group, time_interval) %>%
  summarise(
    n_risk = ifelse(all(is.na(n.risk)), 0, max(n.risk, na.rm = TRUE)),  # Take the maximum number of people at risk within the interval
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(group, time_interval, fill = list(n_risk = 0)) %>%
  # 4. Added total row (fixed syntax)
  bind_rows(
    group_by(., group) %>%
      summarise(
        time_interval = "Total",
        n_risk = sum(n_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Treatment", "Placebo")),
    time_interval = factor(time_interval, levels = c(time_labels, "Total") )
  )

# Plot of a segmented risk table with borders ----------------------------------------------------
risk_table_plot <- ggplot(risk_table_segmented, 
                          aes(x = time_interval, y = group)) +
  # # Cell background (with border)
  # geom_tile(color = "gray50", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.5, 
  #           width = 0.95, height = 0.95) +
  # Numeric Label
  geom_text(aes(label = n_risk), size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  # Column header style
  scale_x_discrete(
    name = "Time Interval (Months)",
    position = "top",
    expand = expansion(add = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    name = NULL, 
    limits = rev,
    labels = c("Treatment\nGroup", "Placebo\nGroup")  # Add group labels
  ) +
  # Color system
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, guide = "none") +
  # Theme System
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      color = group_colors,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(r = 15)
    ),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 30, b = 5, unit = "pt"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15))
  ) +
  # Add an outer border
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           color = "gray30", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
risk_table_plot

set.seed(4284)
n_g <- 60
grp <- factor(rep(c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"), each = n_g),
              levels = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"))
rate <- c(A = 0.030, B = 0.022, C = 0.008, D = 0.016, E = 0.012)
t_event <- rexp(5 * n_g, rate = rate[as.character(grp)])
t_cens  <- rexp(5 * n_g, rate = 0.008)
km5 <- data.frame(OS.time = pmin(t_event, t_cens),
                  OS = as.integer(t_event <= t_cens),
                  group = grp)

# overall log-rank test
fitd <- survdiff(Surv(OS.time, OS) ~ group, data = km5)
p_overall <- 1 - pchisq(fitd$chisq, length(fitd$n) - 1)
p_lab <- paste0("Log-rank test P",
                ifelse(p_overall < 0.001, " < 0.001",
                       paste0(" = ", round(p_overall, 3))))

# pairwise log-rank tests, Holm-adjusted (the survminer default;
# the source figure used p.adjust.method = "none" to match its published table)
ps <- pairwise_survdiff(Surv(OS.time, OS) ~ group, data = km5,
                        p.adjust.method = "holm")

fit <- survfit(Surv(OS.time, OS) ~ group, data = km5)
names(fit$strata) <- gsub("group=", "", names(fit$strata))
mycol <- brewer.pal(n = 10, "Paired")[c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)]

addTab <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(ifelse(round(ps$p.value, 3) < 0.001,
                                         "<0.001", round(ps$p.value, 3))))
addTab[is.na(addTab)] <- "-"

p <- ggsurvplot(fit, data = km5,
                conf.int = FALSE,
                risk.table = TRUE, risk.table.col = "strata",
                palette = mycol,
                xlim = c(0, 120), break.time.by = 24,
                size = 0.9,
                legend.title = "",
                xlab = "Time (months)", ylab = "Overall survival",
                risk.table.y.text = FALSE,
                tables.height = 0.28,
                ggtheme = theme_classic(base_size = 11))

p$plot <- p$plot +
  annotate("text", x = 55, y = 0.95, hjust = 0, fontface = 4, size = 3.4,
           label = p_lab) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.315, hjust = 0, size = 3, fontface = 3,
           label = "Pairwise log-rank P (Holm)") +
  geom_table(data = tibble::tibble(x = 0, y = 0.02, tb = list(addTab)),
             aes(x = x, y = y, label = tb),
             table.rownames = TRUE,
             table.theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 8,
                                          core = list(fg_params = list(fontsize = 7.5))))
p

set.seed(3511)
n_km <- 160
svdata <- data.frame(futime = rexp(n_km, 0.02), fustat = rbinom(n_km, 1, 0.75))
g_expr <- matrix(rnorm(n_km * 8, 5, 1.2), n_km, 8,
                 dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("GENE", 1:8)))
## plant effects: GENE1 high = worse, GENE3 high = protective, GENE5 = no effect
g_expr[, 1] <- g_expr[, 1] + (svdata$futime < quantile(svdata$futime, 0.45)) * 2.2
g_expr[, 3] <- g_expr[, 3] - (svdata$futime < quantile(svdata$futime, 0.45)) * 2.0
svdata <- cbind(svdata, as.data.frame(g_expr))

res.cut <- surv_cutpoint(svdata, time = "futime", event = "fustat",
                         variables = paste0("GENE", 1:8), minprop = 0.3)
res.cat <- surv_categorize(res.cut)
cuts <- summary(res.cut)$cutpoint

my.surv <- with(res.cat, Surv(futime, fustat))
pl <- list()
for (i in paste0("GENE", 1:8)) {
  group <- factor(res.cat[[i]], levels = c("low", "high"))
  sd1 <- survdiff(my.surv ~ group)
  p.val <- 1 - pchisq(sd1$chisq, length(sd1$n) - 1)
  HR <- (sd1$obs[2] / sd1$exp[2]) / (sd1$obs[1] / sd1$exp[1])
  up95 <- exp(log(HR) + qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(1 / sd1$exp[2] + 1 / sd1$exp[1]))
  low95 <- exp(log(HR) - qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(1 / sd1$exp[2] + 1 / sd1$exp[1]))
  if (p.val > 0.05) next
  fit <- survfit(my.surv ~ group)
  svsort <- svdata[order(svdata[, i]), ]
  pl[[i]] <- ggsurvplot(fit, data = data.frame(group = group),
                        conf.int = FALSE, censor = FALSE,
                        palette = c("#D95F02", "#1B9E77"),
                        legend.title = i,
                        legend.labs = c(paste0("high >", round(svsort[fit$n[2], i], 2), " (n=", fit$n[1], ")"),
                                        paste0("low  <=", round(svsort[fit$n[2], i], 2), " (n=", fit$n[2], ")")),
                        pval = paste(ifelse(p.val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", round(p.val, 3))),
                                     paste0("HR = ", round(HR, 2)),
                                     paste0("95% CI: ", round(low95, 2), "-", round(up95, 2)), sep = "\n"))
}
patchwork::wrap_plots(lapply(pl, function(x) x$plot), ncol = 2, guides = "collect")

set.seed(4041)
n_bs <- 200
bs <- data.frame(futime = rexp(n_bs, 0.02), fustat = rbinom(n_bs, 1, 0.8),
                 expression = rnorm(n_bs, 5, 1.3))
bs$expression <- bs$expression - (bs$futime < quantile(bs$futime, 0.42)) * 2.0
sortsv <- bs[order(bs$expression), ]
pvals <- c(); hrs <- c()
for (n in 1:(nrow(sortsv) - 1)) {
  gp <- rep(c("low", "high"), c(n, nrow(sortsv) - n))
  d1 <- survdiff(Surv(futime, fustat) ~ gp, data = sortsv, rho = 0)
  pvals <- c(pvals, pchisq(d1$chisq, length(d1$n) - 1, lower.tail = FALSE))
  hrs <- c(hrs, d1$obs[1] * d1$exp[2] / (d1$obs[2] * d1$exp[1]))
}
fd <- data.frame(Tag = 1:(nrow(sortsv) - 1), HR = hrs, Pvalue = pvals)
best <- which.min(pvals)

ggplot(fd, aes(log2(HR), -log10(Pvalue))) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, aes(fill = Tag), colour = "grey25", size = 2.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#4477AA", "#77AADD", "#FFFFFF", "#EE9988", "#BB4444"),
                       guide = "none") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = log2(hrs[best]), y = -log10(pvals[best]) + 0.6,
           label = "min-P split", size = 3.2, colour = "#BB4444") +
  geom_point(data = fd[best, ], aes(log2(HR), -log10(Pvalue)),
             shape = 21, fill = "#BB4444", colour = "black", size = 3.4) +
  labs(x = "log2 hazard ratio at each split",
       y = "-log10(P), maximally selected log-rank",
       title = "Every split of 200 samples ranked by expression (simulated marker)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

gp_best <- rep(c("low", "high"), c(best, nrow(sortsv) - best))
fit_best <- survfit(Surv(futime, fustat) ~ gp_best, data = sortsv)
gp_med <- ifelse(sortsv$expression > median(sortsv$expression), "high", "low")
fit_med <- survfit(Surv(futime, fustat) ~ gp_med, data = sortsv)
p_best <- ggsurvplot(fit_best, linetype = "strata", conf.int = FALSE,
                     pval = TRUE, palette = c("#D95F02", "#1B9E77"),
                     legend.title = "", legend.labs = c("High", "Low"),
                     ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size = 11),
                     title = "Best separation (min-P split)")
p_med <- ggsurvplot(fit_med, linetype = "strata", conf.int = FALSE,
                    pval = TRUE, palette = c("#D95F02", "#1B9E77"),
                    legend.title = "", legend.labs = c("High", "Low"),
                    ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size = 11),
                    title = "Median separation")
patchwork::wrap_plots(list(p_best$plot, p_med$plot), ncol = 2)

set.seed(3511)
n_km <- 160
svdata <- data.frame(futime = rexp(n_km, 0.02), fustat = rbinom(n_km, 1, 0.75))
g_expr <- matrix(rnorm(n_km * 8, 5, 1.2), n_km, 8,
                 dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("GENE", 1:8)))
## plant effects: GENE1 high = worse, GENE3 high = protective, GENE5 = no effect
g_expr[, 1] <- g_expr[, 1] + (svdata$futime < quantile(svdata$futime, 0.45)) * 2.2
g_expr[, 3] <- g_expr[, 3] - (svdata$futime < quantile(svdata$futime, 0.45)) * 2.0
svdata <- cbind(svdata, as.data.frame(g_expr))

res.cut <- surv_cutpoint(svdata, time = "futime", event = "fustat",
                         variables = paste0("GENE", 1:8), minprop = 0.3)
res.cat <- surv_categorize(res.cut)
cuts <- summary(res.cut)$cutpoint

my.surv <- with(res.cat, Surv(futime, fustat))
pl <- list()
for (i in paste0("GENE", 1:8)) {
  group <- factor(res.cat[[i]], levels = c("low", "high"))
  sd1 <- survdiff(my.surv ~ group)
  p.val <- 1 - pchisq(sd1$chisq, length(sd1$n) - 1)
  HR <- (sd1$obs[2] / sd1$exp[2]) / (sd1$obs[1] / sd1$exp[1])
  up95 <- exp(log(HR) + qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(1 / sd1$exp[2] + 1 / sd1$exp[1]))
  low95 <- exp(log(HR) - qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(1 / sd1$exp[2] + 1 / sd1$exp[1]))
  if (p.val > 0.05) next
  fit <- survfit(my.surv ~ group)
  svsort <- svdata[order(svdata[, i]), ]
  pl[[i]] <- ggsurvplot(fit, data = data.frame(group = group),
                        conf.int = FALSE, censor = FALSE,
                        palette = c("#D95F02", "#1B9E77"),
                        legend.title = i,
                        legend.labs = c(paste0("high >", round(svsort[fit$n[2], i], 2), " (n=", fit$n[1], ")"),
                                        paste0("low  <=", round(svsort[fit$n[2], i], 2), " (n=", fit$n[2], ")")),
                        pval = paste(ifelse(p.val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", round(p.val, 3))),
                                     paste0("HR = ", round(HR, 2)),
                                     paste0("95% CI: ", round(low95, 2), "-", round(up95, 2)), sep = "\n"))
}
patchwork::wrap_plots(lapply(pl, function(x) x$plot), ncol = 2, guides = "collect")

  hrs <- c(hrs, d1$obs[1] * d1$exp[2] / (d1$obs[2] * d1$exp[1]))
}

# Generate quantile breakpoints (automatically adapt to data distribution)
custom_breaks <- quantile(surv_curve$time, 
                          probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), 
                          na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  unique()  # Ensure breakpoints are unique

# How to correctly generate interval labels
time_labels <- paste0(
  round(custom_breaks[-length(custom_breaks)]),  # Starting point (excluding the last one)
  "-",
  round(custom_breaks[-1])  # End point (excluding the first one)
)

# Generate segmented risk table data --------------------------------------------------------
risk_table_segmented <- surv_curve %>%
  mutate(
    time_interval = cut(time,
                        breaks = custom_breaks,
                        include.lowest = TRUE,
                        right = FALSE,
                        labels = time_labels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(group, time_interval) %>%
  summarise(
    n_risk = ifelse(all(is.na(n.risk)), 0, max(n.risk, na.rm = TRUE)),  # Take the maximum number of people at risk within the interval
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(group, time_interval, fill = list(n_risk = 0)) %>%
  # 4. Added total row (fixed syntax)
  bind_rows(
    group_by(., group) %>%
      summarise(
        time_interval = "Total",
        n_risk = sum(n_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Treatment", "Placebo")),
    time_interval = factor(time_interval, levels = c(time_labels, "Total") )
  )

set.seed(3511)
n_km <- 160
svdata <- data.frame(futime = rexp(n_km, 0.02), fustat = rbinom(n_km, 1, 0.75))
g_expr <- matrix(rnorm(n_km * 8, 5, 1.2), n_km, 8,
                 dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("GENE", 1:8)))
## plant effects: GENE1 high = worse, GENE3 high = protective, GENE5 = no effect
g_expr[, 1] <- g_expr[, 1] + (svdata$futime < quantile(svdata$futime, 0.45)) * 2.2
g_expr[, 3] <- g_expr[, 3] - (svdata$futime < quantile(svdata$futime, 0.45)) * 2.0
svdata <- cbind(svdata, as.data.frame(g_expr))

res.cut <- surv_cutpoint(svdata, time = "futime", event = "fustat",
                         variables = paste0("GENE", 1:8), minprop = 0.3)
res.cat <- surv_categorize(res.cut)
cuts <- summary(res.cut)$cutpoint

my.surv <- with(res.cat, Surv(futime, fustat))
pl <- list()
for (i in paste0("GENE", 1:8)) {
  group <- factor(res.cat[[i]], levels = c("low", "high"))
  sd1 <- survdiff(my.surv ~ group)
  p.val <- 1 - pchisq(sd1$chisq, length(sd1$n) - 1)
  HR <- (sd1$obs[2] / sd1$exp[2]) / (sd1$obs[1] / sd1$exp[1])
  up95 <- exp(log(HR) + qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(1 / sd1$exp[2] + 1 / sd1$exp[1]))
  low95 <- exp(log(HR) - qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(1 / sd1$exp[2] + 1 / sd1$exp[1]))
  if (p.val > 0.05) next
  fit <- survfit(my.surv ~ group)
  svsort <- svdata[order(svdata[, i]), ]
  pl[[i]] <- ggsurvplot(fit, data = data.frame(group = group),
                        conf.int = FALSE, censor = FALSE,
                        palette = c("#D95F02", "#1B9E77"),
                        legend.title = i,
                        legend.labs = c(paste0("high >", round(svsort[fit$n[2], i], 2), " (n=", fit$n[1], ")"),
                                        paste0("low  <=", round(svsort[fit$n[2], i], 2), " (n=", fit$n[2], ")")),
                        pval = paste(ifelse(p.val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", round(p.val, 3))),
                                     paste0("HR = ", round(HR, 2)),
                                     paste0("95% CI: ", round(low95, 2), "-", round(up95, 2)), sep = "\n"))
}

## 200 patients x 40 genes; 6 genes planted as prognostic
n <- 200; n_gene <- 40

prognostic <- c("GENE03", "GENE11", "GENE19", "GENE24", "GENE31", "GENE38")
coef <- c(0.32, -0.28, 0.34, 0.28, -0.32, 0.38)
