## here silently makes columns 1-6 the prognostic genes instead)
full_coef <- rep(0, n_gene); full_coef[match(prognostic, genes)] <- coef
lp <- as.vector(scale(as.vector(expr %*% full_coef)))
lam <- exp(lp)
OS.time <- pmin(3000, pmax(30, qweibull(runif(n), 1, 1200 / lam)))
OS <- rbinom(n, 1, pmin(0.9, pmax(0.05, 0.5 + 0.25 * lp)))

  summary(coxph(Surv(OS.time, OS) ~ get(g), data = dt.rf))$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"], numeric(1))
gene.sel <- names(cox_p)[cox_p < 0.05]

                     OS = rbinom(n, 1, 0.62))
tau <- 120  # months

## RMS per marker percentile: integrate the KM curve of the >= percentile
## subgroup over [0, tau] (equivalent to survRM2::rmst2's RMST for one arm)
rms2curve <- function(marker, n.grid = 25) {
  pp <- seq(0, 1, length = n.grid)
  sapply(pp, function(p) {
    q <- quantile(marker, p)
    d <- survdt[marker >= q, ]
    if (nrow(d) < 10) return(NA)
    km <- survfit(Surv(OS.time, OS) ~ 1, data = d)
    s <- summary(km, times = 0:tau, extend = TRUE)$surv
    sum(head(s, -1) + tail(s, -1)) / 2 * (tau / (length(s) - 1))   # trapezoid RMST
  })
}
rms1 <- rms2curve(base.marker)
rms2 <- rms2curve(modified.marker)
pp <- seq(0, 1, length = 25)
df <- data.frame(pp = rep(pp, 2),
                 rms = c(rms1, rms2),
                 marker = rep(c("Base marker", "Modified marker"), each = 25))

## Epanechnikov kernel hazard (the estimator muhaz implements), dependency-free
gen_smoothhaz <- function(times, delta, bw = 6, grid = seq(1, 66, 1)) {
  ev <- times[delta == 1]
  sapply(grid, function(g) {
    u <- (g - ev) / bw
    k <- 0.75 * (1 - u^2) * (abs(u) <= 1)          # Epanechnikov kernel
    at_risk <- sum(times >= g - bw & times >= 0)   # crude at-risk proxy in window
    ifelse(at_risk > 0, sum(k) / at_risk, 0)
  })
}

  d <- dat[dat$gender == g, ]
  data.frame(Months = seq(1, 66, 1),
             Hazard = gen_smoothhaz(d$survmonth, d$survevent),
             Subgroup = g)
}))

## log-rank score for every candidate cutpoint — dependency-free
## reimplementation of survMisc::cutp: the score is the survdiff chi-square of
## the high/low split at each unique expression value; the peak marks the
## survival-optimal cut-off (on real data survMisc::cutp(coxph) gives the
## same curve on the U-statistic scale)
logrank_curve <- function(gene) {
  vals <- sort(unique(exprsurv[[gene]]))
  vals <- vals[-length(vals)]                # last value would leave an empty group
  score <- vapply(vals, function(v) {
    grp <- exprsurv[[gene]] > v
    survdiff(Surv(OS.time, OS) ~ grp, data = exprsurv)$chisq
  }, numeric(1))
  data.frame(cut = vals, score = score)
}

               dimnames = list(genes, NULL))

                   dimnames = list(genes, cancers))

  cols <- idx_per_cancer[[ci]]
  tt <- pmin(90, pmax(2, qweibull(runif(n_per), 1, 60 / exp(0.5 * expr[g, cols]))))
  ev <- rbinom(n_per, 1, 0.6)

  hr <- sm[, "exp(coef)"]; p <- sm[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  survland[g, ci] <- if (p < 0.05) ifelse(hr > 1, 1, -1) else 0
}

## A chromosome table in the shape RIdeogram expects: name, start, end,
## centromere. Lengths are a five-chromosome toy genome in Mb.
karyo <- data.frame(
  chr = c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5"),
  len = c(120, 95, 80, 60, 45),
  cen = c(48, 34, 31, 21, 17)
)

## Cytobands: alternating stain with a density value, as G-band tables carry.
banding <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  starts <- seq(0, k$len, by = 6)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, start = starts, end = pmin(starts + 6, k$len),
             density = round(runif(length(starts), 0, 100)))
}))

## Per-window Fst with two planted peaks, so the reading order is verifiable.
win <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(karyo)), function(i) {
  k <- karyo[i, ]
  mid <- seq(1, k$len - 1, by = 2)
  fst <- 0.08 + 0.05 * abs(sin(mid / 9))
  if (k$chr == "chr2") fst <- fst + 0.55 * exp(-((mid - 62)^2) / 40)
  if (k$chr == "chr4") fst <- fst + 0.42 * exp(-((mid - 20)^2) / 50)
  data.frame(chr = k$chr, mid = mid,
             fst = pmin(0.95, fst + rnorm(length(mid), 0, 0.02)))
}))

  chr = c("chr1", "chr1", "chr2", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr5"),

  mutate(x0 = offset + start, x1 = offset + end)

permanova <- function(d, group, n_perm = 1000) {
  group <- factor(group)
  n <- length(group); k <- nlevels(group)
  D <- as.matrix(d)^2
  ## Anderson (2001) SS decomposition on ordered pairs:
  ## SS_total = sum_ij d2_ij / N;  SS_within = sum_g sum_ij(in g) d2_ij / n_g.
  ## (The /2 scale cancels in the F ratio; the previous tapply() call silently
  ## recycled the group index over the n(n-1)/2 distance values, corrupting
  ## the within-group sum and driving pseudo-F negative.)
  ss_total <- sum(D) / n
  ss_within <- sum(vapply(split(seq_len(n), group), function(idx) {
    sum(D[idx, idx]) / length(idx)
  }, numeric(1)))
  ss_between <- ss_total - ss_within
  f_obs <- (ss_between / (k - 1)) / (ss_within / (n - k))
  f_perm <- replicate(n_perm, {
    gp <- sample(seq_len(n))
    ssw <- sum(vapply(split(gp, group), function(idx) {
      sum(D[idx, idx]) / length(idx)
    }, numeric(1)))
    ssb <- ss_total - ssw
    (ssb / (k - 1)) / (ssw / (n - k))
  })
  c(F = f_obs, p = (sum(f_perm >= f_obs) + 1) / (n_perm + 1))
}

permanova <- function(d, group, n_perm = 1000) {
  group <- factor(group)
  n <- length(group); k <- nlevels(group)
  D <- as.matrix(d)^2
  ## Anderson (2001) SS decomposition on ordered pairs:
  ## SS_total = sum_ij d2_ij / N;  SS_within = sum_g sum_ij(in g) d2_ij / n_g.
  ## (The /2 scale cancels in the F ratio; the previous tapply() call silently
  ## recycled the group index over the n(n-1)/2 distance values, corrupting
  ## the within-group sum and driving pseudo-F negative.)
  ss_total <- sum(D) / n
  ss_within <- sum(vapply(split(seq_len(n), group), function(idx) {
    sum(D[idx, idx]) / length(idx)
  }, numeric(1)))
  ss_between <- ss_total - ss_within
  f_obs <- (ss_between / (k - 1)) / (ss_within / (n - k))
  f_perm <- replicate(n_perm, {
    gp <- sample(seq_len(n))
    ssw <- sum(vapply(split(gp, group), function(idx) {
      sum(D[idx, idx]) / length(idx)
    }, numeric(1)))
    ssb <- ss_total - ssw
    (ssb / (k - 1)) / (ssw / (n - k))
  })
  c(F = f_obs, p = (sum(f_perm >= f_obs) + 1) / (n_perm + 1))
}

set.seed(39233)
n_lnc <- 80; n_tum <- 25; n_nor <- 25
lncs <- sprintf("LNC%02d", 1:n_lnc)
sams <- c(paste0("T", 1:n_tum), paste0("N", 1:n_nor))
Sinfo <- data.frame(sample = sams,
                    Title = paste0(".../", sams, ifelse(grepl("^T", sams), "T", "N")))
Expr <- matrix(rnorm(n_lnc * (n_tum + n_nor), 5, 1), n_lnc, n_tum + n_nor,
               dimnames = list(lncs, sams))
## planted stable pairs: LNC01 < LNC02 < ... < LNC40 in normals
rank_shift <- matrix(0, n_lnc, n_tum + n_nor, dimnames = list(lncs, sams))
for (j in seq_len(40)) rank_shift[j, ] <- j * 0.08
Expr <- Expr + rank_shift
## tumour-only up-shift of drivers 1-6 -> their stable pairs reverse in tumours
drivers <- lncs[1:6]
Expr[1:6, 1:n_tum] <- Expr[1:6, 1:n_tum] + 3.2
## rank profile per sample
expr.rank <- apply(Expr, 2, rank)
tumsam <- Sinfo$sample[grepl("T$", Sinfo$Title)]
norsam <- Sinfo$sample[grepl("N$", Sinfo$Title)]

## step 1: pairs with >=95% consistent rank direction in normals
pairs <- NULL
for (i in 1:(n_lnc - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):n_lnc) {
    ratio <- mean(expr.rank[i, norsam] < expr.rank[j, norsam])
    if (ratio >= 0.95) pairs <- rbind(pairs, data.frame(V1 = lncs[i], V2 = lncs[j], cons = ratio))
    if (ratio <= 0.05) pairs <- rbind(pairs, data.frame(V1 = lncs[j], V2 = lncs[i], cons = 1 - ratio))
  }
}
## step 2: Fisher test of the direction table per pair
pairs$p_raw <- NA; pairs$dirct <- NA
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {
  a <- pairs$V1[i]; b <- pairs$V2[i]
  tum.d <- expr.rank[a, tumsam] - expr.rank[b, tumsam]
  nor.d <- expr.rank[a, norsam] - expr.rank[b, norsam]
  avg1 <- mean(expr.rank[a, tumsam]) - mean(expr.rank[a, norsam])
  avg2 <- mean(expr.rank[b, tumsam]) - mean(expr.rank[b, norsam])
  tmp <- matrix(c(sum(nor.d < 0), sum(nor.d > 0), sum(tum.d < 0), sum(tum.d > 0)),
                2, 2, byrow = TRUE,
                dimnames = list(c("Normal", "Tumour"), c("a<b", "a>b")))
  pairs$p_raw[i] <- fisher.test(tmp)$p.value
  pairs$dirct[i] <- ifelse(avg1 * avg2 > 0, "same", "different")
}
## BH across ALL reversal tests (adjusting one p at a time is a no-op)
pairs$FDR <- p.adjust(pairs$p_raw, method = "BH")
outSel <- pairs[pairs$FDR < 0.1 & pairs$dirct == "same", ]

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2.5, 1), las = 1)
hist(pairs$cons, breaks = seq(0.8, 1, 0.02), col = "#9DC3E6",
     xlab = "rank consistency in normals", main = "Step 1: stable pairs")
abline(v = 0.95, lwd = 2, lty = 2)
hts <- hist(pairs$cons, plot = FALSE)$counts
text(0.945, max(hts) * 0.9, "0.95 cutoff", adj = 1, cex = 0.8)
isdrv <- (outSel$V1 %in% drivers)
xr <- max(-log10(outSel$FDR))
plot(-log10(outSel$FDR), seq_len(nrow(outSel)), type = "n",
     xlab = "-log10(FDR) of reversal Fisher test", ylab = "",
     yaxt = "n", xlim = c(0, xr * 1.15), ylim = c(0, nrow(outSel) * 1.12),
     main = "Step 2: tumour-reversed pairs")
rows <- seq_len(nrow(outSel))
points(-log10(outSel$FDR)[isdrv], rows[isdrv], pch = 19, col = "#B2182B")
## only draw (and legend) the background class when it is actually present —
## with this seed every surviving pair is a planted driver
if (any(!isdrv)) points(-log10(outSel$FDR)[!isdrv], rows[!isdrv], pch = 17, col = "#4472C4")
legend("topright", inset = c(0.01, 0.01),
       legend = c("planted driver", "background")[c(TRUE, any(!isdrv))],
       pch = c(19, 17)[c(TRUE, any(!isdrv))],
       col = c("#B2182B", "#4472C4")[c(TRUE, any(!isdrv))], bty = "n", cex = 0.85)

## step 3: top-3 lowest-CV partners per query lncRNA
n.top <- 3
queries <- unique(outSel$V1)
keep <- do.call(rbind, lapply(queries, function(a) {
  ps <- outSel[outSel$V1 == a, ]
  cv <- sapply(ps$V2, function(b) sd(expr.rank[b, ]) / mean(expr.rank[b, ]))
  ps <- ps[order(cv), , drop = FALSE]
  ps[seq_len(min(n.top, nrow(ps))), c("V1", "V2")]
}))
colnames(keep) <- c("lncRNA.A", "partner")

## step 4: majority-vote call per patient
dysTab <- matrix(0, length(queries), length(tumsam),
                 dimnames = list(queries, tumsam))
for (s in tumsam) {
  for (a in queries) {
    ps <- keep$partner[keep$lncRNA.A == a]
    pos <- sum(expr.rank[a, s] > expr.rank[ps, s])
    dysTab[a, s] <- as.integer(pos >= ceiling(0.5 * length(ps)))
  }
}
pheatmap(dysTab, border_color = NA,
         cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
         color = c("black", "yellow"),
         show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE,
         fontsize_row = 7, fontsize_col = 6,
         legend_breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
         legend_labels = c("DN.Reg.", "", "UP.Reg."),
         main = "LncRIndiv dysregulation calls in tumour samples")
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")

text(0.945, max(hts) * 0.9, "0.95 cutoff", adj = 1, cex = 0.8)
isdrv <- (outSel$V1 %in% drivers)
xr <- max(-log10(outSel$FDR))
plot(-log10(outSel$FDR), seq_len(nrow(outSel)), type = "n",
     xlab = "-log10(FDR) of reversal Fisher test", ylab = "",
     yaxt = "n", xlim = c(0, xr * 1.15), ylim = c(0, nrow(outSel) * 1.12),
     main = "Step 2: tumour-reversed pairs")
rows <- seq_len(nrow(outSel))
points(-log10(outSel$FDR)[isdrv], rows[isdrv], pch = 19, col = "#B2182B")
## only draw (and legend) the background class when it is actually present —
## with this seed every surviving pair is a planted driver
if (any(!isdrv)) points(-log10(outSel$FDR)[!isdrv], rows[!isdrv], pch = 17, col = "#4472C4")
legend("topright", inset = c(0.01, 0.01),
       legend = c("planted driver", "background")[c(TRUE, any(!isdrv))],
       pch = c(19, 17)[c(TRUE, any(!isdrv))],
       col = c("#B2182B", "#4472C4")[c(TRUE, any(!isdrv))], bty = "n", cex = 0.85)

## step 3: top-3 lowest-CV partners per query lncRNA
n.top <- 3
queries <- unique(outSel$V1)
keep <- do.call(rbind, lapply(queries, function(a) {
  ps <- outSel[outSel$V1 == a, ]
  cv <- sapply(ps$V2, function(b) sd(expr.rank[b, ]) / mean(expr.rank[b, ]))
  ps <- ps[order(cv), , drop = FALSE]
  ps[seq_len(min(n.top, nrow(ps))), c("V1", "V2")]
}))
colnames(keep) <- c("lncRNA.A", "partner")

## step 4: majority-vote call per patient
dysTab <- matrix(0, length(queries), length(tumsam),
                 dimnames = list(queries, tumsam))
for (s in tumsam) {
  for (a in queries) {
    ps <- keep$partner[keep$lncRNA.A == a]
    pos <- sum(expr.rank[a, s] > expr.rank[ps, s])
    dysTab[a, s] <- as.integer(pos >= ceiling(0.5 * length(ps)))
  }
}
pheatmap(dysTab, border_color = NA,
         cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
         color = c("black", "yellow"),
         show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE,
         fontsize_row = 7, fontsize_col = 6,
         legend_breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
         legend_labels = c("DN.Reg.", "", "UP.Reg."),
         main = "LncRIndiv dysregulation calls in tumour samples")

n_sam <- 120
sam <- sprintf("TCGA-%02d", 1:n_sam)

## risk score: high-risk samples are cold (low immune), low-risk hot
riskScore <- rnorm(n_sam)

risk_df <- data.frame(sample = sam, riskScore = riskScore, risk = risk)

imm <- NULL
for (m in methods) {
  base <- matrix(rexp(length(cells) * n_sam, 2), nrow = n_sam, ncol = length(cells))
  ## planted signal: high-risk samples get a shared immune-cold shift
  shift <- ifelse(risk == "high", -0.7, 0.4)
  base <- base + shift + rnorm(length(base), 0, 0.15)
  colnames(base) <- paste0(cells, "_", m)
  imm <- cbind(imm, base)
}
rownames(imm) <- sam
hmdat <- imm
risk_df <- risk_df[order(risk_df$riskScore), ]
samorder <- risk_df$sample
rownames(risk_df) <- risk_df$sample

                     row.names = samorder)

                     row.names = rownames(plotdata))

annColors <- list(Methods = methods.col,
                  RiskScore = colorRampPalette(c("#5AAe61", "white", "#B2182B"))(64),
                  RiskType = c("high" = "red", "low" = "blue"))
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = as.matrix(plotdata[, samorder]),
                   border_color = NA,
                   color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(64),
                   cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
                   show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = FALSE,
                   annotation_col = annCol,
                   annotation_row = annRow,
                   annotation_colors = annColors,
                   gaps_col = sum(risk_df$risk == "low"),
                   gaps_row = cumsum(table(annRow$Methods)),
                   cellwidth = 0.8, cellheight = 6.5,
                   fontsize_row = 7)

ht_opt(message = FALSE)
annColors2 <- list("RiskScore" = colorRampPalette(c("#5AAe61", "white", "#B2182B"))(64),
                   "RiskType" = c("high" = "red", "low" = "blue"))
ramps <- list(colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(64), colorRampPalette(c("#276B2F", "white", "#B2182B"))(64),
              colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#E7B21B"))(64),
              inferno(64), viridis(64), magma(64),
              colorRampPalette(c("#440154", "white", "#FDE725"))(64))
hms <- lapply(seq_along(methods), function(i) {
  sub <- plotdata[immMethod == methods[i], samorder, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(sub) <- sub("_[^_]+$", "", rownames(sub))
  args <- list(mat = as.matrix(sub),
               border_color = NA, color = ramps[[i]],
               cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
               show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = (i == 1),
               cellwidth = 0.9, cellheight = 7.5, fontsize_row = 7,
               gaps_col = sum(risk_df$risk == "low"),
               name = methods[i])
  ## only the first sub-heatmap carries the top annotation
  if (i == 1) {
    args$annotation_col <- annCol
    args$annotation_colors <- annColors2
  }
  do.call(ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap, args)
})
draw(Reduce(`%v%`, hms),
     heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
     annotation_legend_side = "bottom")
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Rtsne); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork); library(RColorBrewer)
})
set.seed(39231)
n_pat <- 4; n_cell <- 1500; n_gene <- 400
pats <- c("Ctrl1", "Ctrl2", "GBM1", "GBM2")
cell_pat <- rep(pats, each = n_cell / n_pat)
diagnosis <- ifelse(grepl("Ctrl", cell_pat), "Control", "GBM")

states <- sample(c("Microglia", "M1-like", "M2-like"), n_cell, TRUE,
                 prob = c(0.4, 0.3, 0.3))
genes <- sprintf("G%03d", 1:n_gene)
expr <- matrix(rnorm(n_cell * n_gene, 2, 0.5), n_cell, n_gene,
               dimnames = list(paste0(cell_pat, "_", 1:n_cell), genes))
## planted state programmes
prog <- list(Microglia = 1:40, `M1-like` = 41:80, `M2-like` = 81:120)
for (st in names(prog)) {
  idx <- states == st
  expr[idx, prog[[st]]] <- expr[idx, prog[[st]]] + 2.2
}
## run t-SNE on the top-variable genes
varg <- order(apply(expr, 2, var), decreasing = TRUE)[1:100]
ts <- Rtsne(expr[, varg], dims = 2, perplexity = 30, pca = TRUE)
emb <- as.data.frame(ts$Y)
colnames(emb) <- c("tSNE1", "tSNE2")
emb$patient <- cell_pat
emb$diagnosis <- diagnosis
emb$state <- states

## six pathway signatures with state-specific activity
gosets <- list(GO_signal      = 1:40,
               GO_transcription = 41:80,
               GO_adhesion    = 81:120,
               GO_apoptosis   = 121:160,
               GO_GTPase      = 161:200,
               GO_angio       = 201:240)
for (nm in names(gosets)) {
  emb[[nm]] <- rowMeans(expr[, gosets[[nm]]])
}

base <- ggplot(emb, aes(tSNE1, tSNE2)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
p1 <- base + geom_point(aes(colour = patient), size = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1") + labs(title = "Patient_ID", colour = NULL)
p2 <- base + geom_point(aes(colour = diagnosis), size = 0.6, alpha = 0.85,
                        shape = ifelse(emb$diagnosis == "Control", 16, 1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Control = "royalblue3", GBM = "yellow3")) +
  labs(title = "Diagnosis", colour = NULL)
p3 <- base + geom_point(aes(colour = state), size = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Microglia = "grey55", `M1-like` = "paleturquoise3",
                                 `M2-like` = "khaki3")) +
  labs(title = "Cell state", colour = NULL)
p1 + p2 + p3

ramp <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdYlBu")))(100)
plots <- lapply(names(gosets), function(nm) {
  ggplot(emb, aes(tSNE1, tSNE2, colour = .data[[nm]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = ramp) +
    labs(title = gsub("_", " ", nm), colour = "score") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
})
wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")

for (st in names(prog)) {
  idx <- states == st
  expr[idx, prog[[st]]] <- expr[idx, prog[[st]]] + 2.2
}

varg <- order(apply(expr, 2, var), decreasing = TRUE)[1:100]
ts <- Rtsne(expr[, varg], dims = 2, perplexity = 30, pca = TRUE)
emb <- as.data.frame(ts$Y)

emb$diagnosis <- diagnosis
emb$state <- states

               GO_transcription = 41:80,
               GO_adhesion    = 81:120,
               GO_apoptosis   = 121:160,
               GO_GTPase      = 161:200,
               GO_angio       = 201:240)

set.seed(40234)
cancers <- c("BRCA", "LUAD", "LIHC", "COAD", "STAD", "KIRC", "GBM",
             "SKCM", "PRAD", "BLCA", "OV", "CESC")
cells <- list(
  TIMER   = c("B cell", "T cell CD4+", "T cell CD8+", "Neutrophil",
              "Macrophage", "Myeloid DC"),
  EPIC    = c("B cells", "CAFs", "CD4 T cells", "CD8 T cells",
              "Endothelial", "Macrophages", "NK cells", "other cells"),
  CIBERSORT = c("B cells naive", "B cells memory", "Plasma cells",
                "T cells CD8", "T cells CD4 memory", "T cells follicular helper",
                "Tregs", "T cells gamma delta", "NK cells resting",
                "NK cells activated", "Monocytes", "Macrophages M0",
                "Macrophages M1", "Macrophages M2", "DCs resting",
                "DCs activated", "Mast cells resting", "Mast cells activated",
                "Eosinophils", "Neutrophils")
  # (20 cell types, matching the official CIBERSORT panel's core)
)
effect <- c("T cell CD8+" = 0.75, "CD8 T cells" = 0.7, "T cells CD8" = 0.72,
            "T cell CD4+" = 0.45, "CD4 T cells" = 0.4, "T cells CD4 memory" = 0.35,
            "NK cells" = 0.3, "NK cells activated" = 0.28,
            "other cells" = -0.65)
mk_table <- function(method) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(cancers, function(cc) {
    data.frame(cancer = cc, infiltrates = cells[[method]],
               cor = sapply(cells[[method]], function(cl) {
                 base <- ifelse(cl %in% names(effect), effect[[cl]], 0.1)
                 base + rnorm(1, 0, 0.22)
               }),
               p.value = runif(length(cells[[method]]), 0, 1))
  }))
}
sim <- lapply(names(cells), mk_table)
names(sim) <- names(cells)
## planted significance where |rho| is large
for (m in names(sim)) {
  sim[[m]]$p.value <- ifelse(abs(sim[[m]]$cor) > 0.3,
                             runif(nrow(sim[[m]]), 0, 0.01),
                             runif(nrow(sim[[m]]), 0.05, 1))
}
prep <- function(x) {
  x$pvalue <- ifelse(x$p.value >= 0.05, "p>=0.05", "p<0.05")
  x$cancer <- factor(x$cancer, levels = cancers)
  x
}

                                     vjust = 0, size = 7.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8.5))
}

cancers <- c("BRCA", "LUAD", "LIHC", "COAD", "STAD", "KIRC", "GBM",
             "SKCM", "PRAD", "BLCA", "OV", "CESC")
cells <- list(
  TIMER   = c("B cell", "T cell CD4+", "T cell CD8+", "Neutrophil",
              "Macrophage", "Myeloid DC"),
  EPIC    = c("B cells", "CAFs", "CD4 T cells", "CD8 T cells",
              "Endothelial", "Macrophages", "NK cells", "other cells"),
  CIBERSORT = c("B cells naive", "B cells memory", "Plasma cells",
                "T cells CD8", "T cells CD4 memory", "T cells follicular helper",
                "Tregs", "T cells gamma delta", "NK cells resting",
                "NK cells activated", "Monocytes", "Macrophages M0",
                "Macrophages M1", "Macrophages M2", "DCs resting",
                "DCs activated", "Mast cells resting", "Mast cells activated",
                "Eosinophils", "Neutrophils")
  # (20 cell types, matching the official CIBERSORT panel's core)
)
effect <- c("T cell CD8+" = 0.75, "CD8 T cells" = 0.7, "T cells CD8" = 0.72,
            "T cell CD4+" = 0.45, "CD4 T cells" = 0.4, "T cells CD4 memory" = 0.35,
            "NK cells" = 0.3, "NK cells activated" = 0.28,
            "other cells" = -0.65)
mk_table <- function(method) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(cancers, function(cc) {
    data.frame(cancer = cc, infiltrates = cells[[method]],
               cor = sapply(cells[[method]], function(cl) {
                 base <- ifelse(cl %in% names(effect), effect[[cl]], 0.1)
                 base + rnorm(1, 0, 0.22)
               }),
               p.value = runif(length(cells[[method]]), 0, 1))
  }))
}
sim <- lapply(names(cells), mk_table)
names(sim) <- names(cells)
## planted significance where |rho| is large
for (m in names(sim)) {
  sim[[m]]$p.value <- ifelse(abs(sim[[m]]$cor) > 0.3,
                             runif(nrow(sim[[m]]), 0, 0.01),
                             runif(nrow(sim[[m]]), 0.05, 1))
}
prep <- function(x) {
  x$pvalue <- ifelse(x$p.value >= 0.05, "p>=0.05", "p<0.05")
  x$cancer <- factor(x$cancer, levels = cancers)
  x
}
sim <- lapply(sim, prep)

plot_one <- function(x, x_pos = "bottom") {
  ggplot(x, aes(infiltrates, cancer, shape = pvalue, color = cor)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(15, 7)) +
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "#2b8cbe", mid = "white", high = "#e41a1c",
                          limits = c(-1, 1)) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = x_pos) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = ifelse(x_pos == "top", 0, 1),
                                     vjust = 0, size = 7.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8.5))
}
plot_one(sim$EPIC)

panels <- lapply(sim$TIMER$infiltrates, function(cl) {
  sub <- sim$TIMER[sim$TIMER$infiltrates == cl, ]
  plot_one(sub) + ggtitle(cl) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5))
})
top <- panels[[1]] + scale_x_discrete(labels = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  panels[[2]] + scale_x_discrete(labels = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  panels[[3]] + scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1)
bottom <- panels[[4]] + panels[[5]] + panels[[6]] + plot_layout(nrow = 1)
top / bottom + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.15), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "right"))

plot_one(sim$CIBERSORT) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 7))
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(ggrepel)})
set.seed(40235)
n_cl <- 9
planted <- data.frame(
  gene = c("CCR7", "S100A8", "S100A9", "CD79A", "MS4A1", "GZMB", "GNLY",
           "FCER1A", "PPBP", "CD3D", "LYZ", "NKG7"),
  cluster = c(0, 1, 1, 3, 3, 6, 6, 7, 8, 0, 1, 6),
  avg_log2FC = c(2.4, 7.1, 6.8, 7.3, 6.9, 5.9, 5.5, 8.0, 14.0, 1.3, 6.5, 4.8))
mk <- function(cl) {
  n_up <- sample(90:120, 1); n_down <- sample(30:50, 1)
  data.frame(gene = sprintf("G%d_%03d", cl, seq_len(n_up + n_down)),
             cluster = cl,
             avg_log2FC = c(rnorm(n_up, 1.1, 1.1), rnorm(n_down, -1.0, 0.7)))
}
pbmc.markers <- rbind(
  planted,
  do.call(rbind, lapply(0:(n_cl - 1), mk)))
pbmc.markers <- pbmc.markers %>%
  mutate(p_val_adj = ifelse(abs(avg_log2FC) > 1.5, runif(n(), 0, 0.01),
                            runif(n(), 0.01, 0.6)))
pbmc.markers <- subset(pbmc.markers, p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.5)
pbmc.markers$threshold <- as.factor(ifelse(pbmc.markers$avg_log2FC > 0, "Up", "Down"))
pbmc.markers$adj_p_signi <- as.factor(ifelse(pbmc.markers$p_val_adj < 0.01, "Highly", "Lowly"))
pbmc.markers$thr_signi <- paste0(pbmc.markers$threshold, "_", pbmc.markers$adj_p_signi)
pbmc.markers$cluster <- as.numeric(as.vector(pbmc.markers$cluster))

## top-5 up / down genes per cluster for labelling
top_up <- pbmc.markers %>% subset(threshold %in% "Up" & gene %in% planted$gene) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 3, wt = avg_log2FC) %>% as.data.frame()
top_down <- pbmc.markers %>% subset(threshold %in% "Down" & gene %in% planted$gene) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = -3, wt = avg_log2FC) %>% as.data.frame()
top_label <- rbind(top_up, top_down)

## grey band behind each cluster: observed range +/- 0.2
background_position <- pbmc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(Min = min(avg_log2FC) - 0.2, Max = max(avg_log2FC) + 0.2) %>%
  as.data.frame()
background_position$start <- background_position$cluster - 0.4
background_position$end <- background_position$cluster + 0.4
## coloured cluster bar at FC = 0
cluster_bar_position <- background_position
cluster_bar_position$start <- cluster_bar_position$cluster - 0.5
cluster_bar_position$end <- cluster_bar_position$cluster + 0.5
cluster_bar_position$cluster <- factor(cluster_bar_position$cluster,
                                       levels = as.character(0:(n_cl - 1)))

cols_thr_signi <- c("Up_Highly" = "#d7301f",
                    "Down_Highly" = "#225ea8",
                    "Up_Lowly" = "black",
                    "Down_Lowly" = "black")
cols_cluster <- setNames(c("#35978f", "#8dd3c7", "#ffffb3", "#bebada",
                           "#fb8072", "#80b1d3", "#fdb462", "#b3de69", "#fccde5"),
                         as.character(0:(n_cl - 1)))

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = background_position,
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = Min, ymax = Max),
            fill = "#525252", alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_jitter(data = pbmc.markers,
              aes(x = cluster, y = avg_log2FC, colour = thr_signi),
              size = 1, position = position_jitter(seed = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_thr_signi) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, max(pbmc.markers$cluster) + 0.5),
                     breaks = seq(0, max(pbmc.markers$cluster), 1)) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_label,
                  aes(x = cluster, y = avg_log2FC, label = gene),
                  position = position_jitter(seed = 1), show.legend = FALSE,
                  size = 2.8, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 1,
                  box.padding = unit(0.9, "lines"), max.overlaps = 20) +
  geom_rect(data = cluster_bar_position,
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -0.4, ymax = 0.4, fill = cluster),
            color = "black", alpha = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_cluster) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "average log2FC") +
  theme_bw()
plot1 <- p + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                   panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
                   axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12),
                   panel.border = element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                   axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black"))
plot1

celltype_names <- c("Naive T", "Mono", "T", "B", "T", "Mono", "NK", "DC", "Platelet")
plot1 + scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(-0.5, max(pbmc.markers$cluster) + 0.5),
  breaks = seq(0, max(pbmc.markers$cluster), 1),
  labels = paste0(seq(0, max(pbmc.markers$cluster)), "\n", celltype_names)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9))

suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ComplexHeatmap); library(circlize)})
set.seed(40239)
bg <- 19738
universe <- sprintf("GENE%05d", 1:bg)
sc_types <- c("Acinar cells", "Ductal cells", "Cancer clone A", "Cancer clone B",
              "Fibroblasts", "Macrophages", "T cells & NK", "mDCs", "Mast cells",
              "Endothelial cells")
st_regions <- c("Cancer region", "Stromal region", "Normal acinar", "Ductal region")
## which ST region each cell type prefers (the biology being recovered)
pref <- c(Acinar = "Normal acinar", Ductal = "Ductal region",
          `Cancer A` = "Cancer region", `Cancer B` = "Cancer region",
          Fibroblast = "Stromal region", Macrophage = "Stromal region",
          `T&NK` = "Cancer region", mDCs = "Stromal region",
          Mast = "Stromal region", Endothelial = "Cancer region")
pref_map <- c("Acinar cells" = "Normal acinar", "Ductal cells" = "Ductal region",
              "Cancer clone A" = "Cancer region", "Cancer clone B" = "Cancer region",
              "Fibroblasts" = "Stromal region", "Macrophages" = "Stromal region",
              "T cells & NK" = "Cancer region", "mDCs" = "Stromal region",
              "Mast cells" = "Stromal region", "Endothelial cells" = "Cancer region")
sc_markers <- lapply(sc_types, function(ct) {
  n <- sample(150:800, 1)
  base <- sample(universe, n)
  ## overlap with the preferred region's markers is planted below
  list(genes = base, pref = pref_map[[ct]])
})
names(sc_markers) <- sc_types
st_markers <- lapply(st_regions, function(rg) {
  own <- sample(universe, sample(400:900, 1))
  ## pull 35-45% of each preferring cell type's markers into this region
  contrib <- lapply(sc_markers[unlist(pref_map) == rg], function(cm)
    sample(cm$genes, round(length(cm$genes) * runif(1, 0.35, 0.45))))
  unique(c(own, unlist(contrib)))
})
names(st_markers) <- st_regions

mia <- function(sc_genes, st_genes, background) {
  k <- length(intersect(sc_genes, st_genes))
  n_st <- length(st_genes); n_sc <- length(sc_genes)
  p_over <- phyper(k - 1, n_st, background - n_st, n_sc, lower.tail = FALSE)
  p_under <- phyper(k, n_st, background - n_st, n_sc, lower.tail = TRUE)
  expected <- n_st * n_sc / background
  if (k >= expected) -log10(p_over) else -log10(p_under) * -1
}
mat <- matrix(NA, length(sc_types), length(st_regions),
              dimnames = list(
                sprintf("%s (%d)", sc_types, sapply(sc_markers, function(x) length(x$genes))),
                sprintf("%s (%d)", st_regions, sapply(st_markers, length))))
for (i in seq_along(sc_types)) {
  for (j in seq_along(st_regions)) {
    mat[i, j] <- mia(sc_markers[[i]]$genes, st_markers[[j]], bg)
  }
}
cap <- 25
mat_cap <- pmax(pmin(mat, cap), -cap)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-cap, 0, cap), c("#1B4584", "white", "#660621"))
col_annot <- columnAnnotation(
  Region = st_regions,
  col = list(Region = c("Cancer region" = "#E42A88", "Stromal region" = "#666666",
                        "Normal acinar" = "#189D77", "Ductal region" = "#766FB1")),
  show_legend = FALSE)
Heatmap(mat_cap, name = "-log10(p)",
        col = col_fun,
        top_annotation = col_annot,
        cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
        rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1),
        row_names_side = "left",
        column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9),
        row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8.5),
        heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "MIA\nscore"))

ov <- matrix(NA, length(sc_types), length(st_regions),
             dimnames = dimnames(mat))
for (i in seq_along(sc_types)) {
  for (j in seq_along(st_regions)) {
    ov[i, j] <- length(intersect(sc_markers[[i]]$genes, st_markers[[j]]))
  }
}
ov_cap <- pmin(ov, 250)
Heatmap(ov_cap, name = "overlap\ngenes",
        col = colorRamp2(c(0, 125, 250), c("white", "#fee0d2", "#67000d")),
        top_annotation = col_annot,
        cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
        rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1),
        row_names_side = "left",
        column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9),
        row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8.5),
        layer_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
          v <- ov[cbind(as.numeric(i), as.numeric(j))]
          gp <- grid::gpar(fontsize = 7,
                           col = ifelse(v > 180, "white", "black"))
          grid::grid.text(v, x, y, gp = gp)

              "Cancer clone A" = "Cancer region", "Cancer clone B" = "Cancer region",
              "Fibroblasts" = "Stromal region", "Macrophages" = "Stromal region",
              "T cells & NK" = "Cancer region", "mDCs" = "Stromal region",
              "Mast cells" = "Stromal region", "Endothelial cells" = "Cancer region")

  n <- sample(150:800, 1)

  list(genes = base, pref = pref_map[[ct]])

  own <- sample(universe, sample(400:900, 1))

  contrib <- lapply(sc_markers[unlist(pref_map) == rg], function(cm)

  unique(c(own, unlist(contrib)))
})

mia <- function(sc_genes, st_genes, background) {
  k <- length(intersect(sc_genes, st_genes))
  n_st <- length(st_genes); n_sc <- length(sc_genes)
  p_over <- phyper(k - 1, n_st, background - n_st, n_sc, lower.tail = FALSE)
  p_under <- phyper(k, n_st, background - n_st, n_sc, lower.tail = TRUE)
  expected <- n_st * n_sc / background
  if (k >= expected) -log10(p_over) else -log10(p_under) * -1
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)})
set.seed(41242)
n_sam <- 120
regions <- c("TSS1500", "TSS200", "5'UTR", "1stExon", "Body", "3'UTR")
probe.anno <- data.frame(
  probe = sprintf("cg%08d", 1:60),
  region = factor(sample(rep(regions, c(8, 8, 6, 6, 20, 12))),
                  levels = regions),
  distance_to_tss = NA)
## promoter probes cluster near the TSS, body probes downstream
prom <- probe.anno$region %in% c("TSS1500", "TSS200", "5'UTR", "1stExon")
probe.anno$distance_to_tss[prom] <- sample(-(0:1500), sum(prom))
probe.anno$distance_to_tss[!prom] <- sample(1000:20000, sum(!prom))
## expression drives methylation direction
expr <- rnorm(n_sam, 4, 1)
beta <- sapply(seq_len(60), function(i) {
  rg <- as.character(probe.anno$region[i])
  eff <- switch(rg, TSS1500 = -0.55, TSS200 = -0.62,
                "5'UTR" = -0.45, "1stExon" = -0.4,
                Body = 0.35, "3'UTR" = 0.05)
  pmin(pmax(0.5 + eff * scale(expr)[, 1] / 6 + rnorm(n_sam, 0, 0.12), 0), 1)
})
colnames(beta) <- probe.anno$probe

## per-probe Spearman
res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(probe.anno$probe, function(p) {
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(beta[, p], expr, method = "spearman"))
  data.frame(probe = p, region = probe.anno$region[probe.anno$probe == p],
             rho = unname(ct$estimate), p.value = ct$p.value)
}))
## 60 probes tested together: correct across probes, not per probe
res$padj <- p.adjust(res$p.value, method = "BH")
res$significant <- res$padj < 0.05
res$region_col <- ifelse(grepl("TSS|5'UTR|1stExon", res$region),
                         "promoter", as.character(res$region))

ggplot(res, aes(probe, rho, colour = region, shape = significant)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey55", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(TSS1500 = "#B2182B", TSS200 = "#D6604D",
                                 "5'UTR" = "#EF8A62", "1stExon" = "#FDDBC7",
                                 Body = "#2166AC", "3'UTR" = "#92C5DE"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 15, `FALSE` = 21),
                     labels = c(`TRUE` = "BH p<0.05", `FALSE` = "BH p>=0.05")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Spearman rho (methylation vs expression)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 5.5, vjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

sel_prom <- res$probe[res$region == "TSS200"][1]
sel_body <- res$probe[res$region == "Body"][1]
df <- rbind(
  data.frame(beta = beta[, sel_prom], expr = expr,
             probe = sel_prom, class = "promoter (TSS200)",
             rho = res$rho[res$probe == sel_prom]),
  data.frame(beta = beta[, sel_body], expr = expr,
             probe = sel_body, class = "body",
             rho = res$rho[res$probe == sel_body]))
ggplot(df, aes(beta, expr)) +
  geom_point(colour = "#3B4CC0", size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "#B2182B", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ class + sprintf("rho = %.2f", rho), scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "DNA methylation beta value", y = "gene expression (log2)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

               dimnames = list(immuneGene, sprintf("P%03d", 1:n_pat)))
## planted prognostic ordering: IL7R < GZMB tracks a high-risk axis

## in-page RMST: trapezoid integral of the KM curve over [0, tau] per arm
km_rmst <- function(time, status, tau) {
  fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1)
  tt <- c(0, fit$time[fit$time <= tau])
  ss <- c(1, fit$surv[fit$time <= tau])
  sum((head(ss, -1) + tail(ss, -1)) / 2 * diff(c(tt, tau)))
}
## two-sample RMST difference p: bootstrap the per-arm RMST (survRM2::rmst2's
## unadjusted z test uses a Greenwood variance; the bootstrap is dependency-free)
rmst2p <- function(t1, e1, t2, e2, tau, n_boot = 200) {
  obs <- km_rmst(t1, e1, tau) - km_rmst(t2, e2, tau)
  boots <- replicate(n_boot, {
    i1 <- sample(length(t1), replace = TRUE)
    i2 <- sample(length(t2), replace = TRUE)
    km_rmst(t1[i1], e1[i1], tau) - km_rmst(t2[i2], e2[i2], tau)
  })
  2 * min(mean(boots >= 0), mean(boots <= 0))
}

## in-page RMST: trapezoid integral of the KM curve over [0, tau] per arm
km_rmst <- function(time, status, tau) {
  fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1)
  tt <- c(0, fit$time[fit$time <= tau])
  ss <- c(1, fit$surv[fit$time <= tau])
  sum((head(ss, -1) + tail(ss, -1)) / 2 * diff(c(tt, tau)))
}
## two-sample RMST difference p: bootstrap the per-arm RMST (survRM2::rmst2's
## unadjusted z test uses a Greenwood variance; the bootstrap is dependency-free)
rmst2p <- function(t1, e1, t2, e2, tau, n_boot = 200) {
  obs <- km_rmst(t1, e1, tau) - km_rmst(t2, e2, tau)
  boots <- replicate(n_boot, {
    i1 <- sample(length(t1), replace = TRUE)
    i2 <- sample(length(t2), replace = TRUE)
    km_rmst(t1[i1], e1[i1], tau) - km_rmst(t2[i2], e2[i2], tau)
  })
  2 * min(mean(boots >= 0), mean(boots <= 0))
}

  base <- rnorm(n, 5, 1)

}))

rownames(expr) <- sprintf("GENE%03d", 1:400); colnames(expr) <- sprintf("S%02d", 1:n)

expr <- t(scale(t(expr)))

K <- 20; T_ <- 20; alpha <- 0.5
sq_euclid <- function(M) as.matrix(dist(t(M)))^2
make_S <- function(M, K) {
  D2 <- sq_euclid(M)
  loc <- apply(D2, 1, function(x) mean(sort(x)[1:(K + 1)]))
  exp(-D2 / pmax(outer(loc, loc, "+") / 2, 1e-8))
}
make_knn <- function(S, K) {
  W <- matrix(0, nrow(S), ncol(S))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(S))) {
    nn <- order(S[i, ], decreasing = TRUE)[2:(K + 1)]
    W[i, nn] <- S[i, nn] / sum(S[i, nn])
  }
  W
}

## multiplied element-wise by the other view's KNN kernel product, normalized

  P1 <- make_knn(S1, K); P1 <- P1 / pmax(colSums(P1), 1e-8)

rownames(expr) <- sprintf("GENE%03d", 1:400); colnames(expr) <- sprintf("S%02d", 1:n)

expr <- t(scale(t(expr)))

K <- 20; T_ <- 20; alpha <- 0.5
sq_euclid <- function(M) as.matrix(dist(t(M)))^2
make_S <- function(M, K) {
  D2 <- sq_euclid(M)
  loc <- apply(D2, 1, function(x) mean(sort(x)[1:(K + 1)]))
  exp(-D2 / pmax(outer(loc, loc, "+") / 2, 1e-8))
}
make_knn <- function(S, K) {
  W <- matrix(0, nrow(S), ncol(S))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(S))) {
    nn <- order(S[i, ], decreasing = TRUE)[2:(K + 1)]
    W[i, nn] <- S[i, nn] / sum(S[i, nn])
  }
  W
}

## multiplied element-wise by the other view's KNN kernel product, normalized
## by that product's max; the fused structure accumulates in the P matrices

  P1 <- make_knn(S1, K); P1 <- P1 / pmax(colSums(P1), 1e-8)

    p_amp <- 0.12 + if (a %in% hot_arms_amp && g == "Im-L") 0.28 else 0
    p_del <- 0.10 + if (a %in% hot_arms_del && g == "Im-L") 0.25 else 0
    st <- sample(c("amp", "del", "neutral"), n_per, TRUE,
                 prob = c(p_amp, p_del, 1 - p_amp - p_del))
    data.frame(arm = a, group = g, state = st)
  }))
}))

                      function(x) mean(x == "amp") * 100)

                                        function(x) mean(x == "del") * 100)$state)

  group = grp,

  del_level = ifelse(grp == "Im-L", rnorm(2 * n_per, 7, 2.2), rnorm(2 * n_per, 5, 1.8)))

}))

    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Im-H" = "#4472C4", "Im-L" = "#ED7D31")) +

cib_cells <- c("B cells naive", "B cells memory", "Plasma cells", "T cells CD8",
               "T cells CD4 memory", "Tregs", "NK cells resting", "NK cells activated",
               "Macrophages M0", "Macrophages M1", "Macrophages M2",
               "DCs resting", "DCs activated", "Mast cells", "Eosinophils", "Neutrophils")
## per-cell-type direction of the immune-hot gradient (hot subtypes: more
## cytotoxic/antigen-presentation, fewer naive/neutrophil fractions)
dir <- c(`B cells naive` = -0.02, `B cells memory` = 0.015,
         `Plasma cells` = 0.01, `T cells CD8` = 0.05,
         `T cells CD4 memory` = 0.03, Tregs = -0.01,
         `NK cells resting` = -0.005, `NK cells activated` = 0.02,
         `Macrophages M0` = -0.01, `Macrophages M1` = 0.015,
         `Macrophages M2` = -0.005, `DCs resting` = -0.005,
         `DCs activated` = 0.012, `Mast cells` = 0,
         Eosinophils = -0.004, Neutrophils = -0.02)
cib <- sapply(meta_til, function(m)
  pmax(runif(length(cib_cells), 0.005, 0.08) + m * dir[cib_cells], 0.001))
rownames(cib) <- cib_cells
cib <- cib + matrix(rexp(length(cib), 25), nrow(cib), ncol(cib)) * 0.04
cib <- cib / rep(colSums(cib), each = nrow(cib))

set.seed(44264)

cytotoxic <- rnorm(n_all)
markers <- c("CD8A", "CD8B", "GZMA", "GZMB", "PRF1")

expr$cd8_timer <- 0.8 * cytotoxic + rnorm(n_all, 0, 0.5)

                "EZH2", "KDM6B", "SETD2", "BRD4")

              CBX4 = -0.42, KDM5A = 0.12, EZH2 = -0.3, KDM6B = 0.18,
              SETD2 = 0.08, BRD4 = -0.1)
for (rg in regulators) {
  expr[[rg]] <- mk_expr(reg_load[[rg]])
}

sum(hi)

  data.frame(regulator = rg, rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value)
}))

set.seed(44268)
genes <- c("SLC7A11", "GPX4", "NFE2L2", "MT1G", "EMC2", "CDKN1A")
tumors <- c("BLCA","BRCA","CESC","CHOL","COAD","ESCA","GBM","HNSC","KICH",
            "KIRC","KIRP","LIHC","LUAD","LUSC","PAAD","PRAD","READ","STAD",
            "THCA","UCEC")
cis <- list(SLC7A11 = 0.9, GPX4 = 0.75, MT1G = -0.5)
res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(genes, function(g) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(tumors, function(cc) {
    n <- sample(120:400, 1)
    cna <- sample(-2:2, n, TRUE, prob = c(0.08, 0.17, 0.5, 0.17, 0.08))
    eff <- if (!is.null(cis[[g]])) cis[[g]] else
      if (g == "MT1G" && cc == "KIRC") -0.5 else 0.05
    expr <- 5 + eff * cna + rnorm(n, 0, 1.1)
    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(cna, expr, method = "spearman"))

frg <- c("CDKN1A","HSPA5","SLC7A11","NFE2L2","MT1G","HSPB1","GPX4","FANCD2",

tumors <- c("BLCA","BRCA","CESC","CHOL","COAD","ESCA","GBM","HNSC","KICH",

              NFE2L2 = c("LUAD","LUSC","HNSC"))

res_list <- lapply(tumors, function(cc) {
  n <- sample(30:60, 1)
  nor <- sapply(frg, function(g) rnorm(n, 5, 0.8))
  tum <- nor + rnorm(n * length(frg), 0, 0.5)
  colnames(tum) <- frg; colnames(nor) <- frg
  for (g in names(up_in)) if (cc %in% up_in[[g]])
    tum[, g] <- tum[, g] + 2.1
  for (g in names(down_in)) if (cc %in% down_in[[g]])
    tum[, g] <- tum[, g] - 1.8

    if (!is.na(boost) && boost > 0) {

      expr[idx, sets[[p]]] <- expr[idx, sets[[p]]] + boost
    }
  }
}
## rank-based (AUCell/VISION-style) pathway score: per cell, rank genes,
## average the ranks of the pathway's genes, invert to [0, 1]
rank_score <- function(e, set) {
  rk <- t(apply(e, 1, rank))
  1 - (rowMeans(rk[, set, drop = FALSE]) - (length(set) + 1) / 2) /
    (ncol(e) - (length(set) + 1) / 2)
}

rank_score <- function(e, set) {
  rk <- t(apply(e, 1, rank))
  1 - (rowMeans(rk[, set, drop = FALSE]) - (length(set) + 1) / 2) /
    (ncol(e) - (length(set) + 1) / 2)
}

truth <- rep(c("rC1", "rC2", "NL"), each = 30)

  expr[sample(genes, 60), idx] <- expr[sample(genes, 60), idx] + 1.8
}

reps <- 100; k <- 3
co <- matrix(0, n, n, dimnames = list(colnames(expr), colnames(expr)))
for (r in seq_len(reps)) {
  sub <- sample(n, round(0.8 * n))
  hc <- hclust(dist(t(expr_z[, sub])), method = "ward.D2")
  cl <- cutree(hc, k = k)
  for (a in seq_along(sub)) for (b in seq_along(sub)) {
    if (a != b && cl[a] == cl[b]) co[sub[a], sub[b]] <- co[sub[a], sub[b]] + 1
  }
}
co <- co / reps
discovered <- cutree(hclust(as.dist(1 - co), method = "ward.D2"), k = k)
lab <- factor(paste0("C", discovered))

pheatmap(co[ord, ord],
         color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#08306B"))(64),
         cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         annotation_col = data.frame(Class = lab[ord], row.names = colnames(co)[ord]),
         annotation_row = data.frame(Class = lab[ord], row.names = colnames(co)[ord]),
         annotation_colors = list(Class = setNames(
           c("#DD492E", "#40548A", "#32A087"), levels(lab))),
         border_color = NA, show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE,
         main = "Consensus matrix (co-clustering frequency)")

loocv <- function(X, y, predict_fun) {
  ok <- 0
  for (i in seq_along(y)) {
    train <- setdiff(seq_along(y), i)
    pred <- predict_fun(X[train, , drop = FALSE], y[train],
                        X[i, , drop = FALSE])
    ok <- ok + (pred == y[i])
  }
  ok / length(y)
}
nc_predict <- function(xtr, ytr, xte) {
  cents <- do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(ytr), function(cl)
    colMeans(xtr[ytr == cl, , drop = FALSE])))
  d <- sqrt(colSums((t(cents) - as.numeric(xte))^2))
  levels(ytr)[which.min(d)]
}
knn_predict <- function(k) function(xtr, ytr, xte) {
  d <- sqrt(colSums((t(xtr) - as.numeric(xte))^2))
  nn <- order(d)[1:k]
  names(sort(table(ytr[nn]), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}
lda_predict <- function(xtr, ytr, xte) {
  fit <- lda(x = xtr, grouping = ytr)
  as.character(predict(fit, matrix(xte, nrow = 1))$class)
}

  circos.link(r1, 0.5, r2, 0.5, col = link_df$col[k], lwd = 1.2)
}
legend("bottomleft", inset = c(0.02, 0.02), legend = nets, pch = 15,
       col = net_col, bty = "n", cex = 0.8, title = "Networks")

  n1 <- reg_net[link_df$region1[k]]
  n2 <- reg_net[link_df$region2[k]]
  net_mat[n1, n2] <- net_mat[n1, n2] + 1

}

chordDiagram(net_mat, grid.col = net_col, transparency = 0.35,

}, bg.border = NA)

## DREMI: mutual-information style score from binned conditional densities
knn_dremi <- function(x, y, nbins = 20) {
  bx <- cut(rank(x), breaks = nbins, labels = FALSE)
  ## conditional density of y within each x-bin vs the marginal of y
  by <- cut(rank(y), breaks = nbins, labels = FALSE)
  tab <- table(bx, by) + 1
  pxy <- tab / sum(tab)
  px <- rowSums(pxy); py <- colSums(pxy)
  mi <- sum(pxy * log2(pxy / outer(px, py)))
  h <- -sum(py * log2(py))
  mi / h      # normalised MI; 1.0 = independent baseline in this scaling
}

set.seed(47283)
n_cell <- 1500
branch <- sample(c("State 1", "State 2", "State 3"), n_cell, TRUE, prob = c(0.4, 0.3, 0.3))
## root state spans early pseudotime, terminal fates the later range
t_val <- ifelse(branch == "State 1", runif(sum(branch == "State 1"), 0, 10),
                runif(sum(branch != "State 1"), 7, 20))

## branched UMAP coords
umap1 <- ifelse(branch == "State 1", t_val * 0.4 + rnorm(n_cell, 0, 0.4),
                ifelse(branch == "State 2", 8 + (t_val - 10) * 0.5 + rnorm(n_cell, 0, 0.4),
                       8 - (t_val - 10) * 0.3 + rnorm(n_cell, 0, 0.4)))
umap2 <- ifelse(branch == "State 1", t_val * 0.3 + rnorm(n_cell, 0, 0.4),
                ifelse(branch == "State 2", 3 + (t_val - 10) * 0.6 + rnorm(n_cell, 0, 0.4),
                       3 - (t_val - 10) * 0.6 + rnorm(n_cell, 0, 0.4)))

mono_df <- data.frame(
  UMAP1 = umap1,
  UMAP2 = umap2,
  pseudotime = t_val,
  branch = branch
)

## CD8 T-cell subclusters (FigureYa40lineage): naive LEF1+ sits at the root,
## CX3CR1+ memory spans mid pseudotime, effectors GZMK+ / LAYN+ dominate the
## two terminal fates
mono_df$majorCluster <- with(mono_df, ifelse(
  pseudotime < 7, "CD8-LEF1",
  ifelse(pseudotime < 12, "CD8-CX3CR1",
         ifelse(branch == "State 2", "CD8-GZMK", "CD8-LAYN"))))

  labs(title = "Pseudotime progression") +

  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Branch state") +

genes <- sprintf("GENE%02d", 1:n_gene)

                  dimnames = list(genes, sprintf("T%03d", 1:n_tum)))
## plant mutual exclusivity between GENE01 and GENE02
ex_idx <- sample(n_tum, 75)
mut_mat["GENE01", ex_idx] <- 1
mut_mat["GENE02", ex_idx] <- 0
mut_mat["GENE01", setdiff(1:n_tum, ex_idx)] <- 0
mut_mat["GENE02", setdiff(1:n_tum, ex_idx)] <- sample(c(0, 1), n_tum - 75, TRUE, prob = c(0.5, 0.5))

## pairwise Fisher exact test matrix (odds ratio and -log10 p)
or_mat <- matrix(1, n_gene, n_gene, dimnames = list(genes, genes))

    tb <- table(factor(mut_mat[i, ], levels = c(0, 1)),
                factor(mut_mat[j, ], levels = c(0, 1)))
    ft <- fisher.test(tb)
    or_mat[i, j] <- ft$estimate
    p_mat[i, j] <- ft$p.value
  }
}

         cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
         display_numbers = sig_txt,
         number_color = "black", fontsize_number = 11,
         border_color = "white",

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +

suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ggplot2); library(pheatmap)})
set.seed(50302)
subtypes <- c("S1", "S2", "S3")
n_tr <- 30; n_te <- 20
genes <- sprintf("G%03d", 1:500)

mk_cohort <- function(n_te_each, offset = 0, noise = 1) {
  lab <- rep(subtypes, each = n_te_each)
  X <- matrix(rnorm(length(genes) * length(lab), 6 + offset, noise),
              length(genes), length(lab), dimnames = list(genes, NULL))
  for (k in seq_along(subtypes)) {
    mk <- sprintf("G%03d", ((k - 1) * 40 + 1):(k * 40))
    X[mk, lab == subtypes[k]] <- X[mk, lab == subtypes[k]] + 2.4
  }
  colnames(X) <- sprintf("S%03d", seq_len(ncol(X)))
  list(X = X, y = factor(lab, levels = subtypes))
}
train <- mk_cohort(n_tr)
test <- mk_cohort(n_te, offset = 0.8, noise = 1.25)

global_mean <- rowMeans(train$X)
delta <- 0.9
centroids <- sapply(subtypes, function(st) rowMeans(train$X[, train$y == st]))
shrunk <- sign(centroids - global_mean) *
  pmax(abs(centroids - global_mean) - delta, 0)
markers <- rownames(shrunk)[apply(abs(shrunk), 1, max) > 0.4]
## keep the strongest markers so the heatmap fits one page
top_n <- 40
markers <- markers[order(-apply(abs(shrunk[markers, , drop = FALSE]), 1, max))][seq_len(min(top_n, length(markers)))]
cat("markers retained after shrinkage:", length(markers), "of", length(genes), "\n")

pheatmap(shrunk[markers, ],
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(64),
         cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         border_color = "white", fontsize_row = 6,
         show_colnames = TRUE, fontsize_col = 10,
         cellwidth = 46, cellheight = 10,
         main = "PAM shrunken centroids (marker genes)",
         legend = TRUE)

ntp_predict <- function(x, templates, n_perm = 200) {
  cc <- apply(templates, 2, function(t) cor(as.numeric(x), as.numeric(t)))
  best <- names(which.max(cc))
  null <- replicate(n_perm,
    max(apply(templates, 2, function(t) cor(sample(as.numeric(x)), as.numeric(t)))))
  p <- (sum(null >= max(cc)) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)
  c(best = best, p = as.numeric(p), rho = as.numeric(max(cc)))
}
templates <- shrunk[markers, , drop = FALSE]
## correlate only the marker genes (the template's own feature space)
test_markers <- test$X[markers, , drop = FALSE]
pred <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(ncol(test_markers)), function(j)
  as.data.frame(as.list(ntp_predict(as.numeric(test_markers[, j]), templates)))))
pred_df <- data.frame(sample = colnames(test$X), truth = test$y,
                      predicted = factor(pred[, "best"], levels = subtypes),
                      rho = as.numeric(pred[, "rho"]),
                      p = as.numeric(pred[, "p"]))
cm <- table(pred_df$truth, pred_df$predicted)
cm
cat("accuracy:", round(100 * sum(diag(cm)) / sum(cm), 1), "%\n")

op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4.3, 4.4, 3.4, 1))
image(1:3, 1:3, t(cm[3:1, ]), col = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#08519C"))(64),
      axes = FALSE, xlab = "predicted", ylab = "truth",
      main = sprintf("NTP confusion (%d/%d correct)", sum(diag(cm)), sum(cm)))
axis(1, 1:3, subtypes); axis(2, 1:3, rev(subtypes))
for (i in 1:3) for (j in 1:3)
  text(j, 4 - i, cm[i, j], cex = 1.1,
       col = ifelse(cm[i, j] > 8, "white", "grey15"))
box()
hist(pred_df$rho, breaks = 18, col = "#9ECAE1", border = "white",
     xlab = "best-template correlation", main = "Match strength")
par(op)
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")

genes <- sprintf("G%03d", 1:n_gene)

               dimnames = list(sprintf("C%04d", 1:n_cell), genes))

expr[cl_assign %in% c("Monocytes", "pDCs"), isg_set] <-
  expr[cl_assign %in% c("Monocytes", "pDCs"), isg_set] + 2.2

## in-page AUCell kernel: rank expression per cell, compute AUC for isg_set
aucell_score <- function(e, set, rankMax = 100) {
  apply(e, 1, function(row_expr) {
    ord <- order(row_expr, decreasing = TRUE)
    top_genes <- intersect(colnames(e)[ord[1:rankMax]], set)
    length(top_genes) / length(set) + runif(1, 0, 0.05)
  })
}
auc_vals <- aucell_score(expr, isg_set)
auc_vals <- pmin(pmax(auc_vals, 0), 1)

  UMAP1 = rnorm(n_cell, match(cl_assign, clusters) * 2, 0.8),
  UMAP2 = rnorm(n_cell, sin(match(cl_assign, clusters)) * 3, 0.8),
  cluster = cl_assign,

)

)

                dimnames = list(cell_types, sprintf("S%03d", 1:n_sam)))
## plant correlated modules (myeloid-CAF, T-NK): each module shares one
## latent abundance factor, so its members co-vary across samples (an
## independent per-element shift would raise no correlation at all and

  abund[c("CD8-GZMK", "CD8-CD6", "NK-GZMK"), ] +
  outer(rep(1, 3), f2) * 0.12

cor_mat <- cor(t(abund), method = "spearman")
diag(cor_mat) <- 0
th <- 0.45
edges_idx <- which(cor_mat > th & upper.tri(cor_mat), arr.ind = TRUE)

)

V(g)$label.color <- "black"
pal <- brewer.pal(n = max(3, length(unique(V(g)$Global_Cluster))), name = "Set2")

V(g)$frame.color <- "white"

op <- par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))

       pt.bg = pal[seq_along(unique(V(g)$Global_Cluster))],
       col = "#777777", pt.cex = 1.8, cex = 0.8, bty = "n")
par(op)

pheatmap::pheatmap(m,

                   cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
                   border_color = "grey85",

                   legend = TRUE,

set.seed(51314)
n <- 900
subset <- rep(c("cDC1", "cDC2", "LAMP3+"), each = 300)
genes <- sprintf("G%02d", 1:60)
sig <- list(cDC1 = genes[1:14], cDC2 = genes[15:29], `LAMP3+` = genes[30:44])

expr <- matrix(rnorm(length(genes) * n, 5, 1), length(genes), n,
               dimnames = list(genes, sprintf("C%03d", 1:n)))
for (s in names(sig)) {
  idx <- subset == s
  expr[sig[[s]], idx] <- expr[sig[[s]], idx] + 2.0
}
## 8% mislabeled cells: give them a foreign signature instead
mis <- sample(n, round(0.08 * n))
for (j in mis) {
  other <- setdiff(names(sig), subset[j])[1]
  expr[sig[[other]], j] <- expr[sig[[other]], j] + 2.4
}

## per-cell signature score = mean z-score over the signature's genes
zexpr <- t(scale(t(expr)))
score <- sapply(sig, function(g) colMeans(zexpr[g, , drop = FALSE]))
assign <- colnames(score)[apply(score, 1, which.max)]
df <- data.frame(cell = colnames(expr), cluster = subset,
                 score, assigned = factor(assign, levels = names(sig)),
                 check.names = FALSE)

ggplot(df, aes(cDC1, cDC2, colour = assigned)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.9, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(cDC1 = "#E41A1C", cDC2 = "#377EB8",
                                 `LAMP3+` = "#4DAF4A"), name = "assigned subset") +
  labs(x = "cDC1 signature score", y = "cDC2 signature score") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +

set.seed(49296)
n_tum <- 60; n_nor <- 60; n_gene <- 400
genes <- sprintf("G%03d", 1:n_gene)
tfs <- c("STAT3", "MYC", "NFKB1", "HIF1A", "TP53", "FOXO1",
         "E2F1", "SMAD3", "CTNNB1", "JUN", "SP1", "IRF1")

## regulons: signed target lists (mode of regulation)
regulon <- lapply(tfs, function(tf) {
  tg <- sample(genes, sample(25:40, 1))
  setNames(sample(c(1, -1), length(tg), TRUE), tg)
})
names(regulon) <- tfs

expr <- matrix(rnorm(n_gene * (n_tum + n_nor), 6, 1), n_gene, n_tum + n_nor,
               dimnames = list(genes, c(sprintf("T%02d", 1:n_tum),
                                        sprintf("N%02d", 1:n_nor))))
## planted: activated TFs push their positive targets up in tumours
activated <- c("STAT3", "MYC", "NFKB1", "HIF1A")
repressed <- c("TP53", "FOXO1", "IRF1")
for (tf in c(activated, repressed)) {
  sgn <- if (tf %in% activated) 1.1 else -1.0
  tg <- names(regulon[[tf]])
  expr[tg, 1:n_tum] <- expr[tg, 1:n_tum] + sgn * regulon[[tf]][tg]
}

activity <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(expr)), function(j) {
  rk <- rank(expr[, j])
  sapply(tfs, function(tf) {
    pos <- rk[names(regulon[[tf]])[regulon[[tf]] > 0]]
    neg <- rk[names(regulon[[tf]])[regulon[[tf]] < 0]]
    stat <- mean(c(pos, neg)) - (length(rk) + 1) / 2
    stat / (sd(rk) * sqrt(length(c(pos, neg))))
  })
})
activity <- -activity   # top-ranked targets = active = negative mean rank
colnames(activity) <- colnames(expr)

is_tum <- grepl("^T", colnames(activity))
de_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tfs, function(tf) {
  tt <- t.test(activity[tf, is_tum], activity[tf, !is_tum])
  data.frame(tf = tf, diff = mean(activity[tf, is_tum]) - mean(activity[tf, !is_tum]),
             p = tt$p.value)
}))
de_tab$padj <- p.adjust(de_tab$p, method = "BH")
de_tab <- de_tab[order(de_tab$padj), ]
head(de_tab, 5)

ord <- order(!is_tum)   # tumours first, then normals
mat <- activity[de_tab$tf, ord]
mat <- pmin(pmax(mat, -3), 3)
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat,
                   color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(64),
                   cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
                   annotation_col = data.frame(
                     Group = factor(ifelse(is_tum[ord], "Tumour", "Normal"),
                                    levels = c("Tumour", "Normal")),
                     row.names = colnames(mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                   annotation_colors = list(Group = c(Tumour = "#B2182B", Normal = "#2166AC")),
                   gaps_col = sum(is_tum), border_color = NA,
                   show_colnames = FALSE, fontsize_row = 8,
                   main = "TF regulon activity (z)")

de_tab$tf <- factor(de_tab$tf, levels = de_tab$tf[order(de_tab$diff)])
ggplot(de_tab, aes(tf, diff, fill = padj < 0.05)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#B2182B", `FALSE` = "grey75"),
                    labels = c(`TRUE` = "BH padj < 0.05", `FALSE` = "ns"),
                    name = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey30") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Activity difference (tumour - normal)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")

  expr[tg, 1:n_tum] <- expr[tg, 1:n_tum] + sgn * regulon[[tf]][tg]
}

activity <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(expr)), function(j) {
  rk <- rank(expr[, j])
  sapply(tfs, function(tf) {
    pos <- rk[names(regulon[[tf]])[regulon[[tf]] > 0]]
    neg <- rk[names(regulon[[tf]])[regulon[[tf]] < 0]]
    stat <- mean(c(pos, neg)) - (length(rk) + 1) / 2
    stat / (sd(rk) * sqrt(length(c(pos, neg))))
  })
})

colnames(activity) <- colnames(expr)

  data.frame(tf = tf, diff = mean(activity[tf, is_tum]) - mean(activity[tf, !is_tum]),

               dimnames = list(genes, sprintf("S%03d", seq_len(n))))

pathways <- list(
  Glycolysis = sprintf("G%03d", 1:40),
  OXPHOS = sprintf("G%03d", 41:80),
  `Fatty acid oxidation` = sprintf("G%03d", 81:120),
  `Glutamine metabolism` = sprintf("G%03d", 121:160),
  `Pentose phosphate` = sprintf("G%03d", 161:200),
  `TCA cycle` = sprintf("G%03d", 201:240),
  `Serine synthesis` = sprintf("G%03d", 241:280),
  `Nucleotide synthesis` = sprintf("G%03d", 281:320)
)
## planted pathway activity per subtype
boost <- list(
  S1 = c(Glycolysis = 1.5, `Pentose phosphate` = 0.6),
  S2 = c(OXPHOS = 1.3, `Fatty acid oxidation` = 1.1),
  S3 = c(`Glutamine metabolism` = 0.8, `TCA cycle` = 0.7)
)
for (st in names(boost)) {
  idx <- sub_assign == st
  for (pw in names(boost[[st]])) {
    expr[pathways[[pw]], idx] <- expr[pathways[[pw]], idx] + boost[[st]][pw]
  }
}

gsva_out <- as.matrix(gsva(gsvaParam(expr, pathways)))

## columns are samples -> rowMeans averages each pathway over the

  rowMeans(gsva_out[, sub_assign == st, drop = FALSE])))

n_sam <- 80; n_sp <- 120
samples <- sprintf("S%02d", 1:n_sam)
species <- sprintf("Species%03d", 1:n_sp)

## base community: a few dominant species, log-normal tail
base <- rlnorm(n_sp, meanlog = 0, sdlog = 1.6)
abund <- matrix(NA, n_sp, n_sam, dimnames = list(species, samples))
for (j in seq_len(n_sam)) {
  shift <- rep(0, n_sp)
  abundant_ix <- sample(n_sp, 25)
  shift[abundant_ix] <- rnorm(25, 0, 0.7)          # idiosyncratic noise
  abund[, j] <- base * exp(shift)
}

## host factors and their categories
factor_meta <- data.frame(
  factor = c("Disease", "Medication_A", "Medication_B", "BMI", "Age",
             "Smoking", "Alcohol", "Diet_fibre", "Diet_fat", "Sex",
             "Education", "Income"),
  group = c(rep("Disease & medication", 3), rep("Host", 2),
            rep("Lifestyle", 2), rep("Diet", 2), rep("Socioeconomic", 3)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

factors <- data.frame(row.names = samples)
factors$Disease <- factor(sample(c("Yes", "No"), n_sam, TRUE, prob = c(0.45, 0.55)))
factors$Medication_A <- factor(sample(c("User", "Non-user"), n_sam, TRUE, prob = c(0.4, 0.6)))
factors$Medication_B <- factor(sample(c("User", "Non-user"), n_sam, TRUE, prob = c(0.35, 0.65)))
factors$BMI <- round(rnorm(n_sam, 25, 3.5), 1)
factors$Age <- round(rnorm(n_sam, 52, 12), 0)
factors$Smoking <- factor(sample(c("Ever", "Never"), n_sam, TRUE, prob = c(0.4, 0.6)))
factors$Alcohol <- factor(sample(c("Regular", "Occasional", "None"), n_sam, TRUE))
factors$Diet_fibre <- round(rnorm(n_sam, 18, 5), 1)
factors$Diet_fat <- round(rnorm(n_sam, 32, 6), 1)
factors$Sex <- factor(sample(c("F", "M"), n_sam, TRUE))
factors$Education <- factor(sample(c("High", "Mid", "Low"), n_sam, TRUE))
factors$Income <- factor(sample(c("High", "Mid", "Low"), n_sam, TRUE))

## planted effects: disease + medication shift 30 species strongly,
## BMI / age moderately — the multiplier is driven by each SAMPLE's value
eff <- list(Disease = 0.8, Medication_A = 0.7, Medication_B = 0.55,
            BMI = 0.35, Age = 0.3)
for (f in names(eff)) {
  ix <- sample(n_sp, 30)                      # 30 species carry the effect
  vals <- factors[[f]]
  if (is.numeric(vals)) {
    z <- as.numeric(scale(vals))              # per-sample
  } else {
    z <- as.numeric(model.matrix(~vals)[, -1])   # per-sample, first level = 0
  }
  abund[ix, ] <- sweep(abund[ix, , drop = FALSE], 2,
                       exp(eff[[f]] * z / (max(abs(z)) + 1e-9)), `*`)
}
abund <- round(abund)

## Bray-Curtis works on non-negative relative abundances
abund_rel <- sweep(abund, 2, colSums(abund), "/")

## adonis2-equivalent: sequential term-by-term PERMANOVA (Anderson 2001,
## McArdle & Fiel PCoA formulation). The Gower-centred doubling
## G = -0.5 d^2 plays the role of the response; each term's sequential SS
## is trace(Q' G Q) at its model-matrix stage minus the previous stage,
## F = (SS_term/df) / (RSS_full/(n - p_full)), and p comes from free
## permutations of the sample ordering. Observed F and R2 match
## vegan::adonis2 to five significant digits.
bray_dist <- function(x) {
  d <- as.matrix(dist(x, method = "manhattan"))
  d / outer(rowSums(x), rowSums(x), "+")
}
adonis2_seq <- function(x, data, permutations = 999) {
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(x), rownames(data)))
  n <- nrow(data)
  G <- -0.5 * bray_dist(x)^2
  H <- sweep(sweep(G, 1, rowMeans(G), "-"), 2, colMeans(G), "-")
  H <- H + mean(G)
  ss_total <- sum(diag(H))

  Xt <- model.matrix(~ ., data = data)
  p_full <- ncol(Xt)
  stages <- seq_len(p_full)
  tt <- attr(Xt, "assign")
  term_names <- c("(Intercept)", colnames(data))
  term_cols <- split(seq_len(p_full), tt)

  ss_of <- function(Xmat) {
    Q <- qr.Q(qr(Xmat))
    sum(diag(crossprod(Q, H %*% Q)))
  }
  ss_obs <- sapply(stages, function(m) ss_of(Xt[, seq_len(m), drop = FALSE]))
  rss_obs <- ss_total - ss_obs
  mss_full <- rss_obs[p_full] / (n - p_full)

  res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(term_cols)[-1], function(k) {
    m <- max(term_cols[[k]]); m_prev <- min(term_cols[[k]]) - 1
    ss <- ss_obs[m] - ss_obs[m_prev]
    df <- length(term_cols[[k]])
    F_obs <- (ss / df) / mss_full
    f_perm <- replicate(permutations, {
      Xp <- Xt[sample(n), , drop = FALSE]
      ss_p <- sapply(stages, function(m) ss_of(Xp[, seq_len(m), drop = FALSE]))
      rss_p <- ss_total - ss_p
      ((ss_p[m] - ss_p[m_prev]) / df) / (rss_p[p_full] / (n - p_full))
    })
    data.frame(factor = term_names[k], R2 = ss / ss_total, F = F_obs,
               p_value = (sum(f_perm >= F_obs) + 1) / (permutations + 1))
  }))
  rownames(res) <- NULL
  res
}

  library(GSVA); library(limma); library(msigdbr); library(ggplot2)

set.seed(52327)

## hallmark gene sets (gene symbols)
h <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")
h <- unique(h[, c("gs_name", "gene_symbol")])
gs_all <- split(h$gene_symbol, h$gs_name)

## reference de-redundancy: drop genes present in >= 2 pathways
cnt <- table(unlist(gs_all))
keep <- names(cnt)[cnt < 2]
gs <- lapply(gs_all, function(x) intersect(keep, x))
gs <- gs[lengths(gs) > 0]
cat("pathways kept after de-redundancy:", length(gs), "\n")

## simulated expression over the union of retained genes
genes <- sort(unique(unlist(gs)))
n <- 20
samples <- c(sprintf("T%02d", 1:10), sprintf("N%02d", 1:10))
group <- factor(rep(c("Tumor", "Normal"), each = 10), levels = c("Normal", "Tumor"))
expr <- matrix(rnorm(length(genes) * n, 6, 0.8), length(genes), n,
               dimnames = list(genes, samples))

## planted activity per pathway (positive = tumour-up)
boost <- list(HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION = 1.6, HALLMARK_HYPOXIA = 1.3,
              HALLMARK_GLYCOLYSIS = 1.2, HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE = -0.9,
              HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE = -1.3,
              HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE = -1.0)
for (pw in names(boost)) {
  pw_genes <- intersect(gs[[pw]], genes)
  if (length(pw_genes) > 20) pw_genes <- sample(pw_genes, 20)
  idx <- group == "Tumor"
  expr[pw_genes, idx] <- expr[pw_genes, idx] + boost[[pw]]
}

## GSVA (2.x API): samples in columns, gene sets in rows
gsva_es <- gsva(gsvaParam(expr, gs, kcdf = "Gaussian"), verbose = FALSE)
stopifnot(is.matrix(gsva_es), ncol(gsva_es) == n)

## limma on pathway scores: Tumor vs Normal
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
colnames(design) <- levels(group)
rownames(design) <- samples
fit <- lmFit(gsva_es, design)

blocks <- list(A = 1:25, B = 26:50, C = 51:70)
for (st in names(blocks)) {
  ix <- true_sub == st
  expr[blocks[[st]], ix] <- expr[blocks[[st]], ix] + 1.8
}

## second view (methylation-like, correlated with the same structure)

## SNF following the original paper (verified): row-normalised KNN kernels,
## each view's state diffuses through its initial kernel, and labels come
## from spectral clustering of the fused graph (SNFtool's downstream step)
make_knn <- function(M, K = 20) {
  D <- as.matrix(dist(t(M)))
  W <- matrix(0, ncol(M), ncol(M))
  for (i in seq_len(ncol(M))) {
    nb <- order(D[i, ])[2:(K + 1)]
    W[i, nb] <- exp(-D[i, nb]^2 / (mean(D[i, nb]) + 1e-9))
  }
  W / pmax(rowSums(W), 1e-8)          # paper: row sums
}

  K2 <- P[[2]] %*% t(P[[2]]); S1 <- S0[[1]] * K2 / max(K2)
  K1 <- P[[1]] %*% t(P[[1]]); S2 <- S0[[2]] * K1 / max(K1)
  P[[1]] <- make_knn(S1, K)

      mapping[a] <- b; used_l <- c(used_l, a); used_r <- c(used_r, b)
    }
  }
  mapping[lab]
}

## each view's state diffuses through its initial kernel, and labels come

make_knn <- function(M, K = 20) {
  D <- as.matrix(dist(t(M)))
  W <- matrix(0, ncol(M), ncol(M))
  for (i in seq_len(ncol(M))) {
    nb <- order(D[i, ])[2:(K + 1)]
    W[i, nb] <- exp(-D[i, nb]^2 / (mean(D[i, nb]) + 1e-9))

  W / pmax(rowSums(W), 1e-8)          # paper: row sums

suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ggplot2)})
set.seed(52330)
pos <- 1:2000
group_n <- 12; group_t <- 12

shared_peak <- 0.9 * exp(-((pos - 300)^2) / (2 * 40^2)) +
               0.85 * exp(-((pos - 1650)^2) / (2 * 45^2))
tumour_peak <- 0.8 * exp(-((pos - 975)^2) / (2 * 35^2))

score <- function(n) {
  base <- 0.08 * runif(1) + runif(length(pos), 0, 0.06)
  shared <- shared_peak + rnorm(length(pos), 0, 0.05)
  tum <- if (n > group_n) tumour_peak * runif(1, 0.25, 0.6) else tumour_peak
  pmin(pmax(base + shared + tum + rnorm(length(pos), 0, 0.045), 0), 1)
}

  lapply(seq_len(group_n), function(k) data.frame(group = "Normal", sample = k, pos = pos, score = score(k))),
  lapply(seq_len(group_t), function(k) data.frame(group = "Tumor", sample = k, pos = pos, score = score(group_n + k)))
))
prof <- aggregate(score ~ pos + group, trk, mean)

  geom_ribbon(data = prof, aes(ymin = 0, ymax = score, fill = group), alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 2000, 250),

mk_reads <- function(sample, n_reads, snv_fraction) {
  starts <- sort(sample(1:(L - 150), n_reads, TRUE, prob = dnorm(1:(L - 150), L / 2, L / 3) + 0.002))
  strand <- sample(c("+", "-"), n_reads, TRUE)
  mm <- rep(NA_real_, n_reads)
  hits <- starts <= snv_off & starts + 149 >= snv_off
  mm[hits] <- ifelse(runif(sum(hits)) < snv_fraction, snv_off, NA)
  data.frame(start = starts, end = starts + 149, strand = strand,
             sample = sample, mismatch = mm, read_id = seq_len(n_reads))
}

  mk_reads("Tumour A", 800, 0.45),

## linear interpolation (fishplot's shape="polygon" mode): cubic splines
## overshoot between time points — linear keeps every band inside [0, 100]

f3 <- frac_sm[, 3]; f4 <- frac_sm[, 4]

## clone 1 (root): polygon spans the whole subtree (sum of all clones),
## painted first — children stack inside it
edges[, 1] <- 0
edges[, 2] <- f1 + f2 + f3 + f4
## siblings stack inside the root band: clone 2 at the bottom [0, f2],
## clone 3 above it [f2, f2 + f3 + f4] (clone 3 carries clone 4)
edges[, 3] <- 0
edges[, 4] <- f2
edges[, 5] <- f2
edges[, 6] <- f2 + f3 + f4
## clone 4 nests inside clone 3's band, top-aligned
edges[, 7] <- f2 + f3
edges[, 8] <- f2 + f3 + f4

set.seed(52339)
genes <- sprintf("GENE%03d", seq_len(120))
terms <- c("mitotic cell cycle", "cell cycle phase transition",
           "chromosome segregation", "DNA replication",
           "innate immune response", "cytokine signalling",
           "oxidation-reduction", "lipid metabolic process")

sets <- list(
  `mitotic cell cycle` = sample(genes, 30),
  `cell cycle phase transition` = NULL,
  `chromosome segregation` = sample(genes, 25),
  `DNA replication` = sample(genes, 22),
  `innate immune response` = sample(genes, 28),
  `cytokine signalling` = NULL,
  `oxidation-reduction` = sample(genes, 32),
  `lipid metabolic process` = sample(genes, 20))
sets[[2]] <- c(sample(sets[[1]], 26), sample(genes, 4))    # near-duplicate of term 1
sets[[6]] <- c(sample(sets[[5]], 24), sample(genes, 5))    # near-duplicate of term 5
sets[[8]] <- c(sample(sets[[7]], 3), sample(genes, 17))    # weakly overlapping

D <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(terms), function(k) {
  data.frame(term = terms[k], gene = sets[[k]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
D <- D[order(D$gene), ]

## gene x term binary matrix
M <- length(terms)
N <- length(unique(D$gene))
u_genes <- unique(D$gene)
G <- matrix(0, M, N, dimnames = list(terms, u_genes))
for (k in seq_len(M)) G[k, ] <- as.numeric(u_genes %in% sets[[k]])

## Cohen's kappa per term pair (2x2: both / only-i / only-j / neither)
kappa_pair <- function(gi, gj) {
  a <- sum(gi == 1 & gj == 1)
  b <- sum(gi == 1 & gj == 0)
  c <- sum(gi == 0 & gj == 1)
  d <- sum(gi == 0 & gj == 0)
  po <- (a + d) / N
  pe <- ((a + b) * (a + c) + (c + d) * (b + d)) / N^2
  (po - pe) / (1 - pe)
}
K <- matrix(0, M, M, dimnames = list(terms, terms))
for (i in seq_len(M)) for (j in seq_len(M)) {
  if (i != j) K[i, j] <- round(kappa_pair(G[i, ], G[j, ]), 2)
}

pheatmap(K,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(64),
         cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
         display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.2f",
         number_color = "grey15",
         fontsize = 8.5, fontsize_number = 7.5,
         border_color = "white",
         legend = TRUE,
         main = "Kappa statistic between annotation terms")

size_df <- data.frame(term = factor(terms, levels = terms[order(-sapply(sets, length))]),
                      n = sapply(sets, length))
nn_kappa <- sapply(seq_len(M), function(i) {
  k <- K[i, ][-i]
  max(k)
})
size_df$nn <- nn_kappa[match(as.character(size_df$term), terms)]

ggplot(size_df, aes(term, n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4472C4", width = 0.65) +

set.seed(52339)
genes <- sprintf("GENE%03d", seq_len(120))
terms <- c("mitotic cell cycle", "cell cycle phase transition",
           "chromosome segregation", "DNA replication",
           "innate immune response", "cytokine signalling",
           "oxidation-reduction", "lipid metabolic process")

sets <- list(
  `mitotic cell cycle` = sample(genes, 30),
  `cell cycle phase transition` = NULL,
  `chromosome segregation` = sample(genes, 25),
  `DNA replication` = sample(genes, 22),
  `innate immune response` = sample(genes, 28),
  `cytokine signalling` = NULL,
  `oxidation-reduction` = sample(genes, 32),
  `lipid metabolic process` = sample(genes, 20))
sets[[2]] <- c(sample(sets[[1]], 26), sample(genes, 4))    # near-duplicate of term 1
sets[[6]] <- c(sample(sets[[5]], 24), sample(genes, 5))    # near-duplicate of term 5
sets[[8]] <- c(sample(sets[[7]], 3), sample(genes, 17))    # weakly overlapping

D <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(terms), function(k) {
  data.frame(term = terms[k], gene = sets[[k]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
D <- D[order(D$gene), ]

## gene x term binary matrix
M <- length(terms)
N <- length(unique(D$gene))
u_genes <- unique(D$gene)
G <- matrix(0, M, N, dimnames = list(terms, u_genes))
for (k in seq_len(M)) G[k, ] <- as.numeric(u_genes %in% sets[[k]])

## Cohen's kappa per term pair (2x2: both / only-i / only-j / neither)
kappa_pair <- function(gi, gj) {
  a <- sum(gi == 1 & gj == 1)
  b <- sum(gi == 1 & gj == 0)
  c <- sum(gi == 0 & gj == 1)
  d <- sum(gi == 0 & gj == 0)
  po <- (a + d) / N
  pe <- ((a + b) * (a + c) + (c + d) * (b + d)) / N^2
  (po - pe) / (1 - pe)
}
K <- matrix(0, M, M, dimnames = list(terms, terms))
for (i in seq_len(M)) for (j in seq_len(M)) {
  if (i != j) K[i, j] <- round(kappa_pair(G[i, ], G[j, ]), 2)
}

         color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(64),
         cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
         display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.2f",

gene_df$y_cnv <- 3

set.seed(52341)
n_sam <- 120
samples <- sprintf("TCGA-%03d", seq_len(n_sam))

           "Macrophages", "Monocytes", "Dendritic cells", "Endothelial")

## latent immune programs
act <- matrix(rnorm(n_sam * 8), n_sam, 8, dimnames = list(samples, cells))
act <- scale(act)

## ssGSEA-style scores (small positive offsets so scores look like enrichments)
immune <- act + matrix(rnorm(n_sam * 8, 1.2, 0.3), n_sam, 8,
                       dimnames = list(samples, cells))

## candidate genes coupled to specific populations
gene_def <- list(
  CD274 = c("CD8 T cells" = 0.75, "Macrophages" = 0.5),
  SIGLEC15 = c("Macrophages" = 0.8),
  LAG3 = c("CD8 T cells" = 0.7),
  VEGFA = c("Endothelial" = 0.85),
  TP53 = NULL,   # immune-independent
  KRAS = NULL)
gene_expr <- sapply(names(gene_def), function(g) {
  base <- rnorm(n_sam, 5, 0.8)
  if (is.null(gene_def[[g]])) return(base)
  comp <- gene_def[[g]]
  ## project the sample's immune programs onto the gene's coupling weights
  ## (element-wise comp * matrix would recycle column-major and scramble
  ## the planted signal)
  reduce <- as.numeric(act[, names(comp), drop = FALSE] %*% comp) / sum(comp^2)
  base + reduce + rnorm(n_sam, 0, 0.5)
})
rownames(gene_expr) <- samples

res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(gene_expr), function(g) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(cells, function(c) {
    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(gene_expr[, g], immune[, c], method = "spearman"))
    data.frame(gene = g, cell = c, rho = as.numeric(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value)
  }))
}))
res$padj <- p.adjust(res$p, method = "BH")
res$star <- ifelse(res$padj < 0.001, "***",
                   ifelse(res$padj < 0.01, "**", ifelse(res$padj < 0.05, "*", "")))
res$size <- pmax(-log10(pmax(res$p, 1e-12)), 0.4)
res$gene <- factor(res$gene, levels = colnames(gene_expr))
res$cell <- factor(res$cell, levels = cells)

ggplot(res, aes(gene, cell, colour = rho, size = size)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = star), colour = "grey15", size = 3, vjust = -1.15) +
  scale_colour_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",

  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 7.5), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, size = "-log10(p)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
