set.seed(52342)
tps <- c(0, 6, 24, 72)
profiles <- c("Rising", "Transient", "Falling")
n_per <- c(120, 90, 90)
gene_prof <- rep(profiles, n_per)
genes <- sprintf("GENE%04d", seq_len(n_gene <- sum(n_per)))

## fold-change shapes per profile (plus gene-level noise)
shapes <- list(Rising = c(0, 0.5, 1.6, 2.4),
               Transient = c(0, 2.2, 0.8, 0.1),
               Falling = c(0, -1.2, -2.0, -2.5))
fc <- t(sapply(seq_len(n_gene), function(i) {
  shapes[[gene_prof[i]]] + rnorm(4, 0, 0.28)
}))
rownames(fc) <- genes
colnames(fc) <- tps

## absolute expression = 4 + fc/2 + replicate noise (2 replicates)
abs_expr <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_gene), function(i) {
  base <- 4 + fc[i, ] / 2
  r1 <- base + rnorm(4, 0, 0.35)
  r2 <- base + rnorm(4, 0, 0.35)
  data.frame(gene = genes[i], profile = gene_prof[i],
             tp = rep(tps, 2), expr = c(r1, r2),
             rep = rep(c("rep1", "rep2"), each = 4))
}))
## representative gene per profile: highest final amplitude
rep_gene <- sapply(profiles, function(p) {
  ix <- gene_prof == p
  genes[ix][which.max(abs(fc[ix, 4]))]
})
line_df <- as.data.frame(fc) %>%
  mutate(gene = genes, profile = gene_prof) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(gene, profile), names_to = "tp", values_to = "fc") %>%
  mutate(tp = as.numeric(tp))

box_stats <- abs_expr %>%
  group_by(profile, tp) %>%
  summarise(med = median(expr), .groups = "drop")

p_pairs <- lapply(profiles, function(p) {
  ld <- subset(line_df, profile == p)
  bd <- subset(abs_expr, profile == p)
  p_line <- ggplot(ld, aes(tp, fc, group = gene)) +
    geom_line(colour = "grey72", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_line(data = subset(ld, gene == rep_gene[p]), colour = "#B2182B",
              linewidth = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = tps) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = expression(log[2]~fold~change),
         title = paste0(p, "  (n = ", sum(gene_prof == p), ")")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  ## pairwise Wilcoxon between ADJACENT time points, brackets + stars
  pv <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(length(tps) - 1), function(i) {
    a <- bd$expr[bd$tp == tps[i]]
    b <- bd$expr[bd$tp == tps[i + 1]]
    pv <- wilcox.test(a, b)$p.value
    data.frame(group1 = as.character(tps[i]), group2 = as.character(tps[i + 1]),
               p = pv, y.position = max(bd$expr) * 1.02 + i * 0.1,
               p.signif = ifelse(pv < 0.001, "***",
                                 ifelse(pv < 0.01, "**", ifelse(pv < 0.05, "*", "ns"))))
  }))
  p_box <- ggplot(bd, aes(factor(tp), expr)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, fill = "#DEEBF7", colour = "grey35") +
    stat_pvalue_manual(pv, label = "p.signif", size = 3,
                       bracket.size = 0.3, tip.length = 0.015) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.14))) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = tps) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 expression") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8))
  p_line | p_box
})

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(survival); library(Hmisc); library(ggplot2)

set.seed(52345)
n_pat <- 500
bmi <- pmin(pmax(rnorm(n_pat, 26.5, 4), 15), 45)
gender <- factor(sample(c("Female", "Male"), n_pat, TRUE))

## U-shaped log-hazard around the reference bmi = 25
haz <- 0.05 * exp(0.02 * (bmi - 25)^2 - 0.10 * (gender == "Male"))
dat <- data.frame(bmi = bmi, gender = gender,
                  lenfol = round(rexp(n_pat, rate = pmax(haz, 0.008)), 1),
                  fstat = rbinom(n_pat, 1, 0.65))

knot_probs_all <- list(`3` = c(.10, .50, .90), `4` = c(.05, .35, .65, .95),
                       `5` = c(.05, .275, .50, .725, .95),
                       `6` = c(.05, .23, .41, .59, .77, .95))
aic_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(3:6, function(nk) {
  bs <- rcspline.eval(dat$bmi, knots = as.numeric(quantile(dat$bmi, knot_probs_all[[as.character(nk)]])),
                      inclx = TRUE)
  colnames(bs) <- paste0("rcs", seq_len(ncol(bs)))
  d2 <- cbind(dat, bs)
  fit <- coxph(Surv(lenfol, fstat) ~ . - bmi - lenfol - fstat,
               data = d2, x = TRUE)
  data.frame(nk = nk, AIC = as.numeric(extractAIC(fit)[2]))
}))
best_nk <- aic_tab$nk[which.min(aic_tab$AIC)]
cat("best nk:", best_nk, "\n")
ggplot(aic_tab, aes(nk, AIC)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, colour = "#2166AC") +
  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "#2166AC") +
  geom_point(data = aic_tab[which.min(aic_tab$AIC), ], size = 5,
             shape = 21, fill = "#B2182B", colour = "black", stroke = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 3:6) +
  labs(x = "Knot count (nk)", y = "AIC") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

## Hmisc's default knot placement per nk — pass explicit knots everywhere
## so the single reference value and the curve share the same basis
knot_probs <- list(`3` = c(.10, .50, .90), `4` = c(.05, .35, .65, .95),
                   `5` = c(.05, .275, .50, .725, .95),
                   `6` = c(.05, .23, .41, .59, .77, .95))
knots_loc <- as.numeric(quantile(dat$bmi, knot_probs[[as.character(best_nk)]]))

## build the spline basis once with clean names, used by fit and curve alike
basis <- rcspline.eval(dat$bmi, knots = knots_loc, inclx = TRUE)
kn <- paste0("rcs", seq_len(ncol(basis)))
colnames(basis) <- kn
d2 <- cbind(dat, basis)
fit <- coxph(Surv(lenfol, fstat) ~ rcs1 + rcs2 + rcs3 + gender,
             data = d2, x = TRUE)

## HR(v) vs reference 25: beta' (rcs(v) - rcs(25)) with variance from vcov
beta <- coef(fit)[kn]
V <- vcov(fit)[kn, kn]
ref <- 25
## never extrapolate past the observed covariate range (the rcs tail beyond
## the boundary knot explodes) — trim to the central 99% of the data
v_lo <- as.numeric(quantile(dat$bmi, 0.01))
v_hi <- as.numeric(quantile(dat$bmi, 0.99))
v_seq <- seq(v_lo, v_hi, by = 0.25)
b_seq <- rcspline.eval(v_seq, knots = knots_loc, inclx = TRUE)
colnames(b_seq) <- kn
b_ref <- rcspline.eval(ref, knots = knots_loc, inclx = TRUE)
colnames(b_ref) <- kn
dlo <- b_seq - b_ref[rep(1, nrow(b_seq)), , drop = FALSE]
loghr <- as.numeric(dlo %*% beta)
## CI of the contrast vs the reference: (b(v) - b(ref))' V (b(v) - b(ref))
se <- sqrt(diag(dlo %*% V %*% t(dlo)))
hr_df <- data.frame(bmi = v_seq, hr = exp(loghr),
                    lo = exp(loghr - 1.96 * se), hi = exp(loghr + 1.96 * se))

ggplot(hr_df, aes(bmi, hr)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey45") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 25, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey55") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = "#B2182B", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(colour = "#B2182B", linewidth = 1.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 25, y = 1.02, label = "reference (HR = 1)",
           size = 3, colour = "grey35", hjust = 0, vjust = -0.4) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20)) +
  labs(x = "BMI (kg/m2)", y = "Smoothed hazard ratio (95% CI, log scale)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")

make_tri <- function(i, j, upper) {
  x0 <- j - 0.5; y0 <- i - 0.5
  if (upper) data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 0, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 1, 1))   # upper-left triangle
  else data.frame(x = x0 + c(0, 1, 1), y = y0 + c(0, 0, 1))         # lower-right triangle
}

  rbind(cbind(make_tri(i, j, TRUE),  value =  amp[i, j], id = k, tri = "up",   gi = i, cj = j),
        cbind(make_tri(i, j, FALSE), value = -del[i, j], id = k, tri = "dn",   gi = i, cj = j))
}))

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors <- list(Cluster = c(C1 = "#B31E22", C2 = "#529B40", C3 = "#020105"))
ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         annotation_legend = FALSE,          # legends crowd out the body otherwise
         show_colnames = FALSE,              # 30 sample names would overprint
         cutree_cols = 3,
         legend_breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
         legend_labels = c("mRNA\ndown-regulation", "mRNA\nno-change", "mRNA\nup-regulation"),
         fontsize_row = 8)

genes_p <- paste0("m6A", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))
grades <- c("G2", "G3", "G4")
samples <- paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:60))
grade_v <- factor(rep(grades, each = 20), levels = grades)

expr_p <- matrix(rnorm(12 * 60, sd = 0.8), 12, 60, dimnames = list(genes_p, samples))
expr_p[1:4, grade_v == "G3"] <- expr_p[1:4, grade_v == "G3"] + 0.9
expr_p[1:4, grade_v == "G4"] <- expr_p[1:4, grade_v == "G4"] + 1.6
expr_p[5:8, grade_v == "G4"] <- expr_p[5:8, grade_v == "G4"] - 1.2

## one Kruskal-Wallis per gene, BH-adjusted (the reference's cross_subtype_compr)
p_kw <- apply(expr_p, 1, function(x) kruskal.test(x ~ grade_v)$p.value)
p_adj <- p.adjust(p_kw, method = "BH")

z_mat <- t(scale(t(expr_p)))
p_cut <- cut(p_adj, breaks = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
             labels = c("P < 0.001", "P < 0.01", "P < 0.05", "n.s."))
p_col <- c("P < 0.001" = "#B2182B", "P < 0.01" = "#EF8A62",
           "P < 0.05" = "#FDDBC7", "n.s." = "grey90")
## per-GENE p values go as a row annotation on the right (one p per gene,
## like the reference's extra p column)
row_ha_p <- rowAnnotation(`KW P (BH)` = factor(p_cut, levels = names(p_col)),
  col = list(`KW P (BH)` = p_col),
  annotation_name_side = "bottom")

grade_col <- c(G2 = "#445EAD", G3 = "#EABF00", G4 = "#B2182B")
ha_col <- HeatmapAnnotation(Grade = grade_v, col = list(Grade = grade_col),
                            show_legend = FALSE)

Heatmap(z_mat, name = "Expression (z)",
        top_annotation = ha_col, right_annotation = row_ha_p,
        col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")),
        cluster_columns = FALSE,
        column_split = grade_v, column_gap = unit(1.5, "mm"),
        row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9),
        show_column_names = FALSE, border = TRUE)

set.seed(3110)
subtypes <- c("LumA", "LumB", "Basal")
n_per <- 20
genes <- paste0("PAM50_", sprintf("%02d", 1:50))
n_samp <- length(subtypes) * n_per
sub_lab <- factor(rep(subtypes, each = n_per), levels = subtypes)
base <- matrix(rnorm(50 * n_samp, sd = 0.6), 50, n_samp,
               dimnames = list(genes, paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_samp))))
sig_blocks <- list(
  LumA  = list(up = 1:10,  dn = NULL,  eff = 1.1),
  LumB  = list(up = 11:20, dn = NULL,  eff = 1.2),
  Basal = list(up = 21:30, dn = 31:40, eff = 1.3))
for (st in subtypes) {
  idx <- which(sub_lab == st)
  base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$up, idx] + sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
  if (!is.null(sig_blocks[[st]]$dn))
    base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] <- base[sig_blocks[[st]]$dn, idx] - sig_blocks[[st]]$eff
}
## proliferation genes: high in LumB only
base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] <- base[41:50, sub_lab == "LumB"] + 1.2

## nearest-centroid classification from a training split (SSP stand-in)
train <- c(TRUE, FALSE)[rep(1:2, length.out = n_samp)]
cent <- sapply(subtypes, function(st) rowMeans(base[, train & sub_lab == st]))
pred <- apply(base[, !train], 2, function(x) {
  corrs <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(cent)), function(k) cor(x, cent[, k]))
  subtypes[which.max(corrs)] })
pred <- factor(pred, levels = subtypes)
cat("held-out accuracy:", round(mean(pred == sub_lab[!train]), 2), "\n")

sig_scores <- rbind(
  `AR score`  = colMeans(base[21:30, ]) - colMeans(base[31:40, ]),  # Basal-high
  `Prolif score` = colMeans(base[41:50, ]))                          # LumB-high
pheno <- ifelse(sig_scores["AR score", ] > 0, "AR-high", "AR-low")

## mean-centre each gene (no scaling, the reference's fold-difference scale) and clip
mat <- t(scale(t(base), center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
mat[mat > 4] <- 4; mat[mat < -4] <- -4
ord <- order(pred)
pred_o <- pred[ord]; mat_o <- mat[, ord]
pheno_o <- factor(pheno[ord], levels = c("AR-low", "AR-high"))
ar_o <- sig_scores["AR score", ord]; pro_o <- sig_scores["Prolif score", ord]

col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#170B88", "#FFFFFF", "#D23C30"))
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Subtype = pred_o,

  `Prolif score` = anno_lines(pro_o, border = FALSE),
  Phenotype = pheno_o,
  gap = unit(2.5, "mm"),

logfc_r[7:12, ] <- logfc_r[7:12, ] - 1.8    # down-regulated block
## explicit P-value design: strong bands significant, weak genes mostly not

                                       runif(24 * 8, 0.06, 0.9))

      labels = c("< -2", "-2 - -1", "-1 - 1", "1 - 2", "> 2")))

set.seed(52352)
cats <- c("High-mannose", "Hybrid", "Complex tri-antennary",
          "Complex bi-antennary", "Sialylated", "Fucosylated")
n_mid <- 60
mid_cat <- factor(sample(cats, n_mid, TRUE, c(.18, .12, .2, .22, .16, .12)))
mids <- sprintf("G%02d", seq_len(n_mid))
tgts <- sprintf("P%02d", seq_len(40))
## each glycoprotein takes 1-3 glycosides (first-come, glycosides run out)
edges <- data.frame()
used <- logical(n_mid)
for (t in seq_along(tgts)) {
  k <- sample(1:3, 1, TRUE, c(.4, .4, .2))
  cand <- which(!used)
  if (!length(cand)) break
  k <- min(k, length(cand))
  pick <- sample(cand, k)
  used[pick] <- TRUE
  edges <- rbind(edges, data.frame(mid = mids[pick], tgt = tgts[t]))
}
edges$cat <- mid_cat[match(edges$mid, mids)]
cat("glycosides:", n_mid, " glycoproteins with edges:", length(unique(edges$tgt)), "\n")

n_used <- length(unique(edges$tgt))
## (1) mid ring: category-grouped angular slots
o <- order(mid_cat)
pos_mid <- data.frame(mid = mids[o], cat = mid_cat[o],
                      th = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_mid + 1)[-(n_mid + 1)])
## (2) target ring: sorted by mean glycoside angle, spaced evenly
tgt_mean <- tapply(pos_mid$th[match(edges$mid, pos_mid$mid)], edges$tgt, mean)
tgt_order <- names(sort(tgt_mean))
pos_tgt <- data.frame(tgt = tgt_order,
                      th = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_used + 1)[-(n_used + 1)])
## outer arcs: each category's block span, padded
arcs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cats, function(cc) {
  th <- pos_mid$th[pos_mid$cat == cc]
  if (!length(th)) return(NULL)
  pad <- 2 * pi / (n_mid + n_used) * 0.4
  data.frame(cat = cc, from = min(th) - pad, to = max(th) + pad)
}))
pal <- setNames(c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442",
                  "#0072B2", "#CC79A7"), cats)

arc_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(arcs)), function(i) {
  th <- seq(arcs$from[i], arcs$to[i], length.out = 80)
  data.frame(x = 1.02 * cos(th), y = 1.02 * sin(th), grp = i, cat = arcs$cat[i])
}))
mid_xy <- data.frame(x = cos(pos_mid$th), y = sin(pos_mid$th),
                     mid = pos_mid$mid, cat = pos_mid$cat)
tgt_xy <- data.frame(x = 0.6 * cos(pos_tgt$th), y = 0.6 * sin(pos_tgt$th),
                     tgt = pos_tgt$tgt,
                     w = 2 * pi / n_used * 0.55)
tgt_xy$cat <- edges$cat[match(tgt_xy$tgt, edges$tgt)]
edges2 <- merge(edges, mid_xy[, c("mid", "x", "y")], by = "mid")
names(edges2)[names(edges2) %in% c("x", "y")] <- c("x_m", "y_m")
edges2 <- merge(edges2, tgt_xy[, c("tgt", "x", "y")], by = "tgt")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ggplot2)})
set.seed(52335)
df.patients <- data.frame(
  Age = sample(30:78, 250, TRUE),
  Sex = sample(c("Male", "Female"), 250, TRUE, prob = c(0.70, 0.30)))
df.patients$Group <- "CASE"
df.patients$ID <- paste0("CASE", seq_len(250))
df.patients$QoL <- 55 - 0.25 * (df.patients$Age - 30) + rnorm(250, 0, 9)

df.population <- data.frame(
  Age = sample(18:80, 1000, TRUE),
  Sex = sample(c("Male", "Female"), 1000, TRUE, prob = c(0.5, 0.5)))
df.population$Group <- "CONTROL"
df.population$ID <- paste0("CONTROL", seq_len(1000))
df.population$QoL <- 60 - 0.25 * (df.population$Age - 30) + rnorm(1000, 0, 9)

mydata <- rbind(df.patients, df.population)
mydata$GroupL <- mydata$Group == "CASE"
all_case <- which(mydata$Group == "CASE")     # full case cohort
all_ctrl <- which(mydata$Group == "CONTROL")  # full control cohort

## logistic propensity score
ps_mod <- glm(GroupL ~ Age + Sex, data = mydata, family = binomial)
mydata$ps <- predict(ps_mod, type = "response")

## greedy 1:1 nearest matching without replacement (same sex, |dAge| <= 2)
cases <- which(mydata$GroupL)
ctrl <- which(!mydata$GroupL)
used <- logical(length(ctrl))
pair <- data.frame(case = integer(length(cases)), control = integer(length(cases)))
for (k in seq_along(cases)) {
  cand <- ctrl[!used & mydata$Sex[ctrl] == mydata$Sex[cases[k]] &
                 abs(mydata$Age[ctrl] - mydata$Age[cases[k]]) <= 2]
  if (!length(cand)) next
  best <- cand[which.min(abs(mydata$ps[cand] - mydata$ps[cases[k]]))]
  used[which(ctrl == best)] <- TRUE
  pair$case[k] <- cases[k]; pair$control[k] <- best
}
pair <- pair[pair$case > 0, ]
matched_ctrl <- pair$control
cat("matched pairs:", nrow(pair), "of", length(cases), "cases\n")

jitter_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(set = "Before matching", group = mydata$Group, ps = mydata$ps),
  data.frame(set = "After matching", group = c(rep("CASE", nrow(pair)), rep("CONTROL", nrow(pair))),
             ps = c(mydata$ps[pair$case], mydata$ps[matched_ctrl])))
ggplot(jitter_df, aes(set, ps, colour = group)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.4, width = 0.16, height = 0) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(CASE = "#B2182B", CONTROL = "grey45"), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Before matching", "After matching")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Propensity score (P(case))") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")

## SMD between cases and controls (before: all; after: matched pairs only)
smd <- function(x, a, b) abs(mean(x[a]) - mean(x[b])) / sqrt((var(x[a]) + var(x[b])) / 2)
mydata$Male <- as.numeric(mydata$Sex == "Male")
love <- rbind(
  data.frame(covariate = "Age", stage = "before",
             smd = smd(mydata$Age, all_case, all_ctrl)),
  data.frame(covariate = "Male share", stage = "before",
             smd = smd(mydata$Male, all_case, all_ctrl)),
  data.frame(covariate = "Age", stage = "after",
             smd = smd(mydata$Age, pair$case, matched_ctrl)),
  data.frame(covariate = "Male share", stage = "after",
             smd = smd(mydata$Male, pair$case, matched_ctrl)))
ggplot(love, aes(smd, covariate, colour = stage)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey45") +
  geom_point(size = 3.6) +
  geom_line(aes(group = covariate), linewidth = 0.5, colour = "grey60") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 1.6, label = "0.1 rule of thumb",
           size = 2.9, colour = "grey45", hjust = -0.06) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(before = "#B2182B", after = "#1B7837"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Standardized mean difference", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")

qol_case <- mydata$QoL[all_case]
qol_ctrl_all <- mydata$QoL[all_ctrl]
qol_ctrl_m <- mydata$QoL[matched_ctrl]
eff <- rbind(
  data.frame(set = "All cohorts (crude)",
             diff = mean(qol_case) - mean(qol_ctrl_all),
             se = sqrt(var(qol_case) / length(qol_case) + var(qol_ctrl_all) / length(qol_ctrl_all))),
  data.frame(set = "Matched pairs",
             diff = mean(qol_case) - mean(qol_ctrl_m),
             se = sqrt(var(qol_case) / length(qol_case) + var(qol_ctrl_m) / length(qol_ctrl_m))))
eff$set <- factor(eff$set, levels = c("All cohorts (crude)", "Matched pairs"))
cat("crude difference:", round(eff$diff[1], 2), " matched difference:", round(eff$diff[2], 2),
    " matched Welch p =", format.pval(t.test(qol_case, qol_ctrl_m)$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
ggplot(eff, aes(diff, set)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = diff - 1.96 * se, xmax = diff + 1.96 * se),
                width = 0.12, colour = "grey35") +
  geom_point(size = 3.6, colour = "#B2182B") +
  labs(x = "QoL difference, patients - controls (95% CI)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

set.seed(2026)
n_tum <- 30; n_nor <- 20
path_genes <- paste0("PathGene", sprintf("%02d", 1:20))
base <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 0.3)            # baseline expression per gene
normal_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_nor), function(i) base + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))

tum_shift <- matrix(0, nrow = 20, ncol = n_tum)
tum_shift[1:8, 1:15]    <- 2.2                   # subgroup 1 (T01-T15): genes 1-8 up
tum_shift[17:20, 16:30] <- -2.2                  # subgroup 2 (T16-T30): genes 17-20 down
tum_expr <- sapply(seq_len(n_tum), function(i) base + tum_shift[, i] + rnorm(20, sd = 0.6))
colnames(tum_expr) <- paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_tum))

logdata <- log2(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr) - min(cbind(tum_expr, normal_expr)) + 0.5)
tumordata  <- logdata[, seq_len(n_tum)]
normaldata <- logdata[, (n_tum + 1):(n_tum + n_nor)]

# Three-state coding against the 2.5% / 97.5% normal quantiles, gene by gene
normaldown <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
normalup   <- apply(normaldata, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
status <- tumordata                              # reuse the matrix shell
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tumordata))) {
  row_k <- as.numeric(tumordata[k, ])
  out <- rep(0, length(row_k))
  out[row_k > normalup[k]]   <-  1               # above the 97.5% normal quantile
  out[row_k < normaldown[k]] <- -1               # below the 2.5% normal quantile
  status[k, ] <- out
}

# Ward clustering on genes and samples; cut samples into 3 clusters
hcg <- hclust(dist(status), method = "ward.D")
hcs <- hclust(dist(t(status)), method = "ward.D")
group <- paste0("C", cutree(hcs, 3))

# A dysregulation score per sample (sum of -1/0/1 states), used as annotation
score <- colSums(status)
ann_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(group), Score = score)
p_val <- kruskal.test(score ~ Cluster, data = ann_col)$p.value
score_colname <- sprintf("Pathway score (KW %s)",
                         ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)))
colnames(ann_col)[2] <- score_colname

# Row labels carry the fraction of tumours with the gene UP
pct <- paste0(round(rowSums(status == 1) / ncol(status), 2) * 100, "%")
rownames(status) <- paste0(path_genes, " (", pct, ")")

ann_colors <- list(Cluster = c(C1 = "#B31E22", C2 = "#529B40", C3 = "#020105"))
ann_colors[[score_colname]] <- colorRampPalette(c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"))(64)

pheatmap(status,
         cluster_rows = hcg, cluster_cols = hcs,
         color = c("#283285", "#DEDEDE", "#651430"),   # down / no-change / up
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         annotation_legend = FALSE,          # legends crowd out the body otherwise
         show_colnames = FALSE,              # 30 sample names would overprint
         cutree_cols = 3,
         legend_breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
         legend_labels = c("mRNA\ndown-regulation", "mRNA\nno-change", "mRNA\nup-regulation"),
         fontsize_row = 8)

gene_r <- paste0("MMP", sprintf("%02d", 1:24))
cancer_r <- c("BRCA", "LUAD", "COAD", "STAD", "KIRC", "HNSC", "LUSC", "PRAD")
logfc_r <- matrix(rnorm(24 * 8, sd = 1.5), 24, 8,
                  dimnames = list(gene_r, cancer_r))
logfc_r[1:6, ] <- logfc_r[1:6, ] + 1.8      # up-regulated block
logfc_r[7:12, ] <- logfc_r[7:12, ] - 1.8    # down-regulated block
## explicit P-value design: strong bands significant, weak genes mostly not
p_low <- ifelse(runif(24 * 8) < 0.25, runif(24 * 8, 1e-3, 0.045),
                                       runif(24 * 8, 0.06, 0.9))
pval_r <- ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 2, runif(24 * 8, 1e-8, 1e-3),
          ifelse(abs(logfc_r) > 1, runif(24 * 8, 1e-4, 0.04), p_low))
gene_type <- rep(c("Collagen-binding", "Membrane-type", "Gelatin-binding",
                   "Secreted", "Matrisome", "Other"),
                 each = 4)

## bin into 5 fold-change bands; P >= 0.05 overrides to a 6th (white) band
logfc_cat <- apply(logfc_r, 2, function(x)
  cut(x, breaks = c(-Inf, -2, -1, 1, 2, Inf),
      labels = c("< -2", "-2 - -1", "-1 - 1", "1 - 2", "> 2")))
rownames(logfc_cat) <- gene_r
logfc_cat[pval_r >= 0.05] <- "P >= 0.05"

col_cat <- c("> 2" = "#A80C3A", "1 - 2" = "#ED5E57", "-1 - 1" = "#DDD3D2",
             "-2 - -1" = "#6B9AB7", "< -2" = "#2F5B89", "P >= 0.05" = "white")

cell_fun <- function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
  dark <- logfc_cat[i, j] %in% c("> 2", "1 - 2", "< -2", "-2 - -1")
  val <- logfc_r[i, j]; if (abs(val) < 0.05) val <- 0
  grid::grid.text(sprintf("%.1f", val), x, y,
                  gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8,
                                  col = if (dark) "white" else "black"))
}

  summarise(
    n_risk = ifelse(all(is.na(n.risk)), 0, max(n.risk, na.rm = TRUE)),  # Take the maximum number of people at risk within the interval

  # 4. Added total row (fixed syntax)

  p.val <- 1 - pchisq(sd1$chisq, length(sd1$n) - 1)
  HR <- (sd1$obs[2] / sd1$exp[2]) / (sd1$obs[1] / sd1$exp[1])
  up95 <- exp(log(HR) + qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(1 / sd1$exp[2] + 1 / sd1$exp[1]))
  low95 <- exp(log(HR) - qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(1 / sd1$exp[2] + 1 / sd1$exp[1]))
  if (p.val > 0.05) next
  fit <- survfit(my.surv ~ group)
  svsort <- svdata[order(svdata[, i]), ]
  pl[[i]] <- ggsurvplot(fit, data = data.frame(group = group),
                        conf.int = FALSE, censor = FALSE,
                        palette = c("#D95F02", "#1B9E77"),
                        legend.title = i,
                        legend.labs = c(paste0("high >", round(svsort[fit$n[2], i], 2), " (n=", fit$n[1], ")"),
                                        paste0("low  <=", round(svsort[fit$n[2], i], 2), " (n=", fit$n[2], ")")),
                        pval = paste(ifelse(p.val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", round(p.val, 3))),
                                     paste0("HR = ", round(HR, 2)),
                                     paste0("95% CI: ", round(low95, 2), "-", round(up95, 2)), sep = "\n"))
}
patchwork::wrap_plots(lapply(pl, function(x) x$plot), ncol = 2, guides = "collect")

set.seed(4041)
n_bs <- 200
bs <- data.frame(futime = rexp(n_bs, 0.02), fustat = rbinom(n_bs, 1, 0.8),
                 expression = rnorm(n_bs, 5, 1.3))
bs$expression <- bs$expression - (bs$futime < quantile(bs$futime, 0.42)) * 2.0
sortsv <- bs[order(bs$expression), ]
pvals <- c(); hrs <- c()
for (n in 1:(nrow(sortsv) - 1)) {
  gp <- rep(c("low", "high"), c(n, nrow(sortsv) - n))
  d1 <- survdiff(Surv(futime, fustat) ~ gp, data = sortsv, rho = 0)
  pvals <- c(pvals, pchisq(d1$chisq, length(d1$n) - 1, lower.tail = FALSE))
  hrs <- c(hrs, d1$obs[1] * d1$exp[2] / (d1$obs[2] * d1$exp[1]))
}
fd <- data.frame(Tag = 1:(nrow(sortsv) - 1), HR = hrs, Pvalue = pvals)
best <- which.min(pvals)

ggplot(fd, aes(log2(HR), -log10(Pvalue))) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, aes(fill = Tag), colour = "grey25", size = 2.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#4477AA", "#77AADD", "#FFFFFF", "#EE9988", "#BB4444"),
                       guide = "none") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = log2(hrs[best]), y = -log10(pvals[best]) + 0.6,
           label = "min-P split", size = 3.2, colour = "#BB4444") +
  geom_point(data = fd[best, ], aes(log2(HR), -log10(Pvalue)),
             shape = 21, fill = "#BB4444", colour = "black", size = 3.4) +
  labs(x = "log2 hazard ratio at each split",
       y = "-log10(P), maximally selected log-rank",
       title = "Every split of 200 samples ranked by expression (simulated marker)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

gp_best <- rep(c("low", "high"), c(best, nrow(sortsv) - best))
fit_best <- survfit(Surv(futime, fustat) ~ gp_best, data = sortsv)
gp_med <- ifelse(sortsv$expression > median(sortsv$expression), "high", "low")
fit_med <- survfit(Surv(futime, fustat) ~ gp_med, data = sortsv)
p_best <- ggsurvplot(fit_best, linetype = "strata", conf.int = FALSE,
